Palakkad, Kerala — on India's south-west coast

Kerala lies along the Arabian Sea at the southern tip of India, and Palakkad sits inland at the pass through the Western Ghats. The hospital stands on 65 acres of farm and forest an hour from the nearest city.

Discover the Boundless Potential of Kairali and Ayurveda

With over 10,000 successful Ayurveda and Yoga training programs, we're your trusted partner for authentic, transformative education.

Ayurvedic Training Program

Kairali's Ayurvedic wellness retreat offers a comprehensive Ayurvedic Training Program for health and wellness enthusiasts. With over 10,000 programs conducted, we cater to diverse individuals, including spa and wellness experts, homemakers, industry professionals, therapists, doctors, dieticians, managers, students, and Ayurveda enthusiasts.

TRAINING PROGRAMME →
Ayurvedic Workshop

Discover the transformative power of Ayurveda workshop at the healing village. Immerse yourself in ancient wisdom as expert practitioners guide you through the importance of personalized consultations, herbal remedies, rejuvenating therapies, and yoga sessions.

Yoga & Meditation Training Program

Enhance your well-being with authentic Yoga and meditation practices led by expert teachers. Join our training programs for a holistic Ayurvedic journey or indulge in intensive retreats for seasoned practitioners.

YOGA & MEDITATION TRAINING →
Yoga Teacher Training

The Yoga Teacher Training is an immersive course offering comprehensive knowledge of Vedic philosophy and yoga practices. It covers postures, breathing, relaxation, meditation, and diet. Completion leads to certification as an International Yoga Teacher.

KAIRALI — THE AYURVEDIC HEALING VILLAGE · SINCE 1908
About Us

“I found true joy there, and remembered my reason for living.”

LIVE & BREATHE GOODNESS WITH

Kairali Ayurvedic Village – Personalised Wellness Formula

Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s flagship ayurvedic destination, Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala is one-of-its-kind of a holistic space, which heals you internally and externally with traditional and authentic Ayurvedic therapies, treatments and medications along with Yoga and Meditation. A certified model of a wellness retreat, the healing village is implanted at the foot of Nilgiri and Annamalai ranges (Western Ghats). Set amidst mountains, forests, fertile valley and rivers are the 30 premium villas, which are forever surrounded by the fragrance of Pala trees. In compliance with Vaastu Shastra, the villas add on to the restorative and curative ambience. The Ayurvedic Healing Village also boasts of Red Oxide flooring, a rare Valambari Conch shell and a gentle stream flowing around every villa. Yoga, Meditation, Astrology, Palmistry, nutrition, therapy, spiritual training and traditional Indian rituals (pujas) are part of the routine at the retreat. The Ayurvedic Healing Village is the epitome of Kairali’s skill in concept hospitality – a perfectly intuitive design born of timeless wisdom. Time spent at this inspiring jungle sanctuary will leave you wondering whether you are experiencing the height of modern holistic luxury, or have travelled far into India’s distant past.

◆
Know more about Kairali Group

A SET OF IDEALS

Our Founder’s Vision

We at Kairali wish to transform you to the optimal way of living.

Kairali’s mission is to spread the use of Ayurveda worldwide, upholding its authentic values to promote health and wellness for all. They see humans and nature as interdependent and believe Ayurveda can bring the body into a natural harmony. Kairali aims to be recognized as pioneers in the field, developing new natural elements to empower individuals and transform lives.

◆
Know more about Kairali Group
Mrs Gita Ramesh

Co- Founder , The Kairali Ayurvedic Group

KAIRALI LEADERSHIP

Meet our Directors with Vision of Healthy World
K.V. RAMESH

Managing Director

As the harbinger of Ayurveda, Mr. K.V. Ramesh, Managing Director and co-founder of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, is the bridge between the four generations who have dedicated their lives in promoting Ayurveda. He is blessed with the legacy of ancient science and is responsible for passing it on to the future generations. His contribution to Ayurveda, the alternative form of medicine, did not simply start from when he first founded the Kairali Ayurvedic Group through a small center in South Delhi. It can be traced to his teenage years when he used to lend a helping hand to his father Dr. K.S.V Vasudevan by mixing Ayurvedic medicine for patients. This not only proved to be an initial learning for him, but during those nascent years he also observed the way Ayurveda helped people. In addition, Mr. Ramesh is also the Director at Sumitomo Mitsui Construction Corporation Ltd.

GITA RAMESH

Joint Managing Director

The heart and soul behind the Kairali Ayurvedic Group since its inception, and wife of Mr. K.V Ramesh, Mrs. Gita Ramesh is the Joint Managing Director. She has been the motivation and spearhead of the Group, and a guiding light too. She brings along her expertise in Ayurveda, making Kairali one of the most successful Ayurveda companies in the world. She maintains an unfaltering commitment to the quality of knowledge, expertise, techniques and treatments used at Kairali’s retreats and spas, for which she has garnered praise and recognition as an industry pioneer.

◆
LinkedIn
K.R. ABHILASH

Director

Following the footsteps of his parent, Mr. K.R. Abhilash is impelled to carry forward the legacy he inherited from his forefathers.Director of Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Mr. Abhilash is responsible for expansion and capturing the best in Ayurveda. In a very short time, he is credited with proliferating success and escalating Kairali’s pharmaceutical, training and franchisee units, and strengthening its core businesses. His visionary and innovative outlook has earned him many accolades so early in his career. He has been successful in establishing Kairali Ayurvedic Treatment Centers in India and around the globe. His expertise includes creating, conceptualizing, and delivering world class health retreat or a hotel, destination or a daycare Ayurvedic center, and services customized to pamper themselves.

◆
LinkedIn
K.R. ABISHEK

Director

Product of the New York Institute of Technology, Mr. K.R.Abishek is the youngest in the family of Ayurvedic practitioners who also has pledged to dedicate his life in the service of Ayurveda. He is the fellow member of the board of directors. He entered the family business equipped with ideas and a great enthusiasm to take the company even further in the world of international hospitality. The face of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s franchise division, he also heads the Training and Panchakarma Institutes in Kerala. With great achievements in expanding Kairali’s pharmaceutical brands and strengthening its core businesses, he has firmly established himself within the team.

◆
LinkedIn

A SET OF IDEALS

Awards and Accolades
We at Kairali wish to transform you to the optimal way of living.

Every year Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village is honored to receive awards and accreditations from esteemed organizations from the health and wellness fraternity. Maintaining our position as the best Ayurvedic spa in Asia, we have always catered to uphold the sanctity of the Ayurvedic principles. And it is because of this principle followed that it has received notable appreciations and certifications like the World Spa Awards, Green Leaf Certification, NABH Certification and many more.

KAIRALI — THE AYURVEDIC HEALING VILLAGE · SINCE 1908
Accreditations
ON THIS PAGE
◆

Nestled in the tranquil surroundings of Palakkad, Kerala, Kairali — The Ayurvedic Healing Village—is more than just a wellness retreat; it is a widely acknowledged emblem of superior Ayurvedic health and complete well-being. The certifications and honors Kairali has received over the years demonstrate its steadfast dedication to providing genuine Ayurvedic therapies and a top-notch wellness experience. Kairali has gained the respect and trust of practitioners, industry leaders, and health enthusiasts all around the world thanks to its heritage based on traditional Ayurvedic teachings.

A Benchmark for Excellence

With its high standards, environmentally friendly operations, and first-rate services, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has established a benchmark in the health and wellness sector. The retreat’s accreditations serve as evidence of its caliber, genuineness, and commitment to conserving the age-old Ayurvedic science.

Globally Recognized Accreditations

Kairali’s accreditations attest to its compliance with global safety and quality standards. Some key certifications include:

Ayurveda and Wellness Industry Accreditation
Kairali is accredited by prestigious Ayurvedic and wellness associations, ensuring its practices align with the authentic methodologies and ethical principles of traditional Ayurveda.
ISO Certification
Kairali’s ISO certification highlights its commitment to maintaining world-class standards in operational efficiency, hygiene, and customer service.
Green Leaf Certification
Awarded by the Kerala Tourism Department, this certification recognizes Kairali for its excellence in Ayurvedic treatments and eco-friendly practices, underscoring its role as a model Ayurvedic retreat.
Wellness and Hospitality Awards
Kairali has received numerous accolades for its exceptional hospitality, luxurious accommodations, and wellness programs, making it a preferred destination for holistic healing.
Commitment to Sustainability

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is renowned for its environmentally friendly methods. The infrastructure of the retreat uses eco-friendly materials and energy-saving technologies in a way that respects the environment. Kairali has received recognition for its environmental stewardship and its contribution to responsible tourism as a result of these efforts.

Trusted by Clients and Practitioners Worldwide

In addition to enhancing Kairali’s reputation, the accreditations and accolades provide visitors with trust. Kairali is renowned for its unmatched quality and authenticity, making it a trusted choice for wellness enthusiasts, Ayurvedic practitioners, and international tourists.

Why Accreditations Matter?

Kairali’s accreditations reflect its commitment to:

Authenticity: Providing therapies based on traditional Ayurvedic principles.
Quality: Following worldwide standards in all aspects of service.
Safety: Ensuring hygiene and individualized care.
Sustainability: Promoting eco-friendly practices and preserving Ayurvedic traditions.
Conclusion

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s accolades and accreditations attest to its superiority in Ayurvedic treatment and well-being. These accomplishments demonstrate the retreat’s commitment to offering genuine, life-changing, and long-lasting wellness experiences. By selecting Kairali, visitors identify with a well-known, international brand that prioritizes innovation, quality, and tradition. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, enter a world of recognized excellence and holistic health, where each accreditation is a pledge of well-being, trust, and care.

Advanced Ayurveda Lifestyle Consultant & Therapist Training
AYURVEDA TRAINING COURSE · AALCT-HV · 20 DAYS
Advanced Ayurveda Lifestyle Consultant & Therapist Training

Kairali's practitioner certification: twenty residential days covering the principles of Ayurveda, Panchakarma and eight classical therapies, Ayurvedic dietetics, Prakriti analysis, patient examination and wellness consultation — closing with theory and practical examinations. Graduates receive a practitioner certificate, and outstanding candidates may be considered for Ayurvedic Wellness Consultant roles at Kairali's centres.

Plan your Ayurveda training

Tell us about your background and the course you are considering. We can discuss the training options with you.

ENQUIRE ABOUT AYURVEDA TRAINING
PROCESS
FEATURES
COURSES
FAQS
RELATED
THE PROGRAMME
Process Involved In the Consultant & Therapist Training

Twenty days in four movements: foundations and Abhyangam; the classical therapies one by one; Panchakarma, medicines and dietetics; consultation practice, professional etiquette and examinations.

01

Days 1–5 — Foundations and Abhyangam: introduction, history and branches; Panchamahabhuta, Tridosha, Saptadhatu, Agni and Ama; health and disease; Abhyangam learnt from head and neck to the full body; Shirodhara and Nasyam in theory and practice.

02

Days 6–10 — Therapies in depth: Dhatu, Mala, Agni and Ama and the classification of disease; Dinacharya and Ritucharya; human anatomy and physiology; Podikizhi, Udwarthanam, Udhgarshanam and Kativasti; Roga and Rogi Pareeksha; Prakriti definition, analysis questionnaire and body-constitution analysis.

03

Days 11–15 — Dietetics, medicines and Panchakarma: Ahara and Vihara, Dravyaguna and the actions of substances (Guna, Virya, Vipaka, Prabhava); classical and proprietary medicines with a products demonstration; Snehanam and Swedanam, Poorva and Pashchat Karma, Vamanam, Virechanam, Nasyam, Vasti and Raktamoksha with their precautions and contraindications; Njavara Kizhi and Elakizhi prepared and applied.

04

Days 16–19 — Consultation and practice: Nadee Pareeksha and vital readings; Ayurvedic wellness consultation, body-constitution analysis and programme development with case-file preparation; complete revision of theory and practical; therapy etiquette, treatment-room and tray preparation, steam-generator and pharmacy operations, statutory requirements and the regulatory bodies of Ayurveda.

05

Day 20 — Examinations: an objective theory paper and a practical examination, then the concluding session and certification.

Features of the program
◆
Format: eighty hours over twenty days — theory and practical every day — with examinations at the end.
◆
Who it suits: people from the healthcare and wellness sector, lifestyle consultants and therapists who want a recognised practitioner certificate.
◆
After the course: successful candidates may take part in projects and hands-on work at Kairali's domestic and international centres; outstanding candidates may be considered for Ayurvedic Wellness Consultant roles.
◆
Stay: twenty nights in the hospital's villas, charged per night under the training tariff — Deluxe Villa ₹18,410 single / ₹30,530 double ($263 / $436; €230 / €382).
Learning outcomes
◆
Eight therapies: perform Abhyangam, Shirodhara, Nasyam, Podikizhi, Udwarthanam, Kativasti, Njavara Kizhi and Elakizhi to the hospital's standard.
◆
Consultation: examine a patient (Roga and Rogi Pareeksha, Nadee Pareeksha), analyse body constitution and develop a programme with a case file.
◆
Panchakarma: explain the two aspects of Panchakarma, its five procedures and their precautions.
◆
Dietetics and medicines: apply Dravyaguna and Ahara–Vihara principles and know the classical and proprietary preparations.
◆
Professional practice: run a treatment room to the hospital's etiquette and understand the statutory framework of Ayurveda.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village believes that true healing begins with purity, balance, and mindfulness. As part of our commitment to holistic wellness, our retreat is completely alcohol-free and offers a clean and relaxing environment in accordance with the principles of Ayurveda.

Why an Alcohol Free retreat?

Ayurveda, the ancient science of life, emphasizes that what we consume directly affects our physical, mental, and emotional well-being. Alcohol is known to:

Disrupting the body’s detoxification processes
Weakening the digestive fire (Agni) and thereby causing imbalances
To cloud mental clarity, promote fatigue and emotional instability
Impairing the body’s ability to absorb the healing effects of Ayurvedic therapies and herbal applications

By abstaining from alcohol during your stay, your body and mind can experience deep rejuvenation and transformation.

A place for true healing and detoxification

Our resort offers a caring environment where guests can fully focus on their wellness journey. Whether you’re coming for a Panchakarma detox, stress relief, weight loss, or simply to relax, a clean, alcohol-free environment ensures your body receives the best possible regenerative benefits.

Holistic living in Kairali

More than just an alcohol-free zone, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is also a:

Non-smoking area to ensure clean air and a toxic-free atmosphere
Caffeine-free retreat to promote natural energy and mental clarity
Organic vegetarian retreat to support optimal health and digestion
Experience Ayurveda in its purest form

Kairali invites you to live an Ayurvedic lifestyle that benefits your body, mind, and soul. Free yourself from toxins, reset your system, and discover the true power of holistic healing in a tranquil, alcohol-free environment.

Ananda Lahari Yoga & Ayurveda Retreat
PAST RETREAT
Ananda Lahari Yoga and Ayurveda Retreat

This is a past retreat. The description below is retained from the original retreat page. There are no current dates or bookings for this retreat.

◆
Past Retreats
HISTORICAL RETREAT DESCRIPTION
Ananda Lahari Retreat Ananda – Happiness Lahari – Wave

In our everyday lives, we encounter and handle numerous situations, whether they involve family, work, relationships, or other obligations. This retreat aims to prepare you to handle life and its circumstances with joy and ease.

By utilizing Ayurveda and the teachings and insights of Yoga, you will achieve harmony and equilibrium between your body and mind, as well as with those around you and your surroundings. These time-honored traditions present ways to improve our contemporary way of living and give you a structure to examine existence and experience life to its maximum potential.

The Ananda Lahari Retreat provides a chance to embark on a genuine and thrilling spiritual adventure in India, fostering a realm abundant with love, light, and joy.

What is the Ananda Lahari Retreat?

The Ananda Lahari Retreat offers a journey to well-being via healing, self-exploration, and transformation of both mind and body. It is ideal for yoga practitioners and instructors at any level seeking to enhance their practice and uncover profound health, wellness, and a connection to their authentic self.

Our authentic complete immersion program lasts 7 days at the stunning Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Kerala. Throughout a week, you will immerse yourself in the complete experience of yogic living: engaging in sunrise meditations and asana practice, participating in discussions on Vedanta and philosophy, practicing yoga nidra, exploring Sanskrit and tantra rituals, along with following an Ayurvedic diet and enjoying daily massages and treatments, you will thoroughly incorporate the yogic lifestyle into your life.

This personal journey will allow you to delve into historical wisdom and traditions and subsequently weave their usage into your everyday life. It is probably one of the most impactful experiences for the future health and wellness of your mind, body, and spirit. You will enhance your health and well-being while also enriching your self-awareness and understanding of the universe, building lifelong connections and friendships, and creating numerous lasting memories.

Where will this Journey Take Me?

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village was selected among the top 50 wellness destinations of the world by National Geographic Traveller. The village is situated in Palakkad, just a few kilometres from the world’s biggest mountain pass between Kerala and Tamil Nadu. This award-winning spa and retreat facility is nestled in a luscious landscape of 600 coconut palms.

Time spent at this unique paradise will allow you to experience the authentic healing practices of ancient India while relaxing in the lap of modern holistic luxury.

What Will I Experience?

The term ‘Ayur’ translates to life, while ‘Veda’ refers to knowledge, thus, Ayurveda signifies ‘knowledge of the science of living’.

You will undergo a comprehensive program of genuine Ayurvedic treatments designed to achieve harmony among body, mind, and spirit. A group of Ayurvedic physicians will assess your health and determine the optimal rejuvenation plan for the week. It might be Abhyangam massages (where two therapists rhythmically and simultaneously apply herbal oils) or other targeted therapies like dhaara to achieve optimal wellness and restore equilibrium in you.

Our sessions on Ayurveda and the visit to Kairali’s Ayurvedic Product Factory will give you a basis for understanding the use of Ayurveda in contemporary life.

Yoga & Meditation

The term Yoga comes from the Sanskrit word yuj, signifying “to join” or “to unite.” It is the harmony of the body, mind, and spirit, as well as the link between the personal self and awareness.

Kairali is an ideal destination for those looking to explore the depths of yoga, its historical context, foundational principles, and relevance in contemporary life. The retreat will include workshops for all levels, encompassing yoga philosophy, vedanta, sanskrit, tantra, and meditation. By consciously incorporating these principles into our lives, we can adopt a unified strategy to create a lifestyle that fosters genuine health and longevity.

The philosophy and wisdom of yoga, which is over 5,000 years old, is extensive. In our workshops, we will assist you in understanding ancient philosophies and incorporating them into your daily life.

Broaden your understanding of Vedanta, yogic philosophy, kundalini, meditation, Sanskrit, and tantra.

Every workshop will involve a free discussion and examination of ideas, along with actionable advice for applying them in your daily life, allowing you to incorporate yoga more completely into your routine.

What will you indulge in during the day?

A typical day would involve:

◆
Sunrise meditation.
◆
Dina Chayra – Morning Ayurvedic rituals cultivate well-being and prepare for the day.
◆
Patanjali Smaran –A guided practice of expressing gratitude to the forefathers of the Yoga tradition in the form of a yagna.
◆
A Vinyasa yoga flow designed to move every muscle in the body.
◆
Yogic breakfast.
◆
Ayurvedic consultation with massage or treatment, i.e., an abhyanga massage designed to detoxify the body. The doctors decide on the oils to be used. They are always medicinal oils extracted from herbs and have immense health benefits.
◆
Yogic lunch
◆
Self Time
◆
A workshop on the authentic texts of Yoga
◆
Rejuv Yoga – A signature yoga flow aimed at rejuvenating the nadis.
◆
Dusk Prayer
◆
Group Dinner
◆
Lunar Meditation / Yoga Nidra – The art of yogic sleep

This personal journey will allow you to delve into historical wisdom and traditions and subsequently weave their usage into your everyday life. It is probably one of the most impactful experiences for the future health and wellness of your mind, body, and spirit. You will enhance your health and well-being while also enriching your self-awareness and understanding of the universe, building lifelong connections and friendships, and creating numerous lasting memories.

Where will this Journey Take Me?

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village was selected among the top 50 wellness destinations of the world by National Geographic Traveller. The village is situated in Palakkad, just a few kilometres from the world’s biggest mountain pass between Kerala and Tamil Nadu. This award-winning spa and retreat facility is nestled in a luscious landscape of 600 coconut palms.

Time spent at this unique paradise will allow you to experience the authentic healing practices of ancient India while relaxing in the lap of modern holistic luxury.

What Will I Experience?

The term ‘Ayur’ translates to life, while ‘Veda’ refers to knowledge, thus, Ayurveda signifies ‘knowledge of the science of living’.

You will undergo a comprehensive program of genuine Ayurvedic treatments designed to achieve harmony among body, mind, and spirit. A group of Ayurvedic physicians will assess your health and determine the optimal rejuvenation plan for the week. It might be Abhyangam massages (where two therapists rhythmically and simultaneously apply herbal oils) or other targeted therapies like dhaara to achieve optimal wellness and restore equilibrium in you.

Our sessions on Ayurveda and the visit to Kairali’s Ayurvedic Product Factory will give you a basis for understanding the use of Ayurveda in contemporary life.

Yoga & Meditation

The term Yoga comes from the Sanskrit word yuj, signifying “to join” or “to unite.” It is the harmony of the body, mind, and spirit, as well as the link between the personal self and awareness.

Kairali is an ideal destination for those looking to explore the depths of yoga, its historical context, foundational principles, and relevance in contemporary life. The retreat will include workshops for all levels, encompassing yoga philosophy, vedanta, sanskrit, tantra, and meditation. By consciously incorporating these principles into our lives, we can adopt a unified strategy to create a lifestyle that fosters genuine health and longevity.

The philosophy and wisdom of yoga, which is over 5,000 years old, is extensive. In our workshops, we will assist you in understanding ancient philosophies and incorporating them into your daily life.

Broaden your understanding of Vedanta, yogic philosophy, kundalini, meditation, Sanskrit, and tantra.

Every workshop will involve a free discussion and examination of ideas, along with actionable advice for applying them in your daily life, allowing you to incorporate yoga more completely into your routine.

What will you indulge in during the day?

A typical day would involve:

◆
Sunrise meditation.
◆
Dina Chayra – Morning Ayurvedic rituals cultivate well-being and prepare for the day.
◆
Patanjali Smaran –A guided practice of expressing gratitude to the forefathers of the Yoga tradition in the form of a yagna.
◆
A Vinyasa yoga flow designed to move every muscle in the body.
◆
Yogic breakfast.
◆
Ayurvedic consultation with massage or treatment, i.e., an abhyanga massage designed to detoxify the body. The doctors decide on the oils to be used. They are always medicinal oils extracted from herbs and have immense health benefits.
◆
Yogic lunch
◆
Self Time
◆
A workshop on the authentic texts of Yoga
◆
Rejuv Yoga – A signature yoga flow aimed at rejuvenating the nadis.
◆
Dusk Prayer
◆
Group Dinner
◆
Lunar Meditation / Yoga Nidra – The art of yogic sleep

About

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a model for holistic and sustainable living, not just a wellness resort. This eco-friendly retreat’s Animal Husbandry Program is one of its distinctive features; it is a prime example of a coexisting interaction between people, animals, and the environment. The ethical and sustainable treatment of animals is emphasized in this project, which is in line with Ayurveda’s philosophy of living in harmony with nature.

History of Animal Husbandry

According to Ayurveda, animals are essential to the ecosystem and help to keep the environment in balance. This idea is incorporated into Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village by encouraging a humane and environmentally friendly method of animal husbandry. The initiative helps the local ecology in addition to promoting wellness and agricultural practices at the retreat. Care, respect, and sustainability are the cornerstones of the retreat’s animal husbandry methods. The retreat’s overall sustainability is enhanced while the animals’ well-being is guaranteed by the loving care and natural, healthy surroundings they get.

A Unique Learning Opportunity for Guests

Visitors to Kairali- The Ayurvedic Healing Village can observe how animal husbandry is incorporated into the healing ecosystem of the retreat. Insights into how these techniques enhance the overall sustainability and caliber of the retreat’s activities are provided through interactive seminars and guided tours. It’s an opportunity to discover how health, agriculture, and the environment can all benefit from ethical animal care.

A Commitment to Sustainability and Wellness

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s Animal Husbandry Program is a brilliant representation of how conventional knowledge may coexist with contemporary sustainable techniques. Kairali sets the standard for ethical and environmentally conscious living by carefully caring for animals and incorporating their contributions into the retreat’s wellness ecology.

VISION AND MISSION
Vision and Mission
CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY (CSR)
Social, Cultural & Environmental Commitment
AWARDS & ACCREDITATIONS
Awards & Accreditations
Accreditations

Up until recently, Ayurveda—The Science of Life—was hidden away in our ancient texts. Except for the “remedies” that our grandmothers frequently used and which performed miracles, most people had nearly forgotten its profound benefits. With the exception of a few individuals who have worked tirelessly to preserve the discipline and have, to some degree, been successful in establishing Ayurveda as an alternative form of treatment, many of us were unaware that it was just “Ayurveda.”

For its efforts in this regard, The Kairali Ayurvedic Group deserves recognition. The Group offers you the concept of “Arogya Kendra” to further advance the science, which is certain to rekindle the public’s long-lost interest in Ayurveda. The initiative’s main objective is to spread yoga and Ayurveda throughout the nation and improve and make the earth a healthier place to live.

For Ayurvedic practitioners who are willing to start an Arogya Kendra in their city, this is a once-in-a-lifetime chance. You will be able to combine many Ayurvedic disciplines under the notion, including medications, products, therapies, treatments, and procedures. People in your cities will be able to choose Ayurveda and avoid the inconvenience of traveling to different locations thanks to this.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group provides doctors with full support so that the entire exercise is error-free and we can resuscitate our ancient science. Working with Kairali, a well-known brand in the wellness sector, can only increase your credibility. Indeed, you will have the opportunity to work for a cause—the advancement of our ancient science, which sorely needs to take the lead. Participate in the effort to make Ayurveda available to everyone.

VISION AND MISSION
Vision and Mission
CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY (CSR)
Social, Cultural & Environmental Commitment
AWARDS & ACCREDITATIONS
Awards & Accreditations
Accreditations

It is said that Ayurveda is not merely a system, but a lifestyle in itself. And let us not forget its growing influence on modern day medicine practitioners, who are seemingly more open to embracing Ayurveda into their lives and promoting it. Merged with almost no side effects, Ayurveda can revolutionize the way we see healthcare sector.

To lend a hand in promoting and propagating the revolution, Kairali has commenced a unique endeavour ‘Arogya Shala’. It is a concept via which the outreach of Ayurvedic products can be proliferated in each and every corner of the world. This encapsulates raising awareness about Ayurveda and its benefits among masses by exposing them to Ayurvedic products.

A unique concept in itself, at the core of Arogya Shala is the propagation of the use of Ayurvedic products throughout the country. To be able to successfully establish the concept, Kairali will partner with existing and practicing Ayurvedic doctors in the country. The doctors will be facilitated with the Kairali Ayurvedic products and all the information required to be sold among their patients. This will not only help Kairali succeed in its objective, but will also make the doctors independent.

Extensively beneficial for the private players, under the Arogya Shala scheme, Kairali will provide the doctors with adequate funds to own, lead, and manage a small scale business operation. They will be completely cooperated and will be helped in setting up an agency along with guidance as to how to run a proven and efficient business.

A full-proof scheme, where the doctor will not have to bear any losses, the scheme will only add to the expertise of the doctor. Kairali Ayurvedic Group, a well-established name in the field, will support the doctors with its name, and is giving you a chance to re-establish our age old science ‘Ayurveda’.

Ashtanga Yoga & Ayurveda Retreat
PAST RETREAT
Ashtanga Yoga & Ayurveda Retreat

This is a past retreat. The original description, programme and inclusions below are retained as a historical record and are not a current offer. There are no current dates or bookings for this retreat.

◆
Past Retreats
HISTORICAL RETREAT DESCRIPTION
Ashtanga Yoga & Ayurveda Retreat

Yoga and Ayurveda form an ideal blend for cleansing both the body and mind, helping individuals recognize what truly matters in life and what does not. India is the birthplace of yoga and the wellspring of devotional and meditative motivation. Doing yoga in a location where countless yogis have shaped their forms is akin to accessing a profound spiritual source.

During these two weeks, we will concentrate on finding our inner tranquility and recognizing our unique rhythm by becoming aware of our pulse and biorhythms, emotions, dreams, and digestion, while also permitting ourselves to tune into the changing patterns of physiological rhythms, thoughts, and feelings.

The unique culinary offerings and the daily Ayurvedic care cater to the requirements of every specific constitution type. Through calming massages and oil therapies, the senses can unwind from daily routines. The daily Yoga and Meditation session, set in a serene environment, encourages you to take a break, focus inward, and reconnect with your true self.

YOGA SCHEDULE

Beginners as well as advanced students are welcome to join the program. We practice every day. The weekly courses run from Saturday (Meet and Greet) until Friday evening.

The Daily Schedule
◆
07.00 am to 08:00 am – Ashtanga Yoga
◆
08:00 am to 09:00 am – Breakfast
◆
09:30 am to 12:30 pm – Ayurvedic Massage & Treatment (1-hour slot per person)
◆
12.30 pm to 1.30 pm – Lunch
◆
1:30 pm to 5:30 pm – Free time/ Second Ayurvedic massage
◆
6:00 pm to 7:00 pm – Meditation / Pranayama
◆
7:00 pm to 8.00 pm – Dinner

*times are subject to change upon arrival*

Included in the package:

Full use of retreat facilities including swimming pool, gym, library, meditation hall.

Morning classes

The morning Ashtanga Yoga sessions will be led gently. We will concentrate on the breath – we will flow with the breath. Movement and breath resemble a dance, a creative journey, leading us to the essence of our existence where we discover tranquility, liberation, and quietude within ourselves and among all the creations around us.

Afternoon classes

The afternoon lesson is split into two subject areas.

First area: Our emphasis will be on Meditation or being still in quiet. Engaging in silence enhances your capacity for self-reflection, allowing you to observe the thoughts, feelings, and wishes that arise without immediately responding to them. Three times weekly, we will conduct a guided meditation focusing on the Heart Chakra, Solar Plexus Chakra, and Root Chakra.

Second area: Pranayama, the formal practice of breath control, serves as the source of our essential life energy. We will concentrate on practicing pranayama exercises, breathing methods, and routines.

1 Treatment package includes: Daily one ayurvedic massage, abhyangam

2 Treatment package includes: One Abhyangam and one additional Ayurvedic treatment according to doctor’s prescription (i.e., shirodhara, pizhichil, herbal scrub, etc)

KAIRALI — THE AYURVEDIC HEALING VILLAGE · SINCE 1908
Attractions (15 Kms & Below)

Palakkad has evolved as an excellent tourist destination, offering wilderness excursions, cultural tours, ancient sites, and temples. The following places are easily accessible and close to Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village.

ON THIS PAGE
◆
Rock Garden

Padmashree Nekchand Saini, a world-renowned sculptor who also designed India’s first rock garden in Chandigarh, created the Malampuzha Rock Garden. It is a true work of art because the artifacts on display are constructed entirely of waste materials such as granites, stones, broken bangles, melamine dishware, broken tiles, power insulators, and so on. It supports a calm planted garden where you can relax and be captivated by the panoramic magnificence of the park’s surrounding mountain ranges.

Chittur Gurumadam

Chittur Gurumadam, located on the banks of the Sokanasdini River in Thekkegramam near Arikkode, is a memorial to Thunchath Ramanujan Ezhuthachan, the father of the Malayalam language. Ezhuthachan replicated the two major Sanskrit epics, the Ramayana and the Mahabharata, in Malayalam. A Shri chakra, a stylus, wooden slippers, a few antique manuscripts, and some of the idols he adored are displayed here.

Fantasy Park

Fantasy Park, located near Malampuzha Dam in Palakkad, is Kerala’s first amusement park, and it is a fun place for the entire family. There are numerous entertainment alternatives available, including 16D Cine Magic rides, Boomerang Water Ride, Multi Slide, Planetarium, Wave Pool, Para Trooper, Dragon Coaster, Rain Disco, Fanta Tub, Super Splash, Tora Tora, Virtual Waterfall, Pirate Ship, Merry-go-round, and more.

Malampuzha (The Reservoir)

The Malampuzha Reservoir is a popular tourist attraction. It is bordered by lovely gardens, amusement parks, fish-shaped aquariums, and a snake park. Boating, pedal boats, rowing boats, water scooters, motor boats, and fishing are all available for a low cost.

Attractions (25 to 50 Kms)

Although Palakkad is a small town, its development into a significant tourist destination is unsurprising given its rich culture, abundant greenery, and diverse flora and wildlife. There are magnificent and amazing spots near Palakkad that you will not regret visiting because the trip will be worthwhile. Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village provides trips that allow you to discover the magnificent beauty of Kerala.

ON THIS PAGE
◆
Thiruvegappura Sankaranarayana Temple

This ancient 14th-century temple, also known as Moonnumoorthy temple, was built on the banks of Thootha, a tributary of the Bharathapuzha river. The temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva and Narayana. An elegant Koothambalam, or temple theatre, is claimed to have been erected on the structure around the 15th century.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 25 Km

Meenvallam

The Meenvallam waterfalls, which originate at the mouth of the Thuppanadu River, are a hidden treasure in Kerala. This unique combination of mesmerizing beauty and panoramic splendor is a ten-step waterfall where the water drops from about 20 to 25 feet. The upper eight steps of the waterfall are hidden inside a lush forest, while the lower two are open to visitors.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 30 Km

Meenkara

Meenkara is a tourist destination because of the dam built across the Meenkara River, a sub-tributary of Gayathripuzha that eventually merges into the Bharathapuzha River. The grandeur and pure beauty of this dam are a visual feast for spectators. It is an excellent picnic place, with a fish farm and lovely gardens.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 32 Km

Kanjirapuzha Dam & Garden

Surrounded by the enthralling beauty of mountains, dense evergreen forests, and cotton clouds, Kanjirapuzha Dam is an alluring natural dam. The reservoir has a total of three islands within it and is composed of plenty of fish which is a sight to behold. If you are looking for peace amidst the divine mysticism of nature, you must visit this place once in Kerala.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 40 Km

Pothundy

Constructed across the Meenichiladipuzha and Padipuzha rivers, Pothundy Dam is considered to be one of the oldest dams in India. The core wall of this dam is made with a mixture of jaggery and quick lime which makes it unique among others. Pothundy Dam is an ideal destination for those looking for picnics or a one-day trip. You can also visit nearby attractions such as Padagiri, Kilakettara, Nemmara, and Kollengode.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 45 Km

Mangalam Dam

It is a renowned tourist destination and is located across the river Cherukunnath, a branch of the Mangalam River.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 50 Km

Attractions (Above 50 Kms)

Palakkad, with its diverse natural scenery and man-made wonders, has carved its place into the Kerala tourism landscape. It has become one of the most popular destinations for adventure, trekking, and getting close to nature. People from all over the world are drawn to this place. Apart from the sights found inside and near Palakkad’s borders, there are additional fantastic tourist places to visit if you are willing to venture a bit further into the wilderness.

ON THIS PAGE
◆
Nelliampathy

Nelliyampathy, the ‘Queen of Palakkad Hills’, is a lovely place surrounded by wispy clouds and has a charm all its own. The beauty of this location, which is made up of orange plantations and evergreen forests, will captivate you, making it ideal for a relaxing vacation. The area is famed for its tea and coffee plantations, cardamom plantations, waterfalls, and beautiful weather. It is a small but beautiful hill station that is ideal for trekking, Jeep safaris, and bird and animal watching.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 75 Km

Kalamandalam

Kalamandalam, a world-renowned Kathakali training facility, is based near Cheruthuruthy hamlet. Aside from being a renowned Kathakali centre, it also offers training in other performing arts like Mohiniyattam, Koodiyattam, Thullal, and Nangiarkoothu. Training in voice and percussive instruments is also available here. Kalamandalam, founded in 1930 by Malayalam poet Vallathol Narayana Menon, reflects the simplicity, purity, and ethnic environment in which these arts have flourished over generations.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 70 Km

Thrithala

Thrithala, known for its medieval ruins, is of significant archeological significance. Notable cultural monuments are the ruins of a massive mud fort with a deep laterite moat and the Siva temple. The Kattil Madom Temple, a domed edifice composed of granite slabs on the Pattambi-Guruvayoor route, is a Buddhist monument thought to date from the ninth or tenth centuries. The temple most likely represents the transition from Chola to Pandya architecture.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 75 Km

Attappadi (Mountain Valley)

Attappadi is a large mountain valley located near the headwaters of the Bhavani River, below the Western Ghats’ Nilgiri Hills. Its limits extend from Coimbatore district in Tamil Nadu in the east to Karimba, Pottassery, and Mannarghat in the west, and from the Nilgiris in the north to Palghat taluk in the south. These hills are rich in flora and wildlife, and they greet visitors with a sense of freshness and give you complete serenity and joy.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 80 Km

Silent Valley National Park

Silent Valley National Park is Kerala’s second-largest national park, covering a core area of 236.74 square kilometers. The park is one of the last untouched areas of the South-Western Ghats Mountains. The place is completely silent, even without the chirping of cicadas. Road transportation is only available up to Mukkali, which is 24 kilometers from the park, and the remainder of the journey must be completed by foot.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 80 Km

Guruvayur

Guruvayur is regarded as one of Kerala’s most important pilgrimage sites. Sree Krishna Temple is well-known for its curative qualities and attracts an incredible number of pilgrims each year. It is known as the Dwaraka of the South and is notable for its ‘Thulabharam’ offering, in which devotees are weighed against bananas, sugar, jaggery, and coconuts in proportion to their weight. The annual Guruvayur Festival, held in February-March, begins with an elephant race. The festival is unavoidable. Not to mention the Guruvayur Devaswom Elephant Sanctuary, located barely 3 kilometers from the temple and one of the world’s largest elephant sanatoriums, also known as Punnathurkotta.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village:100 Km

Parambikulam Wild Life Sanctuary

Parambikulam Wildlife Sanctuary is a 391-square-kilometre protected area in Chittur Taluk. It is spread throughout Anaimalai Hills and Nelliampathy Hills. The Kerala Parambikulam National Park is covered in bamboo, rosewood, and sandalwood trees, and it is home to a diverse range of animals such as leopards, wild dogs, sloths, crocodiles, civets, tigers, elephants, wild boar, barking deer, spotted deer, monkeys, langurs, porcupines, and macaques.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village:100 Km

KAIRALI — THE AYURVEDIC HEALING VILLAGE · SINCE 1908
Attractions – 10 Kms & Under

Kerala provides a pure and authentic experience with Ayurveda. And this is only the start of a great journey!! Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is located in the beautiful town of Palakkad, which has an unending number of tourist attractions with a cultural, historical, and religious value that would astound any traveler.

ON THIS PAGE
◆
Thiruvalathoor

Thiruvalathoor is known for its ancient temple, which features excellent woodwork and stone sculptures. According to legend, an army of Gods built the temple’s outside wall, but because they were unable to finish it by daylight, they left it unfinished so that humanity would not notice it. Despite continuous human efforts to erect the wall, it remains unfinished.

Thenari

Thenari is a holy shrine located on the Pollachi Road from Palakkad town. The famed Sree Rama temple in Thenari is devoted to Lord Rama, and the natural spring in front of the old temple is revered as sacred as the waters of the holy Ganges. It is claimed that Lord Rama and Sita visited this location during their exile.

Jain Temple of Jainimedu

Jainimedu is a Jain temple located 3 kilometres from Palakkad’s centre. It was built in the 15th century. This temple was built by Jain Leader Inchana Satur and is dedicated to Chandraprabha, a Tirthankar of the Jain religion. This granite marvel of history is 32 feet long and 20 feet wide, with images of the Jain Thirthankaras and Yakshinis. Kumaranasan, a highly regarded Malayalam poet, penned his famous poem Veenapoovu (The Fallen Flower) at a Jain residence near this temple.

Tipu’s Fort

Tipu’s Fort, also known as the Palakkad Fort, stands high in the middle of Palakkad. Hyder Ali, the monarch of the Mysore region, built this fort in 1766, and it is now a protected monument under the Archaeological Survey of India. The fort has an open-air auditorium called “Rappadi” on its vast grounds. Inside, there is a little temple called Anjaneya Swamy Temple, and on the opposite side is a children’s park. It is one of the best-preserved forts in southern India.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 14 Km

Kalpathy Shiva Temple

Kalpathy is one of Kerala’s oldest ‘Brahmin Agraharams’, situated in the heart of the town. The ‘Ratholsavam’ event, which takes place in the middle of November, is well-known in Palakkad.

Kerala provides a pure and authentic experience with Ayurveda. And this is only the start of a great journey!! Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is located in the beautiful town of Palakkad, which has an unending number of tourist attractions with a cultural, historical, and religious value that would astound any traveler.

Thiruvalathoor

Thiruvalathoor is known for its ancient temple, which features excellent woodwork and stone sculptures. According to legend, an army of Gods built the temple’s outside wall, but because they were unable to finish it by daylight, they left it unfinished so that humanity would not notice it. Despite continuous human efforts to erect the wall, it remains unfinished.

Thenari

Thenari is a holy shrine located on the Pollachi Road from Palakkad town. The famed Sree Rama temple in Thenari is devoted to Lord Rama, and the natural spring in front of the old temple is revered as sacred as the waters of the holy Ganges. It is claimed that Lord Rama and Sita visited this location during their exile.

Jain Temple of Jainimedu

Jainimedu is a Jain temple located 3 kilometres from Palakkad’s centre. It was built in the 15th century. This temple was built by Jain Leader Inchana Satur and is dedicated to Chandraprabha, a Tirthankar of the Jain religion. This granite marvel of history is 32 feet long and 20 feet wide, with images of the Jain Thirthankaras and Yakshinis. Kumaranasan, a highly regarded Malayalam poet, penned his famous poem Veenapoovu (The Fallen Flower) at a Jain residence near this temple.

Tipu’s Fort

Tipu’s Fort, also known as the Palakkad Fort, stands high in the middle of Palakkad. Hyder Ali, the monarch of the Mysore region, built this fort in 1766, and it is now a protected monument under the Archaeological Survey of India. The fort has an open-air auditorium called “Rappadi” on its vast grounds. Inside, there is a little temple called Anjaneya Swamy Temple, and on the opposite side is a children’s park. It is one of the best-preserved forts in southern India.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 14 Km

Kalpathy Shiva Temple

Kalpathy is one of Kerala’s oldest ‘Brahmin Agraharams’, situated in the heart of the town. The ‘Ratholsavam’ event, which takes place in the middle of November, is well-known in Palakkad.

Kairali- The Ayurvedic
Healing Village

Ayurveda has long been ingrained in our society. For 5,000 years, this science has been our health ally, and its effects have been more profound than we can imagine. The great quality of Ayurveda and the reason it has endured over the ages is its ability to treat both the ill and the sick. In the modern period, Ayurvedic resorts and retreats are among the many elements that have contributed to the popularity of Ayurveda. If you want to combine hospitality with therapy, an Ayurvedic retreat is your best friend. It gives patients a sense of home and cultivates genuine trust and concern for them.

Have you ever wished to disconnect from the busy city life, spend some time nurturing your inner self, and take good care of your body? Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village might then serve as a second home for you! For over 115 years, the Kairali Ayurvedic Group has been a veritable synonym for Ayurveda. Since then, we have given health the best attention and care possible. Our creative step toward creating a healthier world is the Ayurvedic Healing Village.

Situated at the base of the Nilgiri mountain range in the charming plains of Palakkad, also known as the granary of Kerala, Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village is among the first of its kind in Kerala. The area is peaceful and unspoiled, and it provides a fantastic view of the slopes, forests, streams, and rice fields. Thirty luxurious villas, a mashup of modern and traditional South Indian architecture, are available to welcome you. They are lavish and cozy. Well-designed, tastefully furnished interiors are visually pleasing, but they pale in comparison to the expansive, picturesque exterior view. Natural walks, cobblestone walkways, and landscaped views all contribute to the allure.

The villas are built with consideration for Vastu shastra principles and are roomy and opulent, complementing a sophisticated taste. The first thing you'll notice about this place is how calm and serene it is. The place is a haven for dendrophiles because of the lush vegetation, blooming flowers, tall evergreens that bear fruit, and the aroma that fills the air. Every day, there are yoga classes led by qualified instructors and a particularly created curriculum. It is conveniently accessible by road and is situated close to the town of Palakkad. The overall climate is tropical, with rainier summers than winters and ideal temperatures throughout the year. The weather can be a little breezy on certain days, but regular summer rains are a treat.

Come & Experience The New Look

Unwind, Rejuvenate, and Transform at Kairali
Various Ayurvedic Treatment
Packages in Kerala, India

Choosing the right medication and therapy is essential to recovery. Medicine, like other treatments, is not for everyone. Finding a treatment plan that works for one is challenging, but not impossible. Before deciding on the best course of action, a person must receive a proper diagnosis, have his Tridosha levels measured, and have his Prakriti (physical constitution) evaluated. In addition to being a competent doctor, having access to advanced medical facilities and potent medication formulations is crucial. In an authentic Ayurvedic manner, we carefully select what is best for you here at Kairali -The Ayurvedic Healing Village!

You will be greeted warmly by the staff, which consists of excellent Ayurvedic physicians and non-clinical staff. The treatment programs that are provided as packages are tailored to meet your specific needs. Numerous treatment packages covering categories such as general health, detox, rejuvenation, Panchakarma, weight management, eye care, musculoskeletal issues, and lifestyle diseases are available for children, adults, senior citizens, pregnant women, and women after giving birth. The doctor here will assist you in making the best decision.

Ayurveda has long been ingrained in our society. For 5,000 years, this science has been our health ally, and its effects have been more profound than we can imagine. The great quality of Ayurveda and the reason it has endured over the ages is its ability to treat both the ill and the sick. In the modern period, Ayurvedic resorts and retreats are among the many elements that have contributed to the popularity of Ayurveda. If you want to combine hospitality with therapy, an Ayurvedic retreat is your best friend. It gives patients a sense of home and cultivates genuine trust and concern for them.

Have you ever wished to disconnect from the busy city life, spend some time nurturing your inner self, and take good care of your body? Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village might then serve as a second home for you! For over 115 years, the Kairali Ayurvedic Group has been a veritable synonym for Ayurveda. Since then, we have given health the best attention and care possible. Our creative step toward creating a healthier world is the Ayurvedic Healing Village.

Situated at the base of the Nilgiri mountain range in the charming plains of Palakkad, also known as the granary of Kerala, Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village is among the first of its kind in Kerala. The area is peaceful and unspoiled, and it provides a fantastic view of the slopes, forests, streams, and rice fields. Thirty luxurious villas, a mashup of modern and traditional South Indian architecture, are available to welcome you. They are lavish and cozy. Well-designed, tastefully furnished interiors are visually pleasing, but they pale in comparison to the expansive, picturesque exterior view. Natural walks, cobblestone walkways, and landscaped views all contribute to the allure.

The villas are built with consideration for Vastu shastra principles and are roomy and opulent, complementing a sophisticated taste. The first thing you'll notice about this place is how calm and serene it is. The place is a haven for dendrophiles because of the lush vegetation, blooming flowers, tall evergreens that bear fruit, and the aroma that fills the air. Every day, there are yoga classes led by qualified instructors and a particularly created curriculum. It is conveniently accessible by road and is situated close to the town of Palakkad. The overall climate is tropical, with rainier summers than winters and ideal temperatures throughout the year. The weather can be a little breezy on certain days, but regular summer rains are a treat.

Choosing the right medication and therapy is essential to recovery. Medicine, like other treatments, is not for everyone. Finding a treatment plan that works for one is challenging, but not impossible. Before deciding on the best course of action, a person must receive a proper diagnosis, have his Tridosha levels measured, and have his Prakriti (physical constitution) evaluated. In addition to being a competent doctor, having access to advanced medical facilities and potent medication formulations is crucial. In an authentic Ayurvedic manner, we carefully select what is best for you here at Kairali -The Ayurvedic Healing Village!

You will be greeted warmly by the staff, which consists of excellent Ayurvedic physicians and non-clinical staff. The treatment programs that are provided as packages are tailored to meet your specific needs. Numerous treatment packages covering categories such as general health, detox, rejuvenation, Panchakarma, weight management, eye care, musculoskeletal issues, and lifestyle diseases are available for children, adults, senior citizens, pregnant women, and women after giving birth. The doctor here will assist you in making the best decision.

THE PROGRAMME
Process Involved In Ayurveda Training Program

The Ayurveda Training Program at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a comprehensive and immersive experience that introduces participants to the principles and practices of ancient Ayurveda. The process is meticulously designed to balance theoretical knowledge with practical application, ensuring holistic understanding and skill development.

01

Initial Orientation: The program begins with an orientation session to familiarize participants with the core concepts of Ayurveda, including its history, philosophy, and applications. Participants are introduced to the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, and Kapha) and their role in maintaining health.

02

Theory Sessions: In-depth classroom-style sessions cover topics such as: Ayurvedic anatomy and physiology, Basics of herbal medicine and Ayurvedic formulations, Principles of diet and lifestyle management.

03

Practical Training: Hands-on practice includes learning various Ayurvedic therapies like: Abhyanga (oil massage), Shirodhara (pouring warm oil on the forehead), Panchakarma (detoxification techniques), Participants also engage in preparing herbal remedies and Ayurvedic dishes to understand the practical applications of theoretical knowledge.

04

Yoga & Meditation Integration: To enhance learning, yoga and meditation are incorporated into the daily routine. These practices align with Ayurveda’s emphasis on mind-body harmony.

05

Personalized Feedback: Instructors provide regular feedback to ensure participants grasp the techniques correctly and refine their skills for effective implementation.

Features of the program
◆
Comprehensive Curriculum & Expert Faculty: Our program offers a broad Ayurvedic curriculum taught by seasoned practitioners, ensuring a well-rounded education.
◆
Practical Training & Customization: Gain hands-on experience through workshops and tailor your focus within Ayurveda, such as therapy, nutrition, or management.
◆
Interactive Learning & Holistic Approach: Engage in interactive sessions that explore Ayurveda’s holistic healing and global applications.
Learning outcomes
◆
Comprehensive Education: Deepen your Ayurvedic knowledge from basics to advanced levels.
◆
Practical Skills: Gain hands-on experience in Ayurvedic therapies.
◆
Tailored Learning & Holistic Approach: Customize your education and explore Ayurveda’s holistic approach.

Learn Ayurveda with Kairali Ayurvedic Group

Kairali & Ayurveda are almost synonyms in India. Founded in 1989, “Kairali Ayurvedic Centre” has over 25 years of experience in providing authentic Ayurvedic Services across the globe. Using the ancient science of Ayurveda as its only means, Kairali established itself as the pioneer in Ayurvedic treatment centres by setting up its first centre in New Delhi after which it never had to look back.

Now with over 35 locations all over the world Kairali is one of the fastest growing Ayurvedic brand.

With a mission to uphold the principles of Ayurveda to propagate health & well-being worldwide, Kairali has delivered various Ayurvedic Training Programs across the globe and started specialised Ayurvedic training centres at selected locations.

Why Learn Ayurveda?

Apart from an additional professional qualification, Ayurveda teaches you how to adopt the Right Way of Living. This ancient wisdom has solutions for all your problems whether its physical, mental or emotional. If you are a health & wellness enthusiast, please don’t be late to sign up for our well-crafted Ayurvedic programs. Kairali has developed tailor made programs for everyone’s needs whether you are a spa & wellness expert or a home maker. Wishing for individuals to lead fuller and healthier lives, Kairali offers Ayurvedic therapies and an ideal way of living across all areas by integrating yoga, nutrition, and more. We invite you to seize this chance to discover the true Ayurvedic lifestyle.

Ayurveda: The Science of Holistic Healing at Kairali

Discover the true essence of Ayurveda – a blend of time-honored therapies, natural wisdom, and a serene retreat surrounded by nature.
If you’re seeking the best Ayurvedic retreat in Kerala, Kairali is the perfect destination to restore balance, rejuvenate your body, calm your mind, and uplift your spirit.

Experience Authentic Ayurveda at Kairali

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a Health Retreat in Kerala that provides a combination of traditional Ayurvedic therapies, yoga, and meditation. The retreat promotes healing and well-being through: 

Personalized Ayurvedic Consultations – Our professional Ayurvedic doctors evaluate your body’s constitution (Prakriti) and offer tailored remedies. 
Authentic Ayurvedic Therapies – Our therapies, which range from Panchakarma detoxification to specialized treatments for stress, skin issues, joint pain, and lifestyle diseases, are aimed at promoting overall health. 
Holistic Wellness Approach – We combine Ayurvedic therapies with yoga, meditation, and nutritional recommendations to provide a complete healing experience.

Serene Natural Environment – This Kerala Ayurvedic retreat, surrounded by beautiful nature, is the ideal place to unwind and rejuvenate yourself.

Therapeutic Treatments at Our Ayurvedic Health Retreat

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we offer a range of traditional Ayurvedic therapies designed to restore balance and promote wellness:

1. Panchakarma Detox Therapy

A five-step purification process that removes toxins from the body, strengthens the immune system and restores vitality.

2. Abhyanga (Ayurvedic Oil Massage)

A wonderfully relaxing full-body massage using herbal oils to boost circulation, reduce tension, and nourish the skin. 

3. Shirodhara

A relaxing technique in which heated herbal oil is repeatedly poured over the forehead, inducing deep relaxation and mental clarity. 

4. Njavarakizhi

A rejuvenating therapy that uses a heated medicinal rice bundle massage to improve muscular tone and strength. 

5. Ayurvedic Diet and Lifestyle Guidance

We provide individualized food suggestions based on specific body types (Vata, Pitta, and Kapha) to improve digestion and overall health. 

Why Choose Kairali – The Best Ayurvedic retreat in Kerala?
Authenticity: We use time-honored Ayurvedic principles to give genuine healing experiences. 
Expertise: Our expert Ayurvedic doctors and therapists provide high-quality therapies. 
Tranquil Setting: Our Kerala Ayurvedic retreat is located in a peaceful, pollution-free location, perfect for deep healing. 
Holistic Wellness Programs: We combine Ayurveda with yoga, meditation, and naturopathy to provide total mind-body-soul regeneration. 
Sustainable & Organic: We use eco-friendly procedures, organic food, and herbal remedies to provide a holistic therapeutic experience. 
Book Your Ayurvedic Retreat Today!

Kairali The Ayurvedic Healing Village provides an unmatched experience for stress alleviation, cleansing, and regeneration. As the best Ayurvedic retreat in Kerala, we invite you on a healing and transformational journey. Book your retreat today and discover the pure essence of Ayurveda at Kairali!

What is Ayurvedic Food?
Ayurvedic Restaurant & Cooking at Healing Village
Ayurvedic Products
Products

Ayurvedic cuisine at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village honors the long-standing Ayurvedic food customs. Fundamentally, Ayurvedic cooking is a holistic approach to nutrition that balances the body, mind, and spirit by carefully choosing and preparing its ingredients. This section demonstrates how the food principles of Ayurveda can be easily incorporated into daily life to support harmony, vitality, and health.

The Essence of Ayurvedic Cuisine 

The foundation of Ayurvedic cooking is the belief that food is medicine and that our diet has a significant influence on our general health. It highlights nutrient-dense, easily digestible, natural, seasonal, and locally sourced components. The food is tailored to each person’s specific dosha (Vata, Pitta, or Kapha) to preserve or reestablish bodily equilibrium. 

The six basic tastes—sweet, sour, salty, bitter, pungent, and astringent—are carefully combined in each meal to produce a pleasing and well-balanced experience. In this way, Ayurvedic food boosts digestion, prevents imbalances, and promotes general health.

Features of Ayurvedic Cuisine at the Healing Village
Personalized Meal Plans: Meals at the Healing Village are carefully prepared to meet each visitor’s unique health requirements and dosha constitution. Every meal boosts the body’s natural healing and renewal processes thanks to this individualized approach.
Seasonal and Organic Ingredients: To preserve its nutritional integrity, the food uses locally produced, fresh, organic produce and ingredients. Every meal is guaranteed to be healthy, sustainable, and in harmony with the environment thanks to our farm-to-table method. 
Digestive Wellness: Ginger, fennel, turmeric, cumin, and other spices are used in Ayurvedic cooking to improve digestion. In addition to adding flavor, these spices enhance nutritional absorption and general vigor by promoting Agni, or digestive fire. 
Detoxifying and Healing: The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers a variety of foods that are intended to promote the body’s natural cleansing processes by gently detoxifying it. Every meal, from herbal teas to light soups, promotes general healing.
Culinary Simplicity with Rich Flavors: Ayurvedic cuisine exemplifies the beauty of simplicity, with clean, basic preparations that highlight the inherent flavors and attributes of each component. This ensures that meals are both nutritious and easy to digest. 

A Dining Experience Like No Other

Dining at the Ayurvedic Healing Village is an engaging experience that extends beyond taste. The peaceful atmosphere, combined with the well-prepared meals, encourages mindfulness and gratitude for the sustenance supplied. Guests are urged to eat deliberately and mindfully, thoroughly experiencing the textures, flavors, and scents. 

Integrating Ayurvedic Cuisine into Daily Life

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village also encourages guests to practice Ayurvedic cooking at home. Workshops and demonstrations teach visitors about dosha-based dishes, the value of mindful eating, and the health benefits of various herbs and spices.  

Conclusion

Ayurvedic cuisine at the Healing Village is a wonderful example of how food can heal. It offers an unmatched culinary experience with its focus on customized meals, seasonal ingredients, and holistic sustenance. Adopting these dietary guidelines can help people develop balance, improve their health, and feel more connected to the age-old wisdom of Ayurveda.

Partner with Kairali Ayurvedic Group: Transform Lives Through Authentic Ayurveda 

As a world leader in genuine Ayurvedic treatments, wellness retreats, and premium products, Kairali Ayurvedic Group extends an invitation to enthusiastic businesspeople to join its mission of promoting holistic health and wellness to people all over the world. With our Ayurvedic franchise concept, which is based on the heritage of Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we offer a special chance to participate in the rapidly expanding wellness sector. 

A Legacy of Excellence in Ayurveda

Kairali Ayurvedic Group was founded in 1989 and is well known for its dedication to conserving and sharing the age-old knowledge of Ayurveda. Our flagship retreat in Palakkad, Kerala, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, is a prime example of this dedication. Known as a haven of holistic well-being, it offers experiences that can change people’s lives by fusing traditional Ayurvedic methods with contemporary hospitality. 

This philosophy is extended by our franchising concept, which enables business owners to provide their communities with the same degree of genuineness, skill, and quality. By working with us, you join a reputable company that has received multiple honors, such as the International Healthcare Excellence Award and the Asia Pacific Entrepreneurship Award.

The Kairali Advantage: Why Partner with Us?  
Proven Expertise: With spas, treatment centres, and wellness centres spread over more than 30 countries, Kairali Ayurvedic Group has three decades of experience and a strong global presence. This knowledge and brand value are advantageous to you as a franchise partner. 
Authenticity and Quality: Using natural ingredients and tried-and-true techniques, all Kairali products and therapies are based on genuine Ayurvedic principles. The highest quality standards are used in the creation of our exclusive herbal formulas, guaranteeing their effectiveness and client pleasure. 
Comprehensive Support: Kairali offers comprehensive support from the establishment of your Ayurvedic centre to employee training, marketing, and operational direction to guarantee the success of your franchise.
Access to Renowned Products: All our franchisees have full access to Kairali Ayurvedic Products which include skincare solutions, herbal medicines, and wellness essentials. These products are well-loved by customers and complement our holistic treatment offerings.
Growing Demand for Ayurveda: The demand for holistic and natural treatment solutions is rising in the worldwide wellness sector. You may take advantage of this trend as a Kairali franchisee to create a profitable and significant company. 
A Business with Purpose

Joining together with Kairali offers you the possibility to change people’s lives in addition to a commercial opportunity. By providing genuine Ayurvedic products and therapies, you support sustainability, enhance health, and protect Ayurveda’s rich history. 

Franchise Models to Suit Your Vision

Our franchise plans accommodate a range of business goals, including opening a health spa, an Ayurvedic treatment facility, or a full-service retreat area. Every model is made to smoothly mesh with Kairali’s operational effectiveness and quality criteria.

Be Part of a Transformative Journey

Joining the Kairali Ayurvedic Group as a franchise partner connects you with a legacy of trust, innovation, and holistic wellness. Together, we can empower individuals and communities to lead healthier, more balanced lives through the time-honored science of Ayurveda.

Kairali Ayurvedic Herbal Tea is a wellness masterpiece that combines the best natural ingredients with the ageless wisdom of Ayurveda to produce a revitalizing and health-promoting experience. This special tea offers a harmonious balance that promotes your general well-being by bringing your body, mind, and spirit into alignment.

Crafted with Authentic Ayurvedic Principles

With roots in the age-old field of Ayurveda, Kairali’s herbal tea is carefully blended to address several health and vitality-related issues. Every drink will support your overall wellness because each component has been carefully chosen for its therapeutic qualities. For people looking for a natural way to detoxify, revitalize, and energize, this caffeine-free infusion is perfect.

A Potent Blend of Nature’s Best Herbs

The magic of Kairali Ayurvedic Herbal Tea lies in its carefully selected ingredients, which include:

Tulsi (Holy Basil): The “Queen of Herbs,” tulsi is a potent adaptogen that supports respiratory health, boosts immunity, and fights stress.
Ashwagandha: Ashwagandha, a highly valued Ayurvedic herb, is praised for its adaptogenic qualities, which help reduce stress, boost vitality, and improve mental clarity. 
Ginger: Ginger’s inherent anti-inflammatory and digestive qualities help to calm the stomach, aid digestion, and increase blood flow. 
Cardamom: This fragrant spice promotes digestive health and detoxification while adding a cool taste. 
Key Benefits of Kairali Ayurvedic Herbal Tea
Detoxification: Packed with antioxidants, the tea aids in the body’s detoxification, leaving you feeling renewed and invigorated.
Immunity Boost: The immune system is strengthened by the potent combination of ashwagandha and tulsi, which keeps you healthy and resistant to disease.
Stress Relief: Ashwagandha and tulsi’s adaptogenic qualities complement each other to lower stress and encourage emotional equilibrium.
Improved Digestion: By calming the stomach and improving the absorption of nutrients, ingredients like cardamom and ginger promote digestive health.
Holistic Wellness: This herbal tea promotes balance between the body and mind and enhances general well-being. 
A Step Towards Holistic Living

Kairali Ayurvedic Herbal Tea provides a respite from the hectic pace of modern life and a link to the ageless teachings of Ayurveda. You’re adopting a more balanced, healthful lifestyle by including this tea in your routine.

Every cup of Kairali Ayurvedic Herbal Tea embodies the nourishing essence of Ayurveda; allow it to lead you on a path to vitality, harmony, and wellness.

Ayurvedic New Year: Yala 2018!
PAST RETREAT
Ayurvedic New Year: Yala 2018!

This is a past retreat. The original description, itinerary and inclusions below are retained as a historical record and are not a current offer. There are no current dates or bookings for this retreat.

◆
Past Retreats
Historical retreat description

YALAcollective invites you to a unique journey in Kerala, the land of Ayurveda to an immersive 10 days experience to dive you into the intelligence of the body and the senses. The beginning of a NEW YEAR is a perfect time to detox and clean our body to welcome all positive new change we will introduce in our daily life.

The program we propose you in collaboration with the healing Ayurvedic village Kairali is a pre-emptive healing program created to stimulate the capacity of self-regulation of our body, according to the wisdom of Ayurveda, Yoga and Meditation, in front of all the stresses that we undergo in our daily life.

Every morning we will start introducing with a detox ritual followed from a meditation and Pranayama (breath techniques) class. After this internal body cleansing we will practice with Francesca Lo Cascio a two hours yoga class. Beyond this daily routine we will enjoy Francesca’s teaching during 3 evening Yin yoga classes, created to deeply relax and stretch your body.

Nathalie Geetha Babouraj, French/Indian doctor and founder of the ISI (Institut de santé integrative) in Paris, will guide us through the knowledge of Ayurveda. Following her guidance we will learn and practice together the principles of this ancient medicine. Nathalie will also guide the group in the art of Indian dance, a joyful moment to learn how to express our self through the movement of the body.

A detailed manual will be offered to you so that you can experience the Detox at home when needed.

You will experience the New Year’s day in Kerala! We will seize the opportunity to celebrate this important moment with a great night celebration.

During the retreat we will have the opportunity to express our creativity through the practice of yoga, meditation, cooking class and dance.

NOTE: This program is also open to people with chronic diseases, followed by their attending physician, who wish to create their lifestyle and further improve the processes of self-regulation and healing of the body in order to reduce symptoms as insomnia, anxiety, painful spurts, digestive disorders and other discomforts of everyday life.

Yoga & Meditation Practice

Francesca Lo Cascio, YALAcollective’s teacher, will guide you during the Meditation and Yoga classes. The classes are mainly held in English with the possibility of classes available in other languages according to our guests needs (French, Spanish or Italian).

Our yoga program is dedicated to all levels of this discipline. Entirely based on how guiding your breathing its practice will be divided in four parts:

The first part is dedicated to breathing (Pranayama) and to meditation.

The second dynamic part of Vinyasa Yoga where the breathing guides your mouvements.

A third part of Yin Yoga where we will wok on our connective tissue to deep hydratate, detoxify and rejuvenate our body.

A last part consists instead in deep relaxation (Shavasana).

The Healing Village

Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s signature property ‘The Ayurvedic Healing Village’ is a nature’s paradise where one can recuperate from stress and strain, undergo treatment for one’s ailments, all while being on holiday.

This ayurvedic haven is situated in Palakkad, just a few kilometers from the world’s biggest mountain pass between Kerala and Tamil Nadu. Nature has bestowed Palakkad immensely with rich natural vegetation, mountains, forests, fertile valleys, rivers and mountain streams which makes it a panoramic repertoire. Time spent at this unique paradise will allow you to experience the authentic healing practices of ancient India, while relaxing in the lap of modern holistic luxury.
