What is Ayurveda

Ayurveda is Sanskrit and is a combination of the words Ayus, meaning life, and Veda, which means science; think of it as ‘the science of life’. Ayurveda is based on the principles of finding harmony and balance between mind, body and soul. The main focus is preventing disease and maintaining vitality and health by following recommendations specific to your type; these recommendations offer insight into the ideal routine of proper diet, lifestyle, behavior and state of mind. Ridding our systems of both physical and spiritual toxins is an important part of the practice.

Ayurvedic Class

Nathalie Geetha is a life-lover… After a career as a family physician, she decides to train in yogatherapy, dance, and Ayurveda, with Deepak Chopra. Following her guidance we will learn and practice together the principles of this ancient medicine. A manual will be offered to you so that you can experience the Detox at home when needed. *This detox program is inspired by Nathalie Geetha’s on-line program “Ma Détox Colorée”

Ayurvedic Diet

Food is perhaps the most important and most neglected ingredient of a healthy lifestyle. The Ayurvedic cuisine is a type of new wave food system where the diet includes all the necessary minerals and nutrients to promote growth and health while also keeping in consideration the palatability of the food offered.

This dietary system takes into account all the possible permutations through which the quality of food can be increased without destroying its taste. This cuisine is not only healthy but it also caters to all the age groups according to their choices.

There is no dearth of variety and there are numerous dishes with varied preparations which help in maintaining the novelty of the food. This cuisine is the best way to promote a healthy lifestyle for everyone.

Kerala Backwaters & Houseboat Trip

Kerala is one of the most charming and captivating states in India and this exceptional natural beauty claims for it being named to be “God’s Own Country”.

Houseboats in Kerala is a unique attraction which has gained the attention of tourists from all over the world. One cannot think of complete tours and travel in India without exploring the scenic backwaters with a stay in a Kerala boathouse.

What is unique about backwaters in Kerala ?

Kerala Backwaters are a network of interconnected canals, rivers, lakes and inlets, a labyrinthine system formed by more than 900 km of waterways.

In the midst of this landscape there are a number of towns and cities, which serve as the starting and end points of backwater cruises.The backwaters have a unique ecosystem – freshwater from the rivers meets the seawater from the Arabian Sea. Many unique species of aquatic life including crabs, frogs and mudskippers, water birds such as terns, kingfishers, darters and cormorants, and animals such as otters and turtles live in and alongside the backwaters. Palm trees, pandanus shrubs, various leafy plants and bushes grow alongside the backwaters, providing a green hue to the surrounding landscape.

The Kairali Ayurvedic Group, well-known for its genuine commitment to Ayurveda and well-being, is the driving force behind the Ayurvedic Healing Village. Kairali Ayurvedic products aim to bring the age-old knowledge of Ayurveda into the contemporary world. These products demonstrate the group’s dedication to holistic health, quality, and authenticity.

Explore a Wide Range of Ayurvedic Products

To promote health, vigor, and well-being, Kairali’s Ayurvedic products are made with high-quality natural ingredients and traditional recipes, representing the principles of Ayurveda. Whether you’re looking for skincare products, treatments for particular health issues, or ways to improve your everyday wellness regimen, Kairali Ayurvedic Products has something to offer everyone. Under the direction of Ayurvedic specialists, every product is created to guarantee efficacy, purity, and adherence to traditional formulae.

Key Product Categories
Herbal Formulations: These products include a selection of expertly made herbal powders, capsules, and syrups that treat a wide range of health issues, including digestion, immunity, joint health, and mental clarity.
Personal Care and Skincare: Ayurvedic skincare products, such as oils, face packs, and moisturizers, are formulated to nourish the skin and produce a natural, glowing complexion. These products contain components such as turmeric, sandalwood, and aloe vera, which are known for their revitalizing effects.
Therapeutic Oils: Features a wide range of medicinal oils, including Ksheerabala and Abhyangam oils, which are utilized in traditional Ayurvedic massages and therapies. These oils are great for increasing circulation, reducing tension, and strengthening muscles and joints.
Lifestyle and Wellness: Ayurvedic teas, immune boosters, and revitalizing tonics are essential components of the lifestyle items offered. These products are intended to smoothly integrate Ayurvedic practices into your routine.
Quality You Can Trust

Every product exemplifies Kairali’s ongoing commitment to quality and authenticity. To retain the potency and natural essence of the components, they are ethically sourced and prepared using environmentally responsible ways. The manufacturing process follows strict quality controls, assuring that each product is devoid of dangerous chemicals and synthetic additions.

Tailored Wellness Solutions

The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers its customers customized wellness solutions in addition to offering products. To help guests make well-informed decisions that support their unique wellness objectives, our retreat incorporates suggestions for certain products depending on medical problems.

Embracing Ayurveda for Modern Living

Kairali Ayurvedic Products encourages people to adopt an Ayurvedic lifestyle by emphasizing sustainability and comprehensive well-being. Through dietary improvements, self-care practices, or therapeutic treatments, it enable guests to enjoy the tremendous advantages of this age-old knowledge.

Conclusion

Kairali Ayurvedic Products provides access to authentic Ayurvedic living in addition to offering products. You are connecting with the ageless concepts of harmony, balance, and natural healing in addition to improving your physical and emotional well-being by including these Ayurvedic products in your daily routine.

Digestive Health: formulations that alleviate acidity, promote digestion, and treat gastrointestinal issues.

Respiratory Support: Herbal remedies for sinus problems, allergies, and asthma that improve respiratory health.
Immunity Boosters: Boost immunity with natural treatments that guard against diseases and infections.
Skin and Hair Care: Products that treat common skin conditions, promote hair growth, and restore natural beauty.
Mental Wellness: formulas to reduce stress, increase cognitive abilities, and improve the quality of sleep.

Authenticity: Backed by over a century of Ayurvedic expertise.
Efficacy: Proven to deliver effective results for a variety of health concerns.
Sustainability: Environmentally friendly practices are followed at every step of production.
Global Trust: Kairali’s medicines are trusted by customers worldwide for their quality and reliability.

Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Medicines provide safe, natural remedies for contemporary health issues while embodying the ageless principles of Ayurveda. Such is the nature of Kairali’s Ayurvedic Proprietary Products, which promote the development of an individual’s inner beauty and health. These products have stood the test of time and continue to play an important role in the field of Ayurveda.

A Commitment to Organic Wellness

Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics prioritizes the use of natural and organic ingredients sourced ethically from reputable vendors. Each product is meticulously created to guarantee that it adheres to Ayurvedic principles while also fulfilling the needs of modern lifestyles. These products are free of dangerous chemicals, synthetic additives, and preservatives, making them a safe and effective option for those looking for natural solutions.

Wide Range of Organic Products

Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics offers an extensive selection of organic products tailored to address various wellness needs. The range includes:

Organic Herbal Formulations
These formulations, which are made using potent herbs and plant extracts with therapeutic qualities, are intended to promote general health. Every combination is designed to bring harmony back and balance the body’s doshas (Pitta, Kapha, and Vata).
Organic Skincare Products
In order to nourish, protect, and revitalize the skin, the skincare line includes a hydrating lotion, rejuvenating facial Oil, and a herbal face pack enhanced with natural components. All skin types can use these products because they are mild and efficient.
Organic Hair Care Solutions
Shampoos, oils, and conditioners in Kairali’s organic hair care range enhance hair texture, lessen dandruff, and encourage hair development while preserving the natural equilibrium of the scalp.
Therapeutic Oils and Balms
Infused with Ayurvedic herbs, the therapeutic oils and balms are designed to provide targeted relief from pain, inflammation, and stiffness. These products are perfect for everyday care and massage treatments.
Organic Wellness Teas
The line of herbal teas is intended to offer several health advantages, including enhancing immunity, facilitating relaxation, and easing digestion. These teas are made with organic herbs and spices and provide a revitalizing and health-promoting experience.
Crafted with Ayurvedic Expertise

Each product in Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics is the result of years of study and development, guided by the knowledge of Ayurvedic practitioners. These exclusive compositions are based on traditional Ayurvedic recipes, so each product captures the essence of ancient therapeutic procedures.

Sustainability and Ethical Practices

Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics prioritizes environmental responsibility in all aspects of production. From responsibly sourcing raw materials to adopting eco-friendly packaging, the business guarantees that its activities are in sync with the environment. Furthermore, it advocates for ethical trading practices and collaborates closely with local communities to promote sustainable farming and fair employment.

The Benefits of Choosing Organic

Organic products from Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics offer numerous benefits:

Purity and Safety: These products are free from artificial chemicals or additives, making them safe for both the environment and human health.
Effective Results: The use of high-quality organic herbs ensures maximum efficacy.
Holistic Wellness: These products support general health and well-being by balancing the mind, body, and spirit.
Eco-Friendly: Biodegradable packaging and sustainable manufacturing processes minimize environmental impact.
Trusted by Wellness Enthusiasts Worldwide

Customers all around the world trust Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics because of its efficacy and authenticity. These products are a favorite among health practitioners and enthusiasts alike since they produce dependable and consistent outcomes whether used at home or in accredited Ayurvedic facilities.

A Legacy of Excellence

The Proprietary Organics line, which is a part of the well-known Kairali Ayurvedic Group, embodies the company’s tradition of Ayurvedic excellence. With decades of expertise in health and healing, Kairali is a leader in providing premium organic and Ayurvedic products.

Conclusion

Beyond mere products, Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics offers a path to effective, sustainable, and natural wellness. These proprietary formulas, which have their roots in Ayurvedic traditions and are made with organic components, address a variety of health and beauty concerns. By selecting Kairali’s organic line, you adopt a holistic way of living and make sure that your path to harmony and health is impactful and safe. With Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics, rediscover wellbeing in its most basic form while harnessing the power of nature and Ayurveda.

Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics

In today’s society, virtually everyone is looking for organic products, which demonstrate their reliance on natural and harmless methods of combating health problems. Such is the nature of Kairali’s Ayurvedic Proprietary Products, which promote the development of an individual’s inner beauty and health. These products have stood the test of time and continue to play an important role in the field of Ayurveda.

A Commitment to Organic Wellness

Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics prioritizes the use of natural and organic ingredients sourced ethically from reputable vendors. Each product is meticulously created to guarantee that it adheres to Ayurvedic principles while also fulfilling the needs of modern lifestyles. These products are free of dangerous chemicals, synthetic additives, and preservatives, making them a safe and effective option for those looking for natural solutions.

Wide Range of Organic Products

Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics offers an extensive selection of organic products tailored to address various wellness needs. The range includes:

Organic Herbal Formulations
These formulations, which are made using potent herbs and plant extracts with therapeutic qualities, are intended to promote general health. Every combination is designed to bring harmony back and balance the body’s doshas (Pitta, Kapha, and Vata).
Organic Skincare Products
In order to nourish, protect, and revitalize the skin, the skincare line includes a hydrating lotion, rejuvenating facial Oil, and a herbal face pack enhanced with natural components. All skin types can use these products because they are mild and efficient.
Organic Hair Care Solutions
Shampoos, oils, and conditioners in Kairali’s organic hair care range enhance hair texture, lessen dandruff, and encourage hair development while preserving the natural equilibrium of the scalp.
Therapeutic Oils and Balms
Infused with Ayurvedic herbs, the therapeutic oils and balms are designed to provide targeted relief from pain, inflammation, and stiffness. These products are perfect for everyday care and massage treatments.
Organic Wellness Teas
The line of herbal teas is intended to offer several health advantages, including enhancing immunity, facilitating relaxation, and easing digestion. These teas are made with organic herbs and spices and provide a revitalizing and health-promoting experience.
Crafted with Ayurvedic Expertise

Each product in Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics is the result of years of study and development, guided by the knowledge of Ayurvedic practitioners. These exclusive compositions are based on traditional Ayurvedic recipes, so each product captures the essence of ancient therapeutic procedures.

Sustainability and Ethical Practices

Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics prioritizes environmental responsibility in all aspects of production. From responsibly sourcing raw materials to adopting eco-friendly packaging, the business guarantees that its activities are in sync with the environment. Furthermore, it advocates for ethical trading practices and collaborates closely with local communities to promote sustainable farming and fair employment.

The Benefits of Choosing Organic

Organic products from Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics offer numerous benefits:

Purity and Safety: These products are free from artificial chemicals or additives, making them safe for both the environment and human health.
Effective Results: The use of high-quality organic herbs ensures maximum efficacy.
Holistic Wellness: These products support general health and well-being by balancing the mind, body, and spirit.
Eco-Friendly: Biodegradable packaging and sustainable manufacturing processes minimize environmental impact.
Trusted by Wellness Enthusiasts Worldwide

Customers all around the world trust Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics because of its efficacy and authenticity. These products are a favorite among health practitioners and enthusiasts alike since they produce dependable and consistent outcomes whether used at home or in accredited Ayurvedic facilities.

A Legacy of Excellence

The Proprietary Organics line, which is a part of the well-known Kairali Ayurvedic Group, embodies the company’s tradition of Ayurvedic excellence. With decades of expertise in health and healing, Kairali is a leader in providing premium organic and Ayurvedic products.

Conclusion

Beyond mere products, Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics offers a path to effective, sustainable, and natural wellness. These proprietary formulas, which have their roots in Ayurvedic traditions and are made with organic components, address a variety of health and beauty concerns. By selecting Kairali’s organic line, you adopt a holistic way of living and make sure that your path to harmony and health is impactful and safe. With Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics, rediscover wellbeing in its most basic form while harnessing the power of nature and Ayurveda.

FOOD THAT UNITES BOUNDARIES

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, each meal is intentionally prepared to contribute to your healing process. Our Ayurvedic eatery offers nourishing, sattvic dishes customized to your Prakriti (body constitution) and present health status. Employing organic, locally sourced ingredients and traditional Ayurvedic cooking techniques, every dish is crafted to restore equilibrium, enhance digestion, and nurture both body and mind.

Founded on the belief that “food is medicine,” our cooking philosophy transcends flavor. Our skilled chefs collaborate with Ayurvedic physicians to guarantee that dishes correspond with therapeutic objectives, aiding in detoxification, rejuvenation, and overall health. The calm, natural environment of our restaurant enriches the dining experience, encouraging mindful eating and tranquility.

Visitors also enjoy the rare chance to engage in Ayurvedic cooking sessions while they are here. These practical experiences immerse you in the age-old knowledge of Ayurvedic nutrition—showing you how to make restorative dishes, utilize therapeutic spices, and incorporate Ayurvedic concepts into your daily cooking. It’s a fulfilling method to bring the healing back with you.

Kerala, the magical tropical land where Ayurveda originated and whose natural beauty captivates everyone, is home to all Ayurvedic and Yoga devotees. Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Palakkad, Kerala, is an escape refuge that provides guests with the best modern holistic therapy while adhering to the ancient principles of Yoga, Ayurveda, traditional Vedic traditions, and natural healing. With the presence of experienced Ayurveda and Yoga teachers, students can choose from a variety of training courses to meet their specific needs in this immersive Ayurvedic retreat in Kerala, India. Each day follows a certain curriculum, beginning with complementary Ayurvedic therapies and concluding with a delicious vegetarian lunch prepared from our organic garden, making it one of the best Ayurvedic treatment centres in Kerala for immersive stays.

Nearby Attractions and Current Events
✳
THIRUVALATHOOR

It is a peaceful village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is rich in culture and spirituality. It is home to the historic Thiruvalathoor Mahadeva Temple, a famous shrine to Lord Shiva. The temple, known for its beautiful wooden carvings and traditional Kerala-style architecture, attracts both devout and architecture aficionados visiting nearby ayurvedic treatment packages in Kerala retreats. Thiruvalathoor, surrounded by thick greenery, has a serene ambiance that makes it an ideal location for spiritual searchers and nature enthusiasts.

Distance: 5.2 km

THENARI

Thenari is a lovely village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is well-known for its natural beauty and cultural significance. The town is famous for the Thenari Natural Spring, a sacred location with divine origins and ties to the Ramayana. Surrounded by rich greenery and quiet scenery, it is a peaceful getaway for those seeking spiritual serenity and a connection with nature while enjoying Kerala ayurvedic treatment stays. Its tranquil surroundings and historical significance make it a hidden gem among Kerala's rich cultural legacy.

Distance: 10 km

KATHAKALI

Kathakali is an ancient classical dance drama that depicts an act of devotion and the universal conflict between good and evil. With years of pedagogy, the dance form uses choreography, face, and hand movements to express Indian folklore and is often showcased to guests staying at the healing Village in Kerala, India.

MOHINIYATTAM

The classical dance form of Kerala, Mohiniyattam, finds its roots in Hindu Mythology. The undulating movements depict the dance of the enchantress Mohini. She made demons fall for her oscillating dance steps, passionate eyes, and graceful gestures to restore elixir. A delight for your eyes, women adorn simple, elegant gold-filigreed dresses in pure white or ivory while performing, often presented as a cultural highlight for guests enjoying ayurvedic treatment packages in Kerala at this retreat.

Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Palakkad, Kerala, is an escape refuge that provides guests with the best modern holistic therapy while adhering to the ancient principles of Yoga, Ayurveda, traditional Vedic traditions, and natural healing. With the presence of experienced Ayurveda and Yoga teachers, students can choose from a variety of training courses to meet their specific needs in this immersive Ayurvedic retreat in Kerala, India. Each day follows a certain curriculum, beginning with complementary Ayurvedic therapies and concluding with a delicious vegetarian lunch prepared from our organic garden, making it one of the best Ayurvedic treatment centres in Kerala for immersive stays.

Nearby Attractions and Current Events
✳
THIRUVALATHOOR

It is a peaceful village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is rich in culture and spirituality. It is home to the historic Thiruvalathoor Mahadeva Temple, a famous shrine to Lord Shiva. The temple, known for its beautiful wooden carvings and traditional Kerala-style architecture, attracts both devout and architecture aficionados visiting nearby ayurvedic treatment packages in Kerala retreats. Thiruvalathoor, surrounded by thick greenery, has a serene ambiance that makes it an ideal location for spiritual searchers and nature enthusiasts.

Distance: 5.2 km

THENARI

Thenari is a lovely village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is well-known for its natural beauty and cultural significance. The town is famous for the Thenari Natural Spring, a sacred location with divine origins and ties to the Ramayana. Surrounded by rich greenery and quiet scenery, it is a peaceful getaway for those seeking spiritual serenity and a connection with nature while enjoying Kerala ayurvedic treatment stays. Its tranquil surroundings and historical significance make it a hidden gem among Kerala's rich cultural legacy.

Distance: 10 km

KATHAKALI

Kathakali is an ancient classical dance drama that depicts an act of devotion and the universal conflict between good and evil. With years of pedagogy, the dance form uses choreography, face, and hand movements to express Indian folklore and is often showcased to guests staying at the healing Village in Kerala, India.

MOHINIYATTAM

The classical dance form of Kerala, Mohiniyattam, finds its roots in Hindu Mythology. The undulating movements depict the dance of the enchantress Mohini. She made demons fall for her oscillating dance steps, passionate eyes, and graceful gestures to restore elixir. A delight for your eyes, women adorn simple, elegant gold-filigreed dresses in pure white or ivory while performing, often presented as a cultural highlight for guests enjoying ayurvedic treatment packages in Kerala at this retreat.

PAST RETREAT
Ayuryoga

This is a past retreat. The original description, programme and inclusions below are retained as a historical record and are not a current offer. There are no current dates or bookings for this retreat.

◆
Past Retreats
Kairali’s Ayurvedic Healing Village in God’s Own Country Kerala

Kerala presents a distinctive language, culture, and cuisine that set it apart from the rest of India, and serves as the origin of Ayurveda, the ancient Indian discipline of holistic healing, making it an ideal destination for natural recovery.

Nowhere in the world can you immerse yourself in nature and revitalize with natural remedies quite like the fragrant landscapes of Kerala.

Time spent in Kerala offers the chance to engage in genuine healing traditions of ancient India, all while enjoying modern holistic luxury.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s premier Ayurvedic location, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, is a unique holistic environment that fosters healing both from within and outwardly. Through traditional and genuine Ayurvedic therapies, treatments, and medications from ancient India, combined with Yoga and Mindfulness practices, the Healing Village provides comprehensive Wellness for everyone.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village covers 60 acres and features 30 villas and suites along with open areas, farms, organic gardens, 3 yoga studios, and provides genuine organic cuisine.

The Healing Village has been inviting wellness enthusiasts globally for various programs, including Yoga Retreats, Ayurveda Retreats, and Ayurveda Training Retreats.

The AyurYoga Retreats typically last for 07 days, 14 days, 21 days, and 28 days, and we host groups of guests in double and triple occupancy.

The AyurYoga 2020 initiative with our collaborators aims to blend yoga, Ayurveda, meditation, pujas, kirtans, and exploring sacred spaces.

Typical day schedule (for guidance)
◆
05:00 – 06:00 Wake-Up Call
◆
06:00 – 07:00 Morning Satsang and Meditation
◆
07:00 – 08:30 Morning Yoga
◆
08:30 – 09:30 Breakfast
◆
09:30 –12:00 Ayur Yoga Workshop
◆
12:30 – 15:00 Lunch and Rest
◆
15:00 – 18:00 Ayurvedic Therapy (45 minutes Abhiyangam)
◆
18:00 – 19:00 Evening Yoga
◆
19:00 – 20:00 Dinner
◆
20:00 – 21:00 Meditation /Satsang /Puja /Cultural program
◆
22:00 – Lights Out
More information:

The retreat might start with a 10-day Panchakarma combined with Yoga therapy to cleanse the body and the nervous system. Panchakarma is a component of Ayurvedic medicine, which has been the traditional form of healing in India for more than 5000 years.

Ayurveda seeks to achieve harmony between body and mind, suggesting, among other practices, the detoxification of the body with every seasonal transition. Panchakarma detoxifies the body of impurities on physical, emotional, and mental dimensions.

Treatment involves consuming a formulation derived from therapeutic plants suitable for each individual’s condition. It involves fasting or a mild diet and continues for eight to ten days. You will have regular consultations with a physician who specializes in Ayurveda.

Several doctor appointments, two massages, along with ayurvedic and sauna treatments were included.

Included in the Retreat:

The AyurYoga retreats at Kairali’s healing village is an all-inclusive package where everything is taken care of by Kairali to make the visit the most memorable.

Back to Roots

This is a past retreat. The original description below is retained as a historical record and is not a current offer. There are no current dates or bookings for this retreat.

◆
Past Retreats
HISTORICAL RETREAT DESCRIPTION
Back to Roots

With its roots in ancient Ayurvedic practices and traditions, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has continuously maintained its dedication to quality and authenticity. Kairali committed at the outset to carry on the tradition of its founders by fusing Ayurvedic knowledge with contemporary wellness techniques. In keeping with this commitment, Kairali works to advance the health and well-being of all visitors who decide to enjoy the tranquility of its home.

The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s commitment to maintaining the authenticity of Ayurvedic cuisine is one of its most notable aspects. The ingredients and recipes are carefully chosen to emphasize healing and nourishment while adhering to Ayurvedic principles. Every meal that Kairali serves is a celebration of Ayurveda, transporting guests to the origins of holistic nutrition. The dishes are made using locally and organically sourced ingredients, preserving the ancient recipes’ medicinal efficacy and purity.

By holding India’s first-ever “Chef Retreat” at its retreat in Palakkad, Kerala, Kairali accomplished a major milestone in its mission to elevate Ayurvedic food to the forefront of wellbeing. Under the direction of Kairali’s visionary leaders, Mrs. Gita Ramesh, Joint Managing Director, and Mr. K.V. Ramesh, Managing Director, this historic event took place in July 2017. In the centre of the healing village, the retreat provided a special stage for renowned chefs from all over India to display their culinary prowess.

The Chef Retreat honored the age-old cooking techniques that have been treasured for many generations, and it was more than just a gourmet event. It emphasized the close relationship between food and emotions by reminding visitors of the coziness and warmth of meals made with love by grandmothers. Kairali wanted to revive interest in Ayurvedic cooking and its ability to heal the body and mind through this project.

Chefs at the event showcased how Ayurvedic concepts may be easily incorporated into gourmet cooking by providing creative, tasty, and beneficial recipes. In addition to enjoying a wide variety of Ayurvedic foods prepared with Ayurvedic wisdom, guests got the chance to engage with famous chefs and watch live culinary demonstrations. The event furthered Kairali’s goal of promoting holistic wellness by highlighting the need for balanced meals in cultivating a healthy lifestyle.

A global community of culinary professionals, wellness aficionados, and visitors came together for the Chef Retreat with the shared objective of honoring tradition and health. The retreat demonstrated Kairali’s steadfast commitment to conserving and advancing age-old customs in a modern context by fusing the science of Ayurveda with the art of cooking.

With programs like these, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village keeps setting the standard for Ayurvedic wellbeing by offering experiences that are steeped in history while meeting the needs of the contemporary pursuit of harmony and health. One meal at a time, Kairali gives its visitors the chance to rediscover the pleasures of mindful living by resurrecting the spirit of Ayurveda via traditional food.

HISTORICAL RETREAT DESCRIPTION
Back to Roots

With its roots in ancient Ayurvedic practices and traditions, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has continuously maintained its dedication to quality and authenticity. Kairali committed at the outset to carry on the tradition of its founders by fusing Ayurvedic knowledge with contemporary wellness techniques. In keeping with this commitment, Kairali works to advance the health and well-being of all visitors who decide to enjoy the tranquility of its home.

The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s commitment to maintaining the authenticity of Ayurvedic cuisine is one of its most notable aspects. The ingredients and recipes are carefully chosen to emphasize healing and nourishment while adhering to Ayurvedic principles. Every meal that Kairali serves is a celebration of Ayurveda, transporting guests to the origins of holistic nutrition. The dishes are made using locally and organically sourced ingredients, preserving the ancient recipes’ medicinal efficacy and purity.

By holding India’s first-ever “Chef Retreat” at its retreat in Palakkad, Kerala, Kairali accomplished a major milestone in its mission to elevate Ayurvedic food to the forefront of wellbeing. Under the direction of Kairali’s visionary leaders, Mrs. Gita Ramesh, Joint Managing Director, and Mr. K.V. Ramesh, Managing Director, this historic event took place in July 2017. In the centre of the healing village, the retreat provided a special stage for renowned chefs from all over India to display their culinary prowess.

The Chef Retreat honored the age-old cooking techniques that have been treasured for many generations, and it was more than just a gourmet event. It emphasized the close relationship between food and emotions by reminding visitors of the coziness and warmth of meals made with love by grandmothers. Kairali wanted to revive interest in Ayurvedic cooking and its ability to heal the body and mind through this project.

Chefs at the event showcased how Ayurvedic concepts may be easily incorporated into gourmet cooking by providing creative, tasty, and beneficial recipes. In addition to enjoying a wide variety of Ayurvedic foods prepared with Ayurvedic wisdom, guests got the chance to engage with famous chefs and watch live culinary demonstrations. The event furthered Kairali’s goal of promoting holistic wellness by highlighting the need for balanced meals in cultivating a healthy lifestyle.

A global community of culinary professionals, wellness aficionados, and visitors came together for the Chef Retreat with the shared objective of honoring tradition and health. The retreat demonstrated Kairali’s steadfast commitment to conserving and advancing age-old customs in a modern context by fusing the science of Ayurveda with the art of cooking.

With programs like these, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village keeps setting the standard for Ayurvedic wellbeing by offering experiences that are steeped in history while meeting the needs of the contemporary pursuit of harmony and health. One meal at a time, Kairali gives its visitors the chance to rediscover the pleasures of mindful living by resurrecting the spirit of Ayurveda via traditional food.

Sightseeing
Backwater Tour

Standing by the sea and watching sun making date with the dawn, the soothing power of waves, lavish coastline, serene land, and awesome weather with a coconut in hand is beyond vision. Waking up to the nice scenery with encompassing trees of coconut, banana, and mango is a relishing delight. The jingle of religious matins in ears and passing glance through hut of rural fishermen is a fascinating delight. The bewitched scenery of nature close to water is beautiful in itself spreading the richness and greenery. The mesmerizing experience to seductive perusal of backwater leaves you hungry for more.

The backwater system in Kerala is never crowded as there are many different waterways to take. The backwaters are dotted with the shadowy palm and coconut trees, providing wonderful opportunities to closely explore the tranquil beauty of nature, marine life of several species, traditional lifestyle of keralites and the magical world of water. Backwaters are the idyllic location for squandering some leisure time with your loved ones.

The houseboats steering on the backwaters provide finest contentment and eccentric escapade journey where everything wakes up and comes to life in the freshness of morning. These boats are fully furnished with lavish amenities to dispense tourist a lifetime adventure. The atmosphere remains simply beautiful.

PROGRAM DETAILS
About Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy

Vision is important only when one starts losing it. So, it needs to be addressed for deep-rooted and everlasting results. Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is offering you an exclusive chance to experience the world with a new vision with a 7/14/21/28 natural eye care program based on your condition.

Eyes can add a lot to your beauty, though we all tend to misuse them in the age of computers, tablets, smartphones, LED TVs etc. This package takes care of your exhausted eyes. The eye care routine will resuscitate them and revive their scintillating spark with Netra Tharpanam, Pindi and other therapies, depending on the need. Diet also plays an important role when an eye care routine is administered. So with the help of our Ayurvedic experts, your diet will be taken care of, including herbal juices to atone you internally. Yoga classes will also be given to return to the land of the living and provide full energy to the body.

Our Approach Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy

Ayurveda, an ancient Indian system of medicine, offers holistic eye care. We view eyes as mirrors of overall health, addressing root causes, not just symptoms. Our therapies like Nasyam, Netra Tarpanam, and Netrabasti cleanse, nourish, and improve circulation in the eyes, enhancing vision and reducing strain. Diet, lifestyle, and herbal meds play crucial roles. We personalize diets with eye-friendly antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals. Lifestyle adjustments include eye exercises and protection from environmental factors. We believe in holistic healing, focusing on body, mind, and spirit harmony. Our approach empowers clients to manage their eye health long-term. At our retreats, we provide compassionate, comprehensive Ayurvedic eye care, combining extensive experience with Ayurvedic wisdom. Trust in Ayurveda and our commitment to your eye care journey. Together, we unlock vibrant and healthy vision for renewed clarity and joy.

Process Involved in Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy

Treatment for Ayurvedic eye care typically involves the following steps.

01

Consultation: An initial consultation with an Ayurvedic doctor to assess your specific eye condition, medical history, and overall health.

02

Diagnosis: The Ayurvedic doctor will diagnose the underlying imbalances and determine the root cause of your eye condition.

03

Treatment Plan: A personalized treatment plan will be created based on your unique needs, which may include a combination of therapies, herbal medications, diet modifications, and lifestyle recommendations.

04

Therapies: The patient will undergo specific Ayurvedic therapies such as Nasyam (nasal administration of medicated oils), Netra Tarpanam (eye rejuvenation therapy), and Netra Basti (medicated eye baths).

05

Medications: Herbal medications and eye drops may be prescribed to nourish the eyes and promote healing.

06

Diet and Lifestyle Modifications: You will receive guidance on incorporating eye-friendly foods and nutritional supplements and adopting lifestyle practices to support eye health.

07

Follow-up: Regular follow-up consultations will be scheduled to monitor progress, make any necessary adjustments to the treatment plan, and provide ongoing support.

Why Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy ?
◆
Ayurvedic eye care takes a holistic approach, addressing the root cause of eye conditions and promoting overall well-being for long-lasting results.
◆
Treatment is personalized, with thorough consultations allowing for tailored plans that target specific conditions effectively.
◆
Ayurvedic therapies and medications are derived from natural sources, offering safety and minimal side effects compared to conventional treatments.
◆
Ayurvedic eye care complements conventional treatments, eases symptoms, aids healing, and may reduce medication needs. It emphasizes prevention and is administered by experienced Ayurvedic practitioners for top-notch care.
BEGIN TREATMENT
Benefits of Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy
◆
Ayurvedic eye care offers improved vision clarity and reduced eye strain and fatigue.
◆
It alleviates dryness, discomfort, and inflammation while enhancing eye circulation, nourishment, and strengthening ocular tissues.
◆
Ayurvedic treatments also balance doshas for overall well-being, increasing focus and concentration, and preventing age-related eye conditions.
◆
Ultimately, these therapies contribute to enhanced overall eye health.
BEGIN TREATMENT

During Treatment

You’ll have regular check-ins with the Ayurvedic doctor for progress monitoring and adjustments. Personalized therapies, including massages and herbal treatments, will be administered. Guidance on balanced living, diet, and stress management is provided, with continued doctor support for a safe and effective journey.

Post Treatment

Follow-up consultations with the Ayurvedic doctor assess the effectiveness and offer guidance. You’ll integrate post-treatment practices, like diet and lifestyle recommendations, for sustained benefits. Ongoing support ensures long-term health and addresses any concerns or needs.

About Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy

Vision is important only when one starts losing it. So, it needs to be addressed for deep-rooted and everlasting results. Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is offering you an exclusive chance to experience the world with a new vision with a 7/14/21/28 natural eye care program based on your condition.

Eyes can add a lot to your beauty, though we all tend to misuse them in the age of computers, tablets, smartphones, LED TVs etc. This package takes care of your exhausted eyes. The eye care routine will resuscitate them and revive their scintillating spark with Netra Tharpanam, Pindi and other therapies, depending on the need. Diet also plays an important role when an eye care routine is administered. So with the help of our Ayurvedic experts, your diet will be taken care of, including herbal juices to atone you internally. Yoga classes will also be given to return to the land of the living and provide full energy to the body.

Our Approach Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy

Ayurveda, an ancient Indian system of medicine, offers holistic eye care. We view eyes as mirrors of overall health, addressing root causes, not just symptoms. Our therapies like Nasyam, Netra Tarpanam, and Netrabasti cleanse, nourish, and improve circulation in the eyes, enhancing vision and reducing strain. Diet, lifestyle, and herbal meds play crucial roles. We personalize diets with eye-friendly antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals. Lifestyle adjustments include eye exercises and protection from environmental factors. We believe in holistic healing, focusing on body, mind, and spirit harmony. Our approach empowers clients to manage their eye health long-term. At our retreats, we provide compassionate, comprehensive Ayurvedic eye care, combining extensive experience with Ayurvedic wisdom. Trust in Ayurveda and our commitment to your eye care journey. Together, we unlock vibrant and healthy vision for renewed clarity and joy.

Process Involved in Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy

Treatment for Ayurvedic eye care typically involves the following steps.

01

Consultation: An initial consultation with an Ayurvedic doctor to assess your specific eye condition, medical history, and overall health.

02

Diagnosis: The Ayurvedic doctor will diagnose the underlying imbalances and determine the root cause of your eye condition.

03

Treatment Plan: A personalized treatment plan will be created based on your unique needs, which may include a combination of therapies, herbal medications, diet modifications, and lifestyle recommendations.

04

Therapies: The patient will undergo specific Ayurvedic therapies such as Nasyam (nasal administration of medicated oils), Netra Tarpanam (eye rejuvenation therapy), and Netra Basti (medicated eye baths).

05

Medications: Herbal medications and eye drops may be prescribed to nourish the eyes and promote healing.

06

Diet and Lifestyle Modifications: You will receive guidance on incorporating eye-friendly foods and nutritional supplements and adopting lifestyle practices to support eye health.

07

Follow-up: Regular follow-up consultations will be scheduled to monitor progress, make any necessary adjustments to the treatment plan, and provide ongoing support.

Why Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy ?
◆
Ayurvedic eye care takes a holistic approach, addressing the root cause of eye conditions and promoting overall well-being for long-lasting results.
◆
Treatment is personalized, with thorough consultations allowing for tailored plans that target specific conditions effectively.
◆
Ayurvedic therapies and medications are derived from natural sources, offering safety and minimal side effects compared to conventional treatments.
◆
Ayurvedic eye care complements conventional treatments, eases symptoms, aids healing, and may reduce medication needs. It emphasizes prevention and is administered by experienced Ayurvedic practitioners for top-notch care.
BEGIN TREATMENT
Benefits of Vision Health & Eye Rejuvenation Therapy
◆
Ayurvedic eye care offers improved vision clarity and reduced eye strain and fatigue.
◆
It alleviates dryness, discomfort, and inflammation while enhancing eye circulation, nourishment, and strengthening ocular tissues.
◆
Ayurvedic treatments also balance doshas for overall well-being, increasing focus and concentration, and preventing age-related eye conditions.
◆
Ultimately, these therapies contribute to enhanced overall eye health.

Guidance on balanced living, diet, and stress management is provided, with continued doctor support for a safe and effective journey.

Post Treatment

Follow-up consultations with the Ayurvedic doctor assess the effectiveness and offer guidance. You’ll integrate post-treatment practices, like diet and lifestyle recommendations, for sustained benefits. Ongoing support ensures long-term health and addresses any concerns or needs.

Books

Ayurveda, the ancient science of life, has been a beacon of holistic wellness for thousands of years. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, this timeless wisdom is not only practiced but also shared through a meticulously curated collection of books. Whether you are a curious beginner, a passionate learner, or a seasoned practitioner, the Book Collection offered by Kairali provides an invaluable resource for exploring the depths of Ayurveda and its multifaceted approach to health, wellness, and spirituality.

Unlocking the Treasures of Ayurvedic Knowledge

Ayurveda is much more than a system of medicine—it is a way of life that emphasizes balance, harmony, and natural healing. The books available at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village reflect this profound philosophy, offering insights into the core principles, therapies, and practices of Ayurveda. From foundational texts to contemporary interpretations, the collection caters to a diverse audience, empowering readers with practical knowledge to incorporate Ayurvedic principles into their lives.

Ayurvedic books at The Healing Village

The founder of Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Gita Ramesh, has written Ayurvedic cookbooks namely- “Get Fit in Just 2 Weeks, Ayurvedic Herbal Massage, and Ayurvedic Wellness Cookbook”, which masterfully blends traditional knowledge with useful recipes for contemporary living. The food and herbal massage guidelines followed at Kairali’s Ayurvedic Healing Village are reflected in these books, which place a strong emphasis on nutrition, balance, and overall wellness. Gita Ramesh’s writings are a priceless tool for incorporating Ayurvedic food & herbal massages into everyday life since guests and readers can experiment with customized, dosha-specific dishes that complement the Ayurvedic wellness philosophy.

Enrich Your Journey with Ayurvedic Wisdom

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we believe in the transformative power of knowledge. By offering this exclusive collection of books, we aim to inspire individuals to embrace Ayurveda as a path to wellness and harmony. Each book is a step toward a deeper understanding of yourself, your environment, and the eternal principles of life.

Explore the Collection Today

Whether you wish to master the art of Ayurvedic cooking, learn therapeutic practices, or immerse yourself in spiritual wisdom, Kairali’s book collection is your gateway to enlightenment.

Brief on Kairali

Kairali Ayurvedic Group has focused its core businesses and energies on treating and educating its guests in the ancient science of Ayurveda. By setting the highest possible standards of quality and service, Kairali has grown in leaps and bounds, and is now one of the world’s leading Ayurvedic destination brands.

Founded by Mr. and Mrs. K.V. Ramesh, who remain the chief mentors for the Kairali group, the next generation has now firmly established itself at the heart of the business activities. In a true continuation of the work of their elders, and their forefathers before them, they look forward to helping the company carry its name as the leading Ayurvedic brand still further around the world.

Butterfly Booklet

Nature has always been a powerful source of healing, and at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we incorporate its essence into every facet of wellness. Among the various natural treasures that distinguish Kairali, butterflies stand out as symbols of renewal, metamorphosis, and peace. Their presence at the retreat depicts the therapeutic journey that each participant takes, from stress and imbalance to total well-being and internal calm.

The Butterfly Booklet is a resource for self-care, mindfulness, and Ayurvedic living during your retreat. Beyond the practices and rituals, it invites you to view and interact with the butterflies that live in the lush, green sanctuary of Kairali.

Butterflies and Their Role in Healing

Butterflies are frequently connected with personal development, transformation, and renewal, which are profoundly ingrained in Ayurveda and holistic wellness. These fragile animals flutter freely at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, contributing to the retreat’s peaceful and quiet atmosphere. Their journey through the gardens, forests, and herbal plantations encourages attention, reflection, and appreciation for life’s natural cycles.

48 species of butterflies belonging to 5 families were observed, which would represent a majority of the butterfly families found in India. The occurrence of the largest Indian butterfly ‘Southern Birdwing Troides Minos’, was recorded during these observations as well.

KAIRALI — THE AYURVEDIC HEALING VILLAGE · SINCE 1908
Cancellation & Refund Policy
ON THIS PAGE
◆

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we strive to offer a seamless booking experience while understanding that plans can change unexpectedly. To ensure transparency and ease for our valued guests, our booking, cancellation and refund policy is outlined below:

Booking Procedure:

To make a reservation at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, guests must submit a booking request through our website, email, or phone. A 100% payment is required to confirm the booking. Guests must provide valid ID proof or a passport during check-in. Date modifications are subject to availability. Smoking, alcohol, and non-vegetarian food are strictly prohibited within the premises to maintain a pure Ayurvedic wellness environment. For assistance, guests can contact our reservations team.

Payment terms: Accepted payment methods (credit/debit cards, UPI, Wire Transfer, PayPal, Razorpay).

Payment Policy
Full payment must be made at the time of booking to confirm the reservation.
Payment methods include credit cards, debit cards, net banking, and digital wallets. Ensure that the transaction is successful to receive a confirmation.
Cancellation Terms:
30 Days or More Before Arrival

Cancellations made 30 days or more prior to the check-in date will receive a full refund of the amount paid.

Any bank or transaction fees incurred during payment will also be refunded.
15 Days Before Arrival

Cancellations made between 15 days and 30 days prior to the check-in date will be eligible for a 50% refund of the amount paid.

This amount excludes any non-refundable charges, such as booking fees or taxes.
Less Than 15 Days Before Arrival or Changes During Stay
Cancellations made less than 15 days before the check-in date will not be eligible for a refund.
Any changes to booking dates made during the stay will also not be eligible for a refund.
Exceptions may be made in cases of medical emergencies or other unforeseen circumstances, subject to documentation and management approval.
No-Show Policy

If a guest fails to check in on the scheduled day without providing prior notice, the booking will be considered a no-show. No refund or rescheduling will be provided in such cases.

Early Departure

In cases where guests choose to depart earlier than their planned stay, refunds will not be provided for the unused portion of their booking.

Refund Turnaround Time

For eligible cancellations, the refund process will be initiated within 5-7 working days from the date of cancellation confirmation. The refund will be credited to the customer’s bank account or the original payment method used during the booking.

Customers will receive a confirmation email once the refund has been processed.
Please ensure accurate bank or payment details are provided to avoid delays.
Force Majeure Clause

In the event of circumstances beyond our control, such as natural disasters, pandemics, government-imposed travel restrictions, or other force majeure events, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village reserves the right to:

Reschedule the booking to a mutually agreeable date without additional charges.
Offer a credit note for the amount paid, valid for future use within a fixed timeline from the date of issuance.
Process a refund in exceptional cases, subject to management approval and applicable deductions for non-refundable costs incurred.

Guests are encouraged to contact our reservations team to discuss available options in such situations.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in adhering to these policies. For further assistance or queries, please contact our support team.

PAST RETREAT

Chef Retreat Food to Wellness

This page records the Chef’s Retreat itinerary for 3–6 July 2017. Its programme, services and inclusions are historical and are not current booking terms.

Past Retreats

Historical retreat description
Chef’s Retreat Itinerary
Date: 3rd – 6th July 2017
Chef Abhijeet Saha, Chef Vikas Seth, Chef Arun Kumar TR & Chef Gill (As Mentor)
Day 1

Check in: Traditional Welcome at Kairali- The Ayurvedic Healing Village

Lunch: Kerala “Sadhya”, a traditional festive meal served on banana leaf.

3.30 pm: First meeting at the Culinary Cove with the directors of Kairali, Chefs, guests and invited guests followed by High Tea.

4.30 pm onwards: Meeting with Kairali doctors, followed by therapies as recommended.

6.00 pm: Group Meditation session

7.30 pm: Masterclass by Chef Vikas Seth (Topic: Localising Global Cuisine- Mexico)

Dinner.

Day 2

6.30 am: Group Yoga Session

7.30 am: Back to Roots Short Classes: Growing your own vegetable at the farm with Kairali’s resident horticulturist, G Anandan and Chef Abhijit Saha.

11 am: Panel discussion: Chef Manjit Singh Gill and Gita Ramesh (JMD – Kairali Ayurvedic Group) on the virtues of Vedic Eating

Noon: Masterclass by Chef Gill (Topic: The Culture of Taste- Heroing Moringa).

1.30 pm: Lunch cooked based on the Ayurvedic Cookbook.

2.30 pm: Kairali Ayurvedic Factory visit.

6.00 pm: Group Meditation

7.30 pm: Masterclass by Chef Arun Kumar TR (Topic: Food Resilience and the Art of Constructing a Dish).

Dinner.

Day 3

6.30 am: Group Yoga session

8.15 am: Masterclass by Chef Abhijit Saha (Topic: Superfood India).

10.15 am: Therapies sessions.

11.30 am: Village tour followed by a traditional local vegetarian meal.

6 pm: Group Meditation

7.30 pm: Panel discussion (Healing Foods: Imbibing the learning in our daily routine).

8.00 pm: Chefs-curated, sit-down dinner prepared by Chef Vikas Seth, Chef Abhijit Saha and Chef Arun Kumar TR.

Day 4

7.30 am: Ayurvedic therapies.

9 am: Back to Roots Session 2: Harvesting Spices at the Herb Garden with Chef Vikas Seth and resident horticulturist, G Ananadan

10 am: Breakfast and photo ops with chefs and others members of Kairali.

11 am: Departure of guests.

Other Complimentary services
Library & Recreational Room
Gym & Fitness centre
Swimming pool
Badminton & Tennis Court
Other Indoor & Outdoor Games
Palmistry, Astrology and Griha Pooja
Above package inclusive of:
Welcome-drink on arrival.
Accommodation in uniquely designed, independent villas.
All Meals (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner – Veg. only)
1 special meal during the stay cooked by our visiting chef with
unique dishes cooked by them.
3 Master classes during the stay.
Daily allotment of in-room mineral-water [1 per person per day]; unlimited supply of herbal-water.
One Ayurvedic treatment daily along with steam bath.
Village Walk with the visiting chefs with special lunch.
Visit to our proprietary Ayurvedic Factory with the chefs, inclusive of local Meal.
Complimentary Juice or Herbal tea after every massage. Additional food-items will be charged extra.
Complimentary Group-Yoga session, daily morning; individual classes are available on chargeable basis.
Complimentary Group-Meditation session daily evening; individual classes are available on chargeable basis.
Daily Personal Lifestyle & Fitness Evaluation.
Free use of Swimming Pool, Gym, Library & all Indoor & Outdoor facilities.
Internal medicines given for your treatment can only be ascertained as your treatment progresses and will cost extra.

OUR VILLAS
Classic Villa
144 – 244 Sqft
Twin/King Size Bed
Upto 3 Adults
Garden View
“Experience the perfect blend of traditional elegance and modern comfort at our Classic Villa. Discover the timeless beauty of Kerala’s architecture and immerse yourself in Ayurvedic healing amidst luxurious amenities. Unwind and rediscover your inner balance in this haven of serenity.“
The Villa

The Classic Villa at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a tranquil haven that blends contemporary conveniences with traditional Kerala architecture, making it the perfect place to unwind and revitalize. Up to three people can stay in each villa, which ranges in size from 144 to 244 square feet and has twin or king-size bedrooms. The villas’ luxurious interiors, which follow the principles of Vastu Shastra, create a peaceful environment that encourages equilibrium and inner serenity.

The Classic Villa guarantees a comfortable stay with air conditioning, LED TVs, telephones, and attached bathrooms with hot and cold running water all day long. A supply of water bottles, bathrobes, toiletries, and wardrobes are extra conveniences. Some villas are situated close to a calming stream that meanders through the grounds, providing calming noises that heighten the feeling of being in harmony with the natural world.

Additionally, guests of the Classic Villas have access to a range of amenities, such as daily yoga and meditation sessions, authentic Ayurvedic treatments, and wholesome organic meals prepared with ingredients that are sourced locally. For a full wellness experience, the retreat also has a gym, library, swimming pool, and indoor recreation facilities. The Classic Villa offers the ideal environment for rest by combining comfort, elegance, and Kerala’s natural beauty harmoniously.

Consultancy

The Kairali Ayurvedic Group boasts more than 80 years of expertise in the production and practice of traditional Ayurvedic science and a solid track record in manufacturing and selling Ayurvedic products. The team has gained the trust and belief of many customers across India and overseas. We are leaders in operating Ayurvedic Health retreats and centres globally.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group, leveraging its knowledge of Ayurveda, has consistently endeavored to uphold the standards established by its ancestors. It provides consultation to all other businesses and organizations that require improvement and advancement of their operations. It successfully offers comprehensive guidance to esteemed companies for enhancing their current practices and standards.

Kairali is celebrated as the most beautifully designed health farm globally, dedicated to the hospitality of its visitors. With its different sectors to manage the business, the consultancy sector too brushes up its functionality.

Business Plan Presentation followed by a concept and financial modeling.
Supervising and execution of the project-
The Consultant shall supervise the architects to provide the concept drawings/presentation, including – providing mood boards with technical specifications, material descriptions, Bill of Quantities (“BoQ”), and Bill of Material (“BoM”) concerning the Project Plan.
Supervising and consulting with the architect to develop ‘good for construction’ drawings. These drawings shall include (but shall not be limited to) the details about:
Civil and structural work required to be undertaken
Electrical work
Plumbing work
Room and bathroom layout
Lighting plan
HVAC detailing
Landscaping and hardscaping of the properties and
Interior layout, designing of the rooms and other amenities and facilities in the properties.
Supervising and consulting with the architect in order to provide the following:
The functional and aesthetic goals for completion of the Project Plan
Sourcing of art (including paintings, installations etc)
Wall elevations
Furniture presentation
Assistance on material, finish and furnishing analysis, including recommendations and specifications of the same
Sketches and/or presentation boards of all interior selections and materials
Management of the project.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is dedicated to respecting your privacy and providing transparency in how we gather, utilize, and manage your information. This Cookie Policy describes how we use cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website (www.ayurvedichealingvillage.com) to improve your user experience.

1. What are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that our website stores on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet). They enable us to recognize your device, remember your preferences, and enhance your surfing experience. Cookies are frequently used to improve website performance and provide useful insights into user behavior. 

2. How We Use Cookies

We use cookies to guarantee that our website works properly, monitor website performance, personalize content, and display relevant adverts. Our use of cookies falls under the following categories as required by the GDPR framework & ePrivacy Directive (EU), PDPA (Singapore), and PIPA (South Korea):

a. Strictly Necessary 

These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. They allow essential functions including security, accessibility, and session management. Without certain cookies, some aspects of our website may not function properly. 

b. Performance

These cookies collect information about how visitors use our website. They help us analyze traffic patterns, identify areas for improvement, and enhance overall user experience. We use tools such as Google Analytics to track website usage without personally identifying visitors.

c. Functional (Preference)

Functional cookies enable us to remember your preferences, such as language, login credentials, and region, allowing us to give a more personalized experience. 

d. Targeting (Marketing)

We may use cookies to display tailored ads depending on your browsing history. These cookies enable us and third-party advertisers to offer relevant content and track the effectiveness of campaigns.

3. Third-Party Cookies

We may enable reputable third-party service providers to set cookies on our website for analytics, advertising, and social media integration. These third parties may collect information about your browser behaviour across multiple websites. 

4. Managing Cookies

You have full control over your cookie preferences. You can manage or delete cookies at any time by adjusting your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to:

Accept or reject cookies automatically
Delete stored cookies
Block third-party cookies
Set preferences for specific websites
5. Changes to This Cookie Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in technology, legal requirements, or our services. Any updates will be posted on this page with the last updated date mentioned.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns regarding our Cookie Policy, please contact us at:

Website: www.ayurvedichealingvillage.com

Cooking Classes

Food is an essential requirement for enhancing bodily strength and immunity. It can be understood as the interplay of mind and nutrition. When we are in sync, we desire foods that are healthy. But if our mind, body, or soul is out of balance, our connection to our inner intelligence goes awry thus creating an imbalance and attracting a whole lot of problems. Food whose color, smell, taste and touch please the senses and is conducive to health, if taken in accordance with the rules can provide fuel to the fire of digestion; and promote mental health, physical strength and complexion.

The modern philosophy that ‘one size fits all’ does not equate with nutrition and hence it is important to understand that for complete nutrition we need to balance it out. Even if you are exercising and your food is not in accordance, it won’t be of any use.

In Ayurveda, food comes first. Ideal nutrition comes from consuming a variety of fresh foods that are appropriately prepared and eaten with awareness. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, along with the other parameters of health, food is given towering importance and a dedicated unit deals with the proper optimization of food. In this section, students participate in Ayurvedic Cooking Classes that teach them the principles and techniques of healthy cooking.

Students have to undergo a course that teaches them to develop a comprehensive approach towards Ayurveda while making them accustomed to the principles behind Ayurvedic cooking. They are taught the ways to balance doshas via food, and the relationship between Ayurvedic cuisine and vegetarian food.

They also learn why Ayurvedic cuisine is strictly vegetarian and how the use of herbs in the diet enhances its rejuvenating properties while simultaneously augmenting its taste. The cooking class is one of the best ways to ease the mind in this village.

Cooking Classes

Food is an essential requirement for enhancing bodily strength and immunity. It can be understood as the interplay of mind and nutrition. When we are in sync, we desire foods that are healthy. But if our mind, body, or soul is out of balance, our connection to our inner intelligence goes awry thus creating an imbalance and attracting a whole lot of problems. Food whose color, smell, taste and touch please the senses and is conducive to health, if taken in accordance with the rules can provide fuel to the fire of digestion; and promote mental health, physical strength and complexion.

The modern philosophy that ‘one size fits all’ does not equate with nutrition and hence it is important to understand that for complete nutrition we need to balance it out. Even if you are exercising and your food is not in accordance, it won’t be of any use.

In Ayurveda, food comes first. Ideal nutrition comes from consuming a variety of fresh foods that are appropriately prepared and eaten with awareness. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, along with the other parameters of health, food is given towering importance and a dedicated unit deals with the proper optimization of food. In this section, students participate in Ayurvedic Cooking Classes that teach them the principles and techniques of healthy cooking.

Students have to undergo a course that teaches them to develop a comprehensive approach towards Ayurveda while making them accustomed to the principles behind Ayurvedic cooking. They are taught the ways to balance doshas via food, and the relationship between Ayurvedic cuisine and vegetarian food.

They also learn why Ayurvedic cuisine is strictly vegetarian and how the use of herbs in the diet enhances its rejuvenating properties while simultaneously augmenting its taste. The cooking class is one of the best ways to ease the mind in this village.

Kathakali

The ancient and classical dance drama Kathakali depicts a devotional act and the universal conflict between good and evil. The dance style uses choreography, hand gestures, facial expressions, and years of training to portray Indian tradition.

Makeup and headdresses, followed by colorful costumes worn by different characters, are the symbolism of Kathakali, which demands a great deal of work. Folk mythologies, religious traditions, and the spiritual concepts of Hindu epics are all exemplified by Kathakali, an otherworldly and wonderful aspect that makes the entire dance extraordinary.

Dance is unique because of its storytelling style, superb footwork, and striking facial and hand movements that are complemented by vocal and musical performances. The ancient martial arts and athletic customs that are common in Kerala and the surrounding areas are reflected in the elaborate and vibrant makeup, distinctive face masks, and costumes, as well as the unrivaled style and moves. Traditionally, male dancers perform it.

Mohiniyattam

Mohiniyattam, Kerala’s traditional dance style, has its origins in Hindu mythology. The enchantress “Mohini” is shown dancing in the flowing motions. With her elixir-restoring beautiful motions, ardent eyes, and oscillating dancing steps, she captivated devils. It’s a visual treat, with women wearing modest, exquisite dresses with gold filigree in ivory or pure white. This impression goes really well with the melodious music that goes with the dance. Facial expressions are highly valued in this dance style, similar to Kathakali, and dancers must be excellent actors to convey them in the best possible way. Popular throughout the Chera dynasty from the ninth to the twelfth centuries, Mohiniyattam is a highly stylized, feminine dancing style.

Bharatanatyam

South India is the birthplace of Bharatanatyam, one of the oldest styles of classical dance. “Bharatanatyam” is the name of a dance style that incorporates bhava(expression), tala(rhythm), and raga (melody). Hindu religious themes and spiritual concepts are illustrated through dancers’ amazing footwork and striking gestures. Among its repertoire of performances are Nrita (Pure dance), Nritya(expressive dance), and Natya(dramatic storytelling). Across the nation, the dance style serves as an inspiration for a variety of artistic mediums, such as sculpture and painting. It is a challenging dance style that calls for dedication, years of practice, intense facial expressions, exceptional acting ability, and intricate foot and body movements.

Chenda

Among Kerala’s many percussion art forms, the Chenda, a percussion instrument, holds a distinct place. The magnificent instrument is seen as inevitable and is utilized extensively in practically every Keralan event. The player beats intricate rhythms on the drum surface using specialized sticks. The instrument’s cylindrical wooden body is composed of cassia fistula, sugar palm, white teak, and jackfruit tree wood. The unique feature is that the wood is from the centre of the jackfruit tree.

Kalari

Kalari Payattu is a martial art practiced in a unique type of gymnasium called Kalari. The unique training in “Marma”, or the art of understanding and triggering each of the 107 energy spots in the human body, is a significant aspect of Kalari. The purpose of these marmas, or vital places, is to restore the body’s resources and balance its energy flows. Thus, Kalari transforms the practitioner into a self-healer as well as a warrior who may use his healing abilities to assist others.

Kalari has its own Ayurvedic medical specialty that treats injuries, physical ailments, and dislocations. These methods are used in conjunction with massages to relieve muscle soreness and improve body flexibility. Although Kalari’s popularity declined in the 17th century, it is currently fast increasing in the state of Kerala.

Treatment is personalized based on your constitution (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) to eliminate toxins and rejuvenate tissues. Ayurvedic treatments excel in tackling drug and alcohol addictions, delivering transformation in the recovery process. Wellness retreats offer an ideal setting for those seeking liberation from harmful substances, immersing participants in a nurturing environment for physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. Tailored Ayurvedic therapies, including Panchakarma, detoxify and rejuvenate, restoring balance to address addiction’s root causes and ensure enduring recovery. Wellness retreats embrace a holistic approach, integrating yoga, meditation, and personalized Ayurvedic-based diets. Choosing a wellness retreat for rehabilitation opens doors to a transformative journey toward freedom from addiction. Process Involved in Addiction Recovery & Behavioral Health Therapy

The process of removing addictions to drugs and alcohol involves a comprehensive and personalized approach that we have successfully implemented at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village. Here’s an overview of the process to help you understand how we can support your journey towards recovery:

01

Assessment: Our experienced doctors will conduct a thorough assessment to understand your unique situation, addiction history, and any underlying factors contributing to the addiction.

02

Detoxification: Trained therapists will employ Ayurvedic therapies, including Panchakarma, to facilitate the gentle and natural detoxification of your body, eliminating accumulated toxins caused by substance abuse.

03

Rejuvenation: Through a combination of Ayurvedic treatments, herbal remedies, and personalized diet plans, we help rejuvenate your body, mind, and spirit. This promotes healing and restores balance, enhancing your overall well-being.

04

Lifestyle Modification: Ayurvedic health practitioners will guide you in making positive lifestyle changes to support your recovery. This may include incorporating healthy habits, stress-management techniques, and regular exercise into your daily routine.

05

Yoga and Meditation: Our wellness retreat emphasizes the power of yoga and meditation to cultivate inner strength, clarity, and peace. These practices aid in managing cravings, reducing anxiety, and promoting emotional stability.

06

Education and Support: We provide educational workshops and counseling sessions to help you understand the root causes of addiction, develop coping mechanisms, and build a strong support network for long-term recovery.

07

Follow-up Care: Even after your stay our team continue to offer support and guidance to ensure your sustained recovery. This includes personalized aftercare plans and resources to help you maintain a drug and alcohol-free lifestyle.

◆
Serene Retreat Environment: Escape daily distractions in our peaceful retreat, where expert guidance and support pave your path to freedom.

Ayurveda offers ancient remedies to help overcome alcohol and tobacco addiction, promoting holistic healing. Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s Ayurvedic Addiction Recovery Program aims to restore balance and detoxify the body.

Treatment is personalized based on your constitution (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) to eliminate toxins and rejuvenate tissues. It includes Panchakarma for complete detoxification and psychological therapies like individual and spiritual counselling, awareness classes, prayer sessions, yoga therapy, relaxation techniques, and meditation to aid recovery.

History of Addiction Recovery & Behavioral Health Therapy

Ayurvedic treatments excel in tackling drug and alcohol addictions, delivering transformation in the recovery process. Wellness retreats offer an ideal setting for those seeking liberation from harmful substances, immersing participants in a nurturing environment for physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. Tailored Ayurvedic therapies, including Panchakarma, detoxify and rejuvenate, restoring balance to address addiction’s root causes and ensure enduring recovery. Wellness retreats embrace a holistic approach, integrating yoga, meditation, and personalized Ayurvedic-based diets. This comprehensive strategy not only helps individuals conquer addiction but also cultivates healthy habits and coping mechanisms for lasting recovery. Choosing a wellness retreat for rehabilitation opens doors to a transformative journey toward freedom from addiction. Place trust in our expertise and the proven effectiveness of Ayurvedic treatments as you embark on the path to recovery and a life of wellness.

Process Involved in Addiction Recovery & Behavioral Health Therapy

The process of removing addictions to drugs and alcohol involves a comprehensive and personalized approach that we have successfully implemented at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village. Here’s an overview of the process to help you understand how we can support your journey towards recovery:

01

Assessment: Our experienced doctors will conduct a thorough assessment to understand your unique situation, addiction history, and any underlying factors contributing to the addiction.

02

Detoxification: Trained therapists will employ Ayurvedic therapies, including Panchakarma, to facilitate the gentle and natural detoxification of your body, eliminating accumulated toxins caused by substance abuse.

03

Rejuvenation: Through a combination of Ayurvedic treatments, herbal remedies, and personalized diet plans, we help rejuvenate your body, mind, and spirit. This promotes healing and restores balance, enhancing your overall well-being.

04

Lifestyle Modification: Ayurvedic health practitioners will guide you in making positive lifestyle changes to support your recovery. This may include incorporating healthy habits, stress-management techniques, and regular exercise into your daily routine.

05

Yoga and Meditation: Our wellness retreat emphasizes the power of yoga and meditation to cultivate inner strength, clarity, and peace. These practices aid in managing cravings, reducing anxiety, and promoting emotional stability.

06

Education and Support: We provide educational workshops and counseling sessions to help you understand the root causes of addiction, develop coping mechanisms, and build a strong support network for long-term recovery.

07

Follow-up Care: Even after your stay our team continue to offer support and guidance to ensure your sustained recovery. This includes personalized aftercare plans and resources to help you maintain a drug and alcohol-free lifestyle.

◆
Proven Effectiveness: Our Ayurvedic treatments blend ancient wisdom with modern techniques, effectively addressing addiction for lasting recovery.
◆
Personalized Approach: Tailored to your unique needs, our herbal therapies for addiction recovery target the root causes of addiction with personalized treatment plans.
◆
Holistic Healing: Beyond detox, we rejuvenate the mind and body through Ayurvedic therapies, diet, yoga, and meditation, ensuring comprehensive wellness.
◆
Serene Retreat Environment: Escape daily distractions in our peaceful retreat, where expert guidance and support pave your path to freedom.
