Defence and Paramilitary Forces

Defence and Paramilitary Forces Offer

We, at Kairali, salute the indomitable spirit of our brave soldiers, who weather harshest terrains and conditions to ensure the safety and integrity of our great nation. Whether there is an attack from the enemy along the border or some natural calamity affecting the people within the country, you are always there to help and save others lives by sacfrificing years. Our Army, Navy, and Air force are the pride of the nation, and we would like to thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Your body goes through so many rigors on daily basis that there is a want to tend to its needs also. As a small token of our gratitude, we would like to invite you to rejuvenate your body at Kairali’s Ayurvedic Healing Village located at Palakkad in Kerala. With the help of our authentic Ayurvedic Healing Programs along with yoga and meditation training, your body will be rid of all toxins and stresses, helping you feel reinvigorated. Kairali is offering up to 20% discount enchantingly on all our treatment packages at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village for our defense and paramilitary force personnel and their family members.

Come and experience the combined power of Ayurveda, Yoga and Meditation & revitalize yourself from within.

For more details about the packages offered at the Ayurvedic Healing Village, please Click Here

*Terms and Conditions:

Bookings made under Military citizen Discount Scheme are changeable and cancellable.

This offer is only applicable for online/offline booking.

Kairali will provide up to 20% discount on Booking amount only.

All applicable fees/taxes payable by the Customer.

This offer is applicable for Army, Navy, Air force Citizens.

About Kairali

KAIRALI AYURVEDIC GROUP is headed by joint Managing Directors Mrs. Gita Ramesh and Mr. K.V. Ramesh, both of whom hail from a long family lineage of traditional Ayurvedic doctors. Blessed with a legacy of expertise emanating from such renowned physicians as the late Dr. Sankunny Vaidiar (grandfather of Mr. K. V. Ramesh) and the Dr. K. S. Vasudevan (father of Mr. K. V. Ramesh), Kairali Group was established on a solid ground of Ayurveda research. Since its inception, Kairali has built on the achievements of its forefathers, developing its product infrastructure to make a diverse range of Ayurvedic products available to a multi-national audience.

TREATMENT CENTRES Keen to promote the healing effects of an Ayurvedic lifestyle, Kairali established our first Treatment Centre in New Delhi, 1989. The success of the treatments and therapies provided there led to the proliferation of demand for Kairali facilities. Our Treatment Centres can now be found throughout India, and we remain an industry favourite for education and staff training. Our regular workshops and training courses attract the participation of doctors, dieticians and therapists from all over the world.

HOSPITALITY & HEALTHCARE With an excellent infrastructure firmly in place, Kairali established their signature Kerala Retreat in 1997. An award-winning retreat centre set in the inspiring tropical forest location of Palakkad, The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers the epitome of modern holistic luxury. The retreat centre is surrounded by fifty acres of organic herbal farmland, and represents a sustainable healing community for guests seeking Panchakarma, detox and yoga retreats. Since the establishment of their Hospitality division, Kairali’s international profile has grown significantly, leading to two further resorts in India, and the proliferation of spa franchises over three continents.

AYURVEDIC MEDICINE Kairali’s Ayurvedic Herbal Remedies have an impressive legacy in the family’s heritage. Established in 1948 by Dr. K. S. Vasudevan, father of Mr. K.V. Ramesh, Spalabs has been responsible for the creation of several best-selling formulas and health supplements. Based on authentic Ayurvedic ingredients and the traditional processes of our ancient scripture, these original recipes have undergone continuous improvement over the course of the last sixty years, resulting in our modern range of Ayurvedic Herbal Remedies. Kairali’s wide range of Ayurvedic products includes a hundred authentic herbal medicines, skin care, body products and spa equipment, available to our partners and spa franchisees for distribution at their outlets.

About Kairali

KAIRALI AYURVEDIC GROUP is headed by joint Managing Directors Mrs. Gita Ramesh and Mr. K.V. Ramesh, both of whom hail from a long family lineage of traditional Ayurvedic doctors. Blessed with a legacy of expertise emanating from such renowned physicians as the late Dr. Sankunny Vaidiar (grandfather of Mr. K. V. Ramesh) and the Dr. K. S. Vasudevan (father of Mr. K. V. Ramesh), Kairali Group was established on a solid ground of Ayurveda research. Since its inception, Kairali has built on the achievements of its forefathers, developing its product infrastructure to make a diverse range of Ayurvedic products available to a multi-national audience.

TREATMENT CENTRES Keen to promote the healing effects of an Ayurvedic lifestyle, Kairali established our first Treatment Centre in New Delhi, 1989. The success of the treatments and therapies provided there led to the proliferation of demand for Kairali facilities. Our Treatment Centres can now be found throughout India, and we remain an industry favourite for education and staff training. Our regular workshops and training courses attract the participation of doctors, dieticians and therapists from all over the world.

HOSPITALITY & HEALTHCARE With an excellent infrastructure firmly in place, Kairali established their signature Kerala Retreat in 1997. An award-winning retreat centre set in the inspiring tropical forest location of Palakkad, The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers the epitome of modern holistic luxury. The retreat centre is surrounded by fifty acres of organic herbal farmland, and represents a sustainable healing community for guests seeking Panchakarma, detox and yoga retreats. Since the establishment of their Hospitality division, Kairali’s international profile has grown significantly, leading to two further resorts in India, and the proliferation of spa franchises over three continents.

AYURVEDIC MEDICINE Kairali’s Ayurvedic Herbal Remedies have an impressive legacy in the family’s heritage. Established in 1948 by Dr. K. S. Vasudevan, father of Mr. K.V. Ramesh, Spalabs has been responsible for the creation of several best-selling formulas and health supplements. Based on authentic Ayurvedic ingredients and the traditional processes of our ancient scripture, these original recipes have undergone continuous improvement over the course of the last sixty years, resulting in our modern range of Ayurvedic Herbal Remedies. Kairali’s wide range of Ayurvedic products includes a hundred authentic herbal medicines, skin care, body products and spa equipment, available to our partners and spa franchisees for distribution at their outlets.

Destination Palakkad: Explore Serenity and Culture with the Ayurvedic Healing Village

Nestled in the heart of Kerala, Palakkad is a picturesque destination celebrated for its lush greenery, rich cultural heritage, and serene ambiance. Known as the “Gateway of Kerala,” this charming district seamlessly blends the tranquility of nature with the vibrant essence of tradition. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, located in Palakkad, you have the perfect base to explore this enchanting destination while immersing yourself in authentic Ayurvedic therapies and holistic wellness.

Why Visit Palakkad?

Palakkad offers a unique blend of natural beauty and cultural richness, making it an ideal destination for travelers seeking peace, rejuvenation, and exploration. Here are some reasons why Palakkad stands out:

Natural Splendor:
Palakkad is a land of endless paddy fields, rolling hills, and serene rivers.
The Western Ghats create a dramatic backdrop, offering stunning vistas and diverse flora and fauna.
Silent Valley National Park, one of the world’s most ecologically diverse areas, is located nearby.

Rich Cultural Heritage:
Palakkad is home to ancient temples, historic forts, and traditional festivals that celebrate Kerala’s vibrant culture.
The district has preserved its heritage through art forms like Kathakali, Carnatic music, and classical dance.

Agricultural Abundance:
Often referred to as the “Rice Bowl of Kerala,” Palakkad’s fertile lands are dotted with vast fields of paddy, coconut, and spices.
Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: Your Wellness Retreat

Located in the serene landscapes of Palakkad, the Healing Village is a sanctuary of tranquility and well-being. It offers an immersive experience where you can connect with nature, rejuvenate your body and mind, and explore the cultural treasures of Palakkad.

Wellness Offerings:
Authentic Ayurveda: Experience personalized treatments and therapies like Panchakarma, Abhyangam, and Shirodhara, guided by expert practitioners.
Yoga and Meditation: Participate in daily sessions designed to align your body, mind, and spirit.
Sustainable Living: Stay in eco-friendly cottages that blend harmoniously with the natural surroundings.
Top Attractions in Palakkad

When you stay at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, you are perfectly positioned to explore the many wonders of Palakkad:

Palakkad Fort: A well-preserved 18th-century fort built by Hyder Ali, this historic site offers a glimpse into the region’s colonial past.

Silent Valley National Park: This UNESCO World Heritage Site is a haven for nature lovers, offering trekking opportunities and the chance to see rare wildlife.

Malampuzha Dam and Gardens: Enjoy a relaxing day at this scenic spot, featuring lush gardens, a ropeway, and boating facilities.

Nelliyampathy Hills: Known as the “Ooty of Kerala,” these hills are perfect for trekking, picnics, and breathtaking views.

Kalpathy Heritage Village: Visit this historic village famous for its Vedic community, ancient temples, and annual chariot festival.

Parambikulam Tiger Reserve: A must-visit for wildlife enthusiasts, this reserve is home to tigers, elephants, and other exotic species.
Cultural Experiences in Palakkad

Palakkad is a treasure trove of cultural experiences. Witness traditional music and dance performances, visit heritage sites, and participate in local festivals such as:

Kalpathy Ratholsavam: A vibrant chariot festival celebrated at the ancient Kalpathy Vishwanatha Swamy Temple.
Navaratri Festival: A grand celebration of art, culture, and spirituality in Palakkad’s temples.
A Gateway to Wellness and Exploration

Palakkad offers an unparalleled blend of tranquility, natural beauty, and cultural richness. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, you can experience the best of Palakkad while enjoying world-class Ayurvedic therapies and wellness programs. Whether you seek relaxation, spiritual growth, or an adventurous exploration of Kerala’s treasures, Palakkad is the perfect destination.

Plan Your Visit to Palakkad Today

Discover the serene charm of Palakkad with Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village as your home base. Let us guide you on a journey of rejuvenation, exploration, and cultural discovery in this enchanting corner of Kerala. Begin your transformative experience and embrace the beauty of “God’s Own Country.”

PROGRAM DETAILS
About the Program

Your gut is the key to well-being. The digestive wellness yoga program at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a dedicated retreat aimed at improving gut health, harmonizing digestive fire (Agni), and fostering overall wellness through a holistic blend of yoga therapy, Ayurvedic treatments, and sattvic nutrition. This ayurvedic gut health therapy integrates carefully selected asanas, pranayama, and pranavmukthasna kriya to stimulate the digestive organs, and basic dietary recommendations to stimulate Agni (digestive fire), alleviate bloating, and promote gut harmony. Every session is guided by knowledgeable instructors who concentrate on posture, breathing, and intentional movement. Perfect for individuals facing issues like acidity, constipation, IBS, or slow digestion, the holistic Ayurvedic program for Gut issues encourages natural recovery, enhanced metabolism, and general wellness. Appropriate for every level, it’s a soothing yet impactful path to digestive balance.

OUR APPROACH TO
Digestive Wellness & Gut Health Yoga Therapy

Kairali’s Yoga and Ayurveda for gut cleansing program combines traditional Ayurvedic knowledge with therapeutic yoga to stimulate and harmonize Agni (digestive fire) for ideal gut health. Led by knowledgeable wellness professionals, the program features targeted asanas, pranayama, and kriyas that enhance digestion, remove toxins, and alleviate issues such as indigestion, bloating, and constipation. Herbal infusions, sattvic dishes, and lifestyle tips promote inner balance. Located in a tranquil, natural setting, the experience is profoundly restorative, reestablishing gut harmony via movement, breath, and conscious living. Kairali’s natural treatment for digestive disorders guarantees enduring digestive health, grounded in nature, supported by tradition, and in harmony with the body’s innate healing system.

Process Involved in Digestive Wellness & Gut Health Yoga Therapy

Digestive Wellness & Gut Health Yoga Therapy at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village includes the following steps:

01

Consultation: We begin with a thorough consultation to understand your medical history, symptoms, and lifestyle. This helps us determine your unique dosha imbalance and design a personalized treatment plan.

02

Diagnosis: Through pulse examination (Nadi Pariksha) and visual examination (Darshana Pariksha), we assess the dosha imbalance and identify the root cause of your condition.

03

Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, we create a comprehensive treatment plan that includes a combination of therapies, herbal medications, dietary recommendations, and lifestyle modifications.

04

Ayurvedic Therapies: Our therapies include abhyangam, dharas, podikizhi, navarakizhi, virechanam, matravasti,kashayavasti, etc, based on the body type and dosha balance.

05

Private Yoga Sessions: Exclusive 2-hour personalized sessions (Theory + Practical) of Asanas, Pranayama, Pavanamukthasana Kriya, and Agnisara Kriya with Pranayama to enhance digestion, stimulate agni (digestive fire), and restore gut harmony.

06

Herbal Medications: Doctors prescribe Ayurvedic medications made from natural herbs to support the internal healing process and strengthen the body.

07

Dietary and Lifestyle Guidance: Ayurvedic doctors will provide dietary recommendations tailored to your dosha imbalance and suggest lifestyle modifications to maintain balance and prevent further aggravation of symptoms.

08

Follow-up and Monitoring: We schedule regular follow-up sessions to track your progress, make necessary adjustments to the treatment plan, and provide ongoing support and guidance.

Why should one go with this treatment?
◆
Leverage 118+ years of expertise with an experienced team of Ayurvedic doctors. Our holistic approach prioritizes well-being, going beyond symptom management.
◆
Experience personalized treatments for your constitution and dosha imbalance. We follow Ayurvedic principles using natural therapies and herbs to minimize side effects.
◆
Deepen your understanding of Ayurvedic principles, your condition’s causes, and our treatment mechanisms. This empowers active participation in your healing journey and informed health decisions.
◆
Escape daily stress in our serene retreat. Get full support from our team with follow-ups, progress monitoring, and treatment plan adjustments as required.

Elephant Safari
Discover the Beauty of Nature and the Majesty of Elephants

Nature offers a wealth of experiences to those who embrace its unspoiled beauty. Among its many marvels, elephants stand out as some of the most magnificent creatures on Earth. Their grandeur and gentle presence captivate the heart, making encounters with them truly unforgettable. For anyone eager to witness these majestic animals in their natural habitat, few places rival the charm of Kerala.

An elephant safari is an exciting way to immerse yourself in nature, offering close-up views of these gentle giants. Watching them playfully bathe and splash water is a delightful spectacle that leaves visitors in awe. Kerala, with its lush landscapes, is home to numerous wildlife sanctuaries, including the renowned Periyar National Park, nestled in the mountainous Western Ghats. This sanctuary serves as a haven for elephants and showcases the harmonious coexistence between humans and wildlife.

The pristine wilderness of Kerala remains largely unspoiled, providing an ideal backdrop for exploring its diverse ecosystems. An elephant ride through dense woodlands and abundant wildlife offers a unique perspective of the natural world. Periyar National Park, known for its century-old artificial lake and rich biodiversity, is a sanctuary not just for elephants but also for a wide range of wildlife. Visitors might encounter tigers, leopards, wild dogs, barking deer, Nilgiri langurs, wild boar, Indian bison, and more.

Elephant Safaris are a sought-after activity for tourists, offering a tranquil journey through scenic routes that often pass through fragrant plantations. As you ride, a gentle breeze carries the refreshing scents of the surrounding flora, providing a sensory experience that rejuvenates the mind and spirit.

Whether you are a nature lover, a wildlife enthusiast, or simply seeking a unique adventure, exploring these landscapes alongside elephants is an enriching way to connect with nature and create lasting memories.

Patient Enquiry · Kerala, India

Start a conversation with our care team

Whether you have a quick question or you’re planning a treatment programme, the fastest way in is a message to Priya. Every channel reaches a real member of our team — and most replies come the same day.

Message Priya on WhatsApp Or call: +919555156156

Enquiry received: Our care team reviews your enquiry and schedules a call.
Pre-arrival consult, if needed: An Ayurvedic physician reviews any major health concerns before your arrival.
Booking & arrival: You’ll receive your booking confirmation email and pre-arrival guidance.

Programmes are individually scheduled around physician availability. October–March dates typically fill 8–10 weeks ahead — earlier enquiries have the widest choice of dates.

We reply in English and Hindi · German and French enquiries welcome.

Priya Patient Care Coordinator Kerala · IST

Tell me what’s on your mind — I’ll help you understand your options, with no pressure at all. Most people hear back from me the same day.
This contact is for time-sensitive enquiries and documentation only. For medical emergencies, please contact local emergency services or your nearest hospital.

— Priya, on how she works with patients

Choose how you’d like to reach us

Six ways in — same team behind every one. Each card tells you what it’s best for and what to expect.

Recommended

Fastest · Personal

Message Priya on WhatsApp

Quick questions, sharing prescriptions or reports, planning your stay.

HowOpens WhatsApp with a short message ready to send. Priya replies personally — not a bot. ExpectA reply within working hours, usually the same day.

HowOpens a small panel on this page with your channel options and a one-line message box. ExpectImmediate options; a reply within working hours.

Open chat panel

Send your enquiry

A detailed enquiry, a family or group, or if you’d like a written programme proposal.

HowTwo quick details and an optional note. Reviewed by the care team and, where relevant, a physician. ExpectA considered reply by email or phone within 24 hours.

Go to the form

Send your enquiry

Two details. That’s all we need to begin.

Tell us how to reach you and, if you like, a little about what brings you to us. There’s no long form to fill — our care team takes it from there.

Reviewed by a real member of our care team
A physician is involved where your enquiry needs it
A reply within 24 hours, by email or phone
Your details stay private and are never shared

In our patients’ words

Recent reflections from people we have cared for. Shared with permission.

with

Gita RameshCo-founder · author & Ayurvedic chef

★★★★★

I arrived unsure and a little nervous. The physician took real time to explain everything, and someone checked on me every single day. I left feeling genuinely looked after.

R. M. · Bengaluru, India · Panchakarma programme

★★★★★

Booking from London, I expected the coordination to be hard. Priya answered every question on WhatsApp, often within the hour. The standard of care matched anything at home.

S. N. · London, UK · Rejuvenation programme

★★★★★

Professional and structured from the very first email. The daily physician consultations and a clear programme schedule gave me complete confidence throughout.

T. K. · Munich, Germany · Panchakarma programme

Pattambi Nercha
Festival Month: January to early March

The celebration of Pattambi Nercha honors Aloor Valiya Poolunjikoya Thangal, a pious Muslim from Malabar. Traditional musical ensembles such as Panchavadyam and Thayambaka are performed during this celebration. Art forms assume a breathtaking magnificence as the procession comes to an end on the riverbanks at midnight.

Konganpada of Chittur
Festival Month: February / March

Konganpada is a colorful celebration commemorating the Nairs of Chittur’s triumphs over the Konganadu (Coimbatore) militia, which was led by the Chola King Rajadhi Raja. It also commemorates their victory over the Kongus. It takes place in Kumbham on the first Monday following the gloomy lunar twilight. An hour-long drumming performance closes out the festival.

Nenmara Vallangi Vela
Festival Month: February / March

Palakkad village’s Nellikulangara Bhagavathy temple is the site of this celebration. The inhabitants of Nenmara and Vallangi villages jointly celebrate the Nellikulangara Bhagavathy on Pooram day of the Malayalam month of Meenam. A traditional flag-hoisting ceremony (Kodiyettam) kicks off the celebration. In addition to thirty adorned elephants, a variety of artistic disciplines, including Karivela, Kummatti, and Andivela, are displayed under an ornate canopy. Thrissur Pooram considers this group of two villages to be of the second highest importance.

Thrissur Pooram (At Thrissur)
Festival Month: April

The search for the best elephants begins in early April, and tenancies of elegant elephants are delivered to Thrissur for the Thrissur Pooram celebrations. The Cochin royal family founded the event in the 18th century to honor Vadakkumnathan Shiva. Elephants transport the deity during festival processions and temple circumambulations. The temple elephants are adorned with gold-plated caparisons (nettipattam), bells, and necklaces. People riding elephants hold tinseled silk parasols aloft, waving white tufts, and peacock feather fans to the beat of the music. Drums and nadhaswarams create devout musical scenes featuring elephants facing each other. The festival’s finale is a spectacular fireworks display.

Onam
Festival Month: August / September

Onam, the grand harvest festival of Kerala, is a vibrant celebration symbolizing unity, prosperity, and cultural heritage. This 10-day festival marks the homecoming of King Mahabali and showcases Kerala’s traditions through elaborate flower carpets (Pookalam), traditional dances like Kathakali and Thiruvathira, and the famous Onasadya feast served on banana leaves. Vallamkali (snake boat races) on serene backwaters and cultural performances add to the festive spirit. Onam reflects the essence of harmony and gratitude, bringing families and communities together to honor a bountiful harvest and cherish the richness of Kerala’s history and traditions. Wishing everyone a joyous and prosperous Onam!

PAST RETREAT

Food Sadhana

This page preserves the Food Sadhana retreat material and its 2017 highlights. The programme, inclusions and book-release reference are historical and are not current booking terms.

Past Retreats

Historical retreat description
Food Sadhana: The Essence of Purity

In the journey to understand the Self, it is essential to begin with the obvious and progress to the finer aspects. The most essential element of our overall existence is food; it influences not just our physical body, but also our energetic self and mind! However, despite the essential role food plays in our physical and spiritual health, it frequently gets neglected or overshadowed by the demands of contemporary life. Food Sadhana encompasses a collection of spiritual practices and a lifestyle that acknowledges the sacred essence of our food – including what we consume, how it is prepared, how it is ingested, how it is processed, and how it exits the body – aiming to transform the individual into a living temple of the Self; a temple that is pristine and pure, where devotion and meditation continuously and effortlessly thrive.

When integrated with the principles of Ayurveda, Food Sadhana transforms into an intensely personal experience, yet a thoughtful, knowledgeable one.

Come and participate in the esteemed Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Kerala for a 9-day immersive Food Sadhana retreat. Pandit Dabral will lead you into the profound realm of the practical philosophy of Food Sadhana through daily satsang rooted in the Himalayan Tradition’s oral heritage. Pandit Tejomaya will lead you in the physical exercises that promote a clean and healthy body for a Food Sadhaka. The expert team of Ayurvedic doctors and personnel from Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village will provide customized therapies and amazing meals to make all of the practices a reality in your life!

This is a unique chance to elevate your sadhana to a level you never thought could be achieved.

Retreat Includes:
Daily Dhyana (Meditation) Practice
Daily Asana (Posture) Practice
Daily Pranayama (Breath) Practice
Daily Satang (Teachings) on Food Sadhana
Daily Ayurvedic Treatment
Delicious Ayurvedic Meals

What To Expect From The Retreat:

If all spiritual practices were reduced to a single word, it would be “purification”. Participants in Food Sadhana retreat will acquire the practical skills to intelligently, yet simply purify their lives by harmonizing the spiritual qualities of food with the essential nature of ourselves as spiritual beings.

Attendees of the Food Sadhana retreat will gain practical abilities to thoughtfully, yet straightforwardly, cleanse their lives by aligning the spiritual attributes of food with our fundamental essence as spiritual beings.

Our practical satsang sessions and physical practice sessions will explore such topics as:

“The Spiritual Purpose of Life Itself”
“Ayurveda for Daily Living: Understanding Your Constitution”
“What To Eat: The Practical Side of Purification”
“How to Cook: Techniques, Attitudes and Mantras in the Kitchen”
“How to Eat: Practices in Mindfulness”
“How to Digest: The Science Within You”
“Seasonal Cleansing and Purification Practices”

Every lesson from the retreat, every practice, every technique, and even all the recipes from the meals provided during the retreat will be featured in our book “Food Sadhana.” Every participant of the retreat will get a complimentary copy of the book once it is released in spring 2018.

About: Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village

The Ayurvedic Healing Village is located amid 65 acres of vibrant greenery in Palakkad, Kerala. It features 30 unique villas, all adhering to “Vastu Shastra” design – the Indian interpretation of feng shui. The retreat is enveloped by herbs and trees that possess great healing and rejuvenating properties, creating the perfect tranquil haven for relaxation! There is a large swimming pool, tennis facility, library, and gym amenities.

The retreat provides top-quality Ayurvedic therapies and therapeutic massages, featuring highly skilled massage therapists and physicians. They provide numerous therapies, such as Abhyangam, Pizhichil, Shirodhara, Panchakarma, and more.

Yoga Teachers:
Pandit Hari Shankar Dabral,

Ph.D is the Spiritual Director of The Himalayan Yoga Meditation Centre (HYMC) in Calgary.

Panditji is an experienced teacher in the Himalayan Tradition who is capable of bringing the authentic teachings of the yoga masters to all types of students. People of all ages enjoy his accessibility and humor. His knowledge of Sanskrit and the Yoga Scriptures is vast and comprehensive, yet he is able to explain complex ideas in ways that are easy to understand and apply to daily life. He brings the experiences and knowledge of the Himalayan Sages to life.

PAST RETREAT

Food Sadhana

This page preserves the Food Sadhana retreat material and its 2017 highlights. The programme, inclusions and book-release reference are historical and are not current booking terms.

Past Retreats

Historical retreat description
Food Sadhana: The Essence of Purity

In the journey to understand the Self, it is essential to begin with the obvious and progress to the finer aspects. The most essential element of our overall existence is food; it influences not just our physical body, but also our energetic self and mind! However, despite the essential role food plays in our physical and spiritual health, it frequently gets neglected or overshadowed by the demands of contemporary life. Food Sadhana encompasses a collection of spiritual practices and a lifestyle that acknowledges the sacred essence of our food – including what we consume, how it is prepared, how it is ingested, how it is processed, and how it exits the body – aiming to transform the individual into a living temple of the Self; a temple that is pristine and pure, where devotion and meditation continuously and effortlessly thrive.

When integrated with the principles of Ayurveda, Food Sadhana transforms into an intensely personal experience, yet a thoughtful, knowledgeable one.

Come and participate in the esteemed Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Kerala for a 9-day immersive Food Sadhana retreat. Pandit Dabral will lead you into the profound realm of the practical philosophy of Food Sadhana through daily satsang rooted in the Himalayan Tradition’s oral heritage. Pandit Tejomaya will lead you in the physical exercises that promote a clean and healthy body for a Food Sadhaka. The expert team of Ayurvedic doctors and personnel from Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village will provide customized therapies and amazing meals to make all of the practices a reality in your life!

This is a unique chance to elevate your sadhana to a level you never thought could be achieved.

Retreat Includes:
Daily Dhyana (Meditation) Practice
Daily Asana (Posture) Practice
Daily Pranayama (Breath) Practice
Daily Satang (Teachings) on Food Sadhana
Daily Ayurvedic Treatment
Delicious Ayurvedic Meals
Typical Daily Schedule:
6:00 AM – Tea and Morning Cleansing
7:00 AM – Asana
8:00 AM – Pranayama
8:30 AM – Meditation
9:00 AM – Breakfast
10:30 AM – Morning Satsang
12:00 PM – Food Sadhana Kriyas
12:30 PM – Lunch
1:00 PM – Rest/Ayurvedic Treatment
4:00 PM – Tea
5:00 PM – Asana
6:00 PM – Pranayama
6:30 PM – Dinner
8:00 PM – Evening Satsang
9:00 PM – Bed
What To Expect From The Retreat:

If all spiritual practices were reduced to a single word, it would be “purification”. Participants in Food Sadhana retreat will acquire the practical skills to intelligently, yet simply purify their lives by harmonizing the spiritual qualities of food with the essential nature of ourselves as spiritual beings.

Attendees of the Food Sadhana retreat will gain practical abilities to thoughtfully, yet straightforwardly, cleanse their lives by aligning the spiritual attributes of food with our fundamental essence as spiritual beings.

Our practical satsang sessions and physical practice sessions will explore such topics as:

“The Spiritual Purpose of Life Itself”
“Ayurveda for Daily Living: Understanding Your Constitution”
“What To Eat: The Practical Side of Purification”
“How to Cook: Techniques, Attitudes and Mantras in the Kitchen”
“How to Eat: Practices in Mindfulness”
“How to Digest: The Science Within You”
“Seasonal Cleansing and Purification Practices”

Every lesson from the retreat, every practice, every technique, and even all the recipes from the meals provided during the retreat will be featured in our book “Food Sadhana.” Every participant of the retreat will get a complimentary copy of the book once it is released in spring 2018.

Highlights:

The 2017 Food Sadhana Highlights:

Daily Teachings
Daily Practices
Asana (Postures)
Pranayama (Breath)
Dhyana (Meditation)
Food Sadhana Kriyas (Practices)
Ayurvedic Physician’s Assessment
All Ayurvedic Meals
All Prescribed Ayurvedic Treatment
Ground Transportation to The Ayurvedic Healing Village
About: Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village

The Ayurvedic Healing Village is located amid 65 acres of vibrant greenery in Palakkad, Kerala. It features 30 unique villas, all adhering to “Vastu Shastra” design – the Indian interpretation of feng shui. The retreat is enveloped by herbs and trees that possess great healing and rejuvenating properties, creating the perfect tranquil haven for relaxation! There is a large swimming pool, tennis facility, library, and gym amenities.

The retreat provides top-quality Ayurvedic therapies and therapeutic massages, featuring highly skilled massage therapists and physicians. They provide numerous therapies, such as Abhyangam, Pizhichil, Shirodhara, Panchakarma, and more.

Retreat Does Not Include:
Airfare to from New Delhi and Return
Transportation from Airport to Palakkad and return
Personal incidentals such as souvenirs and Ayurvedic products

Location: Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala

Yoga Teachers:
Pandit Hari Shankar Dabral,

Ph.D is the Spiritual Director of The Himalayan Yoga Meditation Centre (HYMC) in Calgary.

Panditji is an experienced teacher in the Himalayan Tradition who is capable of bringing the authentic teachings of the yoga masters to all types of students. People of all ages enjoy his accessibility and humor. His knowledge of Sanskrit and the Yoga Scriptures is vast and comprehensive, yet he is able to explain complex ideas in ways that are easy to understand and apply to daily life. He brings the experiences and knowledge of the Himalayan Sages to life.

Founder Message

Dear Guests, 

Greetings from Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, a haven where the ageless knowledge of Ayurveda is combined with the necessities of contemporary life. It gives me great pleasure to share with you the core values of Kairali, which are a dedication to holistic wellness, genuine Ayurvedic therapy, and the progress of humankind.

My vision for Kairali Ayurvedic Group has always been firmly based on the age-old science of Ayurveda, which I consider to be the best route to harmony and health. Growing up in a household immersed in Ayurvedic customs, I have personally seen the significant influence it has on people’s lives. This gave me the motivation to devote my life to protecting and introducing the world to this priceless legacy. 

Authenticity and excellence have always been the cornerstones of Kairali. This idea is reflected in Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village. From the therapies and treatments to the calm, environmentally friendly setting, every element of this retreat has been planned to offer a fully immersive Ayurvedic experience. Here, we establish a sanctuary where visitors can discover tranquility, renewal, and balance by fusing traditional customs with contemporary hospitality standards.

Our goal goes beyond providing Ayurvedic care. It is to encourage a way of living that values mental, spiritual, and physical well-being. We aim to enable our guests to live better, more satisfying lives through our customized therapies, therapeutic diets, yoga classes, and meditation techniques. 

Although Kairali Ayurvedic Group has become a well-known brand worldwide throughout the years, our principles have not changed. We are here to act as Ayurveda’s stewards, offering its therapeutic benefits to those who seek them while upholding the integrity that has established our reputation as a leading authority on holistic health.

To everyone who visits Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, I extend my heartfelt gratitude. Your conviction in Ayurveda and Kairali motivates us to innovate and improve continuously. I welcome you to embark on this transforming journey of self-discovery, healing, and regeneration, guided by the timeless principles of Ayurveda. 

Together, let us create a healthier, happier world.Warm regards,
K.V. Ramesh
Managing Director, Kairali Ayurvedic Group

Kairali Leadership

Meet our Directors with Vision of Healthy World
K.V. RAMESH
Managing Director

Mr. K.V. Ramesh, Managing Director and Co-Founder of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, is the guardian of four generations of Ayurvedic knowledge. His journey began in his adolescence when he helped his father, Dr. K.S.V. Vasudevan, prepare Ayurvedic medications, and he observed Ayurveda’s transformative potential firsthand. Beginning with a tiny location in South Delhi, he has evolved Kairali into a global reputation in holistic wellness.

GITA RAMESH
Joint Managing Director

Mrs. Gita Ramesh, Joint Managing Director of Kairali Ayurvedic Group and wife of Mr. K.V. Ramesh has been the organization’s driving force from its establishment. She has been a guiding light and source of inspiration for Kairali, helping it to become one of the world’s leading Ayurvedic firms. Her extensive knowledge of Ayurveda guarantees that Kairali’s retreats & treatment centre provides the finest quality knowledge, techniques, and treatments possible. Her unwavering dedication to quality has established her as a true pioneer in the wellness sector.

K.R. ABHILASH
Director

Mr. K.R. Abhilash, Director of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, continues to uphold and expand the rich legacy passed down by his predecessors. With a vision to showcase the finest of Ayurveda, he has quickly gained recognition for driving growth across Kairali’s pharmaceutical and healing village, while enhancing its core operations. His innovative approach and dedication have earned him numerous accolades early in his career. Under his leadership, Kairali- The Ayurvedic Healing Village has flourished over the years. His expertise lies in implementing world-class health retreats and offering services crafted for indulgence and well-being.

K.R. ABISHEK
Director

Mr. K.R.Abishek is the youngest in the family of Ayurvedic practitioners who also has pledged to dedicate his life to the service of Ayurveda. He is a fellow member of the board of directors. He entered the family business equipped with ideas and great enthusiasm to take the company even further in the world of international hospitality. The face of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s

Give Feedback

Criticism and appreciation are two different but closely related aspects of human comprehension. Both of these have an impact on our future behavior and aid in improving our decision-making. Similar to how experience in any industry is crucial for a person or organization to develop and enhance their attributes, praise or criticism is also necessary to highlight their strengths and weaknesses while providing guidance on how to handle the situation. It is our responsibility to provide proper feedback because, as customers, we are in the best position to describe a service objectively.

An organization’s dedication and commitment to service are just as crucial as its feedback. An organization would not be able to identify systemic problems on its own without appropriate feedback or reviews. This is where the idea of a feedback system enters the picture. Service customers can voice all of their complaints through this mechanism, and the organization can gain insight from their experiences.

To accomplish this, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has a special section titled “Guest Comments and Feedback“. The guests can provide a thorough review of their visit and the type of services they received by answering a specialized questionnaire. Kairali hopes to enhance its already excellent work ethic through this feedback system, ensuring that guests have no problems while they are here.

PROGRAM DETAILS
About the Program

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village combines authentic Ayurveda with modern wellness for deep detoxification and rejuvenation. Our therapies—including Abhyangam (herbal oil massage), Shirodhara (medicated oil on forehead), and Udvarthana (herbal powder massage)—use pure ingredients grown organically on-site.

Whether you’re seeking to bounce back from burnout, break free from chronic stress cycles, or prevent health complications before they start, our expert team crafts bespoke strategies for your total renewal—privately, discreetly, and respectfully.

◆
NABH Certified Hospital

118+ Years Heritage

World Luxury Award Winner
FREE DOCTOR CONSULTATION
ENQUIRE NOW
1908
History & Heritage

Kairali represents more than 118 years of Ayurvedic healing, drawing from Kerala’s rich medical lineage. The Healing Village, set among 65 lush acres at the foothills of the Western Ghats, is built on Vastu Shastra principles with a tranquil, sattvic environment. Over 100,000 patients from 50+ countries have experienced authentic, doctor-supervised Ayurvedic therapies for a spectrum of health conditions.

◆
Tailored Healing: Every protocol is custom-designed for the guest’s body constitution (prakriti), health needs, and goals.
◆
Clinical Excellence: Led by 5th-generation Ayurvedic physicians, each treatment is reviewed for maximum safety and efficacy.
◆
Comprehensive Approach: Integrates Ashtanga Hridayam classical knowledge, pulse diagnosis (Nadi Pariksha), and modern monitoring.
◆
Serene Kerala Setting: 30 villas, private gardens, and organic farm-to-table meals foster optimal rejuvenation.
BOOK MY TREATMENT
Who is This Program For?
◆
Anyone seeking natural healing & holistic wellness
◆
Executives, professionals, or individuals under chronic stress
◆
Individuals ready to enhance their immunity and restore mind-body balance
◆
Those wishing to boost energy, mental clarity, and focus
Awards & Accreditations

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village was proudly awarded as the Best Luxury Yoga & Wellness Retreat Worldwide (Global Win), Best Luxury Wellness Healing Retreat in Asia (Continent Win).

Read more
Worlds Luxury Hotel Awards 2024

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village takes pride in being honored at the prestigious World Luxury Hotel Awards 2024 for Best Luxury Yoga and Wellness Retreat (Global Win).

APSWC 2024

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has been crowned ‘Wellness Resort of the Year’ at the prestigious Asia Pacific Spa & Wellness Coalition (APSWC) Awards 2024.

Read more

29
MORE)
Process Involved in Kairali’s Rejuvenation & Detoxification Program

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village includes the following steps:

01

Comprehensive Health Assessment: Tailored consultation and advanced diagnostics by experienced Ayurvedic physicians to understand your health history, habits, and goals.

02

Ayurvedic Constitution & Imbalance Analysis: In-depth mapping of body-mind imbalances caused by stress or high work demands.

03

Individualized Treatment: No generic plans—your therapies, nutrition, and medicines are designed for your exact needs and schedule.

04

Daily Customized Therapies: Minimum two treatments per day, constantly adapted to your response.

05

Personalized Internal Medicines: Only physician-prescribed, in-house remedies (GMP-certified) for safe, targeted care (charged separately).

06

Nutrition & Lifestyle Coaching: Practical guidance on food, movement, and daily regimes — habits you can carry into everyday life at home.

07

Ongoing Monitoring & Private Doctor Support: Daily plan review and follow-up so you can maintain your progress after you return home.

Why Choose This Program?
◆
Effective Relief from Chronic & Lifestyle Disorders
◆
Hormonal balance, stress reduction, and enhanced mental clarity
◆
92% patient satisfaction from international guests (2024 data)
◆
87% symptom reduction within 14 days, 94% maintain improvements after 6 months
◆
Zero adverse reactions in 100,000+ therapies
BEGIN TREATMENT
Benefits of the Program
◆
Relief from chronic conditions such as digestive disorders, fatigue, and metabolic imbalances
◆
Restoration of hormonal balance, reduction of inflammation, and alleviation of stress-related symptoms
◆
Strengthening of immunity and enhancement of metabolic and digestive functions
◆
Deep mental clarity and emotional calm through holistic mind-body rejuvenation
◆
Sustained wellness through personalized Ayurvedic therapies, diet, and lifestyle guidance tailored to your unique constitution
BEGIN TREATMENT
DOCTOR GUIDANCE
Guided By Ayurveda Experts
Pre-Program

Teleconsultation with an Ayurvedic doctor to understand your needs and design preparatory steps.

During Treatment

You’ll have regular check-ins with the Ayurvedic doctor for progress monitoring and adjustments. Personalized therapies, including massages and herbal treatments, will be administered. Guidance on balanced living, diet, and stress management is provided, with continued doctor support for a safe and effective journey.

Post Treatment

Follow-up consultations with the Ayurvedic doctor assess the effectiveness and offer guidance. You’ll integrate post-treatment practices, like diet and lifestyle recommendations, for sustained benefits. Ongoing support ensures long-term health and addresses any concerns or needs.

FREE DOCTOR CONSULTATION

Activities

Practical Information
Bring: Cotton clothes, medications, recent reports & open mind
Support: Airport transfers & multilingual staff
Daily Activities
Monday

Organic Farm Visit

Connect with Nature’s Pharmacy

Explore our certified organic farm where medicinal herbs and vegetables are grown using traditional sustainable methods. Learn about the journey from seed to medicine.

Identification of 20+ medicinal plants
Organic farming techniques
Harvesting and processing methods
Creating your own herb garden

Duration: 1 Hour

Tuesday

Basic Principles of Ayurveda

Foundation Knowledge Session

Dive deep into the fundamental concepts of Ayurveda. Understand the three doshas, five elements, and how they influence your health and well-being.

Understanding the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha)
Five elements theory (Panchamahabhuta)
Constitutional analysis basics
Health vs. disease in Ayurveda

Duration: 1 Hour

Wednesday

Ayurvedic Cooking Demonstration

Learn Healing Through Food

Discover the art of Ayurvedic cooking with our expert chef. Learn how to prepare nutritious, healing meals using traditional spices and cooking methods.

Six taste theory in Ayurvedic cooking
Therapeutic use of spices and herbs
Dosha-specific meal preparation
Traditional cooking techniques

Duration: 1 Hour

Thursday

Lecture on Yogic Life

Wisdom from Yoga Teacher

Explore the deeper aspects of yogic living beyond physical postures. Learn how to integrate yoga philosophy into modern life for holistic well-being.

Eight limbs of yoga (Ashtanga)
Ethical principles (Yamas & Niyamas)
Breathing techniques (Pranayama)
Meditation practices for daily life

Duration: 1 Hour

Friday

Daily Regimens in Ayurveda

Dinacharya & Ritucharya

Learn the importance of daily and seasonal routines in Ayurveda. Discover how to align your lifestyle with natural rhythms for optimal health.

Ideal daily routine (Dinacharya)
Seasonal lifestyle adjustments
Sleep hygiene principles
Exercise and work-rest balance

Duration: 1 Hour

Saturday

Agriculture Class

Learn from Farm Manager

Get hands-on knowledge about sustainable farming practices. Learn the science behind growing medicinal herbs and organic vegetables from our expert farm manager.

Sustainable farming principles
Soil health and composting
Pest management without chemicals
Seasonal planting strategies

Duration: 1 Hour

Sunday

Do’s and Don’ts on Ayurveda

Expert Guidance by Doctor

Learn essential Ayurvedic principles for daily life. Our experienced doctor will guide you through practical do’s and don’ts to maintain optimal health and prevent diseases naturally.

Ayurvedic lifestyle principles
Foods to eat and avoid for your dosha
Daily routine recommendations
Common mistakes to prevent

Duration: 1 Hour

Routine (Dinacharya)
06:00
Wake up to wellness

Wake up and perform self-care practices (dinacharya) such as tongue scraping, oil pulling, and washing the face.

06:30
Practice Yoga

07:15
Pranayama

08:00
Detoxifying Drink

Enjoy a herbal tea or detoxifying drink to kickstart the metabolism.

08:30
Ayurvedic Breakfast

Ayurvedic breakfast consisting of a light, nourishing meal like cooked oats with fruits or a steamed vegetable dish.

10:00
Wellness Workshop

Participate in a wellness workshop or educational session on Ayurveda and healthy living.

11:00
Nature Walk

Go for a nature walk or engage in a light physical activity to enhance circulation and boost energy levels.

12:00
Herbal Infused Water

Drink herbal-infused water or a digestive tea to stay hydrated.

12:30
Ayurvedic Lunch

Ayurvedic lunch, focusing on a balanced meal with plenty of fresh vegetables, whole grains, and lean protein sources.

13:30
Rest & Relax

Rest and relax for a short while to aid digestion and promote overall well-being.

14:00
Activity

Cooking demonstration / Factory visits / Workshops & Lectures

15:00
Detoxifying Drink

Enjoy a herbal tea or fresh juice as a mid-afternoon revitalizer.

15:30
Ayurvedic Therapy

Engage in an Ayurvedic therapy session, such as Abhyanga (Ayurvedic massage) or Udwarthana (herbal powder massage), to promote detoxification and relaxation.

17:00
Yoga Practice

Practice gentle yoga or pranayama to further enhance the body-mind connection and relieve any accumulated stress or tension.

18:00
Meditation Session

Participate in a guided meditation or mindfulness session to calm the mind and promote emotional balance.

18:30
Ayurvedic Dinner

Ayurvedic dinner consisting of a light, easily digestible meal such as vegetable soup or kitchari (a mixture of rice and lentils).

19:30
Leisure Activities

Engage in leisure activities like reading, journaling, or socializing with fellow retreat participants.

21:00
Relaxing Techniques

Wind down for the day by practicing relaxation techniques, such as gentle stretches or a warm herbal bath.

22:00
Go to Sleep

Prepare for a restful night’s sleep by creating a calming environment and retiring for the night.

The above day plan is a general outline and may vary based on the specific treatment program, individual requirements, and recommendations provided by the Ayurvedic doctor.

TESTIMONIALS

Explore the Natural Splendor of Backwaters and Rivers in Kerala

Nestled amidst majestic hills and shimmering water bodies lies a land blessed with abundant natural beauty—Kerala. Known for its palm-lined beaches, lush mountains, coffee and spice plantations, and serene wildlife, Kerala offers a haven of tranquility and charm. One of its most captivating features is the tranquil stretches of backwaters, a network of canals that make it one of the most sought-after destinations in Asia. These waterways, with their enchanting beauty, are a must-visit for those seeking serenity and pure bliss.

A key contributor to Kerala’s natural charm is its rivers, which flow gracefully through the state, enriching the land with fertility and beauty. These rivers, along with their tributaries, create picturesque landscapes that attract visitors from around the world. The backwaters, framed by swaying palms and dotted with quaint villages, offer a unique way to experience Kerala’s natural allure. One of the best ways to explore this paradise is by embarking on a journey aboard a traditional houseboat, or Kettuvallom.

In earlier times, these houseboats were used for transporting grains and spices. Over time, they were transformed into floating havens for travelers, offering an unparalleled experience of the backwaters. Today, these houseboats are equipped with modern amenities, blending traditional charm with contemporary comfort. Many feature well-designed bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, cozy living areas, and even kitchens. Some luxurious houseboats offer spacious decks or balconies, perfect for enjoying panoramic views of the serene waters and lush greenery.

A houseboat cruise through Kerala’s backwaters offers a unique perspective of rural life. The waterways weave through a complex network of lagoons, lakes, and canals, providing an intimate view of unspoiled natural beauty and vibrant local culture. Guests can enjoy the sights of verdant paddy fields, traditional fishing villages, and the daily rhythms of life along the banks.

Whether you’re a nature lover, a culture enthusiast, or simply seeking relaxation, the backwaters and rivers of Kerala promise an unforgettable experience. With their calm waters, breathtaking views, and the charm of houseboat living, these natural wonders invite you to unwind and reconnect with the beauty of the world around you.

How to Reach
Your route to the Healing Village

GETTING HERE · DIRECTIONS

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is an NABH-accredited Ayurvedic hospital near Palakkad, Kerala, in South India. This page shows you which airport to choose, how our transfers work and exactly what to expect from the moment you land.

Phone hours 8:00 AM–9:00 PM IST, daily

ARRANGE A TRANSFER ON WHATSAPP
CALL THE MAIN LINE

III/73 Palayamkadu, P.O. Olassery, Kodumbu, Palakkad District – 678551, Kerala, India

India›Kerala (south-west coast)›Palakkad District›📍Olassery, Kodumbu — at the foot of the Western Ghats

START HERE

The simplest way to reach us

ARRIVING FROM OUTSIDE INDIA

Fly to Coimbatore (CJB)

The nearest airport — a private car transfer of about 1½–2 hours. Kochi / Cochin (COK) is a good alternative when it has better connections from your country — about 2½–3 hours by road.

Already travelling within India

Palakkad Junction (PGT)

The nearest railhead, about 35 minutes away — or drive in on the NH544 Coimbatore–Kochi corridor.

Coimbatore airport is in the neighbouring state of Tamil Nadu; the hospital is in Kerala. Your transfer crosses the state border by road — this is routine and needs no extra formalities.

ARRANGE A TRANSFER ON WHATSAPP
OPEN DIRECTIONS IN GOOGLE MAPS

WAYS TO REACH US

By air, by rail, by road

However you travel, we can receive you at the airport or railway station with a named driver — you never have to look for a taxi on arrival.

By air

Coimbatore (CJB) — nearest~62 km · ~1½–2 hr

Kochi / Cochin (COK) — alternative~115 km · ~2½–3 hr

On arrival: share your flight number and landing time with us in advance, and a car with a name-board can wait for you.

By rail

Palakkad Junction (PGT) — recommended~18 km · ~35 min

On arrival: taxis wait at the station, or send us your train number and arrival time — we will pick you up.

By road

On the NH544 corridorCoimbatore–Kochi

Self-drive or private taxivia Palakkad

On arrival: follow the signs to Kodumbu and Olassery; call the main line if you need directions on the day.

TRANSFERS FROM AIRPORT & STATION

Let us handle the last leg

The hospital can arrange a private car for your arrival from the airport or railway station. To request one, message our patient care coordinator, Priya, on WhatsApp, or call the main line. Please tell us:

Your arrival date and time
Flight or train number
Number of patients travelling
Any mobility or medical needs

MESSAGE PRIYA ON WHATSAPP

WhatsApp · patient care
+91 92898 38797

Main line
+91 9555 156 156

The main line is answered by an automated menu — press 2 for reservations. Open 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM IST, daily. Transfer and any charges are confirmed by our team at booking.

FIRST TRIP TO INDIAYOUR ARRIVAL IN INDIA

Where we are

Kerala lies on India’s south-west coast. Palakkad District sits inland, on the border between Kerala and Tamil Nadu, at the foot of the Western Ghats. The two airports you are likely to use are Coimbatore (CJB, in Tamil Nadu, the nearest) and Kochi / Cochin (COK, in Kerala) — both connected to the hospital by a straightforward road transfer.

Coimbatore airport (CJB) lies to the east in Tamil Nadu; Kochi airport (COK) to the south-west in Kerala.

Your arrival, step by step

Clear immigration and collect your baggage.
Exit through the arrivals gate.
A Kairali representative receives you with a name-board. You receive the driver’s name and vehicle details before you land.
The driver helps with your luggage and brings you directly to the hospital.
If you cannot find the driver, call or message the arrival number and wait inside the terminal.

Good to know

Local SIM / eSIM

AVAILABLE AT THE AIRPORT — USEFUL FROM THE MOMENT YOU LAND.

WhatsApp

It is how we coordinate your pick-up and stay in touch throughout.

Currency

The Indian Rupee (₹). ATMs are available at both airports.

English

Widely spoken in Kerala; our team communicates in English.

Late-night arrivals. A pre-arranged transfer is strongly recommended — local roads are quiet after dark. Share the driver and vehicle details with someone at home before you set off.

Travelling with mobility or medical needs. A wheelchair-accessible vehicle, breaks during the drive and an accompanying caregiver can be arranged — please tell us at booking.

Visa & entry. Most international visitors need a valid passport and an Indian visa or an eligible e-Visa. Requirements vary by nationality and can change — please check the official Government of India visa portal before you travel. Government of India visa portal

DISTANCES AT A GLANCE

From the main hubs to the hospital
FROM	MODE	DISTANCE	APPROX. TIME
Coimbatore airport (CJB)	By road	~62 km	~1½–2 hr
Kochi / Cochin airport (COK)	By road	~115 km	~2½–3 hr
Palakkad Junction (PGT)	By road	~18 km	~35 min

Distances are measured to the hospital and are approximate; travel times vary with traffic, route and season. Our team can confirm the best option for your arrival.

Kodumbu, Palakkad District, Kerala

VIEW LARGER MAP

BEFORE YOU TRAVEL

Frequently asked questions

Should I fly to Coimbatore or Kochi?Coimbatore (CJB) is the nearest airport, about one and a half to two hours by road, and the simplest arrival for most visitors. Choose Kochi / Cochin (COK) — about two and a half to three hours by road — when it offers a better international connection from your country.

How far is the nearest airport?Coimbatore International Airport (CJB) is the nearest at around 62 km — about one and a half to two hours by car. Kochi / Cochin International Airport (COK) is around 115 km away, about two and a half to three hours by road.

Do you arrange pick-up from the airport or railway station?Yes. The hospital can arrange a private car for arriving patients. Message our patient care team on WhatsApp, or call the main line, and share your arrival date, time and flight or train number. A team member will confirm the driver and vehicle details.

How will I recognise the driver?A Kairali representative waits for you in the arrivals area with a name-board. You receive the driver’s name and vehicle details before you land, so you know exactly who is picking you up.

Is pick-up available for late-evening arrivals?Yes. A pre-arranged transfer is recommended for late arrivals, when local roads are quiet. Share your flight details in advance and your driver will wait for you at any hour.

Can I come by train?Yes. Palakkad Junction (PGT) is the recommended station, around 18 km away — about a 35-minute drive. Taxis are available at the station, or send us your train number and arrival time and we will pick you up.

Is the trip safe for a solo traveller?Kerala is among the calmest regions of India, and English is widely spoken. With a pre-arranged transfer you are met by a named driver, so there is no need to look for a taxi on arrival. Many of our patients travel to us alone.

Can you accommodate a wheelchair or a caregiver?Yes. A wheelchair-accessible vehicle and an accompanying caregiver can be arranged. Please tell us your requirements at booking so the right vehicle is ready.

Do I need an Indian visa?Most international visitors need a valid passport and an Indian visa or an eligible e-Visa. Requirements vary by nationality and can change — please check the official Government of India visa portal before you travel.

Is this a hospital or a spa?Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is an NABH-accredited Ayurvedic hospital. Care is led by registered Ayurvedic physicians, and every treatment programme begins with a clinical consultation. It is not a spa.

Ready to plan your arrival?

Message Priya on WhatsApp to arrange a transfer, or talk to our team about your trip. A physician or the right team member will get back to you.

PROGRAM DETAILS
About the Program

In today’s fast-paced environment, professionals and executives frequently overlook their most significant asset: Health. The Immunity Enhancement & Executive Health Assessment Therapy at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a carefully curated wellness program designed to strengthen the immune system, detoxify the body, and rejuvenate the mind, with a focus on the needs of high-performing individuals.

Set in the calm heart of Kerala, our unique Ayurvedic therapy combines traditional healing sciences with modern diagnostic insight. It provides a comprehensive health check-up and personalised wellness interventions.

OUR APPROACH TO
Immunity Enhancement & Executive Health Assessment Therapy

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, our approach to Immunity Enhancement & Executive Health Assessment Therapy is grounded in the ancient tenets of Ayurveda, customized to meet the needs of contemporary living. We integrate individualized Ayurvedic treatments, nutrition tailored to doshas, and comprehensive diagnostics to enhance the immune system and reestablish harmony. Created specifically for busy professionals and leaders, this program combines rejuvenating treatments, stress-relief strategies, yoga, and an extensive health evaluation to boost physical energy while fostering mental sharpness and emotional strength. Our tranquil, restorative surroundings in Kerala enhance the healing effects, providing total rejuvenation for both the body and mind.

◆
Corporate executives and entrepreneurs

Frequent travelers and business professionals

Individuals with low immunity or chronic fatigue

People recovering from illness or viral infections

Those experiencing high levels of stress or burnout

Process Involved in Treatment for Immunity Enhancement & Executive Health Assessment Therapy

Immunity Enhancement & Executive Health Assessment Therapy at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village includes the following steps:

01

Consultation: We begin with a thorough consultation to understand your medical history, symptoms, and lifestyle. This helps us determine your unique dosha imbalance and design a personalized treatment plan.

02

Diagnosis: Through pulse examination (Nadi Pariksha) and visual examination (Darshana Pariksha), we assess the dosha imbalance and identify the root cause of your condition.

03

Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, we create a comprehensive treatment plan that includes a combination of therapies, herbal medications, dietary recommendations, and lifestyle modifications.

04

Ayurvedic Therapies: Based on health assessment, the corrective therapies will include abhyangam,podikizhi,navarakizhi,shirodhara,ksheeradhara, and nasyam as per the body type and dosha balance.

05

Herbal Medications: Doctors prescribe Ayurvedic medications made from natural herbs to support the internal healing process and strengthen the body.

06

Dietary and Lifestyle Guidance: Ayurvedic doctors will provide dietary recommendations tailored to your dosha imbalance and suggest lifestyle modifications to maintain balance and prevent further aggravation of symptoms.

07

Follow-up and Monitoring: We schedule regular follow-up sessions to track your progress, make necessary adjustments to the treatment plan, and provide ongoing support and guidance.

Why should one go with this treatment?
◆
Leverage 118+ years of expertise with an experienced team of Ayurvedic doctors. Our holistic approach prioritizes well-being, going beyond symptom management.
◆
Experience personalized treatments for your constitution and dosha imbalance. We follow Ayurvedic principles using natural therapies and herbs to minimize side effects.
◆
Deepen your understanding of Ayurvedic principles, your condition’s causes, and our treatment mechanisms. This empowers active participation in your healing journey and informed health decisions.
◆
Escape daily stress in our serene retreat. Get full support from our team with follow-ups, progress monitoring, and treatment plan adjustments as required.

Post Treatment

Follow-up consultations with the Ayurvedic doctor assess the effectiveness and offer guidance. You’ll integrate post-treatment practices, like diet and lifestyle recommendations, for sustained benefits. Ongoing support ensures long-term health and addresses any concerns or needs.

About the Program

In today’s fast-paced environment, professionals and executives frequently overlook their most significant asset: Health. The Immunity Enhancement & Executive Health Assessment Therapy at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a carefully curated wellness program designed to strengthen the immune system, detoxify the body, and rejuvenate the mind, with a focus on the needs of high-performing individuals.

Set in the calm heart of Kerala, our unique Ayurvedic therapy combines traditional healing sciences with modern diagnostic insight. It provides a comprehensive health check-up and personalised wellness interventions.

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, our approach to Immunity Enhancement & Executive Health Assessment Therapy is grounded in the ancient tenets of Ayurveda, customized to meet the needs of contemporary living. We integrate individualized Ayurvedic treatments, nutrition tailored to doshas, and comprehensive diagnostics to enhance the immune system and reestablish harmony. Created specifically for busy professionals and leaders, this program combines rejuvenating treatments, stress-relief strategies, yoga, and an extensive health evaluation to boost physical energy while fostering mental sharpness and emotional strength. Our tranquil, restorative surroundings in Kerala enhance the healing effects, providing total rejuvenation for both the body and mind.

Process Involved in Treatment for Immunity Enhancement & Executive Health Assessment Therapy

Immunity Enhancement & Executive Health Assessment Therapy at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village includes the following steps:

01

Consultation: We begin with a thorough consultation to understand your medical history, symptoms, and lifestyle. This helps us determine your unique dosha imbalance and design a personalized treatment plan.

02

Diagnosis: Through pulse examination (Nadi Pariksha) and visual examination (Darshana Pariksha), we assess the dosha imbalance and identify the root cause of your condition.

03

Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, we create a comprehensive treatment plan that includes a combination of therapies, herbal medications, dietary recommendations, and lifestyle modifications.

04

Ayurvedic Therapies: Based on health assessment, the corrective therapies will include abhyangam,podikizhi,navarakizhi,shirodhara,ksheeradhara, and nasyam as per the body type and dosha balance.

05

Herbal Medications: Doctors prescribe Ayurvedic medications made from natural herbs to support the internal healing process and strengthen the body.

06

Dietary and Lifestyle Guidance: Ayurvedic doctors will provide dietary recommendations tailored to your dosha imbalance and suggest lifestyle modifications to maintain balance and prevent further aggravation of symptoms.

07

Follow-up and Monitoring: We schedule regular follow-up sessions to track your progress, make necessary adjustments to the treatment plan, and provide ongoing support and guidance.

◆
Leverage 118+ years of expertise with an experienced team of Ayurvedic doctors. Our holistic approach prioritizes well-being, going beyond symptom management.
◆
Experience personalized treatments for your constitution and dosha imbalance. We follow Ayurvedic principles using natural therapies and herbs to minimize side effects.
◆
Deepen your understanding of Ayurvedic principles, your condition’s causes, and our treatment mechanisms. This empowers active participation in your healing journey and informed health decisions.
◆
Escape daily stress in our serene retreat. Get full support from our team with follow-ups, progress monitoring, and treatment plan adjustments as required.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group: Innovating Ayurveda for Modern Lifestyles

The Kairali Ayurvedic Group is dedicated to blending traditional Ayurvedic principles with modern innovation to create products that cater to contemporary lifestyles. Through consistent Research and Development (R&D), Kairali has developed a wide range of Ayurvedic products and medicines designed to address the needs of a global audience. Upholding the highest standards in sourcing, handling, and manufacturing, Kairali ensures that all its offerings are authentic, natural, and free from harmful side effects.

Holistic Ayurvedic Personal Care

Kairali’s range of herbal oils for hair and body is thoughtfully crafted to suit individuals of all ages and lifestyles. These hair oils are specially formulated to strengthen hair, promote healthy growth, and enhance shine and luster, making them a trusted choice for hair care. For body care, Kairali’s Ayurvedic oils offer detoxifying and stress-relieving properties that rejuvenate and energize, leaving users feeling refreshed and balanced.

To complement these oils, Kairali offers a range of shampoos, conditioners, body washes, and lotions. Free from parabens and sulfates, these products are carefully designed to nourish and protect both hair and skin. By leveraging the wisdom of Ayurvedic formulations, they address a variety of hair and body concerns, promoting overall wellness while providing a gentle, natural alternative to synthetic products.

Proprietary Medicines for Modern Ailments

In addition to personal care products, Kairali’s in-house proprietary medicines provide natural solutions for many modern health challenges. Developed through rigorous research and crafted with care, these capsules and syrups are tailored to address conditions such as high cholesterol, liver problems, hypertension, and obesity. Rooted in Ayurvedic compositions, these medicines aim to restore balance and vitality while addressing the root causes of illness rather than just alleviating symptoms.

Kairali’s proprietary medicines represent a commitment to making Ayurvedic health solutions accessible and relevant in today’s world. Each product undergoes meticulous testing and adheres to strict quality standards, ensuring effectiveness and safety for users.

Revitalizing the Body, Mind, and Spirit

Every product from Kairali, whether for personal care or therapeutic use, is designed with a holistic approach. Ayurveda emphasizes the interconnectedness of the body, mind, and spirit, and Kairali’s products reflect this philosophy by promoting comprehensive well-being. From rejuvenating oils to health-boosting medicines, Kairali’s offerings help individuals achieve balance and vitality in their lives.

The commitment to Ayurvedic authenticity extends to every aspect of Kairali’s operations. By sourcing natural ingredients, following traditional manufacturing techniques, and prioritizing sustainability, the group continues to uphold the rich legacy of Ayurveda while meeting the demands of modern living.

A Legacy of Trust and Wellness

The Kairali Ayurvedic Group has built its reputation on a foundation of trust, innovation, and dedication to holistic health. Its products, developed with a perfect blend of tradition and technology, serve as a testament to the enduring relevance of Ayurveda. Whether seeking to enhance daily self-care routines or address specific health concerns, Kairali’s wide range of products offers natural, effective solutions for a healthier and more balanced lifestyle.

By leveraging the wisdom of Ayurvedic formulations, they address a variety of hair and body concerns, promoting overall wellness while providing a gentle, natural alternative to synthetic products.

Developed through rigorous research and crafted with care, these capsules and syrups are tailored to address conditions such as high cholesterol, liver problems, hypertension, and obesity. Rooted in Ayurvedic compositions, these medicines aim to restore balance and vitality while addressing the root causes of illness rather than just alleviating symptoms.

Kairali’s proprietary medicines represent a commitment to making Ayurvedic health solutions accessible and relevant in today’s world. Each product undergoes meticulous testing and adheres to strict quality standards, ensuring effectiveness and safety for users.

Revitalizing the Body, Mind, and Spirit

Every product from Kairali, whether for personal care or therapeutic use, is designed with a holistic approach. Ayurveda emphasizes the interconnectedness of the body, mind, and spirit, and Kairali’s products reflect this philosophy by promoting comprehensive well-being. From rejuvenating oils to health-boosting medicines, Kairali’s offerings help individuals achieve balance and vitality in their lives.

The commitment to Ayurvedic authenticity extends to every aspect of Kairali’s operations. By sourcing natural ingredients, following traditional manufacturing techniques, and prioritizing sustainability, the group continues to uphold the rich legacy of Ayurveda while meeting the demands of modern living.

A Legacy of Trust and Wellness

The Kairali Ayurvedic Group has built its reputation on a foundation of trust, innovation, and dedication to holistic health. Its products, developed with a perfect blend of tradition and technology, serve as a testament to the enduring relevance of Ayurveda. Whether seeking to enhance daily self-care routines or address specific health concerns, Kairali’s wide range of products offers natural, effective solutions for a healthier and more balanced lifestyle.

Five-Day Intensive Ayurveda Training Program
AYURVEDA TRAINING COURSE · WAP-HV · 5 DAYS
Five-Day Intensive Ayurveda Training Program

Five days on the five principal therapies — Abhyangam, Shirodhara, Podikizhi, Udwarthanam and Kativasti — each studied in theory, practised under supervision and received as a therapy session, alongside the philosophical foundations of Ayurveda. A certificate of completion is awarded.

Plan your Ayurveda training

Tell us about your background and the course you are considering. We can discuss the training options with you.

ENQUIRE ABOUT AYURVEDA TRAINING
PROCESS
FEATURES
COURSES
FAQS
RELATED
THE PROGRAMME
Process Involved In the Five-Day Intensive

One hour of theory and one hour of practical each day; every day ends with the therapy just studied, given to the participant.

01

Day 1 — Abhyangam: the origin, branches and benefits of Ayurveda; Abhyangam technique, benefits, contraindications and procedure; a 45-minute Abhyangam session.

02

Day 2 — Shirodhara and concepts: Panchamahabhuta, Tridosha, Saptadhatu, Trimala, Agni and Swastha Lakshana; the types, procedure and benefits of Shirodhara; a 55-minute Shirodhara session.

03

Day 3 — Podikizhi and Prakriti: Prakriti and Ojas in depth; Podikizhi theory, preparation demonstration, procedure and contraindications; a 50-minute Podikizhi session.

04

Day 4 — Udwarthanam and medicines: classical and proprietary Ayurvedic medicines and Kairali products; Udwarthanam theory, types, procedure and applications; a 50-minute Udwarthanam session.

05

Day 5 — Kativasti and assessment: the Prakriti assessment questionnaire; Kativasti theory, its importance, do's and don'ts and dough preparation; a 45-minute Kativasti session; closing Q&A.

06

Certificate: a certificate of completion on successful participation.

Features of the program
◆
Format: fifteen hours over five days — one hour of theory and one hour of practical daily — with the day's therapy received in full.
◆
Who it suits: wellness-industry professionals, trainers, therapists, doctors, holistic practitioners and dieticians who want authentic Ayurvedic methods in their practice.
◆
Faculty: Ayurvedic doctors and senior trainers of the hospital.
◆
Stay: five nights in the hospital's villas, charged per night under the training tariff — Deluxe Villa ₹18,410 single / ₹30,530 double ($263 / $436; €230 / €382).
Learning outcomes
◆
Five therapies: carry out Abhyangam, Shirodhara, Podikizhi, Udwarthanam and Kativasti correctly, with their indications and contraindications.
◆
The Ayurvedic model of health: explain doshas, dhatus, agni and ojas, and how Prakriti is assessed.
◆
Preparation: prepare what each therapy needs — the Podikizhi bolus, the Kativasti dough.
◆
Practice: bring authentic Ayurvedic methods into an existing wellness or healthcare practice.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village believes in developing the future generation of health practitioners, holistic healers, and Ayurveda aficionados through internship programs. Our internships provide a unique opportunity to obtain direct experience in traditional Ayurvedic treatments, wellness practices, retreat administration, and sustainable living, all in the tranquil and natural environment of our renowned health retreat in Kerala. 

Whether you are a student of Ayurveda, yoga, wellness tourism, or holistic health sciences, our internship program offers a dynamic learning environment in which you can immerse yourself in the concepts of Ayurveda and holistic wellness while working with seasoned professionals. 

Who Can Apply?

Students and professionals in Ayurveda, Yoga, Wellness, Hospitality, and Holistic Health Sciences.
Individuals are passionate about sustainability, wellness tourism, and organic living.
Enthusiasts looking for an immersive Ayurvedic experience at a premier Kerala Ayurvedic Retreat. 
Researchers and scholars studying Ayurveda, Yoga, or Traditional Medicine.

Certificate of Completion from Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village.

The opportunity to work in a real-world Ayurvedic healing environment.

Personal growth through self-care, mindfulness, and Ayurveda-based lifestyle practices.
