Nearby Attractions and Current Events

The town of Palakkad lies at the foot of the Western Ghats, the dreamy land of misty mountains with its evergreen tropical forests, dams, wildlife sanctuaries, rivers, rare birds, historical monuments, temples and traditional Ayurvedic treatment centers. Palakkad is fast becoming a favourite destination for Kerala tour packages.

THIRUVALATHOOR

It is a peaceful village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is rich in culture and spirituality. It is home to the historic Thiruvalathoor Mahadeva Temple, a famous shrine to Lord Shiva. The temple, known for its beautiful wooden carvings and traditional Kerala-style architecture, attracts both devout and architecture aficionados. Thiruvalathoor, surrounded by thick greenery, has a serene ambiance that makes it an ideal location for spiritual searchers and nature enthusiasts.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 10 km

KATHAKALI

Kathakali is an ancient classical dance drama that depicts an act of devotion and the universal conflict between good and evil. With years of pedagogy, the dance form uses choreography, face, and hand movements to express Indian folklore.

THENARI

Thenari is a lovely village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is well-known for its natural beauty and cultural significance. The town is famous for the Thenari Natural Spring, a sacred location with divine origins and ties to the Ramayana. Thenari, surrounded by rich greenery and quiet scenery, is a peaceful getaway for those seeking spiritual serenity and a connection with nature. Its tranquil surroundings and historical significance make it a hidden gem among Kerala's rich cultural legacy.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 10 km

MOHINIYATTAM

The classical dance form of Kerala, Mohiniyattam, finds its roots in Hindu Mythology. The undulating movements depict the dance of the enchantress Mohini. She made demons fall for her oscillating dance steps, passionate eyes, and graceful gestures to restore elixir. A delight for your eyes, women adorn simple, elegant gold-filigreed dresses in pure white or ivory while performing.

The town of Palakkad lies at the foot of the Western Ghats, the dreamy land of misty mountains with its evergreen tropical forests, dams, wildlife sanctuaries, rivers, rare birds, historical monuments, temples and traditional Ayurvedic treatment centers. Palakkad is fast becoming a favourite destination for Kerala tour packages.

THIRUVALATHOOR

It is a peaceful village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is rich in culture and spirituality. It is home to the historic Thiruvalathoor Mahadeva Temple, a famous shrine to Lord Shiva. The temple, known for its beautiful wooden carvings and traditional Kerala-style architecture, attracts both devout and architecture aficionados. Thiruvalathoor, surrounded by thick greenery, has a serene ambiance that makes it an ideal location for spiritual searchers and nature enthusiasts.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 10 km

KATHAKALI

Kathakali is an ancient classical dance drama that depicts an act of devotion and the universal conflict between good and evil. With years of pedagogy, the dance form uses choreography, face, and hand movements to express Indian folklore.

THENARI

Thenari is a lovely village in Kerala's Palakkad district that is well-known for its natural beauty and cultural significance. The town is famous for the Thenari Natural Spring, a sacred location with divine origins and ties to the Ramayana. Thenari, surrounded by rich greenery and quiet scenery, is a peaceful getaway for those seeking spiritual serenity and a connection with nature. Its tranquil surroundings and historical significance make it a hidden gem among Kerala's rich cultural legacy.

Distance from Ayurvedic Healing Village: 10 km

MOHINIYATTAM

The classical dance form of Kerala, Mohiniyattam, finds its roots in Hindu Mythology. The undulating movements depict the dance of the enchantress Mohini. She made demons fall for her oscillating dance steps, passionate eyes, and graceful gestures to restore elixir. A delight for your eyes, women adorn simple, elegant gold-filigreed dresses in pure white or ivory while performing.

As a member of the esteemed Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Kairali Ayurvedic Centre is a world authority on offering genuine Ayurvedic remedies and wellness programs. Kairali Ayurvedic Centre, which has its roots in the ancient science of Ayurveda, provides a well-balanced combination of contemporary treatment approaches and traditional healing methods. Under the direction of experienced professionals, these centres are intended to give people a peaceful setting in which to revitalize their bodies, minds, and souls.

A Tradition of Excellence

Kairali Ayurvedic Centre is a symbol of genuineness and excellence. These centres, which were founded to disseminate the knowledge of Ayurveda throughout the world, adhere to the tenets of this age-old Indian medical system and provide individualized treatments that address a range of health issues while fostering general well-being. Every therapy is customized to meet the needs of the patient, ensuring a unique experience.

Extensive Network of Centres

Ayurveda is available to a worldwide audience thanks to the extensive presence of Kairali Ayurvedic Centres in India and abroad. These centres provide a haven for people looking for holistic and natural therapy by bringing the essence of Kerala’s ancient Ayurvedic techniques to urban areas.

Signature Ayurvedic Treatments

To address a variety of health and wellness requirements, Kairali Ayurvedic Centre offers a broad range of therapies and treatments.

Abhyangam: Abhyangam, a traditional full-body massage with therapeutic oils, promotes circulation, reduces stress, and detoxifies the body.
Shirodhara: Shirodhara, a relaxing treatment that involves applying a continuous stream of warm oil to the forehead, is well known for lowering anxiety, promoting better sleep, and increasing mental clarity.
Pizhichil: Pizhichil, sometimes referred to as the “royal treatment,” offers profound relaxation and renewal by combining synchronized massages with gentle oil pouring.
Kizhi Therapy: Herbal poultices are used in this therapy to reduce pain, increase joint mobility, and cleanse the body.
Panchakarma Detoxification: Panchakarma is a thorough Ayurvedic detox procedure that balances the doshas, rids the body of impurities, and revitalizes the body.
Weight Management Programs: By combining Ayurvedic meals, fitness regimens, and personalized therapies, these programs assist people in maintaining a healthy weight.
Expert Practitioners and Therapists

At Kairali Ayurvedic Centre, skilled Ayurvedic physicians and therapists provide treatments. Each practitioner has received training in ancient techniques, ensuring each therapy is authentic and effective. To ascertain their Prakriti (body constitution) and address certain issues, customers go through a detailed consultation prior to starting any kind of treatment.

Ambiance of Tranquility

The centres are carefully planned to produce a calm and peaceful atmosphere. Every feature, from the natural materials to the calming décor, adds to the feeling of calm and relaxation. By enabling clients to detach from everyday concerns and concentrate on their well-being, this environment promotes recovery.

Ayurvedic Products for Continued Wellness

A variety of premium Ayurvedic products, such as oils, skincare products, and herbal supplements, are also available at the Kairali Ayurvedic Centre. These products allow customers to continue their wellness journey at home because they are made with natural ingredients and traditional recipes.

Global Recognition and Trust

Due to its stellar reputation, Kairali Ayurvedic Centre has drawn customers from all over the world. It is a well-known brand in the wellness sector thanks to its dedication to quality, genuineness, and client happiness. The centres have received recognition for their role in promoting Ayurveda’s advantages throughout the world.

Why Choose Kairali Ayurvedic Centre?
Authentic Treatments: Experience therapies rooted in traditional Ayurvedic wisdom.
Customized Care: Benefit from personalized treatments tailored to your unique needs.
Expert Guidance: Receive care from skilled Ayurvedic doctors and therapists.
Holistic Healing: Address physical, mental, and emotional well-being through comprehensive therapies.
Global Presence: Access authentic Ayurvedic treatments in locations around the world.
Conclusion

For those looking for authentic Ayurvedic healing, Kairali Ayurvedic Centre is more than just a health centre. The centre provides an unmatched chance to bring harmony and balance back to life with its array of treatments, skilled professionals, and peaceful atmosphere. Kairali Ayurvedic Centre offers a life-changing experience based on the ageless wisdom of Ayurveda, whether your goal is to rejuvenate or address specific health issues. With Kairali Ayurvedic Centre, find the way to comprehensive well-being and set off on a path to enduring health and energy.

Kairali Ayurvedic Equipment is a key component of the renowned Kairali Ayurvedic Group, delivering high-quality equipment to assist authentic Ayurvedic treatments and therapies. With over three decades of experience promoting holistic wellness, Kairali recognizes the value of accuracy and workmanship in Ayurvedic practices. The Ayurvedic equipment line illustrates the group’s commitment to preserving ancient practices while addressing the needs of modern wellness centres globally.

Ayurvedic treatments rely on specialized equipment to provide effective and accurate therapy. Kairali Ayurvedic Equipment is handcrafted with painstaking attention to detail, combining ancient styles with modern technologies. This guarantees that practitioners may deliver remedies accurately while maintaining the essence of Ayurveda. Kairali’s equipment is trusted by professionals all over the world for its quality, durability, and functionality.

Comprehensive Range of Ayurvedic Equipment

Dronis (Massage Tables)
These handcrafted wooden massage tables are essential for a variety of Ayurvedic therapies and are crafted of high-quality neem and other medicinal woods. Dronis are ergonomically designed to provide comfort during treatments while also being durable and easy to use. 
Steam Chambers
Steam chambers are essential for detoxifying and rejuvenating treatments. Kairali offers steam chambers that are safe, efficient, and built to hold therapeutic steam, hence increasing the advantages of Ayurvedic treatments such as Swedana (herbal steam therapy. 
Shirodhara Stands
Shirodhara, a traditional Ayurvedic therapy, involves pouring a constant stream of warm oil onto the forehead. Kairali’s Shirodhara stands are meticulously designed to enable a steady and consistent flow of oil, thereby enhancing the therapy’s relaxing and restorative effects. 
Pizhichil Equipment
Kairali provides specialized equipment for treatments that need synchronized oil pouring, allowing therapists to execute Pizhichil with precision and optimum therapeutic advantages. 
Herbal Steam Generators
These generators are intended to provide medicinal steam infused with herbal extracts. Kairali’s steam generators are efficient, simple to operate, and designed to meet the stringent requirements of Ayurvedic centres. 
Treatment Accessories
Kairali also offers a variety of accessories, including medicinal boluses for Kizhi therapies, headrests, and stools, all meant to improve the comfort and efficacy of Ayurvedic treatments.
Unmatched Quality and Durability

Kairali Ayurvedic Equipment is crafted from high-quality materials, assuring long-lasting performance. The equipment is intended to survive frequent use in professional situations while yet preserving its aesthetic appeal and functionality. Each product is subjected to rigorous quality inspections to ensure the highest levels of safety and effectiveness.

Why Choose Kairali Ayurvedic Equipment?
Authenticity: Designed to maintain the authentic spirit of Ayurvedic treatments. 
Quality: Crafted from high-quality materials with a focus on durability. 
Expertise: Backed by Kairali’s decades of experience in Ayurvedic wellness.
Customization: Solutions specifically designed to meet particular requirements. 
Global Reach: Trusted by practitioners and wellness facilities worldwide.
Conclusion

Kairali Ayurvedic Equipment symbolizes the organization’s objective to spread real Ayurveda worldwide. Kairali ensures that practitioners offer effective medicines while conserving Ayurvedic traditions by supplying high-quality, dependable, and long-lasting equipment. Whether it’s a wellness centre, a spa, or an Ayurvedic practitioner, Kairali Ayurvedic Equipment provides the ideal combination of tradition, innovation, and utility to help you succeed. Choose Kairali to enjoy the gold standard in Ayurvedic equipment for overall wellness.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group maintains Ayurvedic principles as a holistic approach to health and happiness, carrying on the tradition of our ancient texts, known as “Vedas.” The Group is dedicated to spreading the Ayurvedic lifestyle among the general public, having studied and practiced it for many generations. They are the leaders in the healthcare sector because of their innovative approach to holistic well-being. Kairali Ayurvedic Group, the pinnacle of opulent living and a healthy lifestyle, genuinely understands how Ayurveda may revitalize and mend the body, mind, and soul.

To support and promote research-based Ayurveda and help people, renowned doctors Dr. Sungunny Vaidir (grandfather of Mr. K.V. Ramesh) and Dr. K.S. Vasudevan (father of Mr. K.V. Ramesh) founded the Kairali Ayurvedic Group in 1989. Through four generations of equally committed and experienced physicians, they passed on their extensive knowledge and the duty of reviving Ayurveda’s relevance.

Mr. K.V. Ramesh, the Chairman and Managing Director, and Mrs. Gita Ramesh, the Joint Managing Director, have successfully carried on the Group’s tradition. Their sons, Mr. Abhilash K.R. and Mr. Abishek K.R., follow in their footsteps. Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s combined efforts have allowed it to achieve unprecedented levels of prosperity and kindness.

The Kairali Ayurvedic Group entered the wellness industry in 1989 with its first treatment centre in New Delhi, driven by the admirable goal of providing healthy living. Since then, there has been no turning back. For those seeking a holistic lifestyle, the treatments and therapies became the preferred “choice” due to their authenticity.

Managing Directors Mr. K.V. Ramesh and Mrs. Gita Ramesh were inspired to establish an Ayurvedic utopia by the enormous success and unparalleled demand for Ayurvedic treatments. The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Palakkad, Kerala, the trademark property of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, was thus created.

With its natural therapeutic, restorative, and curative qualities from Kerala, “God’s Own Country,” Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has a significant effect on the psyche, leaving people feeling refreshed and at ease. You will be rendered speechless by the captivating fusion of Ayurveda, technology, and professionalism that adheres to the highest standards of Ayurvedic services and treatments. One of the expanding brands is Kairali, which has roots in over 40 sites worldwide.

The primary focus of Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s operations and efforts has been on treating and instructing visitors in the ancient art of Ayurveda. Kairali has expanded rapidly and is currently among the top Ayurvedic travel brands in the world by upholding the highest standards of quality and service.

The Kairali Ayurvedic Group has worked to achieve the highest standards of client satisfaction with its iconic health retreat in Palakkad, Kerala, as well as our other treatment facilities and spas worldwide.

With all the benefits of its extensive Ayurvedic heritage, this family-run business provides the greatest Ayurvedic training to its Ayurvedic Therapy team. The Government of Kerala has awarded Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village Green Leaf Certification, the highest rating for Ayurvedic centres, in recognition of its flawless standards of Ayurvedic practice, healthcare, and hygiene.

Kairali’s Ayurvedic health system is well recognized as a side-effect-free health rejuvenation plan since it is based on the traditional diagnosis of Ayurvedic body types and the application of ancient oil therapies. Every treatment at the centres or retreats is overseen by our highly skilled and compassionate medical professionals.

Founded by Mr. and Mrs. K.V. Ramesh, who continue to serve as the Kairali group’s primary mentors, the following generation has now solidified its position at the centre of the company’s operations. They look forward to assisting the company in continuing to expand its reputation as the top Ayurvedic brand globally, in a true continuation of the work of their elders and their ancestors before them.

Kairali Ayurvedic Products Pvt. Ltd.: A Legacy of Wellness

Kairali Ayurvedic Products Pvt. Ltd., a reputable name in holistic well-being, has been at the forefront of bringing genuine Ayurvedic solutions to the world. As a member of the prestigious Kairali Ayurvedic Group, the company has a long history steeped in Ayurveda, an ancient Indian system of natural medicine. Kairali Ayurvedic Products Pvt. Ltd. offers a diverse selection of products aimed at promoting health, balance, and well-being.

A Tradition of Excellence

Kairali Ayurvedic Products Pvt. Ltd. draws on decades of Ayurvedic expertise to provide products that are manufactured with precision and care. The company, founded as an extension of the Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s goal, ensures that the time-tested principles of Ayurveda are reflected in every product. Kairali produces high-quality and effective products by integrating ancient processes with cutting-edge technology.

Wide Range of Ayurvedic Products

The company offers an extensive selection of Ayurvedic products catering to diverse health and wellness needs. These products are made from natural ingredients, including medicinal herbs, plant extracts, and essential oils, ensuring their purity and effectiveness. The range includes:

Herbal Supplements
Kairali’s herbal supplements are based on Ayurvedic formulations that build the body from within. They are intended to enhance overall health and address specific health conditions. 
Skincare and Beauty Products
Kairali’s skincare line comprises herbal face packs, body oils, and cleansers that hydrate and revitalize the skin. These products are free of hazardous ingredients, making them suitable for daily use.
Hair Care Solutions
Kairali’s hair care solutions, which range from herbal shampoos to nourishing oils, address common issues including hair loss, dandruff, and dryness while also fostering healthy, lustrous hair. 
Massage and Essential Oils
Massage oils infused with Ayurvedic herbs are great for relaxation, pain relief, and regeneration. These oils are frequently utilized both in professional Ayurvedic medicines and for personal care.
Wellness Teas and Health Drinks
Kairali provides a variety of herbal teas and health drinks that are not only tasty but also good for digestion, immunity, and overall well-being.
Commitment to Quality

Kairali Ayurvedic Products Pvt. Ltd. takes pride in its strict quality control procedures. All products are made in GMP-certified facilities to ensure they meet international standards. From sourcing high-quality raw ingredients to final packaging, every step of the process is meticulously regulated to ensure the highest standards of purity and safety.

Sustainability and Ethical Practices

Kairali Ayurvedic Products Pvt. Ltd. places a premium on sustainability and environmental friendliness as part of its dedication to holistic wellness. The company employs ecologically responsible manufacturing and packaging procedures to have a low environmental effect. In addition, Kairali promotes ethical sourcing and fair trading, which benefit local communities.

Trusted by Millions

Kairali’s Ayurvedic products are trusted by clients all over the world. Kairali is trusted by wellness enthusiasts and professional therapists alike for its authentic, effective, and natural remedies. These products are also widely utilized at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, demonstrating their efficacy in promoting health and well-being.

A Global Reach

While remaining true to its Indian roots, Kairali Ayurvedic Products Pvt. Ltd. has grown its global presence. By catering to a diversified market, the organization ensures that the advantages of Ayurveda are available to individuals from all walks of life, spreading the message of holistic health and harmony around the world.

Conclusion

Experience the legacy of wellness and find the path to holistic health with Kairali Ayurvedic Products Pvt. Ltd. By providing natural, high-quality products inspired by Ayurveda, the company helps people lead healthier and more balanced lives. Whether you’re looking for herbal supplements, skincare products, or relaxation aids, Kairali Ayurvedic Products Pvt. Ltd. offers a range of reliable and efficient options that reflect the time-honored wisdom of Ayurveda.

The strength of a system doesn’t depend on the longevity or endurance of its visible part but rather, it is dependent on the foundation on which it stands. Just like this statement is true for any architectural marvel, it also holds an equal amount of variety for the Ayurvedic healing village. Though the Ayurvedic healing village in Kerala is our flagship among all the other centers, it is actually the importance of these other centers that had convinced us in the first place to have a village where the goodness of all the centers could be merged.

All of these centers pack within themselves incredible work ethos and determination to see the rise of Ayurveda as a contemporary art. Fuelled by excellent personalized care, these centers are the foundation on which the functionality of Kairali depends. Each center has a dedicated team of doctors and therapists who are the crème de la crème of their fields and are experts at providing intensive and customized care to patients. Not only this, there is the provision of choosing your own customized therapy according to your own needs. In cases of beauty and herbal treatments, there is no greater option.

The major features that include these customized therapies include things from all spheres of health, be it beauty or post-natal care or general treatment. There are different treatments available that cater to various maladies such as obesity, arthritis, spondylitis etc. These treatment centers have ascended to such a level where they can easily work out new ways of improving the current system of care without needing a helping hand from elsewhere. These centers have changed the way people look at Ayurveda at the root levels and due to their immense success, more new centers are being established. Good days for Ayurveda has just started.

Kairali provides an exclusive Ayurvedic Weight Reduction Program at their luxury weight management retreat in South India. Herbal oil therapy, Ayurvedic practices, and nutrition assist our clients in achieving profound relaxation and wellness while shedding extra pounds and toning the body in only a few weeks.

A Long-Term Method of Natural Weight Reduction

Our weight management retreat approach is regarded as the most natural and healthy way to reduce your weight, aiding you in attaining a slimmer physique without water loss; this indicates that the outcomes are genuine and enduring. Ayurvedic therapies at our exclusive weight reduction retreat remove excess fat from the body, based on the traditional wellness principles of Ayurveda. Similar to other Ayurvedic cleansing techniques, the detoxification process eliminates obstructions to restore balance to your body, enabling our expert doctors to assist you in reaching your desired outcomes. Our Ayurvedic weight reduction retreat aids in lowering cholesterol levels and preventing lipid build-up, ensuring you years of a healthy, active, and vibrant life.

Ayurvedic Massage Treatment for Weight Management and Skin Care

Our unique Ayurvedic massage program supports weight reduction by combating flaccidity and toning muscles, while also eliminating cellulite. While massaging, herbal oils seep into the skin’s layers, nourishing the entire body system and breaking down toxins, making them easier to eliminate. The influence of Ayurvedic nutrients in the oil is believed to permeate deeply into the tissue cells, bones, and even the nervous system, thanks to a gentle, natural absorption. This profoundly soothing procedure rejuvenates and adds shine to the skin; minimizing wrinkles, combating cellulite, and providing our guests with a radiant, glowing appearance.

Recipe for Maintaining Weight

100 g carrot, 100 g green peas, 1 large onion, 100 g green beans
Cook the vegetables in a pressure cooker along with 4 cups of water.
Blend the vegetables to make a thick soup, adding salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with rice or chapathi (bread).

Recipe for Reducing Weight

Breakfast: should contain only seasonal fresh fruits with no sugar syrups.
Lunch: Fresh light soup with no butter or any type of oils with rice/chappati/bread.
Dinner: Fresh light soup with no butter or any type of oils with rice/chappati/bread, and fresh fruits

Education is the first step towards acquisition of knowledge, realization and motivation. Devoid of it may bereave you from attaining salvation and understanding of the purpose of our existence. Ayurveda- the Science of Life, is not merely about treatments and curative measures, it enlightens us about the path that leads to complete happiness.

It is due to the efforts made by scholars and sages in last so many decades that we have such an impressive medical branch at our disposal. To make sure that their knowledge isn’t wasted, it is crucial to impart this knowledge to future generations and people who want to know more about this fascinating science.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group has been making all efforts to propagate the inherited legacy of India’s ancient tradition. Hence, in 2009, they stepped into the field of education with the launch of ‘Kairali Institute of Ayurveda and Panchakarma Therapy, Palakkad, Kerala, to catch young minds and contribute to the proliferating demand in the Wellness Industry.

The Institute offers both short-term courses and long-durational hands-on training programs for both novice learners and Ayurveda instructors wanting to upgrade their knowledge and skills. The idea is not merely to inform, but to make them learn about our historical roots, which supported health as the ultimate goal.

The institute is proud to have trained therapists and Ayurveda professionals from India, Germany, Japan, Spain, France and Australia.

In the year 2009, Kairali embarked on a new venture- providing quality training to Panchakarma Therapists. Since then, Kairali has trained scores of individuals, from different parts of the world, like Germany, Japan, Spain, France and Australia at The Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala and at their Ayurvedic Centre, in Delhi.

The enormous success of this venture has played a very important role in providing highly trained individuals to meet the ever increasing demand for quality therapists, not only worldwide but within the organization too! With Kairali’s decision to take things to the next level, by having their very own Training Academy, they have ensured the ‘global’ requirement for trained individuals is successfully met and, further assured the consumer by providing each therapist with a Diploma.

Previously, Kairali only provided a brief introduction training program that catered to the individual interested in learning the very basics about Ayurveda.

These courses are still available at ‘The Ayurvedic Healing Village’.

Education is the first step towards acquisition of knowledge, realization and motivation. Devoid of it may bereave you from attaining salvation and understanding of the purpose of our existence. Ayurveda- the Science of Life, is not merely about treatments and curative measures, it enlightens us about the path that leads to complete happiness.

It is due to the efforts made by scholars and sages in last so many decades that we have such an impressive medical branch at our disposal. To make sure that their knowledge isn’t wasted, it is crucial to impart this knowledge to future generations and people who want to know more about this fascinating science.

Kairali Ayurvedic Group has been making all efforts to propagate the inherited legacy of India’s ancient tradition. Hence, in 2009, they stepped into the field of education with the launch of ‘Kairali Institute of Ayurveda and Panchakarma Therapy, Palakkad, Kerala, to catch young minds and contribute to the proliferating demand in the Wellness Industry.

The Institute offers both short-term courses and long-durational hands-on training programs for both novice learners and Ayurveda instructors wanting to upgrade their knowledge and skills. The idea is not merely to inform, but to make them learn about our historical roots, which supported health as the ultimate goal.

The institute is proud to have trained therapists and Ayurveda professionals from India, Germany, Japan, Spain, France and Australia.

In the year 2009, Kairali embarked on a new venture- providing quality training to Panchakarma Therapists. Since then, Kairali has trained scores of individuals, from different parts of the world, like Germany, Japan, Spain, France and Australia at The Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala and at their Ayurvedic Centre, in Delhi.

The enormous success of this venture has played a very important role in providing highly trained individuals to meet the ever increasing demand for quality therapists, not only worldwide but within the organization too! With Kairali’s decision to take things to the next level, by having their very own Training Academy, they have ensured the ‘global’ requirement for trained individuals is successfully met and, further assured the consumer by providing each therapist with a Diploma.

Previously, Kairali only provided a brief introduction training program that catered to the individual interested in learning the very basics about Ayurveda.

These courses are still available at ‘The Ayurvedic Healing Village’.

As the premier retreat of Kairali Ayurvedic Group, this serene haven effortlessly combines 5,000 years of Ayurvedic knowledge with contemporary hospitality, providing a transformative path to wellness, harmony, and inner tranquility. 

A Globally Recognized Wellness Destination

Kairali’s Ayurvedic Healing Village has been honored with prestigious global awards, solidifying its position as a leader in Ayurvedic wellness and holistic healing:

In this context, Ayurveda transcends mere treatment—it embodies a lifestyle that promotes profound healing and inherent wellness.

Monsoon Ayurvedic Treatment in Kerala For a Complete Body Reset
KAIRALI — THE AYURVEDIC HEALING VILLAGE · SINCE 1908
Monsoon Ayurvedic Treatment in Kerala For a Complete Body Reset

Monsoon opens what medicine cannot. Ancient protocols. Clinical precision. Real results. Your healing window is now — in an NABH-accredited Ayurveda village led by BAMS doctors, not a spa resort.

85% of guests leave feeling measurably better than when they arrived — from pain levels and sleep to digestion and energy.

Where 118 Years of Lineage Meets Ayurveda's Most Sacred Season

For over three decades, our founders' family physicians have prepared this very season as the most sacred window for detox, repair, and Rasayana — long before "wellness retreats" became a trend.

Since 1908, Kairali's Ayurvedic lineage has grown from a family of physicians into a government-recognised, NABH-accredited hospital-cum-retreat, with its own GMP-certified pharmacy supplying classical medicines to doctors across India. Karkidaka at Kairali is the meeting point of this 118-year clinical tradition and a monsoon season your body is uniquely prepared for.

On our 65-acre NABH-accredited Ayurveda village in Palakkad, Kerala, Karkidaka is treated like a clinical protocol wrapped in nature — not a spa ritual wrapped in marketing. Every program is designed and overseen by BAMS doctors, backed by hospital-grade Panchakarma infrastructure, therapeutic-grade oils, and experienced physicians letting your treatment move at the pace of your body, not our schedule.

Why Monsoon Is Ayurveda's Most Powerful Season

Karkidaka Chikitsa is performed during the Karkidakam month (July–August) of the Malayalam calendar — the peak of Kerala's monsoon and, by classical Ayurvedic teaching, the most powerful healing window of the year.

Also known as Karkidaka Ayurveda Treatment, this is a traditional monsoon Ayurvedic treatment from Kerala. According to Ayurveda, this window is ideal for deep detoxification and rejuvenation, as the body becomes more receptive to therapies in the cooler, humid climate — allowing treatments to work at a deeper level on your tissues and doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha).

"Most 'monsoon packages' simply offer the same massages all year. Karkidaka here is different — season-specific, physician-designed protocols that work on root causes your usual treatments never touch."

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers a specialised Karkidaka Chikitsa retreat in Kerala, crafted as an intensive monsoon Ayurveda detox program to enhance immunity, clear accumulated toxins, and gently restore your natural balance through time-tested, clinically aligned therapies rooted in classical Ayurveda.

By combining authentic seasonal treatments, personalised diets, and a nature-immersed NABH-accredited clinical setting, this focused monsoon therapy supports your body, mind, and spirit to reset and heal in the most powerful Ayurvedic season of the year.

Four Things Only the Monsoon Can Do to Your Body

What the rainy season delivers, no other window of the year can quite replicate.

Humidity Opens Your Body

When monsoon humidity peaks, your skin's absorption capacity reaches its annual high. Herbal oils penetrate layers of tissue that remain unreachable in any other season — allowing every drop of medicated oil to deliver its full therapeutic effect deep into your body.

Natural Detox Momentum

The monsoon season puts your body's elimination system into overdrive. When Panchakarma is performed during this window, the results aren't just better — it works with the body's natural rhythms in a way that off-season treatments simply cannot replicate.

Nervous System Reset

The rainy season creates a unique biological state in which your nervous system becomes deeply receptive to healing. Treatments like Shirodhara and Basti performed during this period deliver breakthroughs that would otherwise take an entire year of practice to fully achieve.

Karkidaka Kanji Ritual

Once a year, for exactly thirty days, a centuries-old morning ritual comes alive. A warm porridge — prepared the same way it has been for generations — quietly rebuilds your immunity, gut, and vitality from the ground up over four sustained weeks.

Is the Monsoon Calling You?

This Karkidaka program is for you if your body has been whispering — or shouting — that it cannot keep up with the life you are asking it to live.

You may come with a specific diagnosis or simply with the sense that something is "off" — energy, mood, gut, or sleep. If you are ready to pause, listen, and let experienced Ayurvedic physicians hold your healing for 7, 14, or 21 days, this season and this healing village were designed for you.

Concerns Karkidaka Can Meaningfully Address
Chronic Pain & Stiffness

For those living with chronic neck, back, or joint pain who have relied on temporary relief and are ready for structured Panchakarma and Rasayana support that targets root causes.

Stress, Fatigue & Burnout

Professionals carrying years of stress, fatigue, poor sleep, or nervous-system overload who need more than a long weekend to truly come back to themselves and recover at a deeper level.

Metabolic & Lifestyle Concerns

Individuals facing weight fluctuations, metabolic imbalances, blood sugar concerns, sluggish digestion, or recurring acidity and bloating who want to address the root causes rather than continuing to manage surface symptoms.

Post-Illness & Recovery

Guests recovering from recent illness, post-infection weakness, or long periods of medication who need a clinically supervised detox and a structured immunity rebuild in a calm, fully monitored Ayurvedic environment.

First-Time Ayurveda Curious

Anyone curious about Ayurveda but waiting for the right time to begin — Karkidaka is that window, when the body is naturally more receptive and even a first-time guest can see meaningful change.

Poor Sleep & Mood Imbalance

Those experiencing disturbed sleep, low energy, mood fluctuations, or a general sense that body and mind are out of rhythm and need a guided, supervised pause to fully reset and rebalance.

A 4-Pillar Medical-Grade Regimen

At Kairali, Karkidaka is not a generic "monsoon detox" but a complete, medically supervised regimen in an NABH-accredited hospital-grade Ayurveda retreat — recognised among India's leading wellness destinations.

Panchakarma — Deep Detoxification

A structured detox to eliminate Ama (toxins) from deep tissues through classical purification procedures including Virechana, Basti, and Nasyam — preceded by Snehapana, Abhyangam, and Swedana to prepare the body.

Rasayana — Tissue Rejuvenation

Post-detox therapies such as Pizhichil, Njavara Kizhi, Shirodhara, and Udwarthanam help rebuild strength, calm the nervous system, relieve pain, and support healthy ageing.

Aushadha Seva — Internal Medicine & Diet

Daily Karkidaka Kanji, individualised herbal decoctions (Kashaya or Kwatha), medicated ghee (Snehapana), and targeted supplements like Chyawanprash and Ashwagandha restore Agni, support immunity, and correct long-standing imbalances.

Sattvavajaya — Mind & Spirit Reset

Daily yoga, pranayama, and meditation balance Prana, reduce stress, improve sleep, and anchor the physical therapies in emotional and mental wellbeing.

Choose Your Karkidaka Healing Window

Whether you have a week or three, the monsoon works with you. Every program is built around your body, not a fixed formula. Clinical Karkidaka programs typically start from approximately ₹22,780 per night, with 14-night stays depending on accommodation and treatment intensity. This helps you self-select the stay that fits your health goals and budget.

The Monsoon Starter

A short but powerful entry into Karkidaka healing. Seven days that flush out fatigue and bring you back to yourself.

The Monsoon Reset

Two weeks is where real change begins. A structured, physician-led program that works through your body's deepest channels.

The Monsoon Overhaul

For those truly ready. Three weeks of the most comprehensive Ayurvedic care available — deep cellular restoration you'll carry for years.

Note: All programs are personalised based on individual constitution and physician assessment. Inclusions are indicative and subject to clinical evaluation.

A Dedicated Circle of Ayurvedic Physicians

A team trained across Panchakarma, Neurology, Rheumatology, and Gastroenterology walks with you throughout your Karkidaka stay — from arrival to discharge.

What Karkidaka Has Done for Guests

Verified outcomes shared by guests who completed their Karkidaka programs at Kairali.

"My CRP levels dropped from 18 to 5."

After 14 days of monsoon Panchakarma for rheumatoid arthritis, my CRP levels dropped from 18 to 5 and I've been off daily NSAIDs for 6 months.

"Sleeping 7–8 hours without medication."

I arrived exhausted, sleeping barely 4 hours a night. By day 10 of my Karkidaka program, I was sleeping 7–8 hours without medication and my fasting blood sugar came down from 152 to 112.

"Neck and back pain from 8/10 to 2/10."

Twenty-one days here reduced my chronic neck and lower-back pain from 8/10 to 2/10 on most days. I can work, travel, and practice yoga again without fear of a flare-up.

Questions, Answered Without Evasion

Honest, direct answers for guests considering a Karkidaka program.

Begin Your Karkidaka Healing Journey

Share a little about yourself and let our Ayurvedic physicians craft a Karkidaka protocol that speaks to your body, your rhythm, and your needs.

One of our BAMS physicians will personally reach out within 24 hours. No obligation, no pressure — just a conversation about your wellbeing.

Karkidaka Chikitsa is performed during the Karkidakam month (July–August) of the Malayalam calendar — the peak of Kerala's monsoon and, by classical Ayurvedic teaching, the most powerful healing window of the year.

Also known as Karkidaka Ayurveda Treatment, this is a traditional monsoon Ayurvedic treatment from Kerala. According to Ayurveda, this window is ideal for deep detoxification and rejuvenation, as the body becomes more receptive to therapies in the cooler, humid climate — allowing treatments to work at a deeper level on your tissues and doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha).

"Most 'monsoon packages' simply offer the same massages all year. Karkidaka here is different — season-specific, physician-designed protocols that work on root causes your usual treatments never touch."

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers a specialised Karkidaka Chikitsa retreat in Kerala, crafted as an intensive monsoon Ayurveda detox program to enhance immunity, clear accumulated toxins, and gently restore your natural balance through time-tested, clinically aligned therapies rooted in classical Ayurveda.

By combining authentic seasonal treatments, personalised diets, and a nature-immersed NABH-accredited clinical setting, this focused monsoon therapy supports your body, mind, and spirit to reset and heal in the most powerful Ayurvedic season of the year.

Four Things Only the Monsoon Can Do to Your Body

What the rainy season delivers, no other window of the year can quite replicate.

Humidity Opens Your Body

When monsoon humidity peaks, your skin's absorption capacity reaches its annual high. Herbal oils penetrate layers of tissue that remain unreachable in any other season — allowing every drop of medicated oil to deliver its full therapeutic effect deep into your body.

Natural Detox Momentum

The monsoon season puts your body's elimination system into overdrive. When Panchakarma is performed during this window, the results aren't just better — it works with the body's natural rhythms in a way that off-season treatments simply cannot replicate.

Nervous System Reset

The rainy season creates a unique biological state in which your nervous system becomes deeply receptive to healing. Treatments like Shirodhara and Basti performed during this period deliver breakthroughs that would otherwise take an entire year of practice to fully achieve.

Karkidaka Kanji Ritual

Once a year, for exactly thirty days, a centuries-old morning ritual comes alive. A warm porridge — prepared the same way it has been for generations — quietly rebuilds your immunity, gut, and vitality from the ground up over four sustained weeks.

Is the Monsoon Calling You?

This Karkidaka program is for you if your body has been whispering — or shouting — that it cannot keep up with the life you are asking it to live.

You may come with a specific diagnosis or simply with the sense that something is "off" — energy, mood, gut, or sleep. If you are ready to pause, listen, and let experienced Ayurvedic physicians hold your healing for 7, 14, or 21 days, this season and this healing village were designed for you.

Concerns Karkidaka Can Meaningfully Address
Chronic Pain & Stiffness

For those living with chronic neck, back, or joint pain who have relied on temporary relief and are ready for structured Panchakarma and Rasayana support that targets root causes.

Stress, Fatigue & Burnout

Professionals carrying years of stress, fatigue, poor sleep, or nervous-system overload who need more than a long weekend to truly come back to themselves and recover at a deeper level.

Metabolic & Lifestyle Concerns

Individuals facing weight fluctuations, metabolic imbalances, blood sugar concerns, sluggish digestion, or recurring acidity and bloating who want to address the root causes rather than continuing to manage surface symptoms.

Post-Illness & Recovery

Guests recovering from recent illness, post-infection weakness, or long periods of medication who need a clinically supervised detox and a structured immunity rebuild in a calm, fully monitored Ayurvedic environment.

First-Time Ayurveda Curious

Anyone curious about Ayurveda but waiting for the right time to begin — Karkidaka is that window, when the body is naturally more receptive and even a first-time guest can see meaningful change.

Poor Sleep & Mood Imbalance

Those experiencing disturbed sleep, low energy, mood fluctuations, or a general sense that body and mind are out of rhythm and need a guided, supervised pause to fully reset and rebalance.

A 4-Pillar Medical-Grade Regimen

At Kairali, Karkidaka is not a generic "monsoon detox" but a complete, medically supervised regimen in an NABH-accredited hospital-grade Ayurveda retreat — recognised among India's leading wellness destinations.

Panchakarma — Deep Detoxification

A structured detox to eliminate Ama (toxins) from deep tissues through classical purification procedures including Virechana, Basti, and Nasyam — preceded by Snehapana, Abhyangam, and Swedana to prepare the body.

Rasayana — Tissue Rejuvenation

Post-detox therapies such as Pizhichil, Njavara Kizhi, Shirodhara, and Udwarthanam help rebuild strength, calm the nervous system, relieve pain, and support healthy ageing.

Aushadha Seva — Internal Medicine & Diet

Daily Karkidaka Kanji, individualised herbal decoctions (Kashaya or Kwatha), medicated ghee (Snehapana), and targeted supplements like Chyawanprash and Ashwagandha restore Agni, support immunity, and correct long-standing imbalances.

Sattvavajaya — Mind & Spirit Reset

Daily yoga, pranayama, and meditation balance Prana, reduce stress, improve sleep, and anchor the physical therapies in emotional and mental wellbeing.

Choose Your Karkidaka Healing Window

Whether you have a week or three, the monsoon works with you. Every program is built around your body, not a fixed formula. Clinical Karkidaka programs typically start from approximately ₹22,780 per night, with 14-night stays depending on accommodation and treatment intensity. This helps you self-select the stay that fits your health goals and budget.

The Monsoon Starter

A short but powerful entry into Karkidaka healing. Seven days that flush out fatigue and bring you back to yourself.

The Monsoon Reset

Two weeks is where real change begins. A structured, physician-led program that works through your body's deepest channels.

The Monsoon Overhaul

For those truly ready. Three weeks of the most comprehensive Ayurvedic care available — deep cellular restoration you'll carry for years.

Note: All programs are personalised based on individual constitution and physician assessment. Inclusions are indicative and subject to clinical evaluation.

A Dedicated Circle of Ayurvedic Physicians

A team trained across Panchakarma, Neurology, Rheumatology, and Gastroenterology walks with you throughout your Karkidaka stay — from arrival to discharge.

What Karkidaka Has Done for Guests

Verified outcomes shared by guests who completed their Karkidaka programs at Kairali.

"My CRP levels dropped from 18 to 5."

After 14 days of monsoon Panchakarma for rheumatoid arthritis, my CRP levels dropped from 18 to 5 and I've been off daily NSAIDs for 6 months.

"Sleeping 7–8 hours without medication."

I arrived exhausted, sleeping barely 4 hours a night. By day 10 of my Karkidaka program, I was sleeping 7–8 hours without medication and my fasting blood sugar came down from 152 to 112.

"Neck and back pain from 8/10 to 2/10."

Twenty-one days here reduced my chronic neck and lower-back pain from 8/10 to 2/10 on most days. I can work, travel, and practice yoga again without fear of a flare-up.

Questions, Answered Without Evasion

Honest, direct answers for guests considering a Karkidaka program.

Begin Your Karkidaka Healing Journey

Share a little about yourself and let our Ayurvedic physicians craft a Karkidaka protocol that speaks to your body, your rhythm, and your needs.

One of our BAMS physicians will personally reach out within 24 hours. No obligation, no pressure — just a conversation about your wellbeing.

Karma Being Retreat 2019

This page records the 2019 retreat. Its programme, inclusions, travel notes and biographies are historical and must not be used for current bookings or travel planning.

Past Retreats

Historical retreat description
Karma Being Retreat 2019

Take a transformational journey to Kerala, India as you embrace the ancient healing science of Ayurveda.

Touted ‘God’s own Country’ Kerala is India’s luscious jewel abundant with herb and tea plantations, scenic beaches and breathtaking backwaters.

Our retreat takes place at the award winning Kairali Ayurvedic Healing Village well away from the hustle and bustle of India’s City’s. People come here from all corners of the globe to experience profound healing and it’s also where the Indian people themselves come to restore balance, health and inner harmony.

Your retreat begins with a detailed consultation with an Ayurvedic doctor who will carefully design Ayurveda experiences to treat, heal, restore and rejuvenate your health. Ayurveda is an elaborate healing system of India, a science of life based on the laws of nature. Its derived from the Sanskrit words Ayur(life) and Veda(knowledge), it traces its origins to about 50 centuries.

Each day on retreat begins with a yoga session and includes 2 x Daily Ayurveda Treatment (prescribed especially for you by the Doctor), meditation, nourishing food and relaxation. Dotted throughout your retreat you will experience an Ayurvedic cooking class, mindfulness workshops and Yoga Nidra which will arm you with invaluable life skills to return home with.

Upon our arrival in India, before we embark on our Ayurvedic Healing Journey we spend 2 nights in Fort Kochi just 45mins from the international airport. There will be a full day to explore this eclectic neighbourhood at your leisure including the lively spice and antique market and local art scene. After meandering the well preserved colonial streets on foot or by rickshaw we finish our day taking in an unforgettable sunset as the fisherman return with the days catch. For dinner we’ll be feasting on Kerala’s signature curries with new and old friends.

Dosha Quiz

Have you ever wondered why people gain weight at different rates, walk at different speeds and are prone to different health problems? According to the ancient Indian healing system Ayurveda, the answer lies in your constitution type or Dosha. This quiz will help you identify your Dosha, discover which elements govern you and learn how to live the optimum lifestyle for your constitution type.

What’s Included
8 nights at Kairali Ayuvedic Healing Village Accommodation in renovated stand alone ‘Deluxe Villas’
2 nights in Fort Kochi at Old Lighthouse Bristow Hotel
All Meals prepared using traditional Ayurvedic Principles (except one lunch not included in Fort Kochi)
2 x Daily Ayurveda Treatment (45 mins – 1 hour each) prescribed specifically to treat your unique ailments + steam bath
Absolute beginners welcome
Daily Yoga Nidra, Meditation or mindfulness
Ayurvedic Doctors Consultation
Ayurvedic Cooking Class
Village Walk
Use of Pool, gym, library and all indoor and outdoor facilities
welcome drink on arrival
2 x mineral water in room per day
daily juice or herbal tea
All Transfers Airport – Fort Kochi – Ayurvedic Healing Village – Airport

Retreat Notes
Visas

Visas are the responsibility of the individual traveller and currently the E Visa can be applied for 34 days prior to arrival. Entry requirements can change at any time so be sure to visit https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/visa/tvoa.html for up to date information.

INDIA:

An E-Tourist Visa (eVT) Facility is available for holders of a passport for a number of countries. This facility allows travellers to pre-register and pay for their visa prior to travel to India. The Visa is collected upon arrival at one of 16 designated airports in India. Please note strict guidelines on the below website.

An E-Tourist Visa (eVT) visa on arrival is available for select nationalities including but not limited to the following

Australian, Canadian, New Zealand, German, UK and USA passports.

Passport holders from these countries can apply for an E-Tourist Visa (eVT) to have their visa issued upon arrival at 16 major airports in India including Chennai and Trivandrum.

Please follow the instructions at – https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/visa/tvoa.html and complete the application for your E-Tourist Visa.

– Please be aware of strict conditions regarding application and travel (check under ELIGIBILITY section).

– E-visas are only available for entry of up to 30 days. If you plan to be in India longer you will need to apply for a tourist visa at an Indian visa application centre in your home country.

For your visa application you need to include the following information under the local contact section towards the end of the application. :

Fragrant Nature Retreat & Resorts Pvt Ltd.
CP II/709, Nedungolam P.O, Paravur –
Kollam, Kerala, India PIN:691334.

Please note that this information can change at any time. Please always refer to https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/visa/tvoa.html . This is the official visa online site. There have been reports of other non-official websites that travellers should be aware of.

Your visa application form may require you to state the dates on which you enter and exit that country. Please note we suggest you list your date of entry a few days before, and date of exit a few days after, your intended dates in case you encounter any delays or problems en route.

If you would prefer to have your Visa handled by an agent we recommend Vina Visas www.vinavisas.com

Accommodation

2 Nights
Old Lighthouse Bristow Hotel, Fort Kochi

8 Nights
Ayurvedic Healing Village, Kerala is the venue for our retreat. To find out more visit: https://www.ayurvedichealingvillage.com/

Food

Delicious Keralan cuisine, prepared using traditional Ayurvedic principles with pesticide free produce from the retreats own farm.

Getting There

Closest Airport is Kochi. Flights not included.

If you wish to fly with the teacher, Emily will be travelling on Singapore Airlines
Departing Brisbane on Thursday 14th November at 09:10 on SQ256 to Kochi (Via Singapore)
Arriving at Cochin International at 22:05

RETURN
Departing Kochi on Sunday 24th November at at 22:55 on M1467 to Brisbane (Via Singapore) and arriving at 16:55 on the the 25th November.

Teachers

Emily is a Yoga and Mindfulness Teacher and certified Holistic Health Coach. Recognised as an expert in her field, Emily has garnered much acclaim from her viewership on www.fmtv.com where she appears alongside other industry leaders including Deepak Chopra, Wayne Dyer and Dr Bruce Lipton to name a few.

With a decade of teaching experience under her belt Emily is also an eternal student of yoga globally with formal training in Hatha and Vinyasa flow. She has beautifully combined these styles to create her own much loved yoga experience. This ‘fusion’ style is the perfect blend of light and shade, one flow will have you generating heat and building lean muscle and the next will have you blissing out in a slow, opening restorative sequence.

“I love watching the profound effect yoga has on my students, a transformation takes place from the moment they step on to the mat to when their eyes open after Savasana. Yoga has been invaluable in my life as a mum of two young children and also in my previous corporate job. Whatever your situation, yoga can help you navigate the roller coaster that is life. It is my pleasure to share this gift with you.”

PAST RETREAT

Karma Being Retreat

This is a past retreat. The original description, programme and inclusions below are retained as a historical record and are not a current offer. There are no current dates or bookings for this retreat.

Past Retreats

Historical retreat description
Ayurveda & Yoga Retreat – Kerala, India

Set off on a unique journey to one of India’s most stunning southern states, Kerala. Blessed with beautiful landscapes, idyllic beaches, and breathtaking emerald backwaters, it’s no surprise that it ranks among “the paradises of the world” and “50 places of a lifetime,” according to National Geographic Traveller Magazine.

Our retreat offers a more relaxed atmosphere in the Palakkad district, situated at the base of the majestic and enchanting Western Ghats at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village. Awarded ‘Best Luxury Destination Spa, 2012’ by World Luxury Spa Awards, your second home boasts all contemporary luxuries, including a swimming pool, gym, and tennis court. All of this is encircled by vast acres of organic Ayurvedic fields and extensive jungle.

During the retreat, you’ll meet with an Ayurvedic doctor who will recommend specific herbs and treatments tailored to your individual needs. You will participate in two ayurvedic therapies each day, along with a steam bath, paired with daily yoga and meditation sessions. You will additionally obtain a personal lifestyle and fitness assessment and discover the ancient Indian healing science through lectures on Ayurveda and cooking in the Ayurvedic tradition.

You will reside in a deluxe villa with air conditioning, allocated based on your Zodiac sign. Every villa features a tranquil stream encircling it and adheres to “Vastu Shastra” (akin to Feng Shui) to foster harmony with nature and the universal energy flow.

Ayurvedic Nutrition is a big focus at the Ayurvedic Healing Village and each meal is an exquisite feast of vegetarian cuisine.

One on One Session with the teacher of your choice:

Seize this wonderful chance to enhance your practice, address an injury, or perfect poses you find challenging. Dedicate 30 minutes individually with either Suzie, Jane, or Kerry to explore whatever you wish. Suzie focuses on scoliosis and shoulder issues, while Kerry and Jane are to be announced. Kindly reach out to your preferred teacher to schedule your session at a convenient time for both.

Description of Treatment:

Abhyangam (General therapy): The individual receiving the treatment is positioned on the Droni (a wooden bed specifically designed for the therapy). Two masseuses are positioned on both sides of the individual, spreading herbal oil on the scalp and massaging softly. The treatment proceeds on the neck, ears, shoulders, chest, and back. The individual then lies on their back and the treatment proceeds from shoulders to toes. Throughout the therapy session, the individual reclines on their right side, left side, stomach, then back again, and ultimately in a seated posture. General therapy (Abhyangam) has proven to be highly effective in enhancing vision, prolonging life, ensuring restful sleep, alleviating rheumatism, boosting vitality, and promoting radiant skin. These treatments are also a form of preventive healthcare; in brief, they revitalize the body and sustain the physique.

Dhara: The patient rests on a wooden bed in a relaxed posture. A uniquely crafted device is loaded with the therapeutic oil and positioned at a designated elevation. The masseur subsequently moves the device back and forth, allowing the oil to flow steadily and softly over the forehead. The head is subsequently dried with a towel, and oil is reapplied to it. This therapy can be applied to a specific area or the entire body, based on the condition. It encourages renewal and revitalization of the human body and mind, reducing the impact of aging. This is a unique treatment for stress and tension.

Pizhichil: This is among our unique treatments to revitalize the entire body. The recommended medicated oil is used on the scalp and the whole body. During this therapy, the patient reclines on the Droni (a wooden bed specifically created for this use). Next, a section of linen soaked in warm therapeutic oil is pressed onto the patient’s body while it is gently massaged with a slow, light touch. This treatment safeguards you against diseases and enhances your immune system, boosting your vitality and well-being. It also supports recovery from rheumatic conditions, hypertension, joint pain, and diabetes.

What’s included
8 nights accommodation in an Air-conditioned Deluxe Villa
Vegetarian Meals; breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Ayurvedic Doctor consultation
Personal Lifestyle and Fitness Evaluation
2 x daily Ayurvedic treatments with steam bath
Daily Yoga and Meditation
Lecture on Ayurveda
Lecture on Ayurvedic cooking
Teacher

Join classes with some of the top teachers in Australia. Each possesses a distinct style that aids in uniting body, mind, and spirit. Appropriate for novices to experienced individuals.

Join us for classes with some of the top educators in Australia. Each possesses a distinct style that will assist you in uniting your body, mind, and spirit. Appropriate for novices to seasoned practitioners.

This page records the retreat held from 25–31 July 2019. Its programme, timings, facilities and inclusions are historical and are not current booking terms.

Past Retreats

Historical retreat description
Katha Wellness Retreat 2019 (25 – 31 July 2019)

A break is exactly what you need when you feel drained of energy and fatigued by daily routines. This is the moment to reflect inward and regain harmony among your mind, body, and soul.

And where better to discover and reinvent YOURSELF than in God’s own land, Kerala!

We present to you Katha Wellness Retreat at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village.

Unwind in nature’s embrace, encircled by lush greenery, inhale the crisp air and appreciate the peacefulness following a rejuvenating period of Yoga and meditation.

There’s even more to anticipate in a storytelling session where you’ll discover the ancient Vedic texts presented straightforwardly, allowing you to easily integrate the deep teachings into your everyday life for an improved existence!

Additionally, you can indulge in soothing Ayurvedic massages that will revitalize you and assist in restoring the physical vitality that a demanding life has taken away from you.

This retreat aims to help individuals who wish to escape stress, restructure their lives to incorporate healthy habits, both physically and spiritually, and to lead a more fulfilling life upon returning home.

Highlights
Yoga classes Ayurvedic massages
Vedic storytelling
Interesting places to visit near the retreat
Daily vegetarian meals
6 nights accommodation
Yoga Style – Hatha

All 6 days of instruction in English.

Lakshya Yoga Retreat 2017

This page preserves the Lakshya Yoga Retreat 2017 material. Its programme, schedule and inclusions are historical and are not current booking terms.

Past Retreats

Historical retreat description
Lakshya Yoga Retreat 2017

Kairali Ayurvedic Group, a symbol of wellness and quality living, was established in 1989 to promote Ayurvedic principles globally. The founders had deep knowledge of Ayurveda and believed in the principles of holistic living, genuinely acknowledging its potential to heal and purify both body and spirit. They transmitted their extensive experience and wisdom through four generations of physicians who are equally dedicated to revitalizing Ayurveda. It is as a result of their collective endeavors that the Kairali Ayurvedic group has attained new heights of success and generosity.

A key event is the Lakshya Yoga Retreat, a week-long celebration of Ayurveda, Yoga, and a healthy lifestyle. During this retreat, various yogic practices are showcased, offering participants a range of services and guidance concerning health. Numerous renowned practices of Ayurveda, including Panchkarma, are utilised here, making this retreat an essential destination to visit.

Kairli – The Ayurvedic Healing Village represents the essence of tranquility and a healthy lifestyle, allowing individuals to reside free from external disturbances or concerns. Combining advanced technology with the timeless kindness of Ayurveda, this serene environment transforms into an ideal retreat from the busy pace of life.

Join us for our retreat focused on Yoga & Ayurveda at the Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village located in Palakkad, Kerala. This retreat offers an ideal chance to unwind, rejuvenate, and explore the practice of yoga more profoundly. We will partake in Ayurvedic massages, yoga sessions, meditations, and 3 buffet meals daily featuring tasty vegetarian cuisine.

Incorporated in the Retreat
Village Stroll
2 Yoga sessions & 1 Meditation daily
1 Ayurvedic Massage per day
Vegetarian Ayurvedic meal spread (3 servings daily)
Meetings with the Ayurvedic Physicians
Lodging in cottages
Introduction to a conversation about Ayurveda
Ayurvedic Cuisine Workshop
Chanting Mantras

Kariali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is located amid 65 acres of vibrant greenery in Palakkad, Kerala. It features 30 unique villas, all adhering to the “Vastu Shastra” design – the Indian equivalent of feng shui. The retreat is enveloped by herbs and trees possessing great healing and rejuvenating abilities, creating the perfect tranquil haven to unwind in! There is a large swimming pool, library, and gym amenities.

The Daily Schedule
07:00 am to 08:00 am – Hatha Yoga
08:00 am to 09:00 am – Breakfast

2:00 pm to 5:00 pm – Free time/ Second Ayurvedic massage

6:45-7:15 – Meditation

Join the Yoga & Ayurveda retreat at the Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village located in Palakkad, Kerala.

This retreat offers an ideal chance to explore the practice of yoga more profoundly and indulge in Ayurvedic therapies. A four-day retreat that allows you to fully unplug from your routines, technology, and congestion. We will immerse ourselves in the beautiful, abundant nature of Kerala, engaging in yoga, ayurvedic massages, meditation, and enjoying delightful ayurvedic vegetarian meals.

Visit to nearby Ashram

◆
Past Retreats
Historical retreat description

A week of complete rest and revitalization. Reconnect with your inner self via yoga and meditation. Nurture your body with Ayurvedic massages and therapies. Feed your stomach with tasty vegetarian dishes!

We rise to the melody of birds and begin the day with a hatha yoga session. What finer method to invigorate both body and mind! We then enjoy a tasty vegetarian breakfast from South India. The day consists of ayurvedic therapies and lots of leisure time to reflect and appreciate the serene green landscape nearby. Enjoy a swim, take a stroll, or just read a book on the terrace of your exclusive villa! Next, we enjoy lunch and a possible second treatment, and the day concludes with another yoga session. In the evening, we have our meal and occasionally come together for a brief satsanga.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is located within 65 acres of verdant surroundings in Palakkad, Kerala. It boasts 30 exclusive villas, all designed according to “Vastu Shastra” architecture – the Indian equivalent of feng shui. This indicates that they each possess a unique design, harmonizing with the environment and encircled by plants and trees known for their significant healing and rejuvenating abilities.

07.00 am to 08:00 am – Hatha Yoga
◆

Learn About Ayurveda
Learn About Ayurveda

Kairali’s The Ayurvedic Healing Village is one of the few Ayurvedic Treatment centers to be registered as an Ayurvedic hospital by the Government of Kerala, which also recognizes us as the ‘model’ of an Ayurvedic health retreat. Our significant achievements in both healthcare and hospitality has made us an industry leader in both areas, as can be seen in our long list of accreditations and awards.

Training at our Ayurveda College in Kerala

Students of Kairali Ayurvedic Group benefit from four generations and eight decades of experience in Ayurveda treatments; giving us a well-deserved reputation for quality and authenticity. Our growing international reputation brings students from all over the world to our Ayurveda College and Training Institute in Palakkad, Kerala; aiming to earn a Diploma from a world-leader in Ayurvedic spa therapy.

Training courses at our Ayurvedic Massage College will provide you with exceptional expertise in Ayurveda theory and practice; a considerable advantage to spa therapists considering the unprecedented spread of Ayurvedic techniques internationally. Studying massage or Panchakarma with Kairali prepares you to provide these treatments at a very high level, enhancing the value of your therapy skills and work resume.

Some of our guests wish to gain introductory training in Ayurveda, Massage, Yoga or Meditation, and we are pleased to provide fifteen day beginners’ courses at our luxury retreat center in Palakkad, Kerala – the home of Ayurveda in India.

Those with an interest in complementary or holistic approaches to health should consider starting with the therapy that has the longest lineage. Ayurveda, the ancient health practice of India is thought by some historians to predate even ancient Egyptian medicine. Acknowledged as the inventor of modern day surgery, Ayurvedic Treatment and detoxification methods have remained popular for thousands of years, and their success now precipitates the worldwide spread of this natural and traditional wellbeing knowledge.

The first thing to learn about Ayurveda is that the body must always be viewed as a whole, rather than in its separate parts. This means accepting the body as part of an integrated system, involving mind, body and soul. Ayurveda offers curative, as well as preventative methods of health and understands that a united approach to lifestyle ensures true health and longevity.

While viewing all individuals as part of an interwoven community, Ayurveda also looks deeply into each individual. This is the reason that no two courses of Ayurveda Treatment can ever be the same. Guests undertake an initial consultation with one of our experienced and compassionate Ayurvedic doctors, who remain in a supervisory role in order to tailor their treatments perfectly to their body type and individual health needs.

Part of this initial consultation, or ‘Prakriti Analysis’ is the diagnosis of the individual’s body type, or Ayurvedic dosha. Ayurvedic dosha theory is built upon the ancient metaphysics of the five elements, which appear in different combinations in each of us, forming our unique individuality. The tri-dosha system consists of; Vata Dosha, representing ether and air; Pita Dosha representing fire and water; and Kapha Dosha, representing water and earth.

The Retreat Environment at The Ayurvedic Healing Village

Guests undergoing Panchakarma detoxification or another Ayurveda treatment can expect a transformative procedure a Kairali’s The Ayurvedic Healing Village. Our precisely tailored individual courses of treatment are intense processes, ensuring deep and long-lasting renewal of health. For this reason, guests benefit all the more from our tranquil healing environment and private luxury villas offered at our Kerala retreat center.

Yoga and Meditation

The fundamental healing practices of Yoga and Meditation will greatly enhance your experience of Ayurveda, and provide physical and mental ease when practiced in the long-term. Our excellent Yoga teachers provide daily Yoga sessions and meditation training to guests at The Ayurvedic Healing Village. Those wishing to undertake a dedicated course in these practices should read more about our Yoga and Meditation training.

Ayurvedic Oil Massage

Herbal oil massage is a fundamental part of Ayurvedic therapy, and the ancient scripture recommends that it is performed on a near-daily basis, for optimum health and relaxation!

The Managing Director and co-founder of Kairali, Mrs. Gita Ramesh has written an introduction and practical guide to this transformative method of therapy. The following extracts are taken from her excellent manual, which is available in English and Dutch.

state.bodyText:

Level One Advanced Ayurveda Training Program
AYURVEDA TRAINING COURSE · AATP1-HV · 10 DAYS
Level One Advanced Ayurveda Training Program

A ten-day residential programme for wellness professionals: two hours of theory and two hours of practical each day, building from the foundations of Ayurveda to the confident performance of Abhyangam, Shirodhara, Nasyam, Podikizhi, Udwarthanam and Kativasti, and to basic Ayurvedic wellness consultations. Certification on successful completion.

Plan your Ayurveda training

Tell us about your background and the course you are considering. We can discuss the training options with you.

ENQUIRE ABOUT AYURVEDA TRAINING
PROCESS
FEATURES
COURSES
FAQS
RELATED
THE PROGRAMME
Process Involved In the Level One Advanced Program

Ten days, each pairing a theory block with a practical block. Therapies are learnt in stages — head, neck and body, then the prone position, then full body — before the next therapy is introduced.

01

Day 1 — Introduction to Ayurveda, its history, branches and divisions; Abhyangam of the head, neck and body.

02

Day 2 — Panchamahabhuta, Tridosha, Saptadhatu, Agni and Ama; Abhyangam in the prone position.

03

Day 3 — Swastha Lakshana, the Trigunas, health and disease; full-body Abhyangam.

04

Day 4 — Treatment modalities and Shirodhara theory; Shirodhara practical.

05

Day 5 — Abhyangam and Shirodhara review, Nasyam theory; Nasyam practical.

06

Day 6 — Dosha, Dhatu and Mala, the classification of disease, Podikizhi theory; Podikizhi preparation, tying and application.

07

Day 7 — Dinacharya, Ritucharya, anatomy and physiology; Podikizhi practical.

08

Day 8 — Ahara and Vihara, the basics of Dravyaguna, anatomy part two; Udwarthanam theory and practical.

09

Day 9 — Roga and Rogi Pareeksha, an introduction to Panchakarma, Kativasti theory; Kativasti practical.

10

Day 10 — Prakriti basics and the analysis questionnaire; review of all therapies and closing Q&A.

Features of the program
◆
Format: forty hours — two hours of theory and two hours of practical daily over ten days — with group yoga and meditation sessions.
◆
Who it suits: therapists, wellness counsellors and the wider wellness fraternity; yoga instructors and holistic practitioners.

A ten-day residential programme for wellness professionals: two hours of theory and two hours of practical each day, building from the foundations of Ayurveda to the confident performance of Abhyangam, Shirodhara, Nasyam, Podikizhi, Udwarthanam and Kativasti, and to basic Ayurvedic wellness consultations. THE PROGRAMME
Process Involved In the Level One Advanced Program

Ten days, each pairing a theory block with a practical block. Therapies are learnt in stages — head, neck and body, then the prone position, then full body — before the next therapy is introduced.

01

Day 1 — Introduction to Ayurveda, its history, branches and divisions; Abhyangam of the head, neck and body.

02

Day 2 — Panchamahabhuta, Tridosha, Saptadhatu, Agni and Ama; Abhyangam in the prone position.

03

Day 3 — Swastha Lakshana, the Trigunas, health and disease; full-body Abhyangam.

04

Day 4 — Treatment modalities and Shirodhara theory; Shirodhara practical.

05

Day 5 — Abhyangam and Shirodhara review, Nasyam theory; Nasyam practical.

06

Day 6 — Dosha, Dhatu and Mala, the classification of disease, Podikizhi theory; Podikizhi preparation, tying and application.

07

Day 7 — Dinacharya, Ritucharya, anatomy and physiology; Podikizhi practical.

08

Day 8 — Ahara and Vihara, the basics of Dravyaguna, anatomy part two; Udwarthanam theory and practical.

09

Day 9 — Roga and Rogi Pareeksha, an introduction to Panchakarma, Kativasti theory; Kativasti practical.

10

Day 10 — Prakriti basics and the analysis questionnaire; review of all therapies and closing Q&A.

Panchakarma – panch and karmas, when literally translated means ‘Five Procedures’. It is an ayurvedic treatment that involves elaborated methods of purification to release stress, which prepares the body tissues to accept the maximum benefits of food, nutrition and exercise.

The five procedures are Vamana (Emesis), Virechana (Purgation), Niroohavasti (Decoction enema), Nasya (Instillation of medicine through nostrils), and Anuvasanavasti (Oil enema). Panchkarma treatment is a three stage process—purva (pre-operative), pradhana (operative) and paschat (post-operative) measures. Ayurveda advises to practice Purvakarma because of the deep rooted imbalances in the body, which needs to be flushed out in the right way by Purvakarma and then by Panchkarma.

To undergo a purification therapy it is highly important for the body to be prepared for the rigorous process to encourage the body to let go of the toxins. Treatment like abhyangam, shirodhara and elakizhi are included to soften the tissues where the oil is applied to the entire body with a particular type of massage which helps the toxins to move towards the gastro-intestinal tract. Thereafter, therapies like Vamana, Virechana, Vasti, Nasya, Raktamoksha are used as per the body constitution (Vata, Pitta and Kapha) to complete the detoxifying process.

Accumulation of ama (toxin) is the primary reason for almost every disease and Panchkarma help us get rid of ama.

The Maharaja Suite is the ultimate lodging option at this Ayurvedic retreat, combining luxury and imperial grandeur. As the name suggests, “Maharaja” means “Emperor,” and this magnificent suite provides a regal experience.
