Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, nestled in the serene landscapes of Palakkad, Kerala, is a sanctuary of tranquility where ancient Ayurvedic wisdom meets the transformative power of meditation. Our meditation programs are designed to help you embark on a journey of self-discovery, inner peace, and holistic well-being. With a deep respect for the traditional practices of Ayurveda, our offerings integrate meditative techniques that align your body, mind, and spirit.

Why Meditation?

Meditation is an ancient practice that calms the mind and promotes mental clarity. In Ayurveda, it is regarded as a powerful tool to balance the three doshas – Vata, Pitta, and Kapha – and enhance overall health. Stress, anxiety, and emotional imbalance often disrupt this equilibrium, leading to physical and mental ailments. Through meditation, we can restore harmony, foster mindfulness, and achieve a profound sense of relaxation.

Meditation Programs at the Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village

At Kairali -The Ayurvedic Healing Village, meditation is more than a practice—it is a lifestyle. We offer guided meditation sessions tailored to individual needs, ensuring that every participant experiences its benefits to the fullest.

Beginner’s Meditation: For those new to meditation, we provide foundational sessions that introduce simple techniques to calm the mind, improve focus, and cultivate inner awareness.

Advanced Meditation: For seasoned practitioners, advanced techniques delve deeper into the realms of consciousness, fostering self-realization and spiritual growth.

Mindfulness Practices: Our mindfulness sessions are designed to anchor your awareness in the present moment, reducing stress and enhancing mental resilience.

Customized Retreats: We craft personalized meditation retreats based on your unique constitution (Prakriti) and health goals. These retreats seamlessly integrate meditation with Ayurvedic therapies for a comprehensive healing experience.
The Benefits of Meditation

Meditation at the Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a gateway to numerous physical, mental, and emotional benefits, including:

Stress Relief: Regular practice reduces cortisol levels, helping you manage stress effectively.
Enhanced Focus and Clarity: Meditation sharpens the mind, improving decision-making and creativity.
Improved Emotional Health: It fosters emotional stability, reducing feelings of anxiety and depression.
Holistic Healing: When combined with Ayurveda, meditation addresses the root cause of imbalances, promoting long-lasting health.
Spiritual Growth: It deepens your connection with your inner self, paving the way for personal growth and enlightenment.
The Perfect Setting for Meditation

Surrounded by lush greenery, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers the perfect ambiance for meditation. The gentle rustle of palm trees, the chirping of birds, and the soothing flow of nearby streams create an environment conducive to deep relaxation and introspection. Our meditation spaces, designed with simplicity and elegance, resonate with peace, ensuring that every moment spent here enriches your journey.

Why Choose the Ayurvedic Healing Village?

With decades of expertise in Ayurveda and wellness, the Ayurvedic Healing Village provides a unique blend of traditional knowledge and modern comforts. Our team of experienced meditation guides and Ayurvedic practitioners is committed to helping you achieve optimal well-being. Whether you seek to alleviate stress, enhance focus, or embark on a spiritual journey, our meditation programs are the ideal choice.

Experience the profound benefits of meditation at the Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village. Allow us to guide you toward a life of balance, vitality, and inner peace. Begin your transformation today!

PAST RETREAT
Mindfulness Retreat

This is a past retreat. The original description and speaker biographies below are retained as a historical record and are not a current offer. There are no current dates or bookings for this retreat.

◆
Past Retreats
HISTORICAL RETREAT DESCRIPTION
India’s first Mindfulness Retreat in Palakkad Kerala June 26-30

Guided by famous coach Santhosh Babu, Iyengar yoga specialist Raageshwari, and American Holotropic Breathwork professionals Sharanya and Dough.

A dozen specialists, including renowned coach Santhosh Babu, singer and actress Raageshwari, and American holotropic breathwork specialists Sharanya and Dough, will be part of India’s inaugural retreat on Mindfulness in Palakkad, Kerala. The five-day retreat offers tools and methodologies for the inner transformation of individuals keen to explore inner development.

“Mindfulness, as a concept, is gaining popularity with thousands of people showing interest in meditation, yoga, and mindfulness. Time magazine’s January 2014 cover story focused on ‘Mindfulness Revolution’ while the Wisdom 2.0 conference, held in San Francisco in February 2014, deliberated mindfulness”, says Retreat Director Santhosh Babu.

“This Mindfulness Retreat is for people who want to be self-aware and work on themselves. We look forward to working with 40-50 individuals — corporate executives, businessmen, and families — with an open mind, quest for greater understanding, and the will to explore more,” adds Santhosh Babu.

Well-known singer-actress Raageshwari is now a Facial and Iyengar yoga practitioner. She began a long journey of positivity and healing when she was diagnosed with Bell’s Palsy, a nervous disorder that leads to the paralysis of the facial muscles. As medicines could not help, she restored the strength of her facial muscles through facial yoga and Iyengar yoga, without reconstructive surgery.

“For me, the growth during the time I was ill, was huge. Today I know exactly what I want, and that became possible, because I had the time to rediscover myself, when I fell ill. Introduction to yoga, meditation, and holistic healing started to take over my life. If you really, really believe in something, it will come true,” says Raageshwari.

Additional session specialists consist of US-based Holotropic Breathwork instructor Sharanya Naik. Holotropic Breathwork is a technique created by Dr. Stanislav Grof to support psychedelic psychotherapy and serve as a substitute for LSD, which was previously utilized in therapy. This marks the inaugural time that Holotropic Breathwork will be instructed to the public in India.

Raji Prakash, co-chair of the Retreat, stated, “Participants will gain from self-awareness, mindfulness, general well-being, and personal growth.”

Shruti Nanda Poddar, a specialist in Vibrational and Sound healing, will assist attendees in connecting with their inner selves using the power of music. The Mindfulness Retreat will feature Kundalini Yoga and meditation sessions led by Anita Anand, as well as Pranic healing by Nidhi Jain and Shivani Hariharan.

The Retreat is engaging, and each hour at Kairali will guarantee that the body and mind are in harmony. A usual day would include yoga, expert workshops, various Ayurveda massages, music, and evaluations. Organic vegetarian cuisine, specially crafted by the Ayurveda centre, will enhance the transformative experience.

Santhosh Babu, the founder and managing director of Organisation Development Alternatives, assists organizations in transforming via leadership development and cultural change. Santhosh Babu, the writer of India’s inaugural book on coaching, is also a columnist and author. He instructs healers in hypnosis and is recognized for his hypnosis demonstrations at IIT Delhi, Mumbai, IIM Ahmedabad, and IIM Calcutta.

Celebrity Coach
Santhosh Babu

Celebrity Coach Santhosh Babu invites you to join him on a 5-day Mindfulness Journey with experts who will share their knowledge of Tibetan Yoga, Vibrational Healing, Integrated Transpersonal work, Pranic Healing Tools and Holotropic Breathwork for the first time in India. The retreat is designed as an all-inclusive, deeply engaging experience that brings you in touch with yourself and others who are on their own journey of Mindfulness.

Session Experts
RAAGESHWARI
Actress, Singer, Tibetan Yoga expert and a Motivational Speaker

RAAGESHWARI is an actress, singer, Tibetan Yoga expert and Motivational Speaker. She has a fan following that cuts across all age groups. Struck with Bell’s Palsy in 2000 made her turn a corner and nose-dive into Mind-Power. A student of Jack Canfield and having worked on a motivational affirmation CD with Louise Hay, Raageshwari believes that for any transformation the mind, body, heart and soul must be in synergy. Hence, she creates an ambience in her seminars conducive to joy and positivity that impacts you on a visual, auditory, kinesthetic and spiritual level. Raageshwari is teaching the Power of Affirmations and Tibetan Yoga.

SHARANYA NAIK
A school teacher, practitioner and facilitator of Holotropic Breathwork

SHARANYA NAIK is a school teacher, practitioner and facilitator of Holotropic Breathwork, – an unusual, but highly effective, approach to healing the mind, body and spirit. The practice provides a safe and caring container for deep exploration in non-ordinary states of consciousness. Participants use their breath to access these non-ordinary states and, in doing so, surrender to a natural process of spiritual and psychological healing. This healing takes many, often mysterious forms and becomes a collaboration of mind, body, and spirit. Sharanya conducts workshops in Maryland, New Jersey, and New York City and is co-editor of The Inner Door, a journal for Holotropic Breathwork practitioners. Sharanya will teach Holotropic Breathwork to seekers for the first time in India.

ANITA PREM ANAND
Kundalini Yoga Teacher, Integrative, Transpersonal Therapist

ANITA PREM ANAND is a Kundalini Yoga Teacher, Integrative, Transpersonal Therapist. She is a powerful Holistic Therapist who has helped hundreds of people heal themselves of debilitating emotional and physical conditions for over a decade. Anita has a rich, varied background – A Transpersonal and Psychodynamic counselor and Senior Accredited Journey Practitioner (Brandon Bays), an Art Therapist and Hatha and Kundalini Yoga teacher with over 15 years of International teaching experience, conducting workshops worldwide. Anita uses creativity and intuition, encouraging one to feel inwardly to the inner guide and wisdom of the body. The principle philosophy behind Anita’s work is the path of direct experience. Anita will teach elements of ‘The Journey’.

SHRUTI PODDAR
Musician, Healer & leading practitioner of traditional knowledge systems

SHRUTI PODDAR is an internationally renowned musician, educationist, healer, wellness expert, and leading practitioner of traditional knowledge systems. The pioneer of the vibrational and sound healing ecosystem called Nada Vibronics, Shruti works with indigenous knowledge and sonic systems for healing and curing various health conditions. Her audio CDs, healing methods and music are now used for curing various health conditions internationally. Shruti uses the power of music, seed sounds, visualization, breath and the five elemental states (pancha-kosha) in aiding changes at the levels of organ, tissue and cell, and to make us peaceful, vibrant and energetically rejuvenated in everyday life.

SHIVANI HARIHARAN
Certified Trainer and an exceptional healer

Shivani Hariharan holds a postgraduate degree in finance from Melbourne University. She has been in the field of energy well-being and a life coach for over ten years. She is a certified trainer and an exceptional healer. Her understanding and experience in human emotions and psychology, along with a highly intelligent and practical approach to solving problems, make her an excellent mentor. They will be teaching a specially designed Pranic Healing module that aids mindfulness.

NIDHI JAIN
Jewellery Designer and trainer at the World Pranic Healing Foundation, India

Jewellery designer Nidhi Jain has been trained by the pioneers of pranic healing and is now a trainer at the World Pranic Healing Foundation, in India. She has been practicing and leading workshops for over 15 years all over India and abroad. Her warm, nurturing, good-humoured style makes learning easy and fun.

Mindfulness Retreat

This is a past retreat. The original description and speaker biographies below are retained as a historical record and are not a current offer. There are no current dates or bookings for this retreat.

◆
Past Retreats
HISTORICAL RETREAT DESCRIPTION
India’s first Mindfulness Retreat in Palakkad Kerala June 26-30

Guided by famous coach Santhosh Babu, Iyengar yoga specialist Raageshwari, and American Holotropic Breathwork professionals Sharanya and Dough.

A dozen specialists, including renowned coach Santhosh Babu, singer and actress Raageshwari, and American holotropic breathwork specialists Sharanya and Dough, will be part of India’s inaugural retreat on Mindfulness in Palakkad, Kerala. The five-day retreat offers tools and methodologies for the inner transformation of individuals keen to explore inner development.

“Mindfulness, as a concept, is gaining popularity with thousands of people showing interest in meditation, yoga, and mindfulness. Time magazine’s January 2014 cover story focused on ‘Mindfulness Revolution’ while the Wisdom 2.0 conference, held in San Francisco in February 2014, deliberated mindfulness”, says Retreat Director Santhosh Babu.

“This Mindfulness Retreat is for people who want to be self-aware and work on themselves. We look forward to working with 40-50 individuals — corporate executives, businessmen, and families — with an open mind, quest for greater understanding, and the will to explore more,” adds Santhosh Babu.

Well-known singer-actress Raageshwari is now a Facial and Iyengar yoga practitioner. She began a long journey of positivity and healing when she was diagnosed with Bell’s Palsy, a nervous disorder that leads to the paralysis of the facial muscles. As medicines could not help, she restored the strength of her facial muscles through facial yoga and Iyengar yoga, without reconstructive surgery.

“For me, the growth during the time I was ill, was huge. Today I know exactly what I want, and that became possible, because I had the time to rediscover myself, when I fell ill. Introduction to yoga, meditation, and holistic healing started to take over my life. If you really, really believe in something, it will come true,” says Raageshwari.

Additional session specialists consist of US-based Holotropic Breathwork instructor Sharanya Naik. Holotropic Breathwork is a technique created by Dr. Stanislav Grof to support psychedelic psychotherapy and serve as a substitute for LSD, which was previously utilized in therapy. This marks the inaugural time that Holotropic Breathwork will be instructed to the public in India.

Raji Prakash, co-chair of the Retreat, stated, “Participants will gain from self-awareness, mindfulness, general well-being, and personal growth.”

Shruti Nanda Poddar, a specialist in Vibrational and Sound healing, will assist attendees in connecting with their inner selves using the power of music. The Mindfulness Retreat will feature Kundalini Yoga and meditation sessions led by Anita Anand, as well as Pranic healing by Nidhi Jain and Shivani Hariharan.

The Retreat is engaging, and each hour at Kairali will guarantee that the body and mind are in harmony. A usual day would include yoga, expert workshops, various Ayurveda massages, music, and evaluations. Organic vegetarian cuisine, specially crafted by the Ayurveda centre, will enhance the transformative experience.

Santhosh Babu, the founder and managing director of Organisation Development Alternatives, assists organizations in transforming via leadership development and cultural change. Santhosh Babu, the writer of India’s inaugural book on coaching, is also a columnist and author. He instructs healers in hypnosis and is recognized for his hypnosis demonstrations at IIT Delhi, Mumbai, IIM Ahmedabad, and IIM Calcutta.

Celebrity Coach
Santhosh Babu

Celebrity Coach Santhosh Babu invites you to join him on a 5-day Mindfulness Journey with experts who will share their knowledge of Tibetan Yoga, Vibrational Healing, Integrated Transpersonal work, Pranic Healing Tools and Holotropic Breathwork for the first time in India. The retreat is designed as an all-inclusive, deeply engaging experience that brings you in touch with yourself and others who are on their own journey of Mindfulness.

Session Experts
RAAGESHWARI
Actress, Singer, Tibetan Yoga expert and a Motivational Speaker

RAAGESHWARI is an actress, singer, Tibetan Yoga expert and Motivational Speaker. She has a fan following that cuts across all age groups. Struck with Bell’s Palsy in 2000 made her turn a corner and nose-dive into Mind-Power. A student of Jack Canfield and having worked on a motivational affirmation CD with Louise Hay, Raageshwari believes that for any transformation the mind, body, heart and soul must be in synergy. Hence, she creates an ambience in her seminars conducive to joy and positivity that impacts you on a visual, auditory, kinesthetic and spiritual level. Raageshwari is teaching the Power of Affirmations and Tibetan Yoga.

SHARANYA NAIK
A school teacher, practitioner and facilitator of Holotropic Breathwork

SHARANYA NAIK is a school teacher, practitioner and facilitator of Holotropic Breathwork, – an unusual, but highly effective, approach to healing the mind, body and spirit. The practice provides a safe and caring container for deep exploration in non-ordinary states of consciousness. Participants use their breath to access these non-ordinary states and, in doing so, surrender to a natural process of spiritual and psychological healing. This healing takes many, often mysterious forms and becomes a collaboration of mind, body, and spirit. Sharanya conducts workshops in Maryland, New Jersey, and New York City and is co-editor of The Inner Door, a journal for Holotropic Breathwork practitioners. Sharanya will teach Holotropic Breathwork to seekers for the first time in India.

ANITA PREM ANAND
Kundalini Yoga Teacher, Integrative, Transpersonal Therapist

ANITA PREM ANAND is a Kundalini Yoga Teacher, Integrative, Transpersonal Therapist. She is a powerful Holistic Therapist who has helped hundreds of people heal themselves of debilitating emotional and physical conditions for over a decade. Anita has a rich, varied background – A Transpersonal and Psychodynamic counselor and Senior Accredited Journey Practitioner (Brandon Bays), an Art Therapist and Hatha and Kundalini Yoga teacher with over 15 years of International teaching experience, conducting workshops worldwide. Anita uses creativity and intuition, encouraging one to feel inwardly to the inner guide and wisdom of the body. The principle philosophy behind Anita’s work is the path of direct experience. Anita will teach elements of ‘The Journey’.

SHRUTI PODDAR
Musician, Healer & leading practitioner of traditional knowledge systems

SHRUTI PODDAR is an internationally renowned musician, educationist, healer, wellness expert, and leading practitioner of traditional knowledge systems. The pioneer of the vibrational and sound healing ecosystem called Nada Vibronics, Shruti works with indigenous knowledge and sonic systems for healing and curing various health conditions. Her audio CDs, healing methods and music are now used for curing various health conditions internationally. Shruti uses the power of music, seed sounds, visualization, breath and the five elemental states (pancha-kosha) in aiding changes at the levels of organ, tissue and cell, and to make us peaceful, vibrant and energetically rejuvenated in everyday life.

SHIVANI HARIHARAN
Certified Trainer and an exceptional healer

Shivani Hariharan holds a postgraduate degree in finance from Melbourne University. She has been in the field of energy well-being and a life coach for over ten years. She is a certified trainer and an exceptional healer. Her understanding and experience in human emotions and psychology, along with a highly intelligent and practical approach to solving problems, make her an excellent mentor. They will be teaching a specially designed Pranic Healing module that aids mindfulness.

NIDHI JAIN
Jewellery Designer and trainer at the World Pranic Healing Foundation, India

Jewellery designer Nidhi Jain has been trained by the pioneers of pranic healing and is now a trainer at the World Pranic Healing Foundation, in India. She has been practicing and leading workshops for over 15 years all over India and abroad. Her warm, nurturing, good-humoured style makes learning easy and fun.

Experience the Thrill of Adventure with Mountain Jeep Safaris in Kerala

Kerala, often referred to as “God’s Own Country,” is a paradise for nature and adventure enthusiasts alike. Beyond its serene backwaters, palm-lined beaches, and misty hill stations, Kerala offers an adrenaline-pumping experience in the form of mountain jeep safaris. These thrilling expeditions take you off the beaten path, into the heart of Kerala’s wilderness, offering a perfect combination of adventure, breathtaking landscapes, and a unique perspective on the state’s natural beauty.

What is a Mountain Jeep Safari?

A mountain jeep safari is a guided off-road adventure through rugged terrains, winding mountain paths, and dense forests. It provides a front-row seat to Kerala’s stunning vistas, from panoramic views of rolling hills to lush plantations and cascading waterfalls. These safaris are conducted in specially equipped jeeps designed to navigate challenging landscapes, making them an ideal choice for thrill-seekers and nature lovers alike.

The Adventure Awaits

Embarking on a mountain jeep safari in Kerala is like stepping into a world of unspoiled beauty. The adventure begins as your jeep swerves through narrow dirt trails, crossing streams, climbing rocky hills, and maneuvering sharp turns. The thrill of navigating seemingly impossible terrain is matched only by the awe-inspiring views of the surrounding landscapes. Each moment is a testament to the untamed splendor of Kerala’s countryside.

What to Expect:
Idyllic Landforms: The safari takes you through lush forests, scenic valleys, and rugged mountain paths, offering a glimpse of Kerala’s natural diversity.
Panoramic Views: From high vantage points, you’ll be treated to sweeping views of the Western Ghats, verdant plantations, and serene river valleys.
Adrenaline-Pumping Terrain: The excitement of navigating through uneven, off-road trails provides an exhilarating challenge, making every twist and turn unforgettable.
Highlights of Mountain Jeep Safari in Kerala
Scenic Landscapes:

Jeep safaris in Kerala are a window to its captivating wilderness. The rugged beauty of hill stations like Wayanad, Munnar, and Thekkady sets the stage for thrilling expeditions.
Explore dense forests teeming with wildlife, spice plantations, and picturesque tea gardens.
Wildlife Encounters:

Many safari trails pass through protected reserves, offering glimpses of Kerala’s rich biodiversity. Keep an eye out for elephants, wild boar, and exotic bird species.
Adventure for All:

Mountain jeep safaris cater to all adventure levels, from first-time explorers to seasoned thrill-seekers. The journeys are guided by experienced drivers, ensuring safety and fun.
Stops for Refreshment:

Planned stops during the safari allow you to relax, soak in the scenery, and capture stunning photographs. Enjoy the fresh mountain air as you recharge for the next leg of your journey.
Why Choose Kerala for Jeep Safaris?

Kerala’s topography, with its blend of mountains, valleys, and dense forests, provides the perfect setting for mountain jeep safaris. The Western Ghats, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, form the backdrop for these adventures, offering diverse trails that reveal the state’s natural and cultural treasures. Additionally, the safaris are organized with an emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendliness, making them an ethical way to explore nature.

Create Unforgettable Memories

A mountain jeep safari in Kerala is more than just an adventure – it’s an opportunity to connect with the raw beauty of nature and experience the thrill of exploration. Whether you’re navigating rugged trails or pausing to take in breathtaking vistas, every moment is a memory in the making. For those seeking excitement and a deeper connection to Kerala’s wilderness, a mountain jeep safari promises an experience like no other.

Nothing can be more satiating than walking through natural surroundings and freshness, inhaling the warmth of newly blossomed flowers, capturing the beauty of just-born leaves, navigating into the magical world of flora and fauna that ensures peace, calmness, a state of ataraxia and the ultimate union of body, mind and soul.

New Privacy Policy

1. Company Information

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village (“Kairali,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is committed to protecting your personal information and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use our websites, mobile applications, products, services, or otherwise interact with us (collectively, the “Services”). By using our Services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.

2. Types of Information Collected

a. Payment & Financial Information:

We may collect personal information that you choose to provide directly to us, such as:

Contact details: Name, mailing address, phone number, and email address.
Identification data: Government-issued identification numbers (such as passports for verification during bookings, if required).
Health-related information: Any health or medical information you voluntarily provide to customize your Ayurvedic treatments and services, including dietary preferences, current medications, allergies, and treatment goals.
Reservation details: Dates of stay, room preferences, arrival/departure times, and related travel information.

b. Personal Information:

Credit/debit card information: Cardholder name, card number, expiration date, and CVV/CVC code. We use secure, PCI-DSS-compliant payment gateways and encryption technologies to process credit card transactions. We do not store your full card details on our servers; instead, we may store tokens or partial information necessary for reference and transaction tracking.
Bank account details: In certain cases (e.g., refunds, wire transfers), we may request bank account information to facilitate the transaction.

c. Usage Data:

When you use our online Services, we may automatically collect information such as:

Technical information: IP address, browser type, device type, operating system, and language preferences.
Browsing behaviour: Pages viewed, time spent on our website, referral URLs, and any search queries or interactions with site features.
Geolocation data: Approximate geographic location inferred from IP address or with your consent, more precise location data from device GPS.

d. Data from Other Sources:

We may receive information about you from trusted third parties, such as analytics providers, marketing partners, social media platforms (if you connect via social login), and travel agencies. Such data is obtained only if you have provided consent to these parties or if it is otherwise permissible under applicable law.

3. Methods of Data Collection

We collect information through various channels, including:

Direct interactions: When you fill out forms, make reservations, send us inquiries, or communicate with our staff.
Automated technologies: Use of cookies, pixel tags, server logs, and similar tools to track your usage of our Services.
Third-party integrations: From our service providers (e.g., payment processors, analytics vendors) and partners who assist us in delivering our Services.

We require this information to understand your needs and provide you with a better service, and in particular for the following reasons:

Internal record keeping.
We may use the information to improve our services.
We may periodically send promotional emails about our services, special offers or other information which we think you may find interesting using the email address which you have provided.
We may use your information to contact you for market research purposes via email, phone, fax or mail. We may use the information to customize the website according to your interests.
Security

Committed to protect your personal information and privacy, KAIRALI uses appropriate technical and organizational measures, including encryption. A regular review is done to protect your personal information by utilizing IT security controls, including access controls that restrict and manage the way in which your personal information and data is processed, managed and handled. A trained staff is always working towards safeguarding and securing the information we collect online.

How we use cookies

Our website uses cookies. We will ask you to consent to our use of cookies in accordance with the terms of this policy when you first visit our website. By using our website and agreeing to this policy, you consent to our use of cookies in accordance with the terms of this policy.

A cookie is a file containing an identifier that is sent by a web server to a web browser, and stored by the browser. The identifier is then sent back to the server each time the browser requests a page from the server.

We use traffic log cookies to identify which pages are being used. This helps us analyze data about web page traffic and improve our website in order to tailor it to customer needs. We only use this information for statistical analysis purposes.

Overall, cookies help us provide you with a better website, by enabling us to monitor which pages you find useful and which you do not. A cookie in no way gives us access to your computer or any information about you, other than the data you choose to share with us.

You can choose to accept or decline cookies. Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can usually modify your browser setting to decline cookies if you prefer. This may prevent us from taking full advantage of the website.

Controlling your personal information

You may choose to restrict the collection or use of your personal information in the following ways:

While filling in a form on the website, click on the boxes that you do not want the information to be used by anybody for direct marketing purposes.
If you change your mind at any point of time and would want us to avoid using your personal information for direct marketing purposes, you may inform us by writing to or emailing us at info@kairali.com.

Your personal information will not be sold, distributed or leased to third parties unless we have your permission or are required by law to do so. In case, we find any promotional information about third parties that might be interesting for you, we can send it to you if only you want us to.

If you would like a copy of the information held on you please write to info@kairali.com.

Kindly write to or email us without any delay, if you believe that any information we are holding on you is incorrect or incomplete at the above address. We will immediately correct any information found to be incorrect.

Credit Card information

In the course of doing business, we transmit credit card clearing information to a third party service provider for the purposes of charging or refunding credit cards of our guests. Information transferred during this business operation is transmitted via CC AVENUE provided credit and debit card processing equipment, using a secure link employing industry-standard secure protocols, and does not transmit any individual personal information other than credit card number. Such information is required to verify the validity of the credit card number, and the transaction amount.

New to Ayurveda? Discover Holistic Healing at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village

If you’re new to Ayurveda, welcome to a 5,000-year-old tradition that promotes health, longevity, and well-being. Ayurveda, or “The Science of Life,” is a natural and holistic approach to wellness that emphasizes harmony in the body, mind, and spirit. Whether you’re looking for relief from chronic pain, increased energy, or simply a rejuvenating experience, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is the ideal place to explore Ayurveda at your own speed.

Kairali, a prominent Health Retreat in Kerala, provides authentic Ayurvedic experiences tailored exclusively to the needs of older adults seeking natural solutions to maintain health, increase mobility, and improve quality of life.

Why Ayurveda is Perfect for Seniors

Aging is a natural process, but Ayurveda shows us how to age gracefully while being healthy. If you’re experiencing:

Joint stiffness or mobility difficulties.
Digestive problems or loss of appetite.
Stress, anxiety, or disrupted sleep patterns.
Low energy levels or weakened immunity

Then Ayurveda can help you achieve balance in a peaceful, non-invasive, and holistic way. 

Your Ayurvedic Journey Begins at Kairali

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we offer an immersive Ayurvedic experience in a serene and rejuvenating environment. Recognized as the Best Ayurvedic Resort in Kerala, our retreat is designed to help you understand your body’s unique needs and introduce you to the healing benefits of Ayurveda in a way that is simple, practical, and deeply restorative.

What You Can Expect at Kairali’s Ayurvedic Retreat in India
Personalized Ayurvedic Consultation: Your journey begins with a consultation with our Ayurvedic doctors who will evaluate your health, body type (Dosha), and lifestyle requirements. 
Gentle & Therapeutic Ayurvedic Practices: Enjoy traditional Ayurvedic therapies that promote joint flexibility, purification, and relaxation. Herbal oils, warm compresses, and gentle massages are used in our therapies to help aging muscles and joints feel more comfortable and vibrant. 
Ayurvedic Nutrition & Diet: A well-balanced, easy-to-digest Ayurvedic diet is supplied to fuel your body while also improving digestion. Each meal is meticulously made with fresh, seasonal ingredients that adhere to Ayurvedic principles. 
Calming Yoga & Meditation: Learn basic, yoga postures and breathing methods to increase flexibility, reduce stress, and improve lung function.
A Peaceful Stay in a Wellness Resort in India: Relax in a natural, pollution-free environment surrounded by lush foliage and fresh air—the perfect place to relax, rejuvenate, and focus on your health. 
Why Choose Kairali – The Best Ayurvedic Resort in Kerala?
A Home Away from Home: Our retreat is intended to provide a relaxing, quiet, and homey experience in a stress-free environment. 
100% Natural & Holistic: No chemicals or artificial interventions—just pure, traditional Ayurvedic techniques.
Expert Guidance & Support: Our experienced Ayurvedic doctors and therapists will guide you every step of the way.
 A Globally Recognized Ayurvedic Retreat in India: Kairali attracts visitors from all over the world seeking authentic Ayurvedic experiences that improve health and well-being. 
 Perfect for Seniors Seeking Relaxation & Vitality: Our retreat is tailored to older folks who desire to revitalize, enhance their health naturally, and live a balanced lifestyle.
Begin Your Journey to Wellness Today!

Ayurveda is more than just healing; it is about leading a better, more fulfilling life. If you’re new to Ayurveda and seeking a relaxing, revitalizing experience, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is the place to begin.

Your wellness journey starts here. Experience Ayurveda and life!

New to Yoga? Begin Your Journey at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village 

Yoga is an ancient technique that has been used for ages to promote health and wellness. Yoga provides a holistic approach to wellness, whether you seek stress alleviation, increased flexibility, or a deeper connection between your mind and body. If you’re new to yoga and wondering where to start, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers the ideal atmosphere for you to begin your journey. Our Yoga and Ayurveda Retreat in Kerala is designed to help novices ease into the discipline by providing expert guidance and tailored programming. 

Why Start Your Yoga Journey at Kairali?

Getting started with yoga can be overwhelming, especially with so many different styles and practices. At Kairali’s Yoga Retreat Kerala, we recognize that each person has distinct requirements. That is why we provide:

Personalized instruction from qualified yoga instructors.
A serene and supportive environment amidst Kerala’s gorgeous nature.
A combination of yoga and Ayurveda to enhance overall well-being.
Gentle and effective yoga techniques for beginners. 
What to Expect from Our Yoga Retreat Program

If you’re new to yoga, our Yoga Retreat Program is an excellent way to get started. We focus on basic yet effective approaches to help you acquire confidence in your practice. Here’s what to expect: 

1. Introduction to Basic Yoga Asanas (Postures)

Yoga postures, also known as asanas, increase flexibility, strength, and posture. At our retreat, novices will begin with easy postures that align the body, promote blood circulation, and improve general well-being. 

2. Breathing Techniques (Pranayama)

Breathing regulation is a key component of yoga. Pranayama teaches you how to control your breathing, relax your mind, and boost your energy levels. These approaches are very effective at reducing tension and anxiety. 

3. Yoga Meditation for Mental Clarity

Meditation is an extremely effective practice for relaxation and self-awareness. Our instructors will lead you through yoga meditation exercises that encourage mindfulness, emotional balance, and mental clarity. 

4. Ayurvedic Integration for Holistic Wellness

Kairali’s Yoga and Ayurveda Retreat is unique in that it mixes yoga and Ayurvedic healing skills. Each participant receives an Ayurvedic consultation to better understand their body constitution (Prakriti) and receive individualized food and lifestyle suggestions. 

5. A Tranquil and Supportive Atmosphere

Our retreat is situated in a serene, natural setting free of distractions. You can completely focus on your well-being while surrounded by the tranquility of Kerala’s surroundings. 

Benefits of Starting Yoga at Kairali
Enhances physical health by boosting flexibility, strength, and balance.
Relieves stress and anxiety through relaxing techniques.
Yoga meditation promotes mental clarity and attention.
Ayurvedic methods promote complete health.
Provides a foundation for lifetime wellness through guided learning. 
Join Us at Kairali and Begin Your Yoga Journey

If you’re new to yoga, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is the best location to get started. Our Yoga Retreat Kerala is intended to help novices in their quest for health, mindfulness, and self-discovery. Whether you want to improve your flexibility, reduce stress, or discover the profound benefits of yoga and Ayurveda, our retreat is the ideal place to learn and grow.

Begin your wellness journey today at Kairali’s Yoga and Ayurveda Retreat and discover the transformative benefits of yoga!

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: A Caffeine-Free Zone for Holistic Well-Being

In today’s fast-paced world, caffeine has become a daily ritual for many, offering a quick boost of energy. However, from an Ayurvedic perspective, caffeine disrupts the body’s natural balance, or doshas, and can contribute to various health issues. Recognizing these harmful effects, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village takes a firm stand against caffeine, promoting a healthier, more balanced lifestyle for its guests.

The Impact of Caffeine on the Body

Caffeine, though often celebrated for its stimulating properties, has adverse effects on the body when consumed excessively. Ayurveda identifies caffeine as a substance that aggravates the Vata dosha, leading to issues such as anxiety, restlessness, and digestive disturbances. Additionally, caffeine can cause imbalances in other doshas, further disrupting the body’s natural harmony.

Key Concerns with Caffeine:
Elevates Blood Pressure: Caffeine stimulates the nervous system, often leading to increased blood pressure.
Causes Digestive Issues: It can lead to heartburn and acid reflux, disrupting the digestive balance.
Creates Dependency: Regular caffeine consumption fosters reliance, making the body sluggish in its absence.
Hinders Mental Clarity: Excessive intake can overstimulate the mind, reducing focus and stability.

By saying no to caffeine, Kairali helps guests avoid these pitfalls and regain their body’s natural rhythm and vitality.

A Caffeine-Free Commitment at Kairali

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, the focus is on creating an environment that nurtures complete well-being. Adhering to Ayurvedic principles, caffeine is rigorously proscribed to ensure guests experience the purest form of holistic healing. The retreat offers alternative ways to energize the body and mind without the need for stimulants, helping visitors transition away from their dependency on caffeine. Guests are served herbal teas and natural beverages that are both refreshing and nourishing, offering a healthy alternative to caffeinated drinks.

A Sanctuary for Balance and Purity

Kairali is more than just a health retreat- it is a sanctuary of purity and balance. Set amidst pristine natural surroundings, it provides an ideal space for guests to detoxify their bodies and reconnect with their inner selves. The retreat encourages a lifestyle, free from harmful substances like caffeine, focusing on restoring the immune system and achieving mental and physical equanimity.

The serene environment at Kairali plays a vital role in this transformation. Surrounded by lush greenery and a pollution-free atmosphere, guests are inspired to embrace a healthier way of living. The retreat’s emphasis on holistic practices ensures that every individual leaves feeling rejuvenated, balanced, and empowered to maintain a caffeine-free lifestyle.

Embrace a Healthier Future at Kairali

By choosing to eliminate caffeine, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers a unique opportunity to experience life in its purest form. Through Ayurvedic treatments, personalized care, and a supportive environment, the retreat helps guests rediscover energy and vitality without reliance on stimulants. Whether you’re seeking detoxification, a healthier lifestyle, or simply a break from daily routines, Kairali provides the perfect setting for holistic healing and transformation. Say goodbye to caffeine and hello to balance and harmony at Kairali.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: A Caffeine-Free Zone for Holistic Well-Being

In today’s fast-paced world, caffeine has become a daily ritual for many, offering a quick boost of energy. However, from an Ayurvedic perspective, caffeine disrupts the body’s natural balance, or doshas, and can contribute to various health issues. Recognizing these harmful effects, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village takes a firm stand against caffeine, promoting a healthier, more balanced lifestyle for its guests.

The Impact of Caffeine on the Body

Caffeine, though often celebrated for its stimulating properties, has adverse effects on the body when consumed excessively. Ayurveda identifies caffeine as a substance that aggravates the Vata dosha, leading to issues such as anxiety, restlessness, and digestive disturbances. Additionally, caffeine can cause imbalances in other doshas, further disrupting the body’s natural harmony.

Key Concerns with Caffeine:
Elevates Blood Pressure: Caffeine stimulates the nervous system, often leading to increased blood pressure.
Causes Digestive Issues: It can lead to heartburn and acid reflux, disrupting the digestive balance.
Creates Dependency: Regular caffeine consumption fosters reliance, making the body sluggish in its absence.
Hinders Mental Clarity: Excessive intake can overstimulate the mind, reducing focus and stability.

By saying no to caffeine, Kairali helps guests avoid these pitfalls and regain their body’s natural rhythm and vitality.

A Caffeine-Free Commitment at Kairali

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, the focus is on creating an environment that nurtures complete well-being. Adhering to Ayurvedic principles, caffeine is rigorously proscribed to ensure guests experience the purest form of holistic healing. The retreat offers alternative ways to energize the body and mind without the need for stimulants, helping visitors transition away from their dependency on caffeine. Guests are served herbal teas and natural beverages that are both refreshing and nourishing, offering a healthy alternative to caffeinated drinks.

A Sanctuary for Balance and Purity

Kairali is more than just a health retreat- it is a sanctuary of purity and balance. Set amidst pristine natural surroundings, it provides an ideal space for guests to detoxify their bodies and reconnect with their inner selves. The retreat encourages a lifestyle, free from harmful substances like caffeine, focusing on restoring the immune system and achieving mental and physical equanimity.

The serene environment at Kairali plays a vital role in this transformation. Surrounded by lush greenery and a pollution-free atmosphere, guests are inspired to embrace a healthier way of living. The retreat’s emphasis on holistic practices ensures that every individual leaves feeling rejuvenated, balanced, and empowered to maintain a caffeine-free lifestyle.

Embrace a Healthier Future at Kairali

By choosing to eliminate caffeine, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers a unique opportunity to experience life in its purest form. Through Ayurvedic treatments, personalized care, and a supportive environment, the retreat helps guests rediscover energy and vitality without reliance on stimulants. Whether you’re seeking detoxification, a healthier lifestyle, or simply a break from daily routines, Kairali provides the perfect setting for holistic healing and transformation. Say goodbye to caffeine and hello to balance and harmony at Kairali.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: Advocating Fresh, Natural Foods for Holistic Wellness

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, the importance of wholesome, fresh, and unadulterated food is deeply rooted in its Ayurvedic philosophy. Food is not just nourishment for the body; it is a vital source of energy and balance for the mind and soul. Central to Ayurveda is the concept of ‘prana’, the life force present in fresh food, which is essential for maintaining health and vitality. Preserved and canned foods, however, lack this vital energy and fail to meet the body’s holistic nutritional needs.

The Drawbacks of Preserved and Canned Foods

Preserved and canned foods, while convenient, often lose their nutritional integrity and vitality during processing. Packed with preservatives and artificial additives, these foods are devoid of the natural essence required to sustain optimal health. According to Ayurveda, such foods disturb the body’s natural equilibrium by aggravating the doshas, leading to imbalances that manifest as obesity, digestive disorders, and other chronic ailments.

Key issues with preserved and canned foods include:

Loss of Vitality and Nutrients: The processing of food strips it of essential nutrients and prana, reducing its ability to nourish the body effectively.
Aggravation of Doshas: Consuming such foods disrupts the balance of Vata, Pitta, and Kapha doshas, which are vital for physical and mental harmony.
Adulteration and Health Risks: The presence of preservatives and chemicals can lead to toxicity in the body over time, impairing metabolism and overall health.
Digestive Challenges: These foods often lack the natural fiber and enzymes needed to support proper digestion, leading to stagnation and inefficiency in nutrient absorption.
Kairali’s Commitment to Freshness and Purity

At Kairali, food is regarded as a cornerstone of wellness. The Ayurvedic Healing Village strongly advocates for the consumption of fresh, natural, and unprocessed foods, aligning with the principles of Ayurveda that emphasize purity and balance. By promoting a diet rich in seasonal fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and freshly prepared meals, Kairali ensures that guests receive the nourishment they need for a healthy and balanced life.

Why Fresh Food Matters:
Restores Balance: Fresh foods help maintain the dosha balance, promoting optimal physical and mental health.
Enhances Vitality: Foods rich in prana energize the body, improve digestion, and support a stronger immune system.
Purity for the Body and Mind: Fresh, wholesome meals detoxify the body, calm the mind, and elevate the spirit, aligning with Ayurveda’s holistic approach to well-being.
A Lifestyle Free from Preservatives

Kairali’s kitchen practices align with its ethos of purity and simplicity. Meals prepared at the retreat use fresh, locally sourced ingredients, free from preservatives and artificial additives. This approach not only supports physical health but also fosters mindfulness and a deeper connection to the food we consume.

In addition to offering a fresh food philosophy, Kairali encourages guests to adopt these habits in their daily lives. By avoiding preserved and canned foods, individuals can break free from the cycle of poor nutrition, regain energy, and live a malady-free life.

A Commitment to Holistic Health

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village serves as a beacon of Ayurvedic wisdom, inspiring a lifestyle centred around balance, purity, and well-being. Its promotion of fresh, natural foods underscores its dedication to holistic health, empowering individuals to make choices that nurture their body, mind, and soul. By embracing the power of fresh foods, Kairali helps its guests embark on a journey of rejuvenation and vitality, creating a foundation for a healthier and more fulfilling life.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: A Smoke-Free Sanctuary for Holistic Wellness

Smoking is one of the most harmful habits, detrimental not only to personal health but also to the environment. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, smoking is strictly prohibited as part of its commitment to providing a holistic and rejuvenating experience. This health-focused retreat champions a smoke-free environment that fosters healing, strengthens the immune system and promotes a healthier lifestyle aligned with Ayurvedic principles.

The Importance of a Smoke-Free Environment

A no-smoking policy is integral to maintaining the serene and health-focused atmosphere at Kairali. Smoking introduces toxins into the body, disrupts the natural balance (doshas), and diminishes the body’s innate ability to heal. By discouraging smoking, Kairali helps its guests to achieve optimal well-being in an environment designed for restoration and tranquility.

The absence of smoking enhances the immune system, improves respiratory health, and promotes mental clarity. This aligns with the Ayurvedic philosophy of balance and harmony between the body, mind, and soul. By eliminating exposure to harmful substances like nicotine, the body can regain its natural rhythm and vitality.

Nature’s Role in Healing at Kairali

Nestled amidst lush greenery and pristine landscapes, Kairali offers a pollution-free retreat where guests can connect with nature and embrace its healing power. The retreat provides an environment of peace and purity, encouraging guests to enjoy the beauty of their surroundings while detoxifying the body and mind.

Breathing clean, fresh air is a vital part of the rejuvenation process at Kairali. Surrounded by unspoiled natural beauty, guests can experience a sense of calm and revitalization that’s impossible in a polluted or smoke-filled environment. This connection with nature supports healing on a deeper level, allowing guests to fully immerse themselves in the retreat’s restorative offerings.

Ayurvedic Principles and the Harmful Effects of Smoking

Adhering to Ayurvedic principles, Kairali recognizes the negative impact of smoking on the body and mind. Smoking aggravates the doshas, leading to imbalances that manifest as physical and mental health issues. Additionally, smoking creates dependency, diminishing mental clarity and contributing to lethargy.

At Kairali, the focus is on empowering guests to live naturally and free from artificial dependencies. By providing a smoke-free space, the retreat encourages a return to simplicity and balance, helping guests reconnect with their true selves.

The Transformative Power of a Smoke-Free Retreat

Kairali is not just a retreat – it’s a transformative journey. With its restorative therapies, Ayurvedic treatments, and serene environment, it provides the perfect setting for guests to let go of unhealthy habits like smoking. Therapies designed to detoxify the body, yoga and meditation practices to calm the mind, and nutritious Ayurvedic meals all work in harmony to restore vitality and encourage a healthier lifestyle.

By eliminating smoking, Kairali creates an atmosphere of pure wellness, where guests can focus entirely on healing and self-discovery. The retreat’s pollution-free environment, combined with its holistic approach to health, enables guests to experience the joy of living free from toxins and unhealthy influences.

A Step Toward a Healthier You

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is more than just a destination; it’s a commitment to well-being. Its no-smoking policy is a reflection of its dedication to fostering a clean, healthy, and rejuvenating environment. Whether you’re seeking to detoxify, rediscover balance, or simply relax in nature’s embrace, Kairali offers a sanctuary for holistic transformation. Choose a life of wellness and harmony at Kairali, where every breath is a step toward a healthier, smoke-free future.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: A Smoke-Free Sanctuary for Holistic Wellness

Smoking is one of the most harmful habits, detrimental not only to personal health but also to the environment. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, smoking is strictly prohibited as part of its commitment to providing a holistic and rejuvenating experience. This health-focused retreat champions a smoke-free environment that fosters healing, strengthens the immune system and promotes a healthier lifestyle aligned with Ayurvedic principles.

The Importance of a Smoke-Free Environment

A no-smoking policy is integral to maintaining the serene and health-focused atmosphere at Kairali. Smoking introduces toxins into the body, disrupts the natural balance (doshas), and diminishes the body’s innate ability to heal. By discouraging smoking, Kairali helps its guests to achieve optimal well-being in an environment designed for restoration and tranquility.

The absence of smoking enhances the immune system, improves respiratory health, and promotes mental clarity. This aligns with the Ayurvedic philosophy of balance and harmony between the body, mind, and soul. By eliminating exposure to harmful substances like nicotine, the body can regain its natural rhythm and vitality.

Nature’s Role in Healing at Kairali

Nestled amidst lush greenery and pristine landscapes, Kairali offers a pollution-free retreat where guests can connect with nature and embrace its healing power. The retreat provides an environment of peace and purity, encouraging guests to enjoy the beauty of their surroundings while detoxifying the body and mind.

Breathing clean, fresh air is a vital part of the rejuvenation process at Kairali. Surrounded by unspoiled natural beauty, guests can experience a sense of calm and revitalization that’s impossible in a polluted or smoke-filled environment. This connection with nature supports healing on a deeper level, allowing guests to fully immerse themselves in the retreat’s restorative offerings.

Ayurvedic Principles and the Harmful Effects of Smoking

Adhering to Ayurvedic principles, Kairali recognizes the negative impact of smoking on the body and mind. Smoking aggravates the doshas, leading to imbalances that manifest as physical and mental health issues. Additionally, smoking creates dependency, diminishing mental clarity and contributing to lethargy.

At Kairali, the focus is on empowering guests to live naturally and free from artificial dependencies. By providing a smoke-free space, the retreat encourages a return to simplicity and balance, helping guests reconnect with their true selves.

The Transformative Power of a Smoke-Free Retreat

Kairali is not just a retreat – it’s a transformative journey. With its restorative therapies, Ayurvedic treatments, and serene environment, it provides the perfect setting for guests to let go of unhealthy habits like smoking. Therapies designed to detoxify the body, yoga and meditation practices to calm the mind, and nutritious Ayurvedic meals all work in harmony to restore vitality and encourage a healthier lifestyle.

By eliminating smoking, Kairali creates an atmosphere of pure wellness, where guests can focus entirely on healing and self-discovery. The retreat’s pollution-free environment, combined with its holistic approach to health, enables guests to experience the joy of living free from toxins and unhealthy influences.

A Step Toward a Healthier You

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is more than just a destination; it’s a commitment to well-being. Its no-smoking policy is a reflection of its dedication to fostering a clean, healthy, and rejuvenating environment. Whether you’re seeking to detoxify, rediscover balance, or simply relax in nature’s embrace, Kairali offers a sanctuary for holistic transformation. Choose a life of wellness and harmony at Kairali, where every breath is a step toward a healthier, smoke-free future.

Senior Citizen Offer

🌿 Up to 20% Off — Senior Wellness Programs

Holistic Ayurvedic Care for Ageing Parents & Senior Wellbeing

Compassionate Ayurvedic care designed to ease joint pain due to ageing, relieve body pain in old age, boost low energy in seniors, and gently support muscle weakness — so your loved ones can age with comfort and dignity.

BOOK YOUR CONSULTATION
EXPLORE PROGRAMS
118
YEARS OF LEGACY
80+
COUNTRIES
5 ★
RATED

A LIFETIME OF LOVE, HONOURED

They Gave Everything. Now It’s Our Turn.

They nurtured us with patience, strength, and unconditional love. Today, as joint pain, body pain, and low energy start to affect their daily life — it’s our turn to surround them with comfort, care, and respect.

At Kairali, we provide a calm, nurturing space where seniors can feel safe, cared for, and truly understood.

◆
Gentle therapies to reduce body pain in old age and improve flexibility.
◆
Supportive routines that rebuild stamina, balance, and confidence in movement.
◆
A warm, respectful environment that prioritizes dignity and wellbeing for ageing parents.

WHY CHOOSE KAIRALI

A Legacy of Trust in Ayurvedic Healing

For over a century, Kairali has been the trusted choice for authentic Ayurvedic healing — now bringing the same expertise and compassion to senior wellness.

Doctor-Led Expertise

All therapies are guided by Experienced Ayurvedic Doctors trained in geriatric care, ensuring safe and effective treatment for seniors.

Generations of Legacy

118 years of Ayurvedic healing experience, especially in addressing joint pain due to ageing, body pain in old age, and age-related muscle weakness.

Global Clientele

Guests from over 80 countries have trusted Kairali for authentic Ayurveda, holistic rejuvenation, and long-term wellbeing for ageing parents.

Certified Excellence

Rigorous quality and safety standards — offering dependable care for seniors needing structured support and continuous monitoring throughout their stay.

FIND OUT

Is This Program Right For You or Your Loved Ones?

For Seniors (60+)

Are you or your loved ones experiencing:
◆
Persistent joint pain due to ageing — difficulty standing, walking, or climbing stairs.
◆
Body pain in old age — back pain, neck stiffness, or generalized aches.
◆
Muscle weakness in seniors — reduced balance or fear of falling.
◆
Disturbed sleep, sluggish digestion, or feeling mentally drained.

Our programs are designed to gently ease discomfort, restore mobility, and rekindle vitality.

For Adult Children & Caregivers

Are you searching for:
◆
Expert medical supervision with Ayurvedic doctors and nurses overseeing every step.
◆
Personalized, gentle care that respects the emotional and physical needs of your parents.
◆
Peace of mind knowing joint stiffness and body pain are being addressed holistically.
◆
A nurturing, dignified environment focused on long-term wellbeing for ageing parents.

Kairali supports both seniors and families through clear communication, transparency, and compassionate guidance.

HOW WE HELP

Our Holistic Approach to Senior Wellness
Personalized Consultations

In-depth review of health, pain, energy, and emotional state. Forms the base for a tailored wellness roadmap crafted specifically for your loved one.

Senior-Friendly Therapies

Safe, soothing Ayurvedic therapies for ageing bodies — helping reduce pain, swelling, and stiffness while improving circulation and joint flexibility.

Gentle Yoga & Daily Routines

Light, guided movements and breathing practices adapted for seniors — supporting balance, flexibility, energy levels, and peace of mind every day.

Continuous Medical Care

On-site doctors and nurses track vitals and progress throughout the stay — with extra attentive care for seniors with chronic conditions or complex health needs.

THE PROCESS

Your Journey to Well-being

From arrival to departure, every step is thoughtfully designed to reduce pain, restore strength, and uplift mood.

01

Consultation

Health assessment & goal-setting with our physician

02

Custom Plan

Personalised treatment & diet plan designed for you

03

Daily Routine

Therapies, yoga, diet & rest — carefully structured

04

Monitoring

Daily vitals tracking and doctor check-ins for safety

05

Outcomes

Improved mobility, energy & a home wellness plan

Trust our senior-friendly care team every step of the way — we are here to make this journey as comfortable, safe, and effective as possible for your loved ones.

WHAT WE OFFER

Signature Wellness Programs at Kairali

Each program is crafted specifically for the unique health needs of seniors and ageing parents, guided by Ayurvedic wisdom and modern medical care.

MOST POPULAR

Kairali’s rejuvenation and detoxification healing program

A comprehensive anti-ageing program that revitalises tissues, supports immunity, and enhances stamina — ideal for low energy in seniors and muscle weakness. Experience the deep restoration of Panchakarma combined with modern wellness protocols.

FOR ARTHRITIS & JOINT PAIN

Joint rehabilitation and arthritis treatment

Focused therapies and herbal formulations that precisely target joint pain due to ageing, arthritis, and chronic body pain in old age. Includes specialised Janu Basti, Kati Basti, and herbal steam therapies for lasting relief.

FOR MIND & MOOD

Digestive wellness and gut health yoga therapy

Calming treatments and mind-body practices that ease worry, restlessness, and emotional fatigue — promoting deep mental peace for both seniors and their caregivers. Includes Shirodhara, meditation, and pranayama sessions.

FOR DIGESTION & ENERGY

Digestive Harmony & Detox

Gentle detoxification and digestive support to reduce bloating, heaviness, and sluggishness — helping improve energy, clarity, and overall wellbeing for ageing parents. Herbal formulations paired with therapeutic diet plans.

ACCOMMODATION

Your Comfort, Our Priority: Elegant Villas

Each villa is thoughtfully designed with senior comfort in mind — spacious, accessible, and surrounded by serene natural beauty.

Exclusive Offer for Olympic and Paralympic Athletes – Up to 20% OFF

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is delighted to extend a unique discount of up to 20% off our wellness packages in recognition of the commitment and accomplishments of Olympic and Paralympic competitors. With the aid of Ayurveda’s healing properties, this unique program aims to assist athletes in resting and recuperating amid Kerala’s serene surroundings.

 

Our carefully selected therapies are intended to help athletes recuperate from the demanding physical and mental demands they face, regain equilibrium, and increase their general vitality. Abhyangam, Pizhichil, and Kizhi are examples of specialized Ayurvedic treatments designed to reduce muscle tiredness, increase flexibility, and revitalize the body. To improve mental clarity and cultivate inner calm, these therapies are coupled with yoga and meditation practices. 



The package also includes personalized consultations with Ayurvedic professionals to design health regimens that address specific requirements, such as healing, detoxification, or improved performance. Visitors can enjoy exquisite lodgings and healthy, wholesome meals designed to promote optimal health. 



This exclusive offer highlights the retreat’s dedication to supporting athletes who inspire others through their perseverance and brilliance. Reconnect with yourself and recharge for future challenges in a peaceful, soothing environment that honors your accomplishments and promotes holistic wellness.

Generations of Legacy

118 years of Ayurvedic healing experience, especially in addressing joint pain due to ageing, body pain in old age, and age-related muscle weakness.

Global Clientele

Guests from over 80 countries have trusted Kairali for authentic Ayurveda, holistic rejuvenation, and long-term wellbeing for ageing parents.

Certified Excellence

Rigorous quality and safety standards — offering dependable care for seniors needing structured support and continuous monitoring throughout their stay.

FIND OUT

For Seniors (60+)

Are you or your loved ones experiencing:
◆
Persistent joint pain due to ageing — difficulty standing, walking, or climbing stairs.

Body pain in old age — back pain, neck stiffness, or generalized aches.
◆
Muscle weakness in seniors — reduced balance or fear of falling.
◆
Disturbed sleep, sluggish digestion, or feeling mentally drained.

Our programs are designed to gently ease discomfort, restore mobility, and rekindle vitality.

For Adult Children & Caregivers

Are you searching for:
◆
Expert medical supervision with Ayurvedic doctors and nurses overseeing every step.
◆
Personalized, gentle care that respects the emotional and physical needs of your parents.
◆
Peace of mind knowing joint stiffness and body pain are being addressed holistically.
◆
A nurturing, dignified environment focused on long-term wellbeing for ageing parents.

Kairali supports both seniors and families through clear communication, transparency, and compassionate guidance.

HOW WE HELP

Our Holistic Approach to Senior Wellness
Personalized Consultations

In-depth review of health, pain, energy, and emotional state. Forms the base for a tailored wellness roadmap crafted specifically for your loved one.

Senior-Friendly Therapies

Safe, soothing Ayurvedic therapies for ageing bodies — helping reduce pain, swelling, and stiffness while improving circulation and joint flexibility.

Gentle Yoga & Daily Routines

Light, guided movements and breathing practices adapted for seniors — supporting balance, flexibility, energy levels, and peace of mind every day.

Continuous Medical Care

On-site doctors and nurses track vitals and progress throughout the stay — with extra attentive care for seniors with chronic conditions or complex health needs.

THE PROCESS

AYURVEDA TRAINING COURSE · OAP-HV · 1 DAY
One-Day Ayurveda Workshop

A three-hour introduction to Ayurveda at the hospital: two hours of guided theory with an Ayurvedic doctor, then a 45-minute Abhyangam session so the principles are felt as well as heard. No prior knowledge is needed, and a participation certificate is awarded at the close.

Plan your Ayurveda training

Tell us about your background and the course you are considering. We can discuss the training options with you.

ENQUIRE ABOUT AYURVEDA TRAINING
PROCESS
FEATURES
COURSES
FAQS
RELATED
THE PROGRAMME
Process Involved In the One-Day Workshop

The workshop runs as a single structured session — theory first, then a supervised therapy experience — and is scheduled around a group's visit.

01

Understanding Ayurveda: what it is, where it began, its branches, the classical texts, and why it still matters in the 21st century.

02

Ayurvedic medicines: an introduction to classical and proprietary preparations, with a demonstration of Kairali's own products.

03

Therapies on screen: a live video demonstration of the principal Ayurvedic therapies and how each is carried out.

04

Abhyangam experience: a 45-minute full-body oil massage given by a trained therapist, so the theory is understood in practice.

05

Certificate: a participation certificate at the end of the session.

Features of the program
◆
Format: two hours of theory and one hour of practical therapy, in one day.
◆
Who it suits: corporate groups, group travellers, associations and clubs, and anyone taking a first look at Ayurveda.
◆
Faculty: Ayurvedic doctors and trainers of Kairali.
◆
Stay: optional. Participants who stay overnight are accommodated in the villas at the per-night training tariff — Deluxe Villa ₹18,410 single / ₹30,530 double ($263 / $436; €230 / €382).
Learning outcomes
◆
Core ideas: explain the doshas, the meaning of 'the science of life' and the place of daily routine in Ayurveda.
◆
Therapies: recognise the main Ayurvedic therapies and what each is for.
◆
Medicines: know how classical and proprietary Ayurvedic medicines differ.
◆
Daily life: take home practical ways to bring Ayurveda into a daily routine.

Online Consultation
ONLINE CONSULTATION · NO CHARGE

Speak with an Ayurvedic physician about your health.

Share your concern and our registered physician will give you a considered assessment of your constitution (prakṛti) and an honest view on whether our treatment programmes are appropriate for you. No obligation, no charge.

A CONSIDERED PROCESS — NOT A QUEUE
Three calm steps, designed around your time and your physician’s.

We ask very little to begin. The detailed clinical history comes afterwards as a short private form you complete at your own pace — so your physician arrives at the consultation already understanding your case.

STEP 01
You request a consultation

A minute or two of your time — your concern and how to reach you. That’s all we need to begin.

1–2 minutes
STEP 02
You complete a health summary

A short private form we send by WhatsApp or email. Vitals, history and an Ayurvedic functional review — mostly taps, at your own pace. Reports are optional.

In your own time · before the call
STEP 03
You meet your physician online

Having read your summary in advance, the physician gives a considered assessment and an honest view on suitable treatment programmes.

By WhatsApp video or call
Preview the health summary you’ll complete
WHY PATIENTS TRUST THIS CONSULTATION
A teaching hospital’s standards, a family’s century of care.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a NABH-accredited Ayurvedic hospital in Kodumbu, Palakkad, Kerala — a medical institution, not a leisure property. Your consultation is with qualified physicians, supported by our own WHO-GMP-certified pharmacy and 118 years of family practice.

1908
Ramesh family practice · 118 years
12+ yrs
Clinical practice of our Chief Physician, Dr. Deepu John
WHO-GMP
Certified in-house Ayurvedic pharmacy
For my family, Ayurveda has never been about quick fixes — it is a way of life, practised in its true form. We built this hospital so that every patient is understood as an individual, their constitution read with care before anything is advised, and treated by qualified physicians as we would treat our own family. That responsibility, carried for over a century, is what you will find here.
Gita Ramesh
Co-founder & Joint Managing Director · author, The Ayurvedic Cookbook

We don’t publish curated quotes on this page. Our patients — who have come to us from more than 120 countries — review us publicly on Google; read their unedited experiences there.

Organic Farming

Kairali has its own organic garden that are free from pesticides, chemicals and preservatives that snatch away the piquant essence and purity of food. The organic plantation of Kairali is not only sustainable but enhances soil fertility and biological diversity. It is devoid of prohibiting synthetic pesticides, antibiotics, synthetic fertilizers, genetically modified organisms and growth hormones.

Chemicals do no good to anyone except for adding a plethora of maladies. Nutrition-less food makes you prone to diseases like diabetes, cholesterol, blood pressure, hormonal disorders and many more which can even turn to be fatal.

Ayurveda is much deeper than just being prognostic and diagnostic as it not only cures the symptoms and illness but drives a person to a health oriented lifestyle. The Ayurvedic food for health thus plays a major role in providing a balanced immune system. Keeping in mind, Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village boasts of organic plantation at its property, which is the source of food for all the visitors at the hospital and retreat. Promoting and propagating the concept of ‘Back to the Nature’, the healing village offer healthy gourmet foods to all the visitors as food plays vital role in freeing you from all sorts of diseases.

We let you celebrate food while making you understand the importance of holistic health on your palette at the retreat. Besides your mesmerizing stay you get to visit the Organic Farm while getting to learn the significance of natural food, which is grown in accordance with nature.

KAIRALI — THE AYURVEDIC HEALING VILLAGE · SINCE 1908
Our Partners

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has formed a network of distinguished partners to expand its offerings and spread the message of authentic Ayurvedic healing. These relationships are critical to Kairali’s objective of promoting holistic health and traditional healing techniques globally.

Franchise Partnerships:

With its all-inclusive Ayurvedic Franchise Scheme, Kairali helps business owners open Ayurvedic treatment facilities, wellness spas, luxury hotel spas, and health resorts. Franchisees benefit from this program’s leadership experience and well-known brand. Associates gain access to Kairali’s GMP-certified Ayurvedic products, staff training, technical support, and marketing assistance.

Collaborations with Wellness Centers:

Kairali incorporates its authentic Ayurvedic products and therapies into a range of health and wellness initiatives by collaborating with wellness facilities throughout the world. Through these partnerships, traditional Ayurvedic methods are made available to a wider range of people, encouraging natural healing and overall health.

Educational Alliances:

Kairali works with training facilities and educational institutions to provide courses in yoga and Ayurvedic treatments. These collaborations seek to preserve and advance this age-old discipline by teaching people traditional therapeutic techniques and sharing Ayurvedic knowledge.

By extending its global reach and ensuring that everyone has access to holistic well-being, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village can maintain its dedication to authentic Ayurvedic healing.

state.bodyText:
Skip to main content
