Our Story
Our Story

“I found true joy there, and remembered my reason for living.”

Live & Breathe Goodness with
Kairali Ayurvedic Village – Personalised Wellness Formula

Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s flagship ayurvedic destination, Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala is one-of-its-kind of a holistic space, which heals you internally and externally with traditional and authentic Ayurvedic therapies, treatments and medications along with Yoga and Meditation. A certified model of a wellness retreat, the healing village is implanted at the foot of Nilgiri and Annamalai ranges (Western Ghats). Set amidst mountains, forests, fertile valley and rivers are the 30 premium villas, which are forever surrounded by the fragrance of Pala trees. In compliance with Vaastu Shastra, the villas add on to the restorative and curative ambience. The Ayurvedic Healing Village also boasts of Red Oxide flooring, a rare Valambari Conch shell and a gentle stream flowing around every villa. Yoga, Meditation, Astrology, Palmistry, nutrition, therapy, spiritual training and traditional Indian rituals (pujas) are part of the routine at the retreat. The Ayurvedic Healing Village is the epitome of Kairali’s skill in concept hospitality – a perfectly intuitive design born of timeless wisdom. Time spent at this inspiring jungle sanctuary will leave you wondering whether you are experiencing the height of modern holistic luxury, or have travelled far into India’s distant past.

Know more about Kairali Group

A set of ideals
Our Founder’s Vision
We at Kairali wish to transform you to the optimal way of living.

Kairali’s mission is to spread the use of Ayurveda worldwide, upholding its authentic values to promote health and wellness for all. They see humans and nature as interdependent and believe Ayurveda can bring the body into a natural harmony. Kairali aims to be recognized as pioneers in the field, developing new natural elements to empower individuals and transform lives.

Mrs Gita Ramesh
Co- Founder , The Kairali Ayurvedic Group

Kairali Leadership

Meet our Directors with Vision of Healthy World
K.V. RAMESH
Managing Director

As the harbinger of Ayurveda, Mr. K.V. Ramesh, Managing Director and co-founder of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group, is the bridge between the four generations who have dedicated their lives in promoting Ayurveda. He is blessed with the legacy of ancient science and is responsible for passing it on to the future generations. His contribution to Ayurveda, the alternative form of medicine, did not simply start from when he first founded the Kairali Ayurvedic Group through a small center in South Delhi. It can be traced to his teenage years when he used to lend a helping hand to his father Dr. K.S.V Vasudevan by mixing Ayurvedic medicine for patients. This not only proved to be an initial learning for him, but during those nascent years he also observed the way Ayurveda helped people. In addition, Mr. Ramesh is also the Director at Sumitomo Mitsui Construction Corporation Ltd.

GITA RAMESH
Joint Managing Director

The heart and soul behind the Kairali Ayurvedic Group since its inception, and wife of Mr. K.V Ramesh, Mrs. Gita Ramesh is the Joint Managing Director. She has been the motivation and spearhead of the Group, and a guiding light too. She brings along her expertise in Ayurveda, making Kairali one of the most successful Ayurveda companies in the world. She maintains an unfaltering commitment to the quality of knowledge, expertise, techniques and treatments used at Kairali’s retreats and spas, for which she has garnered praise and recognition as an industry pioneer.

K.R. ABHILASH
Director

Following the footsteps of his parent, Mr. K.R. Abhilash is impelled to carry forward the legacy he inherited from his forefathers.Director of Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Mr. Abhilash is responsible for expansion and capturing the best in Ayurveda. In a very short time, he is credited with proliferating success and escalating Kairali’s pharmaceutical, training and franchisee units, and strengthening its core businesses. His visionary and innovative outlook has earned him many accolades so early in his career. He has been successful in establishing Kairali Ayurvedic Treatment Centers in India and around the globe. His expertise includes creating, conceptualizing, and delivering world class health retreat or a hotel, destination or a daycare Ayurvedic center, and services customized to pamper themselves.

K.R. ABISHEK
Director

Product of the New York Institute of Technology, Mr. K.R.Abishek is the youngest in the family of Ayurvedic practitioners who also has pledged to dedicate his life in the service of Ayurveda. He is the fellow member of the board of directors. He entered the family business equipped with ideas and a great enthusiasm to take the company even further in the world of international hospitality. The face of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s franchise division, he also heads the Training and Panchakarma Institutes in Kerala. With great achievements in expanding Kairali’s pharmaceutical brands and strengthening its core businesses, he has firmly established himself within the team.

A set of ideals
Awards and Accolades
We at Kairali wish to transform you to the optimal way of living.

Every year Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village is honored to receive awards and accreditations from esteemed organizations from the health and wellness fraternity. Maintaining our position as the best Ayurvedic spa in Asia, we have always catered to uphold the sanctity of the Ayurvedic principles. And it is because of this principle followed that it has received notable appreciations and certifications like the World Spa Awards, Green Leaf Certification, NABH Certification and many more.

state.title: Effective Pain Management with Ayurvedic Treatments in Kerala
state.bodyText:
Embrace a Pain-Free Life with the Wisdom of Ayurveda
Exclusive Healing Secrets Of Kairali
Treatment for Pain Management
Treatment for Pain Management
Is Pain Rewriting the Story of Your Life's Tapestry?

Pain management at Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village is approached holistically with modern wellness practices. As a leading Ayurvedic healing destination, we specialize in natural and authentic treatments that address joint discomfort, chronic pain, and muscular tension. Our customized programs are designed for clients' unique constitution (dosha) and emphasize relieving pain from its root cause.

Located in the serene landscapes of Kerala, Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers a sanctuary where pain relief and holistic healing are achieved naturally and sustainably.

Signature treatments such as Abhyangam, a medicated oil massage, and Kizhi, a herbal treatment, work to increase circulation, reduce inflammation and promote healing. While Ayurvedic formulations and herbal medicines offer long-term healing, Panchakarma detox therapies are used to remove toxins and bring the body back into balance. Our treatments, when combined with yoga and meditation, improve mental health and flexibility.

Our Approach
To Treatment for Pain Management
Our Approach
Our Approach of Treatment for Pain Management

With 115+ years of Ayurvedic expertise and 30,000+ patients treated at Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we specialize in pain management. Ayurveda targets root causes, often Vatadosha imbalances from factors like poor posture, sedentary living, stress, and diet. Our personalized approach starts with an assessment for a tailored plan. Ayurvedic therapies like Abhyanga, Pizhichil, Kati Basti, and Nasya focus on pain relief, inflammation reduction, and dosha rebalancing. Herbal remedies reduce inflammation, nourish tissues, and strengthen the spine. Lifestyle and diet changes, including gentle exercises and stress reduction, maintain dosha balance and prevent pain recurrence. Ayurveda offers a holistic, natural, non-invasive approach that alleviates symptoms and prevents future issues, enhancing overall well-being, reducing stress, and improving your quality of life. Experience this transformation at Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village, where Ayurveda empowers a pain-free life with enhanced well-being.

ENQUIRE NOW

Recommended For?
Slip Disc
Arthritis {Osteo & Rheumatoid}
Spondylitis
Rheumatism
Pain Management
Sciatica (Pain radiating from the lower back to the legs)

BOOK YOUR FREE DOCTOR CONSULTATION

Process Involved In Treatment for Pain Management

The process followed for Ayurvedic treatment of Pain Management involves a comprehensive approach that includes the following steps:

01

Consultation and Assessment: Receive an initial consultation with an experienced Ayurvedic doctor to delve into your medical history, lifestyle, and the root causes of your pains. Additionally, undergo a comprehensive assessment of your body constitution (dosha), imbalances, and specific factors contributing to your pain.

02

Customized Treatment Plan: Following the assessment, the Ayurvedic doctor crafts a personalized treatment plan designed to meet your specific needs. This comprehensive plan encompasses a blend of therapies, medications, lifestyle adjustments, and dietary recommendations for your holistic well-being.

03

Ayurvedic Therapies: Skilled therapists, guided by Ayurvedic doctors, administer therapies such as Abhyanga (oil massage), Pizhichil (warm oil treatment), Kati Basti (herbal oil pooling), and Nasya (nasal herbal oil application) for pain management. These therapies alleviate pain, inflammation, and muscle tension, improve circulation, and support healing.

04

Natural Medications: Ayurvedic doctors prescribe herbal formulations and natural medications to target the root causes of pains, selected for their ability to reduce inflammation, nourish tissues, strengthen the spine, and alleviate pain. These herbal remedies, derived from potent herbs and minerals, are chosen for their safety and effectiveness.

05

Lifestyle and Diet Modifications: Ayurveda highlights lifestyle and dietary management for pain management. The Ayurvedic doctor offers personalized guidance on adopting a healthful routine, incorporating gentle exercises, stress reduction techniques, and a balanced diet. These changes aim to maintain dosha equilibrium, enhance posture, and prevent pain recurrence.

06

Follow-up and Monitoring: Regular follow-up sessions with the Ayurvedic doctor assess progress, allowing adjustments to the treatment plan and addressing concerns as needed. These sessions also monitor the effectiveness of therapies, medications, and lifestyle changes to ensure optimal results in managing pain.
Why one should go this therapy?
115+ years of healing excellence, trusted by 30,000+ patients worldwide.
Holistic approach targeting root causes for lasting relief and well-being.
Personalized treatment plans tailored to your unique needs.
Authentic Ayurvedic therapies, natural medications, and lifestyle guidance for sustainable results in a serene environment.
Benefits Of Ayurvedic Treatment for Pain Management
Effective, holistic relief from pain management
Personalized, natural treatments addressing root causes
Improved well-being, flexibility, and relaxation
Ongoing support for sustained results
Doctor GUIDANCE
Personalised Doctor Guided Program

Start with an appointment to discuss your pains and medical history. Receive a personalized plan with therapies, medications, and lifestyle advice, including exercises and diet modifications for optimal results.

Attend regular therapeutic sessions for Ayurvedic treatments targeting pains, follow prescribed natural medications, and maintain communication with your doctor for progress monitoring and adjustments if needed.

Attend follow-ups, maintain recommended lifestyle changes, and practice self-care for sustained relief and prevention of pains. By following this doctor-guided program, you can maximize the effectiveness of your Ayurvedic treatment for pain management. “Panchakarma” is the renowned detox process in “Ayurveda”, rejuvenating youth through the use of therapeutic oils. This unique approach involving medicated oil massage and herbal therapies was recommended in ancient Vedic texts and has been utilized in Kerala for numerous centuries, following the significant writings of the “Charaka Samhita.” Panchakarma and Shirodhara are prominent treatments in Indian Ayurveda; given the extent of transformative detoxification they offer, it’s easy to see why.

WHAT IS PANCHAKARMA?

Panchakarma consists of five natural techniques for purging or cleansing, providing the body with a thorough detoxification while harmonizing the three doshas: Vata, Pitta, and Kapha.

Vamanam/Vamana (Emesis Therapy or vomiting): This process is well supervised at The Ayurvedic Healing Village, by highly trained therapists at our certified Panchakarma hospital. Vamanam is induced to eliminate Kapha, which causes excess mucus. Congestion in the lungs causes repeated attacks of bronchitis, colds and coughs. Vamanam is the best treatment for Kapha-related diseases, as well as chronic skin diseases such as psoriasis.

Virechanam (Purgation: The elimination of toxic matter from the intestines by administrating therapeutic purgation or a therapeutic laxative, Virechanam is an especially effective cure in cases of jaundice and hemorrhoids.

Vasti: Ayurvedic therapy through medicines or natural decoctions, such as oils, ghee or milk through enema is known as Vasti. The decoction depends on the disease that needs to be cured. It has huge advantages and is powerful against diseases like piles, constipation and arthritis.

Nasyam: For patients suffering from issues like Sinus, and migraine that target the head area, this Ayurvedic therapy is the best. It is a natural cleansing technique where the cerebral area gets freed from any kind of pain and nasal drops are regulated in the nostrils.

Raktamokshana: Lastly, this process is done to clean the blood. As per Ayurveda impure blood is a major cause of many diseases, so this therapy allows for the purification of the blood thus getting rid of health issues like psoriasis, pigmentation, dermatitis and many more.Nutrition is essential both during and following Panchakarma. Following the purification process, the patient ought to consume Kitchari (a mixed vegetable dish) whenever hunger arises. They ought to stick to this diet for three to four days, gradually adding a variety of other foods such as ginger, pepper, salt, green gram soup, and other pulse soups, and slowly increasing the amount.

Raktamokshana: Lastly, this process is done to clean the blood. Following the purification process, the patient ought to consume Kitchari (a mixed vegetable dish) whenever hunger arises. They ought to stick to this diet for three to four days, gradually adding a variety of other foods such as ginger, pepper, salt, green gram soup, and other pulse soups, and slowly increasing the amount.

About the Program

No matter if you’re facing chronic diseases, lifestyle-related issues, or various comorbidities in the post-covid era, Swasthya Anukūla Chikitsa at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village provides a highly individualized Ayurvedic healing experience. Based on traditional Ayurvedic literature and guided by experienced doctors, this program is customized to address your health issues, objectives, and constitution (prakriti).

Guests enjoy 2 Ayurvedic treatments daily, meticulously selected by our doctors following in-depth consultations and dosha evaluations. Therapies focus on lasting health, harmonizing bodily energies, and targeting underlying issues, not merely symptoms. Yoga, meditation, a pure diet, and Kerala’s therapeutic environment provide deep revitalization for the mind and body.

Kairali represents more than 115 years of Ayurvedic healing, drawing from Kerala’s rich medical lineage. The Healing Village, set among 65 lush acres at the foothills of the Western Ghats, is built on Vastu Shastra principles with a tranquil, sattvic environment. Over 100,000 patients from 50+ countries have experienced authentic, doctor-supervised Ayurvedic therapies for a spectrum of health conditions.

Process Involved in Kairali’s Personalized & Customized Healing Program

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village includes the following steps:

01

Consultation: The first consultation consists of a comprehensive health history review, lifestyle assessment, and dosha evaluation (Nadi Pariksha, Darshana Pariksha, Prashna Pariksha).

02

Diagnosis: Identification of underlying imbalances, health objectives, and any comorbidities. Each aspect of the patient is observed through the lens of Ayurvedic physiology.

03

Personalized Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, a completely individualized plan is created. This includes a combination of therapies, herbal medications, dietary guidelines, and daily routines (Dinacharya).

04

Ayurvedic Therapies: Two therapies per day, selected by the physician as per your health goal. May include Pizhichil, Shirodhara, Navarakizhi, Udwartanam, Lepam, Nasyam, Vasti, or detox-based Panchakarma therapies.

05

Internal Medications: Natural Ayurvedic formulations are prescribed to address internal imbalances, support immunity, digestion, and mind-body harmony.

06

Diet & Lifestyle: You will receive a personalized sattvic meal plan and lifestyle guidance based on your dosha and medical requirements.

07

Follow-Up & Monitoring: Daily doctor consultations to monitor progress and adapt therapies. After discharge, you’ll be provided with guidance for sustained wellness.

No matter if you’re facing chronic diseases, lifestyle-related issues, or various comorbidities in the post-covid era, Swasthya Anukūla Chikitsa at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village provides a highly individualized Ayurvedic healing experience. Based on traditional Ayurvedic literature and guided by experienced doctors, this program is customized to address your health issues, objectives, and constitution (prakriti).

Guests enjoy 2 Ayurvedic treatments daily, meticulously selected by our doctors following in-depth consultations and dosha evaluations. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village includes the following steps:

Consultation: The first consultation consists of a comprehensive health history review, lifestyle assessment, and dosha evaluation (Nadi Pariksha, Darshana Pariksha, Prashna Pariksha).

Diagnosis: Identification of underlying imbalances, health objectives, and any comorbidities. Each aspect of the patient is observed through the lens of Ayurvedic physiology.

03

Personalized Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, a completely individualized plan is created. This includes a combination of therapies, herbal medications, dietary guidelines, and daily routines (Dinacharya).

Ayurvedic Therapies: Two therapies per day, selected by the physician as per your health goal. May include Pizhichil, Shirodhara, Navarakizhi, Udwartanam, Lepam, Nasyam, Vasti, or detox-based Panchakarma therapies.

Internal Medications: Natural Ayurvedic formulations are prescribed to address internal imbalances, support immunity, digestion, and mind-body harmony.

06

Diet & Lifestyle: You will receive a personalized sattvic meal plan and lifestyle guidance based on your dosha and medical requirements.

07

Follow-Up & Monitoring: Daily doctor consultations to monitor progress and adapt therapies. After discharge, you’ll be provided with guidance for sustained wellness.

About Postpartum Rejuvenation Therapy Program

Motherhood is an incredible journey, but it’s important to understand that your well-being continues to be a priority after giving birth. After childbirth, your body undergoes significant physical and hormonal changes. Ayurveda, with its ancient herbal therapies, can help you regain your pre-pregnancy vitality while allowing you to relish motherhood fully. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we offer a post-delivery rejuvenation program lasting 14/21/28 days, extendable to 40 days. This program focuses on restoring your strength, energy, and shape.

Our postpartum rejuvenation therapy in Ayurveda package includes Sootika Charya, a therapeutic post-pregnancy massage, and a balanced diet. Under the careful supervision of Ayurvedic experts, this treatment aids in healing and restoring your pelvic structure, promoting healthy lactation, reducing stress, and relieving neck and backaches.

History of Postpartum Rejuvenation Therapy Program

For centuries, Ayurveda has celebrated the postpartum phase as a critical period for a mother’s rejuvenation and renewal. In ancient Indian households, this phase, known as the “Sutika Kala,” was treated with immense care, recognizing the physical and emotional transformation a woman undergoes after childbirth. Families followed a meticulously crafted regimen involving nourishing meals, therapeutic massages, and calming rituals to ensure recovery and long-term well-being.

Ayurvedic texts emphasized restoring balance to the body, strengthening the uterus, and replenishing energy reserves. Practices like oil baths and gentle detox therapies were handed down through generations, offering holistic healing.

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we carry forward this timeless tradition, offering personalized care that blends ancient wisdom with modern needs.

About Postpartum Rejuvenation Therapy Program

Motherhood is an incredible journey, but it’s important to understand that your well-being continues to be a priority after giving birth. After childbirth, your body undergoes significant physical and hormonal changes. Ayurveda, with its ancient herbal therapies, can help you regain your pre-pregnancy vitality while allowing you to relish motherhood fully. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we offer a post-delivery rejuvenation program lasting 14/21/28 days, extendable to 40 days. This program focuses on restoring your strength, energy, and shape.

Our postpartum rejuvenation therapy in Ayurveda package includes Sootika Charya, a therapeutic post-pregnancy massage, and a balanced diet. Under the careful supervision of Ayurvedic experts, this treatment aids in healing and restoring your pelvic structure, promoting healthy lactation, reducing stress, and relieving neck and backaches.

History of Postpartum Rejuvenation Therapy Program

For centuries, Ayurveda has celebrated the postpartum phase as a critical period for a mother’s rejuvenation and renewal. In ancient Indian households, this phase, known as the “Sutika Kala,” was treated with immense care, recognizing the physical and emotional transformation a woman undergoes after childbirth. Families followed a meticulously crafted regimen involving nourishing meals, therapeutic massages, and calming rituals to ensure recovery and long-term well-being.

Ayurvedic texts emphasized restoring balance to the body, strengthening the uterus, and replenishing energy reserves. Practices like oil baths and gentle detox therapies were handed down through generations, offering holistic healing.

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we carry forward this timeless tradition, offering personalized care that blends ancient wisdom with modern needs.

Prav-Simona Monsoon Yoga Retreat

PAST RETREAT

Prav-Simona Monsoon Yoga Retreat

This page records the Prav–Simona Monsoon Yoga Retreat programmes of 17–22 and 23–30 September 2017. The programme, biographies, schedule and inclusions are historical and are not current booking terms.

Past Retreats

Historical retreat description
Yoga retreat by Prav and Simona from Denmark

17th – 22nd Sept (5 nights/ 6 days) & 23rd – 30th Sept, (7 nights/ 8 days), 2017

Kairali – The Ayurvedic healing village represents tranquility and a beneficial way of life, where individuals can reside free from external disturbances or concerns. Featuring exceptional amenities combined with the timeless generosity of Ayurveda, this serene environment serves as an ideal retreat from the chaos of daily life.

The reasons for the ailments associated with both (mind and body) are threefold – improper use, lack of use, and overuse of time, mental abilities, and sensory objects. This retreat helps you recover from daily stress and provides you with a healthier way of living. Daily sessions of Yoga, Pranayama, Ayurvedic treatments, preparing nutritious Ayurvedic meals, workshops, and various activities would take place. Our instructors will also guide you in Hatha Yoga.

In the course of our daily routines, teams would be formed. The groups would be limited and exclusive to ensure that each individual gets personalized attention. Our yogis possess extensive experience, having taught for over 20 years while journeying around the world to promote yoga awareness.

70% of the ingredients in our nutritious organic food come from the organic farm located in the healing village, while the remaining ingredients are sourced locally. Our meals are cooked based on a person’s body constitution. We adhere to a suitable meal plan created by our on-site physicians. We also arrange a workshop on Ayurvedic cooking classes, enabling you to prepare those healthy recipes at home after the retreat.

In line with the retreat’s theme, our physicians and yoga instructors will provide various Ayurvedic treatments but solely following a thorough assessment of your body. In addition to Ayurvedic cooking classes, we will also offer workshops focused on Yoga philosophy, the significance of yoga in everyday life, personalized consultations and advice, management of specific ailments, village walks, etc.

The Yoga retreat focuses on stress management, healing, and a healthy lifestyle. scheduled for September, aims to assist you in balancing your mind and body. Our expert yogis, Prav and Simona from Denmark, will assist you with all your stress-related concerns for 6 days, followed by healing through Pranayams and Meditation for the next 8 days. Encompassing a complete bundle of rejuvenation for the Mind, Body, and Soul.

Ayurveda and Yoga for Stress Management & Healthy Lifestyle
17th – 22nd Sept, 2017)

The retreat is perfect for those who want to adopt a stress-free and healthier lifestyle. Mental stress has a direct effect on our nervous system, leading to various health issues. Adapting the ancient science of Yoga and Ayurveda amid beautiful trees and medicinal herbs that is situated in our blissful Ayurveda village in Kerala would help you heal in no time.

Introduction to yoga.
Mindfulness and yoga asana practice.
Yoga and movement.
Holistic healing of mind, body spirit.
Practice the right techniques.
Posture clinic.
Dealing with injuries and safety precautions.
“Ayurveda and Yoga for Healing”: 23rd – 30th Sept, 2017”

This part of the retreat deals with the Healing of the body. The inclusions are supplementary to the preceding retreat. Various Pranayams & Meditation are explained and practiced. The Balance between Mind and Body is the ultimate goal of this retreat.

Introduction to pranayama and mudras.
Intro to Natural way to health.
Introduction to the Vedic system.
Science of Yoga and Health.
Nadis, chakra and kundalini for healing self.
Yoga in day-to-day application.
Guided meditation.
Yoga Nidra for mind and body relaxation.
Science of Yoga and Health.
Balancing mind and body for total integration of self.
Dinachariya
Meditation /science behind the art of self-silence.
Retreat Includes:
Welcome-drink on arrival.
Accommodation in uniquely designed, independent villas.
All Meals (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner – Veg. only).
Daily allotment of in-room mineral water [1 per person per day, max of 2 bottles per room per day]; unlimited supply of herbal water & one Ayurvedic therapy daily along with Steam bath.
Complimentary Juice or Herbal tea after every massage. Additional food items will be charged extra.
Complimentary Village Walk (Once a Week).
Visit our proprietary Ayurvedic Factory—chargeable—please ask our friendly staff for rates and details.
Daily Personal Lifestyle & Fitness Evaluation.
Complimentary use of Swimming Pool, Gym, Library & all Indoor & Outdoor facilities.
Internal medicines given for your treatment can only be ascertained as your treatment progresses and will cost extra.
The Retreat: Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village

The Ayurvedic Healing Village is located within 65 acres of verdant landscape in Palakkad, Kerala. It features 30 unique villas, all adhering to “Vastu Shastra” design – the Indian equivalent of feng shui. The retreat is enveloped by herbs and trees possessing profound healing and restorative abilities, creating the perfect serene haven to unwind in! There are extensive gym facilities, a tennis court, a spacious swimming pool, and a library.

The retreat provides top-notch Ayurvedic therapies and therapeutic massages, featuring skilled massage therapists and physicians. They provide various therapies, such as Abhyangam, pizhichil, shirodhara, panchakarma, and more.

The Daily Schedule
6.30 am – Proper Body relaxation technique in Group class.
8.00 am – Breakfast.
9.00 am – Rest/ Ayurvedic therapy/ Workshops / Village walkthrough.
11.30 am – Posture-related exercises to attain flow of energy.
1 pm Lunch
2.00 pm – Leisure time/ Ayurvedic therapy.
4.30 pm – Pranayama/Meditation / Yoga Philosophy.
6.30 pm – Leisure Time.
7.30 pm – Dinner

**Schedules are subject to change as per local conditions.”

Optional Extras:
Ayurvedic treatment courses for specific health conditions
Palmistry consultations
Vedic Astrology Readings
Spiritual ceremonies (pujas)
Kerala tours and local travel
Date: 17th – 22nd Sept (5 nights/ 6 days) & 23rd – 30th Sept, (7 nights/ 8 days), 2017
Location: Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala

Not included in the Retreat
Flights and local transportation

Yoga Teachers:

Prav Satthi is a professional accredited by the European Yoga Federation. Rejuvenation specialists excelled in collaboration, Ayurveda, ancient Egyptian healing techniques, and Scandinavian healing practices. He has been employed worldwide for the last 16 years. He is a researcher in the field and has led multiple retreats, currently teaching over 1000 individuals in the Faroe Islands.

Specialization – Management of back problems, scoliosis treatment, diabetes control, stress alleviation, burnout treatment, yoga principles, Vedic analysis, and the study of pranayama.

Simona Sathhi, certified by Yoga Alliance internationally with 4 years of experience, is currently located in Slovenia.

Specialization – Body alignment, Stress management, Chinese medicine, Food consultant, Healthy cooking (Ayurvedic & Western concept)

PROGRAM DETAILS
About the Program

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s regenerative wellness treatment, rooted in traditional Ayurveda, rebalances doshas, restores well-being, and enhances health. This preventive approach wards off ailments rejuvenates, promotes longevity, and restores natural health. Daily Abhyangam massages and therapeutic therapies bolster your body’s resilience. A prescribed vegetarian diet aligns with Ayurvedic principles. Immerse in Yoga and Meditation in the serene Western Ghats, disconnecting from the world and reconnecting with your inner self. Zodiac-assigned rooms, designed following Vaastu Shastra principles, enhance your healing experience. This retreat offers a fulfilling stay, fostering recuperation and vitality in a tranquil ambiance.

HISTORY
History of Preventive Health & Regenerative Ayurvedic Detox Program

Regenerative body detox program, rooted in Ayurvedic traditions, offers a holistic approach to optimal health. It emphasizes prevention and rejuvenation to enhance vitality. Preventive care involves identifying dosha imbalances and using herbal remedies, diet adjustments, yoga, meditation, and lifestyle changes to boost immunity and maintain harmony. Regenerative therapies revitalize the body, promoting detoxification through ayurvedic therapies and using specialized herbs to nourish tissues. Ayurvedic massages like Abhyangam and Shirodhara enhance circulation, relax the mind, and stimulate healing. This approach fosters balance, addresses the root causes of potential health issues, and promotes self-care for lasting wellness and vitality. Ayurveda’s time-tested wisdom guides the journey to holistic well-being.

Process Involved in Preventive Health & Regenerative Ayurvedic Detox Program

Preventive & Regenerative Ayurvedic Therapy focuses on enhancing the body’s natural ability to maintain health and recover from damage. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, this holistic approach integrates ancient Ayurvedic practices with modern wellness techniques. Here’s a step-by-step overview of the process:

01

Personalized Assessment: Each program begins with an in-depth consultation to evaluate the individual’s physical, mental, and emotional well-being. This includes analyzing lifestyle, dietary habits, and dosha imbalances.

02

Nutrition and Lifestyle Planning: A customized diet plan, based on Ayurvedic principles, helps restore balance and improve immunity. Participants are also educated on lifestyle modifications to prevent future health issues.

03

Regenerative Therapies: Regenerative Body Detox Program focuses on eliminating body pains and day-to-day stress and provides relaxation to the guest to revitalize the body. Techniques include in-house herbal oil therapy (Abhyangam) and yoga practices to enhance cellular health and energy flow.

04

Yoga & Meditation: Group yoga and meditation sessions are integrated to reduce stress, improve flexibility, and foster mental clarity. These practices align with Ayurveda’s focus on holistic well-being.

05

Continuous Monitoring and Feedback: Progress is closely monitored, and the program is refined to suit evolving needs, ensuring lasting results and preventive care.

◆
It focuses on preventing health issues before they arise, promoting a proactive approach to well-being.
◆
This therapy rejuvenates the body naturally, enhancing energy, vitality, and overall physical health.
◆
By strengthening the immune system, it reduces the risk of illnesses and boosts the body’s defense mechanisms.
◆
It restores balance and harmony to the mind and body, leading to improved mental well-being and reduced stress.
◆
With its roots in ancient Ayurvedic wisdom, this holistic approach supports long-term health and empowers individuals to take control of their wellness.

Guidance on balanced living, diet, and stress management is provided, with continued doctor support for a safe and effective journey.

Post Treatment

Follow-up consultations with the Ayurvedic doctor assess the effectiveness and offer guidance. You’ll integrate post-treatment practices, like diet and lifestyle recommendations, for sustained benefits. Ongoing support ensures long-term health and addresses any concerns or needs.

History of Preventive Health & Regenerative Ayurvedic Detox Program

Regenerative body detox program, rooted in Ayurvedic traditions, offers a holistic approach to optimal health. It emphasizes prevention and rejuvenation to enhance vitality. Preventive care involves identifying dosha imbalances and using herbal remedies, diet adjustments, yoga, meditation, and lifestyle changes to boost immunity and maintain harmony. Regenerative therapies revitalize the body, promoting detoxification through ayurvedic therapies and using specialized herbs to nourish tissues. Ayurvedic massages like Abhyangam and Shirodhara enhance circulation, relax the mind, and stimulate healing. This approach fosters balance, addresses the root causes of potential health issues, and promotes self-care for lasting wellness and vitality. Ayurveda’s time-tested wisdom guides the journey to holistic well-being.

Preventive & Regenerative Ayurvedic Therapy focuses on enhancing the body’s natural ability to maintain health and recover from damage. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, this holistic approach integrates ancient Ayurvedic practices with modern wellness techniques. Here’s a step-by-step overview of the process:

01

Personalized Assessment: Each program begins with an in-depth consultation to evaluate the individual’s physical, mental, and emotional well-being. This includes analyzing lifestyle, dietary habits, and dosha imbalances.

02

Nutrition and Lifestyle Planning: A customized diet plan, based on Ayurvedic principles, helps restore balance and improve immunity. Participants are also educated on lifestyle modifications to prevent future health issues.

03

Regenerative Therapies: Regenerative Body Detox Program focuses on eliminating body pains and day-to-day stress and provides relaxation to the guest to revitalize the body. Techniques include in-house herbal oil therapy (Abhyangam) and yoga practices to enhance cellular health and energy flow.

04

Yoga & Meditation: Group yoga and meditation sessions are integrated to reduce stress, improve flexibility, and foster mental clarity. These practices align with Ayurveda’s focus on holistic well-being.

05

Continuous Monitoring and Feedback: Progress is closely monitored, and the program is refined to suit evolving needs, ensuring lasting results and preventive care.

◆
With its roots in ancient Ayurvedic wisdom, this holistic approach supports long-term health and empowers individuals to take control of their wellness.

Why is Detoxification important for the human body?

Detoxification is important for the human body because it helps to eliminate harmful toxins and chemicals that accumulate in the body over time. These toxins can contribute to a variety of health issues and can impair the body's natural ability to function optimally.

Why should you opt for the treatment?

The human body tirelessly processes various substances and differentiates between what's beneficial and what's harmful. However, it's now overburdened with toxins, stress, and processed foods, causing a buildup of toxicity in the system. A detox and rejuvenation program can help unload the stress and cleanse the body for better health.

What would be the duration of the treatment?

You can opt for this program for a minimum of 7 days up to 14 days depending upon your consultation with the doctor

Is any specific or generic post-treatment care required?

Post-care or "Paschat Karma" is as important as the main detox procedures. It acts as a buffer period for your digestive system, allowing you to gradually reintroduce simple foods and eventually your regular healthy diet. During this period, your body continues to process the toxins that were released during the detox and your digestive system becomes more sensitive to overly stimulating or processed foods. Our practitioners will design a balanced and appropriate diet to help you make a slow and smooth transition back to your normal routine

What are the outcomes of the treatment?

The Ayurvedic detox and rejuvenation program purifies and rests the digestive system to improve the strength of Agni, the metabolic fire, throughout the body. This process fosters a sense of energy, vitality, and enthusiasm for life, and supports healthy weight and overall health. The program provides an opportunity for self-reflection and deeper inner awareness, and a healthy diet and lifestyle can further enhance your well-being even after the program is complete.

Privacy Statement
ON THIS PAGE
◆
Last Update: February 18, 2025

Our goal at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village (“Kairali,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is to safeguard your privacy and make sure that your personal data is handled sensibly and safely. This Privacy Statement describes how we gather, use, share, and safeguard your personal information when you engage with us, such as when you browse our website, make a reservation, or make use of our health and Ayurvedic services.

1. Information We Collect

We collect personal data in the following ways:

1.1 Information You Provide Directly
Name, contact details (email, phone number, address) when you make a reservation or inquiry.
Health-related information (only with your consent) for Ayurvedic consultations and treatments.
Payment details for bookings, purchases, or spa treatments.
Preferences, feedback, and communication history.
1.2 Information Collected Automatically
IP address, browser type, and device details when you visit our website.
Cookies and tracking technologies to analyze website usage and improve user experience.
Location data (if permitted) to provide personalized recommendations.
1.3 Information from Third Parties
Travel agencies, partners, or wellness platforms when you book through third-party services.
Social media interactions if you engage with our content on platforms like Instagram, Facebook, or LinkedIn.
2. Children policy 

We do not intentionally target our platforms to children or knowingly collect information from children. We will remove any information we discover that we have gathered from minors. For additional details regarding the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) of 2023, which applies to websites that target children younger than 18.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use your data for the following purposes:

Providing Services – Taking reservations, personalizing Ayurvedic therapies, and improving your overall health.
Communication –sending newsletters, special offers, booking confirmations, and customer service messages.
Health & Safety – Based on your health details ( only with consent) ensuring personalized Ayurveda treatments 
Marketing & Promotions – Sharing exclusive wellness offers, updates, and retreat information.
Website Optimization – Improving our digital experience through analytics and performance tracking.
Legal & Compliance – Meeting regulatory requirements, fraud prevention, and ensuring data security.
Sensitive data handling – Sensitive information, including health, religious views, and biometric data, is handled, kept, and safeguarded as per local laws. 
4. Data Sharing &  Disclosure

We do not sell or trade your personal data. However, we may share information with:

Service Providers: Payment processors, IT support, and trusted third parties who assist in delivering our services.
Legal Authorities: If required by law, court orders, or regulatory obligations.
Marketing & Advertising Partners: Only with your consent, for exclusive offers and wellness programs.
5. Data Security & Retention

We put strong security measures in place to guard against abuse, unauthorized access, and alteration of your personal data. Your information is only kept for as long as is required to achieve its goals, meet legal requirements, or settle disputes.

5.1 Security Measures We implement comprehensive security protocols including:
Industry-standard encryption for all data transmission and storage
Regular security audits and penetration testing
Mandatory data protection training for all staff members
Access control systems with multi-factor authentication
Regular backup procedures and disaster recovery planning
5.2 Retention Periods We retain your information according to the following guidelines:
Health and treatment records: 7 years from your last visit, as required by Indian healthcare regulations
Booking and accommodation data: 3 years from your last stay
Marketing preferences: Until you withdraw consent
Financial records: 8 years, as required by tax regulations
6. Data breach

As soon as a breach is discovered, we will start containment procedures and carry out an initial evaluation to ascertain the type and extent of the problem. As required by law, Kairali will notify the appropriate supervisory authorities within 72 hours of the breach being confirmed. When a breach poses a serious risk to the rights and freedoms of affected data subjects, they must be informed as soon as possible.  Such notifications shall include: 

description of the breach,
categories of personal data affected, likely consequences, 
measures taken to mitigate potential adverse effects, 
contact information for further inquiries. 

If prompt disclosure might obstruct a criminal investigation, Kairali retains the right to postpone reporting. All breaches will be thoroughly documented by us, including the facts, consequences, and corrective measures implemented. After a breach occurs, we will put in place the proper organizational and technical safeguards to stop it from happening again. These safeguards may include improved encryption techniques, system updates, and employee training. 

7. User Rights & Choices

Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), you have certain rights regarding your personal information:

7.1 Access and view your personal information we hold: 

View and access the personal data we have on you.
To guarantee accuracy, ask for corrections.
When your data is no longer needed, delete it.
Remove your consent to the processing of your data.
Get your data in a transferable format.
Object to certain processing methods
7.2 How We Handle Your Data

As a data fiduciary, we are committed to:

Getting your consent before gathering or using your data
Putting in place the right security measures to safeguard your information
Notifying you of any potential data breaches
Processing just the information required to deliver our Ayurvedic services
Keeping our data management procedures transparent
7.3 Data Protection Measures

We have implemented:

Regular security assessments
Data protection training for employees
Systems for safely storing medical records
Protocols for data encryption
Access restrictions for private data
7.4 Data Retention

We retain your information only for as long as necessary to:

Offer our ayurvedic treatments.
Observe your legal responsibilities
Keep up-to-date medical records
Encourage any continued medical interventions.
7.5 Compliance with DPDPA

As required by law, we:

Keep track of all data processing actions.
Regularly evaluate the impact of data protection.
Collaborate with the Indian Data Protection Board
Respond quickly to requests for data transfers.

7.6  International Data Protection Standards

While we operate primarily under Indian law (DPDPA), we also respect and comply with international data protection standards where applicable, These include, but are not limited to:

EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) 
California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) 
South Korean Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) 
Singapore  Personal Data Protection Act (Singapore) 
Japanese Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI)
Other regional privacy laws as applicable to our international guests
7.7  Consent Management

We obtain explicit consent through:

Clear consent for health data collection
Specific authorization for sharing data with treatment providers
Documented consent for international data transfers
7.8 Data Protection Officer

For privacy-related inquiries or concerns, contact our designated Data Protection Officer:

Email: info@kairali.com 

Address: D-130 Ambedkar Colony Mehrauli, New-Delhi 110030
Feel free to contact us at info@kairali.com to exercise these rights. As required by DPDPA standards, we will reply to your request within the allotted period.

8. Opt-out option 

We offer thorough opt-out procedures to data subjects about the use of their personal information for targeted advertising. Data subjects have the right to revoke their consent at any moment for the use of their data for marketing purposes by: 

adjusting privacy preferences through their account settings
clicking the “unsubscribe” link in any commercial electronic communication,


Kairali will stop using the data subject’s personal information for targeted advertising after receiving an opt-out request. We may nonetheless process personal data despite such an opt-out if it is required to carry out contractual obligations or if it is otherwise allowed by relevant legislation.

9. AI Chatbot Disclosure & Policy

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, our AI chatbot offers automated help for reservation support, frequently asked questions and general inquiries. Although it improves convenience, it cannot provide medical diagnoses or tailored Ayurvedic recommendations nor substitute for human interaction. For professional advice, we recommend seeking out our experts. 

We emphasize the importance of data privacy and adherence to regulations. Following CCPA (USA), our AI does not retain personal information without permission, and per Japan’s AI Transparency Regulation, all AI-based interactions are completely transparent. 

If you have any questions about AI interactions, kindly contact info@kairali.com 

10. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies to enhance user experience, track website activity, and improve services. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

For more details, refer to our Cookie Policy.

11. International Data Transfers

As Kairali serves an international clientele, your data may be processed outside your home country. We ensure compliance with global data protection laws when handling such transfers.

12. Third-Party Links & External Services

Our website may contain links to third-party services, such as social media platforms, booking partners, or wellness affiliates. We are not responsible for their privacy practices and encourage you to review their policies.

13. Updates to This Privacy Statement

We may update this Privacy Statement periodically to reflect changes in legal requirements or our services. The latest version will always be available on our website.

Keeping our data management procedures transparent
7.3 Data Protection Measures

We have implemented:

Regular security assessments
Data protection training for employees
Systems for safely storing medical records
Protocols for data encryption
Access restrictions for private data
7.4 Data Retention

We retain your information only for as long as necessary to:

Offer our ayurvedic treatments.
Observe your legal responsibilities
Keep up-to-date medical records
Encourage any continued medical interventions.
7.5 Compliance with DPDPA

As required by law, we:

Keep track of all data processing actions.
Regularly evaluate the impact of data protection.
Collaborate with the Indian Data Protection Board
Respond quickly to requests for data transfers.

7.6  International Data Protection Standards

While we operate primarily under Indian law (DPDPA), we also respect and comply with international data protection standards where applicable, These include, but are not limited to:

EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) 
California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) 
South Korean Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) 
Singapore  Personal Data Protection Act (Singapore) 
Japanese Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI)
Other regional privacy laws as applicable to our international guests
7.7  Consent Management

We obtain explicit consent through:

Clear consent for health data collection
Specific authorization for sharing data with treatment providers
Documented consent for international data transfers
7.8 Data Protection Officer

For privacy-related inquiries or concerns, contact our designated Data Protection Officer:

Email: info@kairali.com 

Address: D-130 Ambedkar Colony Mehrauli, New-Delhi 110030
Feel free to contact us at info@kairali.com to exercise these rights. As required by DPDPA standards, we will reply to your request within the allotted period.

8. Opt-out option 

We offer thorough opt-out procedures to data subjects about the use of their personal information for targeted advertising. Data subjects have the right to revoke their consent at any moment for the use of their data for marketing purposes by: 

adjusting privacy preferences through their account settings
clicking the “unsubscribe” link in any commercial electronic communication,


Kairali will stop using the data subject’s personal information for targeted advertising after receiving an opt-out request. We may nonetheless process personal data despite such an opt-out if it is required to carry out contractual obligations or if it is otherwise allowed by relevant legislation.

9. AI Chatbot Disclosure & Policy

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, our AI chatbot offers automated help for reservation support, frequently asked questions and general inquiries. Although it improves convenience, it cannot provide medical diagnoses or tailored Ayurvedic recommendations nor substitute for human interaction. For professional advice, we recommend seeking out our experts. 

We emphasize the importance of data privacy and adherence to regulations. Following CCPA (USA), our AI does not retain personal information without permission, and per Japan’s AI Transparency Regulation, all AI-based interactions are completely transparent. 

If you have any questions about AI interactions, kindly contact info@kairali.com 

10. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies to enhance user experience, track website activity, and improve services. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

For more details, refer to our Cookie Policy.

11. International Data Transfers

As Kairali serves an international clientele, your data may be processed outside your home country. We ensure compliance with global data protection laws when handling such transfers.

12. Third-Party Links & External Services

Our website may contain links to third-party services, such as social media platforms, booking partners, or wellness affiliates. We are not responsible for their privacy practices and encourage you to review their policies.

13. Updates to This Privacy Statement

We may update this Privacy Statement periodically to reflect changes in legal requirements or our services. The latest version will always be available on our website.

Product Range

Our product line at Kairali Ayurvedic Group reflects more than a century of Ayurvedic knowledge and experience. Natural, carefully selected ingredients are used to create each composition to guarantee purity, effectiveness, and compatibility with the age-old Ayurvedic knowledge. Our products, which range from restorative oils to therapeutic powders, are made to address certain health issues and encourage overall well-being.

Kairali Ayurvedic Herbal Tea is designed to promote holistic wellness, Kairali Ayurvedic Herbal Tea is a carefully crafted blend of authentic Ayurvedic herbs. The tea boosts immunity, offers natural detoxification, and soothes the mind and body with each sip. Embrace a healthier lifestyle with the calming essence of Ayurveda in every cup.

Ayurvedic Proprietary Organics represents the knowledge of Ayurveda and the purity of nature. Our carefully formulated organic products are designed to promote energy, balance, and wellness. Kairali’s dependable organic line offers genuine, sustainable Ayurvedic treatment.

Kair by Kairali is a premium range of Ayurvedic wellness products that revitalize the body and soul. Kair provides a variety of treatments for modern living, all based on true Ayurvedic principles. Kair by Kairali captures the essence of timeless healing. 

Kairali Ayurvedic Proprietary Medicines are precisely created to address a variety of health conditions using the wisdom of Ayurveda. These tried-and-tested formulations combine real herbs with natural substances to promote effective, holistic healing. 

Kairali Ayurvedic Classical Medicines capture the essence of traditional Ayurvedic learning in its purest form. These authentic compositions, based on ancient scriptures, are designed to promote balance and comprehensive health. Kairali’s tried-and-tested classical treatments provide the ageless efficacy of Ayurvedic medicine. 

Books The founder of Kairali Ayurvedic Group, Gita Ramesh, has written Ayurvedic cookbooks namely- “Get Fit in Just 2 Weeks, Ayurvedic Herbal Massage, and Ayurvedic Wellness Cookbook”, that masterfully blend traditional knowledge with useful recipes for contemporary living. 


Kairali Ayurvedic Equipment is intended to accompany real Ayurvedic treatments with accuracy and care. Each product, from basic massage tables to modern therapy equipment, meets the highest quality and functional criteria. Kairali’s trusted Ayurvedic equipment can help you empower your health practice.

Time slowly passes and our lifestyle gets increasingly deplorable. Everyone chases something or another, and everyone takes the full brunt of an unhealthy lifestyle on their bodies. In this age of constant work and cutthroat competition, it is actually necessary to stay ahead of the game but when this diligence towards work starts having an adverse effect on our bodies, then it is a cue to reduce the time spent in front of paper works and computer monitors. Unfortunately, for some the prospect of having regulated work is only a fantasy and that is where the concept of Yoga retreat comes in.

A Yoga retreat is a place where one could revitalise their fatigued body and tired mind through Yoga and its practices. It is one such place that packs all the goodness of nature and mixes it in a perfect blend of yoga and Ayurveda to rejuvenate the degrading state of a body. Among these retreats, the Kairali Ayurvedic village stands out quite distinctly. The village situated amidst a forest adorned by Pala trees is the image of serenity where the mind is without inhibitions and is free to breathe in the air of placidity.

Not only is it immensely well maintained and provides a once in a lifetime opportunity at learning the intricacies of yoga and then employing it in our daily lives, it is also affordable which makes it very approachable. With their assorted conglomeration of yogic experts and certified professionals, this is the place to be if one wants to find the true meaning of living according to the philosophies taught by yoga.

We often hear cancer patients saying that they have undergone numerous chemo radiation therapies. It is a form of killer in disguise. It weakens the body and kills the person from inside. So, Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala, has come with an initiative to detoxify the immune system and give the bodily constitution a boost to energise and lead a life with happiness and peace.

Three categories of cancer patients visit our health resort. One who has been recently diagnosed with cancer. Second, who is already suffering and undergoing treatment and third, whose chemo therapies have stopped and might be is free from being a cancer victim as well. Maintaining a good lifestyle and proper diet helps in every kind of ailment and Kairali is the best place to get yourself relaxed and gain mental peace. The serene environment spreads a positive aura which automatically helps in healing.

Our Ayurvedic Health Resort with the help of authentic ayurvedic massages and therapies helps the cancer patients to revitalise their bodies and stay fit and make their mind positive, relaxed and motivated. Therapies like Abhyangam, Shirodhara and Vaman based on the condition of the patient. These treatments allow the detoxification of the body. Yoga sessions are also arranged that helps in calming and control one’s senses.

This package will also include:
Welcome drink on arrival.
Unparalleled and beautifully designed independent villas for accommodation.
All vegetarian meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner).
Daily allotment of In-house Atmospheric Natural Water, unlimited supply of herbal water.
Daily steam bath with two Ayurvedic therapies per person.
Complimentary juice or herbal tea with every session of massage. Charges applicable for additional food items.
Complimentary group yoga sessions every morning. Individual classes will be chargeable.
Complimentary group-meditation sessions every evening. Individual classes will be chargeable.
Complimentary lecture on Ayurveda once a week.
Complimentary lecture on Yoga once a week.
Complimentary workshop on cooking once a week.
Complimentary village walk once a week.
Organic garden guided tour.
Visit to our Proprietary Ayurvedic Factory on chargeable basis. Our friendly staff will guide you on the rates and details.
Evaluation of personal lifestyle and fitness on daily basis.
Swimming pool, library, gym and all indoor facilities can be used for free.
Internal medicines will be charged extra as they can be ascertained as the treatment progresses.

HIGHLIGHTS

Ayurveda helps in detoxification of the imbalanced doshas in the body.
It serves to be a motivator for cancer patients.
Ayurvedic therapies are considered to be the best medicines.
It increases the positivity and longevity of life.

About the Program

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has a long history of offering comprehensive care, which includes holistic care for cancer patients in Ayurveda. Kairali’s programs, which have their roots in the age-old science of Ayurveda, concentrate on enhancing immunity, reviving vitality, and enhancing quality of life both during and after cancer treatments. Cancer patients’ physical and mental problems are addressed by these treatments, which use individualized therapies including Panchakarma, herbal formulations, and dietary advice. Process Involved in Treatment

Supportive Care Therapy for Cancer Patients involves a comprehensive approach to optimize health and well-being. This holistic method draws from ancient Ayurvedic traditions and focuses on preventing ailments and rejuvenating the body. Here is a step-by-step guide to this transformative process:

01

Consultation and Assessment: Begin with an in-depth consultation with an Ayurvedic practitioner. They will assess your unique constitution, identify imbalances, and understand your specific health goals.

02

Personalized Treatment Plan: Based on the assessment, a personalized treatment plan is created. This plan incorporates dietary adjustments, herbal medicines, yoga, meditation, and lifestyle modifications tailored to your needs.

03

Preventive Measures: Embrace preventive measures to maintain balance and strengthen your body’s natural defences. These may include Ayurvedic dietary recommendations, daily routines (dinacharya), and seasonal practices (ritucharya).

04

Rejuvenation Therapies: Experience rejuvenation through specialized therapies. Panchakarma, a comprehensive detoxification process, helps eliminate toxins from the body. Ayurvedic massages, such as Abhyanga and Shirodhara, promote relaxation and stimulate the body’s healing capacity.

05

Follow-up and Maintenance: Regular follow-up sessions are essential to monitor progress and make necessary adjustments. The practitioner may suggest herbal supplements and lifestyle recommendations to maintain long-term well-being.

Why should one choose this therapy?
◆
It focuses on preventing health issues before they arise, promoting a proactive approach to well-being.
◆
This treatment rejuvenates the body naturally, enhancing energy, vitality, and overall physical health.
◆
By strengthening the immune system, it reduces the risk of illnesses and boosts the body’s defence mechanisms.
◆
It restores balance and harmony to the mind and body, leading to improved mental well-being and reduced stress.
◆
With its roots in ancient Ayurvedic wisdom, this holistic approach supports long-term health and empowers individuals to take control of their wellness.

Kerala, also known as “God’s Own Country,” is a place of verdant landscapes, serene backwaters, foggy hill stations, and a rich cultural legacy. While visiting Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village to rejuvenate and restore balance through Ayurveda, visitors can also enjoy the beautiful beauty of Kerala on customized sightseeing excursions.

Our touring experiences allow you to discover Kerala’s natural beauties, heritage sites, and cultural treasures while staying connected to wellness and serenity.

Thiruvalathoor

Thiruvalathoor Temple, an ancient architectural wonder, is famous for its exquisite woodwork and elaborate stone sculptures. This medieval temple honors Kerala’s rich history through superb craftsmanship that has stood the test of time.

Distance from Healing Village– 10 Km.


Rock Garden

Padmashree Nekchand Saini, the world-renowned artist who previously constructed the Malampuzha Rock Garden, designed India’s first rock garden in Chandigarh. Given that all of the objects on show are made from scrap materials such as granite, stones, broken bangles, melamine plates, shattered tiles, and so on, it is a remarkable work of creativity and art. 


Distance from Healing Village -15 km.

Thiruvegappura Sankaranarayana Temple

Thiruvegappura Sankaranarayana Temple- This 14th-century temple, also known as Moonnumoorthy Temple, was built on the banks of Thootha, a tributary of the Bharathapuzha River. The temple devotes its homage to both Lord Shiva and Lord Narayana.

Distance from Healing Village– 25 Km.

Nelliampathy

Nelliyampathy, also known as the “Queen of Palakkad Hills,” is a lovely spot draped in ethereal clouds with a distinct beauty. The area is famous for its cardamom farms, tea and coffee plantations, waterfalls, and beautiful weather. This small but beautiful hill station is great for trekking, jeep safaris, wildlife, and bird watching.

Distance from the healing village– 75 km

Given that all of the objects on show are made from scrap materials such as granite, stones, broken bangles, melamine plates, shattered tiles, and so on, it is a remarkable work of creativity and art. 


Distance from Healing Village -15 km.

Thiruvegappura Sankaranarayana Temple

Thiruvegappura Sankaranarayana Temple- This 14th-century temple, also known as Moonnumoorthy Temple, was built on the banks of Thootha, a tributary of the Bharathapuzha River. The temple devotes its homage to both Lord Shiva and Lord Narayana.

Distance from Healing Village– 25 Km.

Nelliampathy

Nelliyampathy, also known as the “Queen of Palakkad Hills,” is a lovely spot draped in ethereal clouds with a distinct beauty. The area is famous for its cardamom farms, tea and coffee plantations, waterfalls, and beautiful weather. This small but beautiful hill station is great for trekking, jeep safaris, wildlife, and bird watching.

Distance from the healing village– 75 km

PROGRAM DETAILS
About the Program

Sleep Restoration Therapy at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a focused wellness initiative aimed at naturally tackling insomnia, anxiety, and irregular sleep patterns. Grounded in classic Ayurvedic knowledge, the therapy merges soothing techniques such as Shirodhara, Abhyangam (oil massage), therapeutic steam baths, herbal remedies, and guided meditation. Tailored diets and lifestyle changes according to individual Prakriti aid in reestablishing the body’s natural sleep cycle. Nestled in Kerala’s tranquil environment, this program promotes profound relaxation, mental clarity, and emotional stability. Discover tranquil, restorative sleep through the Ayurvedic approach — and awaken to complete wellness at Kairali’s renowned Healing Village.

OUR APPROACH TO
Sleep Restoration Therapy

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we emphasize traditional Ayurveda principles, aiming to harmonize the mind, body, and spirit to rejuvenate natural sleep patterns. We start with an in-depth consultation to determine the underlying reasons for sleep issues — whether caused by aggravated doshas, stress, or lifestyle discrepancies. The therapy consists of relaxing treatments such as Shirodhara, Abhyangam, and herbal infusions that relax the nervous system, paired with a sattvic diet, everyday yoga, meditation, and breath exercises. Our calm atmosphere and tailored support provide a soothing, comprehensive route back to profound, rejuvenating sleep.

Process Involved in Sleep Restoration Therapy

Sleep Restoration Therapy at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village includes the following steps:

01

Consultation: We begin with a thorough consultation to understand your medical history, symptoms, and lifestyle. This helps us determine your unique dosha imbalance and design a personalized treatment plan.

02

Diagnosis: Through pulse examination (Nadi Pariksha) and visual examination (Darshana Pariksha), we assess the dosha imbalance and identify the root cause of your condition.

03

Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, we create a comprehensive treatment plan that includes a combination of therapies, herbal medications, dietary recommendations, and lifestyle modifications.

04

Ayurvedic Therapies: Treatment therapies include abhyangam, nasyam, shirodhara, takradhara, thapotichil, and sirovasti.Which will be administered as per body type and doctor’s consultation.

05

Herbal Medications: Doctors prescribe Ayurvedic medications made from natural herbs to support the internal healing process and strengthen the body.

06

Dietary and Lifestyle Guidance: Ayurvedic doctors will provide dietary recommendations tailored to your dosha imbalance and suggest lifestyle modifications to maintain balance and prevent further aggravation of symptoms.

07

Follow-up and Monitoring: We schedule regular follow-up sessions to track your progress, make necessary adjustments to the treatment plan, and provide ongoing support and guidance.

Why should one go with this treatment?
◆
Leverage 118+ years of expertise with an experienced team of Ayurvedic doctors. Our holistic approach prioritizes well-being, going beyond symptom management.
◆
Experience personalized treatments for your constitution and dosha imbalance. We follow Ayurvedic principles using natural therapies and herbs to minimize side effects.
◆
Deepen your understanding of Ayurvedic principles, your condition’s causes, and our treatment mechanisms. This empowers active participation in your healing journey and informed health decisions.
◆
Escape daily stress in our serene retreat. Get full support from our team with follow-ups, progress monitoring, and treatment plan adjustments as required.

You’ll have regular check-ins with the Ayurvedic doctor for progress monitoring and adjustments. Personalized therapies, including massages and herbal treatments, will be administered. Guidance on balanced living, diet, and stress management is provided, with continued doctor support for a safe and effective journey.

Post Treatment

Follow-up consultations with the Ayurvedic doctor assess the effectiveness and offer guidance. You’ll integrate post-treatment practices, like diet and lifestyle recommendations, for sustained benefits. Ongoing support ensures long-term health and addresses any concerns or needs.

PROGRAM DETAILS
About the Program

Sleep Restoration Therapy at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a focused wellness initiative aimed at naturally tackling insomnia, anxiety, and irregular sleep patterns. Grounded in classic Ayurvedic knowledge, the therapy merges soothing techniques such as Shirodhara, Abhyangam (oil massage), therapeutic steam baths, herbal remedies, and guided meditation. Tailored diets and lifestyle changes according to individual Prakriti aid in reestablishing the body’s natural sleep cycle. Nestled in Kerala’s tranquil environment, this program promotes profound relaxation, mental clarity, and emotional stability. Discover tranquil, restorative sleep through the Ayurvedic approach — and awaken to complete wellness at Kairali’s renowned Healing Village.

OUR APPROACH TO
Sleep Restoration Therapy

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we emphasize traditional Ayurveda principles, aiming to harmonize the mind, body, and spirit to rejuvenate natural sleep patterns. We start with an in-depth consultation to determine the underlying reasons for sleep issues — whether caused by aggravated doshas, stress, or lifestyle discrepancies. The therapy consists of relaxing treatments such as Shirodhara, Abhyangam, and herbal infusions that relax the nervous system, paired with a sattvic diet, everyday yoga, meditation, and breath exercises. Our calm atmosphere and tailored support provide a soothing, comprehensive route back to profound, rejuvenating sleep.

Process Involved in Sleep Restoration Therapy

Sleep Restoration Therapy at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village includes the following steps:

01

Consultation: We begin with a thorough consultation to understand your medical history, symptoms, and lifestyle. This helps us determine your unique dosha imbalance and design a personalized treatment plan.

02

Diagnosis: Through pulse examination (Nadi Pariksha) and visual examination (Darshana Pariksha), we assess the dosha imbalance and identify the root cause of your condition.

03

Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, we create a comprehensive treatment plan that includes a combination of therapies, herbal medications, dietary recommendations, and lifestyle modifications.

04

Ayurvedic Therapies: Treatment therapies include abhyangam, nasyam, shirodhara, takradhara, thapotichil, and sirovasti.Which will be administered as per body type and doctor’s consultation.

05

Herbal Medications: Doctors prescribe Ayurvedic medications made from natural herbs to support the internal healing process and strengthen the body.

06

Dietary and Lifestyle Guidance: Ayurvedic doctors will provide dietary recommendations tailored to your dosha imbalance and suggest lifestyle modifications to maintain balance and prevent further aggravation of symptoms.

07

Follow-up and Monitoring: We schedule regular follow-up sessions to track your progress, make necessary adjustments to the treatment plan, and provide ongoing support and guidance.

Why should one go with this treatment?
◆
Leverage 118+ years of expertise with an experienced team of Ayurvedic doctors. Our holistic approach prioritizes well-being, going beyond symptom management.
◆
Experience personalized treatments for your constitution and dosha imbalance. We follow Ayurvedic principles using natural therapies and herbs to minimize side effects.
◆
Deepen your understanding of Ayurvedic principles, your condition’s causes, and our treatment mechanisms. This empowers active participation in your healing journey and informed health decisions.
◆
Escape daily stress in our serene retreat. Get full support from our team with follow-ups, progress monitoring, and treatment plan adjustments as required.

Holistic Commitments of Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: 
1. Environmental Sustainability

The foundation of Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, is the idea of balance with the natural world. By using renewable energy sources, organic farming methods, and eco-friendly construction, the facility reduces its negative environmental effects. To promote biodiversity and the preservation of natural ecosystems, the retreat cultivates a lush landscape.

2. Cultural Preservation

Kairali Ayurvedic Group is committed to preserving Indian heritage and the rich customs of Ayurveda. The Healing Village incorporates genuine Ayurvedic practices into contemporary wellness initiatives, serving as a living archive of age-old knowledge. Frequent workshops, retreats, and cultural gatherings guarantee that this legacy is conserved and disseminated to the world community. 

3. Social Responsibility

Through the help of farmers, artists, and the community, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village actively supports the local economy. Locals are empowered by employment possibilities and training initiatives, and ethical sourcing is promoted through partnerships with regional suppliers. To improve impoverished regions, the retreat also takes part in humanitarian endeavors, focusing on health and education programs.

4. Health and Well-Being Advocacy

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village serves as a sanctuary for holistic health with a focus on physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. Spreading awareness about the advantages of Ayurveda and inspiring individuals to embrace a healthy lifestyle, the retreat offers customized wellness programs. 

5. Ethical Tourism 

By encouraging mindful travel practices, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village promotes ethical tourism. Fostering a sense of responsibility toward cultural and environmental conservation, guests are invited to participate in eco-friendly activities making their stay more memorable. 

By intertwining environmental care, cultural preservation, and community development, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village exemplifies a model of sustainable wellness rooted in Ayurvedic principles.

Holistic Commitments of Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: 
1. Environmental Sustainability

The foundation of Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, is the idea of balance with the natural world. By using renewable energy sources, organic farming methods, and eco-friendly construction, the facility reduces its negative environmental effects. To promote biodiversity and the preservation of natural ecosystems, the retreat cultivates a lush landscape.

2. Cultural Preservation

Kairali Ayurvedic Group is committed to preserving Indian heritage and the rich customs of Ayurveda. The Healing Village incorporates genuine Ayurvedic practices into contemporary wellness initiatives, serving as a living archive of age-old knowledge. Frequent workshops, retreats, and cultural gatherings guarantee that this legacy is conserved and disseminated to the world community. 

3. Social Responsibility

Through the help of farmers, artists, and the community, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village actively supports the local economy. Locals are empowered by employment possibilities and training initiatives, and ethical sourcing is promoted through partnerships with regional suppliers. To improve impoverished regions, the retreat also takes part in humanitarian endeavors, focusing on health and education programs.

4. Health and Well-Being Advocacy

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village serves as a sanctuary for holistic health with a focus on physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. Spreading awareness about the advantages of Ayurveda and inspiring individuals to embrace a healthy lifestyle, the retreat offers customized wellness programs. 

5. Ethical Tourism 

By encouraging mindful travel practices, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village promotes ethical tourism. Fostering a sense of responsibility toward cultural and environmental conservation, guests are invited to participate in eco-friendly activities making their stay more memorable. 

By intertwining environmental care, cultural preservation, and community development, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village exemplifies a model of sustainable wellness rooted in Ayurvedic principles.
