VISION AND MISSION
Vision and Mission
Social, Cultural & Environmental Commitment
AWARDS & ACCREDITATIONS
Awards & Accreditations
Accreditations

A business of today must run its activities in a socially acceptable way if it desires to sustain in the long run. Businesses should operate without jeopardizing the fate of the future generation. And for that, business needs to think for the society, environment, and its customers. Continuing business with ethics and contributing to economic development while improving the quality of the life of the workforce and their families demonstrated by the Kairali Ayurvedic Group. The local community and society at large is always considered to be benefitted by the actions.

Successful growth of an organization cannot be measured just by its increasing profitable value; rather it lies in the appreciation and recognition by the community. Kerala also known as the Paradise of Ayurveda, is the home of Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village and our success story would not have been same without the ancient knowledge and wisdom that Kerala has bestowed us with. Therefore it’s our responsibility to pay back in the form of taking its care socially, culturally and environmentally.

Local Outreach

A wide range of vital needs of surrounding population are satisfied by our charitable outreach programs

Providing Lands for Cultivation: Local farmers, who are suffering from financial crisis and economic difficulties, don’t have their own land to cultivate and find it difficult to feed their families are given agricultural lands by Kairali Ayurvedic Group. Surplus grain is either purchased by Kairali or sold to the local co-operative society.
Buyback on MSP (Minimum Support Price): We have procedure to buyback grains on MSP from the farmers who have been given land for cultivation from our grounds.
In alignment with the “Hope” foundation we focus to help local adults especially women in attaining economic independence by upgrading their skills via training.
Kairali Ayurvedic Group gives donation to the local communities around Palakkad. We also provide financial support, hospital beds and equipments to the local hospital in Chitoor Village and this effort will be continued in future too.
We have donated computers, tables, chairs, cupboards and money for books to the local school in Kodumbu Village.
Free medical checkups have been offered to almost 5000 financially weak people and free health consultation along with 2 nights in facility at Kairali has also been offered.
90% of our staff at The Ayurvedic Healing Village and other treatment centers is from Palakkad or Kerala. This is done with the aim of hiring the locals and contributing to their financial and economic development. These all are enabled by contributing to a local skills training program.
Charitable Concerns

Charitable ventures who are pursuing to help the environment and less privileged members of the community are keenly supported by Kairali. Active presence of Kairali can be seen in a number of projects.

Kairali supports Blue Yonder’s eco-tourism initiative Traveler’s Forest.
Instigated by their Managing Director, Mr. K.V Ramesh, Kairali gives medical care and support to blind children in association with Hellen Keller Centenary Memorial Model School for the Blind.
Every year, Kairali Group, adopts a girl and provides her with the corrective surgery.
Organic Business Practices

Every area of our business can depict our concern for the environment and nature. Kairali understands the need for sustainable development and therefore, sustainable practices are used at its organic herb farm in Kerala.

Vermiculture system has been employed at the Ayurvedic Healing Village to recycle all the organic waste for compost which further is used as a manure to enrich the soil at the organic farm.
The waste food which is not suitable for even vermiculture is not thrown away, but is sent to the pig farms as their feed.
Wastage Treatment plant is being installed to recycle and treat the waste products. It is a three tier system to ensure maximum output and sustainability.
Only CFL lights are used which aid in reducing the carbon footprint and reducing the usage of electricity by 40 per cent. Strict electricity policies are followed to save it.
State-of-the-art- generator is being used at Kairali outlets to decrease the carbon emissions.
Moving a step closer to protect our environment, we educate people in and around the resort to minimize the usage of polythene and also raise awareness and knowledge among staff, associates and customers.
1.25MW windmill is under planning, which would be an alternate source of energy to run the village.
Product Quality

Kairali is dedicated to enhancing the good name of Ayurveda and follows the strictest parameters in all its product development and treatment practices.

Dedicated towards promoting Ayurveda across the world, Kairali follows strict parameters for its product development, and treatment therapies and practices.
Events
Kairali feels proud to apprise that the Silver Jubilee edition of our Souvenir was released on 5th January 2013. It has been a supporter of Navjyoti India Foundation that is a non-profit NGO that prevents criminal prevention through welfare policing.
Kairali took the educational responsibility of ten (10) children wherein it sponsored everything that was required for them to study like books, uniforms, stationery items etc.
Creation of a Cross Cultural Environment
The Kairali Ayurvedic Group has been motivating its clients to interact with local people with a hope of generating a cross cultural environment, and fading off the gap of knowledge and culture between the clients and the local communities. This also allows the locals to be exposed to the workings of the modern world.

By accessing or using our website, facilities, accommodations, or services, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions set forth herein.

These Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) govern your use of our services, including bookings, Ayurvedic treatments, accommodations, website access, and related offerings. Booking Confirmation: Reservations will be confirmed against 100% advance payment.
Advance Requirements: We may request additional information, such as identification documents or health details, to ensure appropriate treatments and arrangements.
Child Policy: Children below 5 years can stay and have meals free of charge when sharing the room and existing bedding with adults. Additional charges may apply for older children or extra beds.
6. Doctor Consultation Timing

Guests with same-day bookings or walk-in arrivals must check in before 3:30 PM to be eligible for a doctor consultation on the same day. This cut-off is essential to allow our Ayurvedic doctors to provide a detailed and unhurried consultation experience.
Arrivals after 3:30 PM will have their consultation scheduled for the next available day, depending on doctor availability. We encourage all guests to plan their travel accordingly to avoid delays in beginning their healing program.

7. Payment Terms and Methods
Payment Methods: Guests may pay by credit/debit card, bank transfer, or other acceptable methods as specified at the time of booking.
Currency and Charges: All payments will be processed in the specified currency. Any bank charges, transaction fees, or exchange rate differences are the responsibility of the Guest.
8. Pricing, Offers, and Taxes
Pricing: All rates and charges will be as stated at the time of booking. We reserve the right to modify prices, promotions, and packages without prior notice but changes will not affect confirmed bookings.
Taxes and Levies: All applicable taxes, government levies, and service charges will be added to the bill as required by law.
9. Cancellation, Amendments, and Refund Policy
Cancellation Timeframes:
Up to 30 days before the stay: Full refund.
Between 15 and 30 days before the stay: 50% refund.
Less than 15 days before the stay or changes during the stay: No refund.
Amendments: Changes to reservation dates, treatments, or room categories are subject to availability and may incur additional charges.
Refund Process: Approved refunds will be processed within a reasonable timeframe using the same payment method used for the original transaction.
10. Check-in, Check-out, and Stay Policies
Check-In Time: 12:00 PM
Check-Out Time: 10:00 AM
Early/Late Requests: Early check-ins and late check-outs are subject to availability and may incur additional charges.
Length of Stay: Minimum or maximum stay requirements may apply during certain seasons, offers, or events.
11. Guest Conduct and Usage Restrictions
Ayurvedic Guidelines: Guests are expected to follow Ayurvedic guidelines provided by our experts and maintain the tranquility of the environment.
Prohibited Items and Behavior: Smoking, alcohol consumption, and non-vegetarian food are strictly forbidden.
Disruptive Conduct: Any unacceptable behavior or violation of Property rules may lead to immediate termination of stay without refund.
12. Additional Services and Charges
Facilities Use: Guests may use recreational grounds, yoga studios, and swimming pools during operational hours and must adhere to posted rules.
Damage to Property: Guests are liable for any damage caused to Property facilities or equipment. Repair or replacement costs will be charged to the Guest’s account.
Extra Services: Additional services such as laundry, guided tours, or special diets may incur extra charges.
13. Privacy and Data Protection
Data Use: Personal information collected during booking and treatment consultations will be kept confidential and used solely for reservation, treatment planning, and associated services.
Marketing Consent: With prior authorization, we may use anonymous feedback or endorsements for promotional purposes. Guests can opt-out by notifying management.
International Data Protection Compliance: We are committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with applicable laws and regulations worldwide. While we primarily operate under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) and IT Act of India, we also comply with relevant international data protection standards that may apply to our global guests, including but not limited to:
European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) 
California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA)
South Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA)
Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA)
Japan’s Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI)
Brazil’s Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD)

For specific inquiries regarding how we handle your data in accordance with regulations in your region, please contact our Data Protection Officer via the contact information provided in Section 24.

14. Third-Party Services and Links

Our website or other materials may reference third-party services, links, or resources. We do not control or endorse these external entities and are not responsible for the content, privacy practices, or services provided by third parties.

15. Force Majeure

We are not liable for cancellations, delays, modifications, or interruptions caused by events beyond our control (e.g., natural disasters, pandemics, government restrictions). In such cases, we will endeavor to reschedule or provide suitable alternatives as circumstances permit.

16. Website Use and Intellectual Property
Content Ownership: All content, trademarks, logos, and intellectual property displayed on our website and marketing materials are owned or licensed by Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village.
Permitted Use: You may not reproduce, modify, distribute, or exploit our content without express written permission.
17. Liability and Disclaimers
Health Disclosure: Guests must disclose any allergies, pre-existing medical conditions, or health concerns before treatments.
Assumption of Risk: Guests participate in therapies, activities, and exercises at their own risk. We are not responsible for injuries resulting from undisclosed conditions or non-compliance with instructions.
No Warranties: While we strive to provide exceptional services, we do not guarantee the outcome or effectiveness of any particular treatment or activity.
18. Indemnification

You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, its employees, and affiliates from any claims, losses, liabilities, damages, costs, or expenses arising from your misuse of our services, violation of these Terms, or infringement of any third-party rights.

19. Prohibited Activities
Illegal Activities: Guests shall not engage in any illegal, harmful, or fraudulent activities while on our Property or using our services.
Unauthorized Commercial Use: The Property, its facilities, and online platforms may not be used for any unauthorized commercial purpose.
20. Security and Fraud Prevention

We take reasonable measures to protect your information and maintain the security of our Property. Guests are expected to safeguard their personal belongings, payment information, and identification documents. We reserve the right to refuse service or report suspicious activities to the authorities.

21. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with Indian law, and any disputes arising out of or related to these Terms or our services shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Kerala, India.

22. Termination of Services

We reserve the right to terminate or restrict access to our services at any time, for any reason, including but not limited to non-compliance with these Terms, without any liability to you.

23. Changes to Terms and Conditions

We may update or modify these Terms at any time without prior notice. Such changes will be effective upon posting on our website. Your continued use of our services after such modifications constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

24. Feedback and Reviews

We welcome your feedback and reviews. By submitting feedback or testimonials, you grant us the right to use, reproduce, and publish such content for marketing and promotional purposes. If you prefer not to have your feedback publicly shared, please inform us in advance.

25. Contact Information

For questions, clarifications, or concerns regarding these Terms or any aspect of your experience at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, please contact us at:

Ayurvedic Training Program

Kairali's Ayurvedic wellness retreat offers a comprehensive Ayurvedic Training Program for health and wellness enthusiasts. With over 10,000 programs conducted, we cater to diverse individuals, including spa and wellness experts, homemakers, industry professionals, therapists, doctors, dieticians, managers, students, and Ayurveda enthusiasts.

TRAINING PROGRAMME →
Ayurvedic Workshop

Discover the transformative power of Ayurveda workshop at the healing village. Immerse yourself in ancient wisdom as expert practitioners guide you through the importance of personalized consultations, herbal remedies, rejuvenating therapies, and yoga sessions.

Yoga & Meditation Training Program

Enhance your well-being with authentic Yoga and meditation practices led by expert teachers. Join our training programs for a holistic Ayurvedic journey or indulge in intensive retreats for seasoned practitioners.

YOGA & MEDITATION TRAINING →
Yoga Teacher Training

The Yoga Teacher Training is an immersive course offering comprehensive knowledge of Vedic philosophy and yoga practices. It covers postures, breathing, relaxation, meditation, and diet. Completion leads to certification as an International Yoga Teacher.

Palakkad, Kerala — on India's south-west coast

Kerala lies along the Arabian Sea at the southern tip of India, and Palakkad sits inland at the pass through the Western Ghats. The hospital stands on 65 acres of farm and forest an hour from the nearest city.

Things to do in Kerala

Kerala, a paradise of golden beaches, tranquil backwaters, verdant hills, and a thriving culture, is tucked away on the southern coast of India and lapped by the Arabian Sea. From its captivating backwaters and lagoons to its rich history and customs, Kerala, sometimes referred to as “God’s own Country” exudes unspoiled natural beauty. Kerala, a genuine representative of Indian tourism, provides a fantastic vacation experience that combines charm, culture, and nature.

Many locations throughout the world boast beautiful scenery and expansive vistas. Many of these locations are just over-marketed tourist destinations that have benefited from the powerful wave of globalization and are using it to further their allure. Nonetheless, some locations are gifts from God to humanity. These locations are so beautiful, charming, and full of memorable moments that they seem like they belong in a fairy tale.

Kerala is home to stunning forests and glistening water features. Among the many things this state has to offer is a houseboat tour that offers tranquility or a drive through the expansive canopy of Pala trees that will excite your spirit. It’s no surprise that Kerala has the fastest pace of tourist growth. It is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Things to do in Kerala:

Wildlife Drive: An incredible journey through Kerala’s verdant woods and wildlife reserves may be had with a wildlife driving tour. Visit places like Parambikulam, Wayanad, and Periyar, which are home to tigers, leopards, elephants, and other bird species. Experience the captivating beauty of Kerala’s wildlife and plants while blending adventure with the tranquility of nature.

Elephant Safari: Kerala’s lush woods and sceneries may be experienced in a unique way with an elephant safari. You may get up close and personal with nature and wildlife by riding magnificent elephants along beautiful paths. This incredible experience, which combines adventure, culture, and Kerala’s natural beauty, is well-liked in Thekkady and Wayanad.

Houseboat tour:  A Kerala houseboat cruise offers a tranquil getaway along the stunning backwaters of Alleppey and Kumarakom. Cruise along peaceful canals with beautiful villages, coconut trees, and green vegetation all around. Immerse yourself in the delicious cuisine, the laid-back pace of life by the sea, and traditional Kerala hospitality for an incredible journey.

Mountain jeep safari: In Kerala, a mountain jeep safari is an exhilarating journey through lush plantations, misty hills, and steep terrain. Explore charming locations like Munnar and Wayanad, where winding paths lead to breathtaking vistas, undiscovered waterfalls, and opportunities to interact with wildlife. It’s a thrilling way to experience the wildlife, beauty, and mountains of Kerala.

Cultural events: Kerala’s cultural festivals showcase the state’s diverse customs and rich history. These festivities honor Kerala’s art, music, and spirituality, from the grand celebrations of Onam and Thrissur Pooram to the captivating performances of Kathakali, Theyyam, and Mohiniyattam. Discover the cultural essence of the state by taking in its colorful festivals and customs.

Things to do in healing village

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, which is tucked away in the tranquil surroundings of Palakkad, Kerala, is a sanctuary for comprehensive relaxation and rejuvenation in addition to health therapies. The village allows you to try a variety of experiences and activities that will make your stay more enjoyable, even though Ayurveda is the core offering.

Kairali, which is surrounded by peaceful scenery and lush gardens, provides guided yoga and meditation programs that let you balance your body, mind, and soul. Take part in participatory workshops on Ayurvedic living concepts, traditional performances, or cookery demonstrations to fully immerse yourself in Kerala’s rich cultural legacy. The Healing Village is the perfect place for nature lovers to take strolls, observe birds, or just take in the tranquil beauty of its natural surroundings.

The village offers outdoor activities that encourage movement and vitality, as well as a gym and swimming pool for fitness lovers. Discover the neighboring countryside with carefully planned village trips that provide an insight into Keralan customs, including stops at temples, paddy fields, and local craftspeople.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village guarantees a remarkable experience that goes well with its genuine wellness programs, whether you’re looking for peace, cultural enrichment, or a connection with nature.

Nature Walk: Taking a nature walk at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers a peaceful experience amidst verdant surroundings. Reconnect with nature as you stroll through aromatic herbal plantations, organic gardens, and serene surroundings. The village’s comprehensive wellness philosophy is complemented by this restorative experience that calms the senses.

Village Facilities: Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village provides top-notch amenities for relaxation and overall health. Traditional Ayurvedic treatment facilities, yoga and meditation areas, an organic restaurant, a fitness facility, a swimming pool, and exquisitely decorated eco-friendly villas are all available to visitors. A revitalizing and enriching experience is guaranteed by the tranquil surroundings.

Cooking Classes: The cooking lessons offer a special chance to master the art of making nutritious, traditional Ayurvedic meals. Under the direction of skilled chefs, participants investigate how to combine culinary techniques with holistic nutrition to produce well-balanced meals that support health and vitality using fresh, organic foods and spices.

Organic Farm: The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s organic farm is a bustling area where sustainable farming methods are used to grow fresh, chemical-free produce. In addition to enjoying the abundance of seasonal fruits, vegetables, and herbs utilized in the village’s healthful Ayurvedic meals, visitors can tour the farm and learn about traditional farming methods.

Herbal Garden: The Ayurvedic Healing Village’s herbal garden is a verdant haven of therapeutic plants and herbs that are utilized in conventional Ayurvedic therapies. The essence of Ayurveda in its purest form can be experienced by visitors as they stroll about this tranquil area and discover the therapeutic benefits of different herbs.

Meditation: Kairali provides a calm setting for meditation that promotes inner peace and mental clarity. The village’s holistic approach to wellness is well complemented by guided sessions in a peaceful setting that helps visitors connect with their inner selves, lower stress levels, and improve general well-being.

Yoga Classes ( Theory): Kairali offers yoga theory lessons that shed light on the tenets and philosophy of yoga. These classes explore yoga’s ancient origins, going over ideas like asanas, pranayama, and meditation, giving participants a better grasp of how yoga contributes to overall harmony and wellness.

Yoga Classes (Practical): At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, practical yoga lessons emphasize facilitated sessions that combine meditation, pranayama (breathing methods), and asanas (postures). These programs, taught by knowledgeable teachers, promote mindfulness, strength, and flexibility while fostering a peaceful, balanced body-mind relationship.

AYURVEDA TRAINING COURSE · TAP-HV · 3 DAYS
Three-Day Ayurveda Certificate Program

Three days at the hospital, each with an hour of theory, an hour of practical learning and a personal therapy session — Abhyangam, Shirodhara and Podikizhi — so every therapy is studied and then experienced. A certificate of completion is awarded on the third day.

Plan your Ayurveda training

Tell us about your background and the course you are considering. We can discuss the training options with you.

ENQUIRE ABOUT AYURVEDA TRAINING
PROCESS
FEATURES
COURSES
FAQS
RELATED
THE PROGRAMME
Process Involved In the Three-Day Certificate Program

Each day pairs a theory hour with a practical hour and closes with the therapy the day has covered, given to the participant by the hospital's therapists.

01

Day 1 — Foundations: what Ayurveda is, its origin and history, its branches and its relevance today; theory and a full Abhyangam experience, including procedure, contraindications and the do's and don'ts.

02

Day 2 — Therapies and concepts: Panchamahabhuta, Tridosha, Saptadhatu, Trimala and Agni; how Ayurveda defines health and disease; theory and a personal Shirodhara session — procedure, benefits, types and contraindications.

03

Day 3 — Practice: Prakriti and Ojas; classical and proprietary Ayurvedic medicines with a Kairali products demonstration; theory and a practical Podikizhi session, including how the herbal bolus is prepared.

04

Certificate: an official certificate of completion at the end of the third day.

Features of the program
◆
Format: nine hours of instruction over three days — one hour of theory and one hour of practical daily — plus a therapy session each day.
◆
Who it suits: wellness-industry professionals, salon managers and owners, IT professionals and diplomats, small travelling groups, and mind-body enthusiasts.
◆
Faculty: Ayurvedic doctors and senior trainers.
◆
Stay: three nights in the hospital's villas, charged per night under the training tariff — Deluxe Villa ₹18,410 single / ₹30,530 double ($263 / $436; €230 / €382).
Learning outcomes
◆
Principles: describe the Tridosha and Panchamahabhuta concepts and how Ayurveda defines health.
◆
Three therapies: know the procedure, benefits and contraindications of Abhyangam, Shirodhara and Podikizhi.
◆
Medicines: distinguish classical from proprietary Ayurvedic medicines.
◆
Application: apply Ayurvedic principles in a personal routine and, for professionals, in conversations with clients.

Training Programs

–

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, nestled in Kerala’s tranquil surroundings, provides immersive training programs for individuals wanting to delve into the depths of Ayurveda. Kairali, one of the Best Ayurvedic Retreat in Kerala, offers guests a one-of-a-kind opportunity to explore the philosophy, techniques, and lifestyle practices based on this ancient science.

Our Ayurveda Training Programs provide a thorough and realistic experience for anyone looking for structured study in a tranquil and restorative setting. Whether you are a wellness enthusiast, a professional trying to broaden your knowledge, or simply interested in holistic well-being, our carefully designed courses provide useful insights into Ayurveda and its applications.

Discover Ayurveda in a Tranquil Setting

Set against a backdrop of beautiful greenery, flowing water streams, and clean air, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is the ideal setting for self-discovery and learning. Our workshops are held in a calm and friendly environment, allowing participants to expand their knowledge of Ayurveda while bonding with nature.  Each program is designed to provide both academic knowledge and practical experience, making learning a rewarding and transformational experience.

Training Programs Tailored for Global Learners

Our courses cater to individuals from all backgrounds and levels of familiarity with Ayurveda. The structured curriculum ensures that each participant receives a well-rounded introduction to core concepts and traditional practices.

1. Ayurveda Lifestyle & Wellness Training

This program introduces participants to the foundations of Ayurveda, emphasizing daily wellness practices, personalized routines, and balanced living. Through guided sessions, participants gain an understanding of how natural elements influence overall well-being and learn practical applications for integrating these principles into daily life.

2. Ayurvedic Nutrition & Culinary Training

Food plays a vital role in achieving balance. This training focuses on traditional Ayurvedic dietary principles, exploring how different foods interact with the body and mind. Participants will learn to prepare balanced meals using natural ingredients while understanding the connection between nutrition and overall vitality.

3. Yoga & Ayurveda Training

Designed for those looking to explore the synergy between yoga and Ayurveda, this program offers an in-depth understanding of movement, breathwork, and mindfulness techniques that align with Ayurvedic principles. Sessions include personalized guidance on yoga postures, breathing exercises, and relaxation methods to promote balance.

4. Ayurvedic Beauty & Wellness Training

This program highlights time-honored beauty practices using natural herbs and techniques that support skin and hair care. Participants will explore self-care routines based on Ayurvedic principles, focusing on radiant skin, healthy hair, and overall rejuvenation.

Why Choose Kairali for Your Ayurveda Training?
Authentic Learning – Led by seasoned practitioners with extensive knowledge.
Immersive Experience – Learn Ayurveda in a serene setting suited for rejuvenation.
Holistic Approach – Programs emphasize practical applications for daily well-being.
Global Community – Meet people who share your interests from all over the world.
Serene Surroundings – A leading health retreat in Kerala that provides a nature-infused experience.
Begin Your Ayurvedic Journey at Kairali

Our training programs provide an authentic experience at one of the Best Ayurvedic retreat in Kerala, making them the ideal entry point into the world of Ayurveda. Whether you want to improve your practice or broaden your professional knowledge, Kairali offers a unique environment for learning, self-care, and transformation.

Join us at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village for a voyage of holistic learning!

About Joint Rehabilitation & Arthritis Treatment

If you’re experiencing joint pain, fever, fatigue, and loss of appetite, it could be Arthritis (Osteoarthritis or Rheumatoid Arthritis), often worsened by aging and imbalanced vata dosha. Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers tailored 14/21/28-day programs with therapies like Abhyangam, Podikizhi, and dietary recommendations. They focus on body cleansing, immune system strengthening, and personalized treatments using herbal oils. Yoga, meditation, and Kerala’s environment aid recovery. For Rheumatoid Arthritis, a body cleansing plan is employed along with therapies like Elakizhi, Pizhichil, and more.

The treatment is customized as per doctor’s consultation, body type and medical history.

Our Approach Joint Rehabilitation & Arthritis Treatment

With over 118 years of experience treating 30,000+ patients at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, our team understands the challenges of arthritis and spondylitis. Ayurveda offers personalized solutions, addressing imbalances in the body’s doshas. Seeking a permanent solution for bronchial issues? Look no further! Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers a 7 to 21-day treatment package to eliminate bronchial diseases. OUR APPROACH
Our Approach to Treatment for Breath Enhancement & Respiratory Health Therapy

With over 115 years of expertise, we’ve aided 30,000+ patients with Ayurvedic principles to treat bronchial conditions. Ayurveda, rooted in holistic healing, recognizes bronchial ailments as respiratory system imbalances from impaired digestion, toxin buildup, and weakened immunity. Our approach identifies the root cause and combines Ayurvedic therapies and herbal medications. Treatment involves personalized dietary advice, breathing exercises, herbal steam inhalation, and specialized massages for respiratory passage opening and detoxification. Ayurvedic remedies, comprising natural herbs, enhance lung function, reduce inflammation, and boost immunity. Our holistic method addresses underlying imbalances, strengthening the respiratory system, and enhancing overall well-being. Beyond symptom relief, Ayurveda promotes a healthy lifestyle and body-mind harmony to prevent future occurrences. Rely on our extensive experience and successful outcomes. We provide personalized care, considering your unique constitution and needs, ensuring lasting relief and optimal respiratory health.

Process Involved in Treatment for Breath Enhancement & Respiratory Health Therapy

The usual process for Ayurvedic treatment of bronchial conditions involves the following steps:

01

Consultation: A thorough consultation with the Ayurvedic doctor at the retreat. The doctor will assess your medical history, current symptoms, and overall health to understand the root cause of the bronchial condition.

02

Prakriti Assessment: The Ayurvedic doctor will determine your unique body constitution (Prakriti) to personalize the treatment plan. This assessment helps in identifying the underlying imbalances causing the bronchial condition.

03

Diagnosis: The doctor will diagnose the specific type of bronchial condition you have, such as asthma, bronchitis, or respiratory allergies. This helps in designing a targeted treatment approach.

04

Treatment Plan: Based on the consultation and diagnosis, the Ayurvedic doctor will create a comprehensive treatment plan tailored to your individual needs. The plan may include herbal medications, dietary recommendations, lifestyle modifications, and specific Ayurvedic therapies.

05

Ayurvedic Therapies: You may undergo various Ayurvedic therapies to support respiratory health. These therapies may include herbal steam inhalation, specialized massages, nasal irrigation, and breathing exercises to open up the respiratory passages and promote detoxification.

06

Herbal Medications: The doctor will prescribe specific herbal formulations and natural remedies to address the root cause of the bronchial condition, reduce inflammation, strengthen the immune system, and improve lung function.

07

Follow-up & Lifestyle Recommendations: Regular follow-up visits will be scheduled to monitor your progress and make any necessary adjustments to the treatment plan. The Ayurvedic doctor may provide guidance on lifestyle modifications, including dietary changes, exercise routines, stress management techniques, and sleep hygiene to support respiratory health.

08

Long-Term Maintenance: Once the symptoms subside, the focus shifts to long-term maintenance and prevention. The doctor will provide strategies to sustain the improvements achieved and minimize the risk of future bronchial episodes.

09

Holistic Approach: Throughout the treatment process, the emphasis will be on addressing the underlying imbalances in the body and promoting overall well-being, as Ayurveda considers the mind-body connection in treating bronchial conditions.

Cervical spondylosis, a degenerative condition affecting the neck, can lead to chronic pain, stiffness, and reduced mobility. At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, we offer a Ayurvedic treatment for neck and back pain to treating this condition. Our expert Ayurvedic doctors design customized treatment plans that combine therapies like Greeva vasti (neck therapy) and rejuvenating massages like Abhyangam to alleviate pain and restore mobility.

Treatment for Chronic Back Pain Relief

Chronic back pain, often caused by factors like poor posture, inactivity, and muscle weakness, can be excruciating. Symptoms include sharp pain, stiffness, leg discomfort, and numbness. Ageing, obesity, smoking, and conditions like arthritis or spondylitis contribute to this issue.

Ayurveda attributes chronic back pain to imbalanced Vata and weakened bones/muscles. Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers 14/21/28-day packages targeting dosha equilibrium. Treatment includes Ayurvedic medicines, herbal massages (Abhyangam, Vasti, Elakizhi, Kativasti), meditation, and Yoga to rejuvenate tissues, fortify bones, and relieve pain.

Our Holistic back pain relief therapy starts with an assessment for a tailored plan. Ayurvedic therapies like Abhyangam, Pizhichil, Kati Basti, and Nasya focus on pain relief, inflammation reduction, and dosha rebalancing. Herbal remedies reduce inflammation, nourish tissues, and strengthen the spine. Lifestyle and diet changes, including gentle exercises and stress reduction, maintain dosha balance and prevent pain recurrence. Ayurveda offers a holistic, natural, non-invasive approach that alleviates symptoms and prevents future issues, enhancing overall well-being, reducing stress, and improving your quality of life. Process Involved in Treatment for Chronic Back Pain Relief

The process followed for Ayurvedic treatment of chronic back pain relief involves a comprehensive approach that includes the following steps:

01

Consultation and Assessment: Receive an initial consultation with an experienced Ayurvedic doctor to delve into your medical history, lifestyle, and the root causes of your back pain. Additionally, undergo a comprehensive assessment of your body constitution (dosha), imbalances, and specific factors contributing to your pain.

02

Customized Treatment Plan: Following the assessment, the Ayurvedic doctor crafts a personalized treatment plan designed to meet your specific needs. This comprehensive plan encompasses a blend of therapies, medications, lifestyle adjustments, and dietary recommendations for your holistic well-being.

03

Ayurvedic Therapies: Skilled therapists, guided by Ayurvedic doctors, administer therapies such as Abhyanga (oil massage), Pizhichil (warm oil treatment), Kati Basti (herbal oil pooling), and Nasya (nasal herbal oil application) for chronic back pain. These therapies alleviate pain, inflammation, and muscle tension, improve circulation, and support healing.

04

Natural Medications: Ayurvedic doctors prescribe herbal formulations and natural medications to target the root causes of back pain, selected for their ability to reduce inflammation, nourish tissues, strengthen the spine, and alleviate pain. These herbal remedies, derived from potent herbs and minerals, are chosen for their safety and effectiveness.

05

Lifestyle and Diet Modifications: Ayurveda highlights lifestyle and dietary management for chronic back pain. The Ayurvedic doctor offers personalized guidance on adopting a healthful routine, incorporating gentle exercises, stress reduction techniques, and a balanced diet. These changes aim to maintain dosha equilibrium, enhance posture, and prevent pain recurrence.

06

Follow-up and Monitoring: Regular follow-up sessions with the Ayurvedic doctor assess progress, allowing adjustments to the treatment plan and addressing concerns as needed. These sessions also monitor the effectiveness of therapies, medications, and lifestyle changes to ensure optimal results in managing chronic back pain.

Treatment for Chronic Back Pain Relief

Chronic back pain, often caused by factors like poor posture, inactivity, and muscle weakness, can be excruciating. Symptoms include sharp pain, stiffness, leg discomfort, and numbness. Ageing, obesity, smoking, and conditions like arthritis or spondylitis contribute to this issue.

Ayurveda attributes chronic back pain to imbalanced Vata and weakened bones/muscles. Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers 14/21/28-day packages targeting dosha equilibrium. Treatment includes Ayurvedic medicines, herbal massages (Abhyangam, Vasti, Elakizhi, Kativasti), meditation, and Yoga to rejuvenate tissues, fortify bones, and relieve pain.

Process Involved in Treatment for Chronic Back Pain Relief

The process followed for Ayurvedic treatment of chronic back pain relief involves a comprehensive approach that includes the following steps:

01

Consultation and Assessment: Receive an initial consultation with an experienced Ayurvedic doctor to delve into your medical history, lifestyle, and the root causes of your back pain. Additionally, undergo a comprehensive assessment of your body constitution (dosha), imbalances, and specific factors contributing to your pain.

02

Customized Treatment Plan: Following the assessment, the Ayurvedic doctor crafts a personalized treatment plan designed to meet your specific needs. This comprehensive plan encompasses a blend of therapies, medications, lifestyle adjustments, and dietary recommendations for your holistic well-being.

03

Ayurvedic Therapies: Skilled therapists, guided by Ayurvedic doctors, administer therapies such as Abhyanga (oil massage), Pizhichil (warm oil treatment), Kati Basti (herbal oil pooling), and Nasya (nasal herbal oil application) for chronic back pain. These therapies alleviate pain, inflammation, and muscle tension, improve circulation, and support healing.

04

Natural Medications: Ayurvedic doctors prescribe herbal formulations and natural medications to target the root causes of back pain, selected for their ability to reduce inflammation, nourish tissues, strengthen the spine, and alleviate pain. These herbal remedies, derived from potent herbs and minerals, are chosen for their safety and effectiveness.

05

Lifestyle and Diet Modifications: Ayurveda highlights lifestyle and dietary management for chronic back pain. The Ayurvedic doctor offers personalized guidance on adopting a healthful routine, incorporating gentle exercises, stress reduction techniques, and a balanced diet. These changes aim to maintain dosha equilibrium, enhance posture, and prevent pain recurrence.

06

Follow-up and Monitoring: Regular follow-up sessions with the Ayurvedic doctor assess progress, allowing adjustments to the treatment plan and addressing concerns as needed. These sessions also monitor the effectiveness of therapies, medications, and lifestyle changes to ensure optimal results in managing chronic back pain.

About Diabetes & Metabolic Balance Therapy

Diabetes is a lifestyle disease that often goes unnoticed. Left unmanaged, it can affect the heart, nervous system, kidneys, eyes, hearing, and skin. Early signs include increased thirst, frequent urination, hunger, weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, and infections.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers Ayurvedic detox for Diabetes. It uses Ayurvedic medication, purification treatments, and massages like Thakaradhara, Pizhichil, and Abhyangam. With personalized care from Ayurvedic doctors, it helps you control diabetes and embrace a healthy lifestyle. This 14/21/28-day program also includes Yoga, fitness classes, Ayurvedic cooking workshops, and personalized diet plans for continued health at home.

Approach of Diabetes Treatment

With over a century of experience, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has successfully treated over 10,000 diabetic patients using a holistic approach. Instead of merely symptom management, we target the root causes of diabetes. In Ayurveda, diabetes is seen as an imbalance in doshas and impaired digestion. Our Ayurvedic treatment for Diabetes involves personalized herbal medications, dietary adjustments, and lifestyle changes. We choose herbs like bitter melon, fenugreek, and Indian gooseberry for their anti-diabetic properties, aiding blood sugar regulation and organ protection. Our goal is to empower clients with a deeper understanding of diabetes management through Ayurveda. By addressing root causes and promoting overall well-being, we offer a holistic approach to enhancing quality of life.

Process Involved in Diabetes & Metabolic Balance Therapy

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, diabetes therapy takes a comprehensive approach to the disorder. The treatment procedure consists of the following steps:

01

Consultation and Assessment: Upon arrival, you will have a thorough consultation with our experienced Ayurvedic doctor. Your medical history, current symptoms, and lifestyle factors will be evaluated to create a personalized treatment plan.

02

Panchakarma Detoxification: Panchakarma, a series of detoxification therapies, forms an integral part of the treatment. It involves procedures like Virechana (therapeutic purgation) and Basti (medicated enema) to eliminate toxins, improve digestion, and restore balance.

03

Herbal Medications: Customized herbal medications are prescribed to regulate blood sugar levels, enhance pancreatic function, and support overall health. These natural formulations are prepared from Ayurvedic herbs known for their anti-diabetic properties.

04

Therapeutic Treatment: A range of Ayurvedic therapies is administered to address specific imbalances and promote healing. These may include Abhyangam (herbal oil massage), Shirodhara (oil pouring on the forehead), and Udwarthanam (herbal powder massage).

05

Diet and Lifestyle Modifications: Our expert nutritionists provide personalized dietary recommendations to manage diabetes effectively. You will be guided towards a balanced diet, incorporating specific foods and spices known to regulate blood sugar levels. Lifestyle modifications, such as exercise and stress management techniques, are also advised.

06

Yoga and Meditation: Yoga asanas, pranayama (breathing exercises), and meditation sessions are integrated into the treatment plan. These practices help reduce stress, improve insulin sensitivity, and promote overall well-being.

07

Follow-up and Maintenance: After completing the intensive treatment, you will receive guidance on maintaining a healthy lifestyle and managing diabetes in the long term. Regular follow-up consultations and support are provided to track progress and make any necessary adjustments to the treatment plan.

Why Diabetes & Metabolic Balance Therapy
◆
Blood Sugar Control: Ayurvedic methods maintain stable blood sugar, reducing dangerous fluctuations.
◆
Symptom Relief: Ayurveda alleviates common diabetes symptoms like thirst and fatigue.
◆
Enhanced Insulin Sensitivity: Improve insulin effectiveness for better glucose utilization.
◆
Hormonal Balance: Target underlying hormonal issues to restore equilibrium.

About Diabetes & Metabolic Balance Therapy

Diabetes is a lifestyle disease that often goes unnoticed. Left unmanaged, it can affect the heart, nervous system, kidneys, eyes, hearing, and skin. Early signs include increased thirst, frequent urination, hunger, weight loss, fatigue, irritability, blurred vision, and infections.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers Ayurvedic detox for Diabetes. It uses Ayurvedic medication, purification treatments, and massages like Thakaradhara, Pizhichil, and Abhyangam. With personalized care from Ayurvedic doctors, it helps you control diabetes and embrace a healthy lifestyle. This 14/21/28-day program also includes Yoga, fitness classes, Ayurvedic cooking workshops, and personalized diet plans for continued health at home.

With over a century of experience, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village has successfully treated over 10,000 diabetic patients using a holistic approach. Instead of merely symptom management, we target the root causes of diabetes. In Ayurveda, diabetes is seen as an imbalance in doshas and impaired digestion. Our Ayurvedic treatment for Diabetes involves personalized herbal medications, dietary adjustments, and lifestyle changes. We choose herbs like bitter melon, fenugreek, and Indian gooseberry for their anti-diabetic properties, aiding blood sugar regulation and organ protection. Our goal is to empower clients with a deeper understanding of diabetes management through Ayurveda. By addressing root causes and promoting overall well-being, we offer a holistic approach to enhancing quality of life.

Process Involved in Diabetes & Metabolic Balance Therapy

At Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, diabetes therapy takes a comprehensive approach to the disorder. The treatment procedure consists of the following steps:

01

Consultation and Assessment: Upon arrival, you will have a thorough consultation with our experienced Ayurvedic doctor. Your medical history, current symptoms, and lifestyle factors will be evaluated to create a personalized treatment plan.

02

Panchakarma Detoxification: Panchakarma, a series of detoxification therapies, forms an integral part of the treatment. It involves procedures like Virechana (therapeutic purgation) and Basti (medicated enema) to eliminate toxins, improve digestion, and restore balance.

03

Herbal Medications: Customized herbal medications are prescribed to regulate blood sugar levels, enhance pancreatic function, and support overall health. These natural formulations are prepared from Ayurvedic herbs known for their anti-diabetic properties.

04

Therapeutic Treatment: A range of Ayurvedic therapies is administered to address specific imbalances and promote healing. These may include Abhyangam (herbal oil massage), Shirodhara (oil pouring on the forehead), and Udwarthanam (herbal powder massage).

05

Diet and Lifestyle Modifications: Our expert nutritionists provide personalized dietary recommendations to manage diabetes effectively. You will be guided towards a balanced diet, incorporating specific foods and spices known to regulate blood sugar levels. Lifestyle modifications, such as exercise and stress management techniques, are also advised.

06

Yoga and Meditation: Yoga asanas, pranayama (breathing exercises), and meditation sessions are integrated into the treatment plan. These practices help reduce stress, improve insulin sensitivity, and promote overall well-being.

07

Follow-up and Maintenance: After completing the intensive treatment, you will receive guidance on maintaining a healthy lifestyle and managing diabetes in the long term. Regular follow-up consultations and support are provided to track progress and make any necessary adjustments to the treatment plan.

Facial Paralysis, often caused by factors like nerve occlusion, infection, or injury, results in loss of facial function. This condition leads to various symptoms such as weakness, numbness, pain, and speech difficulties.

Ayurvedic treatment for facial paralysis offered at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, aims to restore balance and treat aggravated Vata. Herbal medications are used to reduce facial swelling and pain, while blood purification and brain function enhancement are addressed with special tablets, choornam, and ghee preparations.

About Facial Paralysis & Nerve Rehabilitation Therapy

Facial Paralysis, often caused by factors like nerve occlusion, infection, or injury, results in loss of facial function. This condition leads to various symptoms such as weakness, numbness, pain, and speech difficulties.

Ayurvedic treatment for facial paralysis offered at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, aims to restore balance and treat aggravated Vata. Herbal medications are used to reduce facial swelling and pain, while blood purification and brain function enhancement are addressed with special tablets, choornam, and ghee preparations.

Ayurvedic approach to treating facial paralysis naturally lasts 14/21/28 days and includes therapies like Thalam, Nasyam, Shirodhara, Pichu, Sirovasti, Podikizhi, and Ksheeradhoomam. Additional rehabilitation therapies will be tailored based on individual consultations. Yoga and meditation sessions are incorporated to aid recovery.

Medicinal herbs such as Ashwagandha, Brahmi, and Bala, along with Rasayanas, strengthen the nervous system. We also emphasize lifestyle and diet modifications to promote overall health and recovery. Ayurveda’s ancient wisdom, combined with our expertise, offers a reliable and effective path to recovery from facial paralysis. Process Involved In Treatment of Facial Paralysis & Nerve Rehabilitation Therapy

The process followed for treating Nerve rehabilitation through Ayurveda through Ayurveda involves the following steps:

01

Initial Consultation: Our experienced Ayurvedic doctor conducts a detailed consultation to understand the patient’s medical history, symptoms, and lifestyle factors. This helps in determining the underlying cause of facial paralysis and tailoring a personalized treatment plan.

02

Diagnosis and Evaluation: Through careful examination, including pulse diagnosis (Nadi Pariksha) and assessment of dosha imbalances, the Ayurvedic doctor determines the specific dosha imbalance causing facial paralysis and identifies the affected tissues and channels.

03

Individualized Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, a customized treatment plan is formulated, taking into account the patient’s constitution, severity of symptoms, and overall health. The plan may include herbal medicines, therapies, dietary recommendations, lifestyle modifications, and specific exercises.

04

Ayurvedic Therapies: Various Ayurvedic therapies are employed to address the root cause and promote healing. These may include Abhyangam (herbal oil massage), Shirodhara (oil pouring on the forehead), Nasyam (nasal administration of herbal oils), and localized therapies targeting the affected area.

05

Medicinal Herbs and Formulations: Specific Ayurvedic herbs and formulations known for their neuroprotective, anti-inflammatory, and rejuvenating properties are prescribed to support nerve regeneration, reduce inflammation, and strengthen the muscles.

06

Lifestyle and Dietary Recommendations: Patients are guided on adopting a balanced daily routine, incorporating stress management techniques, and following a diet that promotes healing and balances the doshas. This helps in optimizing the treatment outcomes and preventing future imbalances.

07

Regular Follow-ups: Regular follow-up consultations with the Ayurvedic doctor are scheduled to monitor progress, make necessary adjustments to the treatment plan, and provide ongoing support and guidance.

08

Holistic Approach: Ayurveda considers the mind-body connection, so treatments may also involve practices like meditation, breathing exercises (pranayama), and yoga to promote overall well-being and enhance the healing process.

Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers an Ayurvedic treatment for blood pressure for 14/21/28 days. Experts identify root causes and provide tailored remedies. About Neurological Wellness & Function Therapy

The brain, governing our actions, organs, thoughts, and more, is of utmost importance. Disruptions in its structure, biochemistry, or electrical activity can lead to various neurological disorders. About Paralysis Recovery & Rehabilitation Therapy

Paralysis is the loss of muscle function in part or all of the body and is often accompanied by a loss of sensation. It occurs due to disruptions in the communication between the brain and muscles, typically caused by conditions affecting the nervous system. Common causes include stroke, spinal cord injuries, traumatic brain injuries, multiple sclerosis, and infections like polio.

Paralysis can be classified as partial (affecting some muscles) or complete, and it can be temporary or permanent depending on the underlying cause. It is further categorized by the affected area, such as paraplegia (lower body) or quadriplegia (all four limbs).

Early diagnosis, rehabilitation, physiotherapy, and advanced treatments can significantly improve quality of life.

About Sinus & Migraine Relief Treatment

Sinusitis and Migraine are prevalent conditions today. Sinusitis involves Sinus inflammation, while migraines bring acute headaches, often with nausea and light/sound sensitivity. Neglecting them can lead to serious consequences. Signs like sneezing, runny nose, altered smell, and headaches are associated with sinusitis, while severe headaches, eye pain, and light flashes indicate migraines.

OUR APPROACH
For Sinus & Migraine Relief Treatment

With over 118 years of Ayurvedic expertise, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers sinus & migraine management naturally using this ancient holistic healing system. Ayurveda offers a comprehensive approach to addressing conditions by restoring balance to the body and mind. In Ayurveda, Sinusitis and Migraine are viewed as imbalances in the doshas, fundamental energies in our physiology. We create tailored treatment plans for individuals based on their unique constitution and imbalances. Ayurvedic therapies like Nasyam (nasal herbal oil administration) and Shirodhara (forehead herbal oil pouring) reduce inflammation and clear sinus passages. Our doctor prescribes Ayurvedic medications with potent herbs and natural ingredients to boost the immune system, enhance digestion, and pacify aggravated doshas. Lifestyle and dietary recommendations help avoid triggers, foster healthy habits, and maintain long-term relief.

Process Involved in Sinus & Migraine Relief Treatment
01

Consultation: A comprehensive consultation with the Ayurvedic doctor to assess the individual’s medical history, symptoms, and dosha imbalances. This helps in customizing the treatment plan.

02

Diagnosis: The doctor performs a thorough examination, which may include pulse diagnosis, tongue examination, and questions about lifestyle and dietary habits. This aids in identifying the underlying causes and imbalances.

03

Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, a personalized treatment plan is created. It may include a combination of Ayurvedic therapies, herbal medications, dietary modifications, and lifestyle recommendations.

04

Therapies: The individual undergoes specific Ayurvedic therapies targeting sinus and migraine, such as Nasyam (nasal administration of herbal oils), Shirodhara (pouring of herbal oil on the forehead), and gentle head massages to improve circulation and relieve congestion.

05

Dietary Guidance: The doctor provides dietary guidelines, suggesting foods that pacify the aggravated doshas and recommending the avoidance of triggering substances like certain spices, caffeine, and processed foods.

06

Lifestyle Recommendations: Individualized lifestyle modifications, such as stress management techniques, yoga, meditation, and regular exercise, are advised to support overall well-being and reduce the frequency and intensity of sinus and migraine episodes.

07

Follow-up: Regular follow-up sessions with the Ayurvedic doctor help monitor progress, make any necessary adjustments to the treatment plan, and provide ongoing support and guidance.

About Treatment for Ayurveda Skin Vitality Revival

The Ayurvedic Skin Vitality Revival Treatment at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a therapeutic skin-care program rooted in classical Ayurvedic principles. Designed to restore the natural glow, elasticity, and health of the skin, this treatment is ideal for those experiencing dryness, dullness, premature aging, pigmentation, or chronic skin conditions.

It combines detoxifying Panchakarma therapies, specialized herbal applications, and nourishing massages using traditional Ayurvedic oils. The treatment not only addresses external concerns but also focuses on balancing internal imbalances—often the root cause of skin issues—through dietary guidance, lifestyle modification, and stress management techniques. The therapy also supports Skin Vitality by enhancing circulation, improving digestion, and strengthening immunity—leading to luminous, resilient skin from the inside out.

Our skilled Ayurvedic doctors assess each patient’s constitution and create tailored treatment plans incorporating therapies and herbal medicines. Our therapies include Panchakarma detox, rejuvenating herbal oil massages, and specialized skin treatments for cleansing, nourishing, and revitalizing the skin. We also recommend dietary and lifestyle changes to support overall well-being. We prioritize natural, plant-based ingredients and prepare herbal medicines following Ayurvedic principles for purity and effectiveness. Expert Ayurvedic Care: Benefit from over 118 years of expertise with specialized Ayurvedic doctors dedicated to skin diseases. Expect precise diagnosis and personalized plans from our seasoned team.

Holistic Healing: Our Ayurvedic approach delves deep into addressing the root causes of skin diseases, aiming for long-lasting relief and overall rejuvenation. We rebalance doshas, promoting profound well-being beyond symptom management.

03

Tailored Personal Care: Recognizing your uniqueness, we customize every aspect of therapy to your specific needs, constitution, and skin condition. This personalized approach maximizes treatment effectiveness for optimal outcomes.

04

05

Natural Herbal Medications: We prioritize pure, plant-based ingredients in our herbal medicines, prepared using traditional methods for enhanced therapeutic value.

06

Comprehensive Wellness: Beyond skin disease treatment, we guide you on diet, lifestyle adjustments, and stress management for overall health support.

07

Exceptional Retreat Experience: Our retreats offer a tranquil atmosphere, enabling relaxation and focus on your healing journey. Enjoy attentive staff, luxurious amenities, and rejuvenating surroundings, enhancing your overall experience.

About Treatment for Ayurveda Skin Vitality Revival

The Ayurvedic Skin Vitality Revival Treatment at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village is a therapeutic skin-care program rooted in classical Ayurvedic principles. Designed to restore the natural glow, elasticity, and health of the skin, this treatment is ideal for those experiencing dryness, dullness, premature aging, pigmentation, or chronic skin conditions.

It combines detoxifying Panchakarma therapies, specialized herbal applications, and nourishing massages using traditional Ayurvedic oils. The treatment not only addresses external concerns but also focuses on balancing internal imbalances—often the root cause of skin issues—through dietary guidance, lifestyle modification, and stress management techniques. The therapy also supports Skin Vitality by enhancing circulation, improving digestion, and strengthening immunity—leading to luminous, resilient skin from the inside out.

About Spinal Disc & Nerve Restoration Treatment

Suffering from numbness or discomfort? Weakness or injury often leads to this issue, with factors like age, smoking, and obesity playing a role.

Discover relief at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village, where we follow Ayurveda’s holistic approach to address not just symptoms but the root causes, restoring spinal column health. Our ancient Ayurvedic treatments – Elakizhi, Vasti, and Kativasti – in 14/21/28 day programs provide stability and firmness to the affected area. Ayurveda’s non-invasive techniques and medicines offer a tangible solution to spine problems. We tailor treatments based on individual evaluations by our Ayurveda doctors.

Our unique approach, combined with Yoga and Meditation, not only heals your spine comprehensively but also rejuvenates it, reducing the chances of recurrence.

Our Approach Spinal Disc & Nerve Restoration Treatment

With over 118 years of Ayurvedic expertise, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers doctor-guided Ayurvedic programmes for spinal-disc and nerve-related concerns, tailored after individual assessment. Ayurveda, an ancient holistic system, restores balance and harmony to combat slip disc. It views slip disc as a Vata dosha imbalance affecting movement and the nervous system. Our approach combines therapies like Abhyanga (therapeutic oil massage), Pizhichil (oil bath), Kati Basti (herbal oil retention on the affected area), and Greeva Basti (neck treatment) to ease pain, reduce inflammation, and nourish spinal discs. Herbal Ayurvedic medications strengthen the spine, enhance flexibility, and promote tissue regeneration. These remedies work together to heal the slip disc, relieve pain, and prevent recurrence. Ayurveda emphasizes lifestyle changes: a balanced diet, yoga, meditation, and gentle exercises for healing and long-term well-being. Opt for Ayurveda for personalized care, natural healing, and a holistic approach addressing the root cause of slip disc. Trust Kairali’s extensive experience for effective and safe treatment.

Process Involved in Treatment for Spinal Disc & Nerve Restoration

At our wellness retreat, we follow a comprehensive process for treating slip disc, combining Ayurvedic therapies and personalized care:

01

Consultation: We begin with a detailed consultation to understand your medical history, symptoms, and lifestyle factors contributing to slip disc.

02

Diagnosis: Our experienced Ayurvedic doctor will perform a thorough examination to determine the specific imbalances and severity of the slip disc.

03

Treatment Plan: Based on the diagnosis, a personalized treatment plan is created, incorporating a range of Ayurvedic therapies and medications tailored to your needs.

04

Ayurvedic Therapies: You will undergo various therapeutic treatments such as Abhyanga (therapeutic oil massage), Pizhichil (oil bath), Kati Basti (herbal oil retention on the affected area), and Greeva Basti (neck treatment) to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and nourish the affected spinal discs.

05

Herbal Medications: Our Ayurvedic doctor will prescribe herbal formulations to strengthen the spine, improve flexibility, and promote tissue regeneration.

06

Lifestyle Modifications: We guide you in adopting a balanced diet, incorporating specific exercises, practicing yoga, and meditation to support the healing process and prevent slip disc recurrence.

07

Ongoing Support: Throughout your stay, our team will provide continuous support, monitor your progress, and make any necessary adjustments to your treatment plan.

08

Education and Guidance: We empower you with knowledge about self-care practices, postural corrections, and preventive measures to maintain a healthy spine even after leaving the retreat.

Symptoms vary, including restricted movement, persistent pain, or fatigue. To address this, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers 14, 21, or 28-day treatment packages in a peaceful environment, focusing on holistic care.

About Spine Care & Spondylitis Treatment

Spondylitis refers to inflammation in the spinal joints, causing pain and stiffness in the back, neck, or lower spine. It can result from ageing, poor posture, lifestyle issues, or degeneration, with nerve compression and an increase in Vata dosha being key contributors.

Symptoms vary, including restricted movement, persistent pain, or fatigue. To address this, Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers 14, 21, or 28-day treatment packages in a peaceful environment, focusing on holistic care.

Our expert therapists use Ayurvedic therapies like Snehan, Kati Vasti, Abhyangam, Shirodhara, and Nasyam to reduce pain, improve mobility, and provide lasting relief from Spondylitis.

History of Spine Care & Spondylitis Treatment

Ayurvedic Treatment for Spondylitis, rooted in Ayurvedic traditions, offers a holistic approach to optimal health. It emphasizes prevention and rejuvenation to enhance vitality. Preventive care involves identifying dosha imbalances and using herbal remedies, diet adjustments, yoga, meditation, and lifestyle changes to boost immunity and maintain harmony. Regenerative treatments revitalize the body, promoting detoxification through Panchakarma and using specialized herbs to nourish tissues. Ayurvedic massages like Abhyangam and Shirodhara enhance circulation, relax the mind, and stimulate healing. This holistic spine health treatment fosters balance, addresses the root causes of potential health issues, and promotes self-care for lasting wellness and vitality. Ayurveda’s time-tested wisdom guides the journey to holistic well-being.

Process Involved In Spine Care & Spondylitis Treatment

Spine Care Therapy in Ayurveda involves a comprehensive approach to optimize health and well-being. This holistic method draws from ancient Ayurvedic traditions and focuses on preventing ailments and rejuvenating the body. Here is a step-by-step guide to this transformative process:

01

Consultation and Assessment: Begin with an in-depth consultation with an Ayurvedic practitioner. They will assess your unique constitution, identify imbalances, and understand your specific health goals.

02

Personalized Treatment Plan: Based on the assessment, a personalized treatment plan is created. This plan incorporates dietary adjustments, herbal medicines, yoga, meditation, and lifestyle modifications tailored to your needs.

03

Preventive Measures: Embrace preventive measures to maintain balance and strengthen your body’s natural defences. These may include Ayurvedic dietary recommendations, daily routines (dinacharya), and seasonal practices (ritucharya).

04

Rejuvenation Therapies: Experience rejuvenation through specialized therapies. Ayurvedic massages, such as Abhyangam and Shirodhara, promote relaxation and stimulate the body’s healing capacity.

05

Follow-up and Maintenance: Regular follow-up sessions are essential to monitor progress and make necessary adjustments. The practitioner may suggest herbal supplements and lifestyle recommendations to maintain long-term well-being.

◆

◆
With its roots in ancient Ayurvedic wisdom, this holistic approach supports long-term health and empowers individuals to take control of their wellness.

Аутентичный аюрведический ретрит

Вы планируете посетить

в Керале, Индия?
Но беспокоит:
Exclusive Healing Secrets Of Kairali

СОБСТВЕННАЯ СТРАНА БОГА

Керала является жемчужиной юго-западного побережья Индийского субконтинента. Окруженная Аравийским морем на западе, возвышающимися Западными Гатами на востоке и объединенная сетью 44 взаимосвязанных рек, Керала наделена уникальным набором географических особенностей, которые сделали ее одним из самых популярных туристических направлений в Азии.

Длинная береговая линия с безмятежными пляжами, тихие участки изумрудных заводей, пышные холмы и экзотическая дикая природа — вот лишь некоторые из чудес, которые ждут вас, когда вы перейдете на другую сторону. Делится на три географических региона: Высокогорье, которое спускается от Западных Гат к Мидленду волнистых холмов и долин в непрерывную 580-километровую береговую линию с множеством живописных заводей, соединенных между собой каналами и реками. Благословленная приятным и ровным климатом в течение всего года, Керала является тропической землей, где можно расслабиться и чувствовать себя непринужденно. Муссоны (июнь-сентябрь и октябрь-ноябрь) и лето (февраль-май) — это сезоны, которые здесь особенно заметны, а зима — это лишь незначительное понижение температуры по сравнению с нормальным диапазоном 28-32°C.

Источник: Керала Туризм

В Керале больше всего вакцинированных людей, и жизнь вернулась в нормальное русло.

«Керала — один из самых безопасных штатов для путешествий в Индии. Люди дружелюбны, и это чистый штат. Я посетила Кералу в 10-й раз, это собственная страна Бога»

СОБСТВЕННАЯ СТРАНА БОГА

Керала является жемчужиной юго-западного побережья Индийского субконтинента. Окруженная Аравийским морем на западе, возвышающимися Западными Гатами на востоке и объединенная сетью 44 взаимосвязанных рек, Керала наделена уникальным набором географических особенностей, которые сделали ее одним из самых популярных туристических направлений в Азии.

Длинная береговая линия с безмятежными пляжами, тихие участки изумрудных заводей, пышные холмы и экзотическая дикая природа — вот лишь некоторые из чудес, которые ждут вас, когда вы перейдете на другую сторону. Делится на три географических региона: Высокогорье, которое спускается от Западных Гат к Мидленду волнистых холмов и долин в непрерывную 580-километровую береговую линию с множеством живописных заводей, соединенных между собой каналами и реками. Благословленная приятным и ровным климатом в течение всего года, Керала является тропической землей, где можно расслабиться и чувствовать себя непринужденно. Муссоны (июнь-сентябрь и октябрь-ноябрь) и лето (февраль-май) — это сезоны, которые здесь особенно заметны, а зима — это лишь незначительное понижение температуры по сравнению с нормальным диапазоном 28-32°C.

Кайрали аюрведическая лечебная деревня - это единственное в своем роде целостное пространство, созданное для того, чтобы исцелить вас, как внутренне, так и внешне, с помощью наших традиционных и аутентичных аюрведических методов лечения, лечения и лекарств, а также йоги и медитации.

Расположенные между предгорьями хребтов Нилгири и Аннамалай, в окружении гор, густых зеленых лесов, плодородных долин и рек, расположены наши 30 вилл премиум-класса, спланированных согласно Васту, всегда окруженных ароматом деревьев Пала, полом из красного оксида, редкой раковиной Валамбари. Раковина и нежный ручей, омывающий каждую виллу, создают восстанавливающую и целебную атмосферу.

Йога, медитация, астрология, хиромантия, питание, терапия, духовное обучение и традиционные индийские ритуалы (пуджи) являются частью рутины ретрита. аюрведическая лечебная деревня является воплощением мастерства Кайрали в концептуальном гостеприимстве - совершенно интуитивный дизайн, рожденный вневременной мудростью. Время, проведенное в этом вдохновляющем святилище джунглей, заставит вас задаться вопросом, испытываете ли вы высоту современной целостной роскоши или путешествовали далеко в далекое прошлое Индии.

Аюрведические процедуры являются древней практикой и считаются лучшей естественной формой исцеления. Зародившись около 5000 лет назад на Индийском субконтиненте, аюрведические процедуры, как мы все знаем, представляют собой естественные процессы для лечения, исцеления и улучшения психического, физического и эмоционального благополучия человека. Аюрведа — это образ жизни, который учит всех вести здоровый образ жизни и понимать различные изменения, происходящие в организме.

Аюрведа и лечение: Пути и средства, которым следует Аюрведа, полностью основаны на ведических принципах и учениях. Аюрведические процедуры помогают увеличить продолжительность жизни и указывают меру здоровой жизни. Кайрали - аюрведическая лечебная расположенная среди красивой пышной зелени в Палаккаде, штат Керала, является одним из лучших аюрведических ретритов, которые может предложить Индия, где наша команда опытных врачей и врачей мирового класса предлагает одни из лучших аюрведических процедур, которые назначают соответствующие процедуры. и меры для наших пациентов. Компоненты - Вата, Питта и Капха. Вата доша, состоящая из пространства и воздуха, управляет всеми движениями ума и тела. Он контролирует кровоток, удаление отходов, дыхание и движение мыслей в уме. Питта-доша состоит из огня и воды, которые отвечают за управление всем теплом, обменом веществ и трансформацией в уме и теле. Он контролирует то, как мы перевариваем пищу и как мы усваиваем наши сенсорные восприятия. Это позволяет нам различать правильное и неправильное. Наконец, что не менее важно, Капха, состоящая из воды и земли, управляет всей структурой и смазкой в уме и теле. Он контролирует вес, рост и смазку суставов и легких, а также формирование всех тканей тела.

Поскольку аюрведа является не только формой медицинской науки, но и образом жизни, Кайрали - аюрведическая лечебная деревня продвинула этот принцип вперед, подав пример традиционной и подлинной дисциплины. Он был воплощением хорошего здоровья и благополучия, который предоставляет лучшие условия гостеприимства и размещения. С присутствием квалифицированных и опытных врачей, терапевтов и физиотерапевтов, это убежище для здоровья является домом для всех усталых путешественников и людей, у которых есть проблемы с физическим здоровьем.

Аюрведические процедуры являются ключевым активом, за который выступает Кайрали аюрведическая лечебная деревня. Многочисленные аюрведические процедуры, начиная от массажа тела, массажа головы, массажа ног и многих других видов массажа, доступны в лечебной деревне, которая проводится в истинно аюрведической манере.

Аюрведа, как форма медицинской науки, предлагает решения почти для всех проблем, связанных со здоровьем, и рекомендует естественный образ жизни. Традиционные знания и практика вековой дисциплины дополняют любой образ жизни и находят пути и средства включения здорового режима для жизни без стресса. Нет определенной возрастной группы, для которой можно пройти аюрведическое лечение. Все, от подростков до пожилых людей, могут без опасений проходить лечение и лечение. Лучше, если люди начнут с более раннего возраста и будут заботиться о своем здоровье, чтобы впоследствии избежать ненужных и нежелательных изменений в своем образе жизни. Кайрали-аюрведическая лечебная деревня в Палаккаде предлагает самые аутентичные аюрведические процедуры, и мы видели, что люди в возрасте от 18 до 90 лет приходят на консультации по различным вопросам здоровья, и самое главное, очень приятно видеть пациентов не только для лечения своих заболеваний, но и в профилактических целях.

После суматошной уличной жизни в Индии вы словно попадаете в оазис спокойствия. Сразу после прибытия вы получаете 1 1/2 приема врача. Она посадила меня на строгую диету на 17 дней. Во время пребывания я чувствовал, что мое тело очищается, физически и умственно. Весь замечательный, дружелюбный и приятный персонал делает пребывание очень приятным. Если вы решите пройти аюрведическое лечение, я очень рекомендую это место. Это был потрясающий опыт.

Номера безупречно чистые; курорт безмятежен и спокоен; аюрведические процедуры просты и непревзойденны; но самое главное персонал невероятно услужливый! Я очень рекомендую Кайрали аюрведическую лечебную деревню, будь то лечение или просто отдых.

Последние две недели я провел в этом чудесном месте. Обслуживание было выдающимся с момента моего первого контакта с Кайрали во время моего визита. Ежедневные процедуры и консультации с врачом в аюрведической больнице были очень профессиональными, и все беспокоились о моем здоровье. Еда была очень хорошо приготовлена. Занятия йогой и медитацией были хорошей возможностью улучшить самочувствие, и я продолжу это делать. Весь персонал очень хотел сделать все возможное, чтобы мой визит был как можно лучше. Я также оценил чистые помещения. Если вы планируете отправиться в аюрведическое путешествие, я очень рекомендую Кайрали.

Мы пробыли в Кайрали месяц (январь-февраль 2018 г.), хотя хватило бы и на 3 недели. Обязательно приеду снова. Там нас ждали самые профессиональные и заботливые врачи, очень внимательные и душевные терапевты, очень вкусная и разнообразная еда без каких-либо ограничений в количестве (никогда не голодали, как можно подумать), красивая и уютная территория. А самое главное - РЕЗУЛЬТАТ! Это даже лучше, чем ожидалось. Наше тело в тонусе, кожа сияет, мы чувствуем много дополнительной энергии.

Я прекрасно провел время в Кайрали в январе. Я был там в течение недели на пакете омоложения и детоксикации. Территория абсолютно красивая, и ежедневные процедуры моих замечательных терапевтов были потрясающими. Весь персонал, особенно кухонный персонал и официанты, очень дружелюбны и полезны. Еда была также фантастической и такой здоровой. Я обязательно вернусь.

Наши цели заключаются в здоровье и счастье людей, и мы предпочитаем поддерживать то же самое. Именно так мы выдерживаем испытание временем и продолжаем оставаться лучшими в этой области.

Разработанные в соответствии с принципами Васту Шастры, древней системы архитектуры, эти виллы представлены в четырех жанрах, основанных на удобствах и комфорте, которые они обеспечивают: вилла Классика, вилла Делюкс, Королевская вилла и Махараджа сьют.

КЛАССИЧЕСКАЯ ВИЛЛА
